articles.title: 'Sexy Mantis,' obscene orangutan and prancing sparrowhawk feature in 2026 Nikon Comedy Wildlife Awards
articles.author: Patrick Pester

paras.en: Have you ever wondered what it's like to be flipped off by an orangutan or seduced by a mantis? Well, wonder no more, thanks to the 2026 Nikon Comedy Wildlife Awards.
paras.zh: 您是否想过被猩猩激怒或被螳螂引诱是什么感觉？好吧，不用再好奇了，感谢 2026 年尼康喜剧野生动物奖。

paras.en: This photography competition showcases the amusing side of nature, usually by anthropomorphizing it in some way, and features a variety of comical critters from across the globe.
paras.zh: 这项摄影比赛通常通过某种方式将其拟人化，展示自然有趣的一面，并以来自世界各地的各种滑稽小动物为特色。

paras.en: This year, a surprised owl and a brown bear striking a pose are featured among the more than 10,000 entries, with photographers competing for a luxury safari in Kenya's Maasai Mara National Reserve.
paras.zh: 今年，一只惊讶的猫头鹰和一只摆出姿势的棕熊出现在 10,000 多件参赛作品中，摄影师们竞相在肯尼亚马赛马拉国家保护区进行豪华狩猎。

paras.en: Live Science rounded up some of the funniest photos from the 2026 finalists for your enjoyment. And yes, the orangutan and mantis have made it to the finals.
paras.zh: Live Science 收集了 2026 年决赛入围者中一些最有趣的照片，供您欣赏。是的，猩猩和螳螂已经进入了决赛。

paras.en: Here we see a squirrel launching itself at a great horned owl fledgling in Natural Bridges State Beach park in Santa Cruz, California. According to photographer Kevin Lohman, the squirrel knocked the owl off its perch three times.
paras.zh: 在加利福尼亚州圣克鲁斯的自然桥州立海滩公园，我们看到一只松鼠向一只刚孵出的大角鸮发起攻击。据摄影师凯文·洛曼称，松鼠三度将猫头鹰从栖息处击落。

paras.en: Our video channels editor, Elise Poore, said this photo really made her laugh. I doubt the owl found it quite so funny. However, great horned owls (Bubo virginianus) do hunt squirrels, so it's no surprise that these rodents can get a little tetchy around the birds.
paras.zh: 我们的视频频道编辑 Elise Poore 说这张照片真的让她开怀大笑。我怀疑猫头鹰是否觉得这很有趣。然而，大角鸮（Bubo virginianus）确实会捕食松鼠，因此这些啮齿动物在鸟类面前变得有点暴躁也就不足为奇了。

paras.en: This "Spicy Orangutan" entry features a male Bornean orangutan (Pongo pygmaeus) raising one finger, giving the appearance that he's flipping off the camera. In the description accompanying the image, photographer Tanner Mansell explained that the orangutan was finishing his meal at the time.
paras.zh: 这张“辣猩猩”条目的主角是一只雄性婆罗洲猩猩 (Pongo pygmaeus) 举起一根手指，看起来就像是在从镜头前翻转过来。在图像的描述中，摄影师坦纳·曼塞尔解释说，猩猩当时正在吃完饭。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: "Even though he was completely wild and just enjoying his food, I couldn't help wondering, 'Does he know what he's doing?'" Mansell wrote.
paras.zh: “尽管他完全狂野，只是享受他的食物，我还是忍不住想，‘他知道自己在做什么吗？’”曼塞尔写道。

paras.en: This photo of a sparrowhawk (Accipiter nisus) in Dumfries, Scotland, is titled "Ballet Dancer," but to me, the balancing bird looks more like an Olympic gymnast in the middle of a complex beam routine. Either way, perfect form!
paras.zh: 这张苏格兰邓弗里斯的雀鹰（Accipiter nisus）照片的标题是“芭蕾舞者”，但对我来说，这只保持平衡的鸟看起来更像是一位正在进行复杂平衡木动作的奥林匹克体操运动员。无论哪种方式，完美的形式！

paras.en: This lion snapshot, taken in the Ruckomechi riverbed in Zimbabwe, is one of many finalists that appear to show animals laughing or joking around.
paras.zh: 这张狮子照片拍摄于津巴布韦的鲁科梅奇河床，是众多表现动物大笑或开玩笑的入围作品之一。

paras.en: Photographer Rosie Barrett was getting shots of three yearling brown bears (Ursus arctos) in Finland when one appeared to strike a pose.
paras.zh: 摄影师罗西·巴雷特 (Rosie Barrett) 在芬兰拍摄三只一岁棕熊 (Ursus arctos)，其中一只似乎正在摆姿势。

paras.en: "Pretty sure he knew it was for Instagram..un-bear-lieavable!" Barrett wrote in a description of her photo.
paras.zh: “很确定他知道这是为了 Instagram……令人难以忍受！”巴雷特在她的照片的描述中写道。

paras.en: I know what you're thinking: This mantis looks like it's saying, "Draw me like one of your French girls." However, if you can look past the sexualization of an insect, you might notice a pretty neat trick in how the photo was framed.
paras.zh: 我知道你在想什么：这只螳螂看起来像是在说：“把我画得像你的法国女孩一样。”然而，如果你能忽略昆虫的性化，你可能会注意到照片的构图方式有一个非常巧妙的技巧。

paras.en: Half of the mantis's body is hidden behind the leaf. What appears to be a torso and legs are actually the creature's forelimbs, which it uses to catch prey. Photographer Diego Perez explained that he snapped the mantis while documenting wildlife in the proposed Bosques del Araza Regional Conservation Area in Peru, which is currently threatened by illegal gold mining.
paras.zh: 螳螂的一半身体隐藏在叶子后面。看似躯干和腿的东西实际上是这种生物的前肢，它用来捕捉猎物。摄影师迭戈·佩雷斯解释说，他在秘鲁拟议的博斯克德尔阿拉萨地区保护区记录野生动物时拍到了这只螳螂，该保护区目前受到非法金矿开采的威胁。

paras.en: Here we see a herd of walruses on the coast of Svalbard in Norway. The photo is titled "Sea Gangsters," implying that the walruses look like tough guys. You'd probably feel tough, too, if your tusks (which are actually sabers) grew to around 3 feet (1 meter) long.
paras.zh: 在这里，我们在挪威斯瓦尔巴群岛海岸看到了一群海象。这张照片的标题是“海上黑帮”，暗示海象看起来像硬汉。如果您的獠牙（实际上是军刀）长到大约 3 英尺（1 米）长，您可能也会感觉很艰难。

paras.en: Ten out of 10. No notes. But, in all seriousness, red squirrels (Sciurus vulgaris) are known to grab materials like dried grass and moss to line their nests, called dreys, so maybe this little fellow is working on its home sweet home.
paras.zh: 十分之十。没有注释。但是，说实话，红松鼠（Sciurus vulgaris）会抓取干草和苔藓等材料来筑巢，称为“dreys”，所以也许这个小家伙正在为它的甜蜜家园而努力。

paras.en: Sometimes, all a photographer needs is the Maasai Mara, three young giraffes and a perfectly placed acacia tree. It's nice that the photographer caught them at a standstill, since these ungulates can run up to 35 mph (56 km/h) in short bursts.
paras.zh: 有时，摄影师所需要的只是马赛马拉、三只小长颈鹿和一棵位置完美的金合欢树。摄影师捕捉到它们静止的瞬间真是太好了，因为这些有蹄类动物可以在短时间内以 35 英里/小时（56 公里/小时）的速度奔跑。

paras.en: This is just a selection of the finalists. You can see the rest of the contenders in Nikon's 2026 finalists gallery. The winners will be announced Dec. 8.
paras.zh: 这只是决赛入围者的选择。您可以在尼康 2026 年决赛入围者图库中看到其余的竞争者。获奖者名单将于 12 月 8 日公布。

paras.en: What do you know about the animal kingdom? Test your knowledge with our animal quiz!
paras.zh: 关于动物王国，你了解多少？通过我们的动物测验测试您的知识！

paras.en: Patrick Pester is the trending news writer at Live Science. His work has appeared on other science websites, such as BBC Science Focus and Scientific American. Patrick retrained as a journalist after spending his early career working in zoos and wildlife conservation. He was awarded the Master's Excellence Scholarship to study at Cardiff University where he completed a master's degree in international journalism. He also has a second master's degree in biodiversity, evolution and conservation in action from Middlesex University London. When he isn't writing news, Patrick investigates the sale of human remains.
paras.zh: 帕特里克·佩斯特 (Patrick Pester) 是《Live Science》的热门新闻撰稿人。他的作品曾出现在其他科学网站上，例如 BBC Science Focus 和 Scientific American。帕特里克在其早期职业生涯从事动物园和野生动物保护工作后，接受了记者再培训。他获得了硕士卓越奖学金，前往卡迪夫大学学习，并在那里完成了国际新闻学硕士学位。他还拥有伦敦密德萨斯大学生物多样性、进化和保护实践的第二个硕士学位。当帕特里克不写新闻时，他会调查人类遗骸的买卖。

articles.title: 'Completely unexpected': Astronomers spy never-before-seen 'phoenix planet' rising from the ashes of a dead star
articles.author: Harry Baker

paras.en: Astronomers have spotted a never-before-seen type of "phoenix planet" rising from the ashes of a dying alien sun. The discovery, which the scientists say was "completely unexpected," raises hopes that more of these reborn alien worlds could be lurking throughout the cosmos — and may offer a glimpse of our own solar system's fate.
paras.zh: 天文学家发现了一种前所未见的“凤凰行星”，它从垂死的外星太阳的灰烬中升起。科学家们称这一发现“完全出乎意料”，它让人们燃起了希望，更多的重生外星世界可能潜伏在整个宇宙中，并可能让我们一睹太阳系的命运。

paras.en: The unnamed exoplanet was spotted circling the white dwarf HS 0209+0832, which is located roughly 270 light-years from Earth. White dwarfs are stellar remnants, sometimes dubbed "zombie stars," that form from the leftovers of massive red giants that run out of fuel before eventually collapsing into shriveled husks. HS 0209+0832 is a particularly young white dwarf, still burning at around 63,000 degrees Fahrenheit (35,000 degrees Celsius), which suggests it made this transition within the past few million years.
paras.zh: 这颗未命名的系外行星被发现围绕着白矮星 HS 0209+0832 旋转，该行星距离地球约 270 光年。白矮星是恒星的残余物，有时被称为“僵尸恒星”，是由巨大的红巨星的残余物形成的，这些红巨星耗尽了燃料，最终塌陷成干瘪的外壳。 HS 0209+0832 是一颗特别年轻的白矮星，仍然在 63,000 华氏度（35,000 摄氏度）左右燃烧，这表明它在过去的几百万年内完成了这一转变。

paras.en: Scientists previously discovered some surprising heavy elements within the visible spectrum of HS 0209+0832, which was first captured by the Hubble Space Telescope in the late 1990s. These elements — which included aluminium, titanium and nickel — are not normally found inside white dwarfs, so their presence suggested that something unusual was going on. But until now, there was not enough data to figure out what.
paras.zh: 此前，科学家们在 HS 0209+0832 的可见光谱内发现了一些令人惊讶的重元素，这些重元素是哈勃太空望远镜在 20 世纪 90 年代末首次捕获的。这些元素——包括铝、钛和镍——通常不会在白矮星内部发现，因此它们的存在表明正在发生一些不寻常的事情。但到目前为止，还没有足够的数据来弄清楚到底是什么。

paras.en: In the new study, published Oct. 5 in the journal Nature Astronomy, researchers took a closer look at HS 0209+0832. Using some of Hubble's updated instruments and data from other observatories, the team captured a more detailed spectrum of the stellar zombie. This revealed a high concentration of additional heavy elements, including zinc and copper, as well as niobium, which has never been seen in a white dwarf before.
paras.zh: 在 10 月 5 日发表在《自然天文学》杂志上的新研究中，研究人员仔细观察了 HS 0209+0832。利用哈勃的一些更新仪器和其他天文台的数据，该团队捕获了僵尸恒星的更详细的光谱。这揭示了高浓度的额外重元素，包括锌和铜，以及铌，这是以前从未在白矮星中见过的。

paras.en: The researchers think these out-of-place elements were created during the death throes of the former red giant and later coalesced into a "second-generation" planet around the newly forged white dwarf. They suspect the atmosphere of this hypothetical planet is being stripped by the white dwarf's stellar winds, causing the rare elements to fall back onto the zombie star.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，这些不合适的元素是在前红巨星垂死挣扎期间产生的，后来在新形成的白矮星周围合并成一颗“第二代”行星。他们怀疑这颗假想行星的大气层正在被白矮星的恒星风剥离，导致稀有元素落回到僵尸恒星上。

paras.en: Follow-up observations then revealed a recurring dip in the brightness of HS 0209+0832, suggesting that an exoplanet was repeatedly passing in front of the undead star. Based on the alien world's orbit, which lasts approximately 4.4 Earth days, and the duration of its transits in front of the star, the team predicted that the planet is roughly the size of Jupiter. (Its close proximity to the white dwarf also supports the hypothesis that its atmosphere is being stripped away.)
paras.zh: 后续观测发现 HS 0209+0832 的亮度反复下降，表明一颗系外行星反复经过这颗不死恒星的前面。根据外星世界持续约 4.4 个地球日的轨道，以及它在恒星前面凌日的持续时间，研究小组预测这颗行星的大小大致相当于木星。 （它与白矮星的距离很近也支持了它的大气层正在被剥离的假设。）

paras.en: "Second-generation planets are worlds that form out of the material a star casts off as it dies," study first author Jamie Williams, a doctoral candidate in astronomy and astrophysics at the University of Warwick in the U.K., said in a statement. "They're incredibly rare, and finding one around a white dwarf was completely unexpected. It's a bit like finding a planet that has risen from the ashes of the very star it once orbited."
paras.zh: 该研究的第一作者、英国华威大学天文学和天体物理学博士生杰米·威廉姆斯在一份声明中说：“第二代行星是由恒星死亡时释放的物质形成的世界。” “它们非常罕见，在白矮星周围发现一颗是完全出乎意料的。这有点像找到一颗从它曾经绕行的恒星的灰烬中升起的行星。”

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: This is not the first time astronomers have spotted an exoplanet around a white dwarf. For example, in 2019, some of the authors of the new study previously spotted an alien world surrounding the white dwarf WDJ0914+1914. However, in that case, they were confident that it was a first-generation world that somehow survived its star's fiery end.
paras.zh: 这并不是天文学家第一次在白矮星周围发现系外行星。例如，2019年，这项新研究的一些作者此前曾发现白矮星WDJ0914+1914周围有一个外星世界。然而，在这种情况下，他们确信这是一个第一代世界，以某种方式在恒星的烈火终结中幸存下来。

paras.en: But the heavy elements that seem to be falling onto HS 0209+0832 — and the relative lack of other elements common in first-generation planets, such as silicon and iron — suggest that's not what's happened for this recently detected world.
paras.zh: 但似乎落在 HS 0209+0832 上的重元素——以及第一代行星中常见的其他元素（例如硅和铁）相对缺乏——表明这并不是这个最近发现的世界所发生的情况。

paras.en: "This pattern of elements is a telltale sign of the 's-process,' a nuclear reaction that builds heavy elements inside dying stars during their bloated red giant phase," study co-author Nicholas Stone, an astronomer at the University of Wisconsin-Madison, said in the statement. "It's a chemical signature no ordinary, 'first-generation' planet should carry, which told us that this new planet was something different."
paras.zh: 研究报告的合著者、威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校的天文学家尼古拉斯·斯通在声明中表示：“这种元素模式是‘s-过程’的明显迹象，这是一种核反应，在垂死的恒星处于膨胀的红巨星阶段时，在其内部产生重元素。” “这是普通‘第一代’行星不应该携带的化学特征，它告诉我们这个新行星是不同的。”

paras.en: Instead, the newly detected exoplanet likely formed directly from the material that was shed by the dying red giant after it expanded and before it collapsed in on itself.
paras.zh: 相反，这颗新发现的系外行星很可能直接由垂死的红巨星在膨胀后和自身塌陷之前脱落的物质形成。

paras.en: Similar phoenix planets have been spotted alongside other stellar remnants, such as pulsars, which form when stars explode as supernovas. However, until now, such worlds have never been seen around a white dwarf.
paras.zh: 类似的凤凰行星与其他恒星遗迹一起被发现，例如脉冲星，它们是在恒星爆炸为超新星时形成的。然而，到目前为止，还从未在白矮星周围发现过这样的世界。

paras.en: "What's remarkable about the planet around HS 0209+0832 is that this isn't a planet from somewhere else, or a survivor from the system's birth, it looks like it was built from the very material its own star cast off as it died," study co-author Boris Gänsicke, an astrophysicist at the University of Warwick who also helped to discover the exoplanet around WDJ0914+1914 in 2019, said in the statement. "In a sense, this system has given birth to a new world using the foundations of the old one."
paras.zh: “HS 0209+0832周围行星的非凡之处在于，它不是来自其他地方的行星，也不是该系统诞生后的幸存者，它看起来像是由其恒星死亡时所抛弃的物质构成的，”该研究的合著者鲍里斯·甘西克(Boris Gänsicke)说，他是华威大学的天体物理学家，他也在2019年帮助发现了WDJ0914+1914周围的系外行星。在声明中。 “从某种意义上说，这个系统在旧世界的基础上诞生了一个新世界。”

paras.en: HS 0209+0832 may have once harbored other exoplanets when it was a red giant. But if they existed, these alien worlds likely perished in flames as the dying star ballooned — similar to what experts think will happen to Earth when the sun runs out of fuel and transitions into a red giant in around 5 billion years.
paras.zh: HS 0209+0832 在还是红巨星时可能曾经拥有其他系外行星。但如果它们存在的话，这些外星世界很可能会随着垂死恒星的膨胀而在火焰中毁灭——就像专家认为的那样，当太阳耗尽燃料并在大约 50 亿年后转变为红巨星时，地球上将会发生什么。

paras.en: Once the sun has finished bulging, it will turn into a white dwarf too. The new discovery hints that our star could also host brand-new worlds after it has transformed, creating a sort of solar system 2.0.
paras.zh: 一旦太阳完成凸出，它也会变成一颗白矮星。这一新发现暗示，我们的恒星在转变后也可能拥有全新的世界，创造出一种太阳系2.0。

paras.en: - Newly confirmed 'baby planet' is the youngest alien world scientists have ever discovered
paras.zh: - 新确认的“婴儿星球”是科学家迄今为止发现的最年轻的外星世界

paras.en: - Scientists identify 10,000 'impossible' exoplanet candidates, potentially tripling the number of known alien worlds
paras.zh: - 科学家们发现了 10,000 个“不可能”的系外行星候选者，可能使已知外星世界的数量增加两倍

paras.en: - A giant cosmic 'fart' is making a wobbling zombie star repeatedly flash us, 'groundbreaking' observations reveal
paras.zh: -“突破性”观测显示，一个巨大的宇宙“屁”正在让一颗摇晃的僵尸恒星不断向我们闪光

paras.en: "Finding this one example raises the question of how many more might be out there and might our own solar system host a second-generation planet formed from the ashes of our sun," Gänsicke said.
paras.zh: 甘西克说：“发现这个例子提出了一个问题：那里可能还有多少行星，以及我们的太阳系是否拥有一颗由太阳的灰烬形成的第二代行星。”

paras.en: However, more work is required to figure out exactly how the newfound exoplanet formed and, as a result, how likely this scenario is. The researchers suspect that another object, such as a lost stellar sibling, may have been required to create the new world.
paras.zh: 然而，还需要做更多的工作来弄清楚新发现的系外行星是如何形成的，以及这种情况的可能性有多大。研究人员怀疑可能需要另一个物体，例如失踪的恒星兄弟姐妹来创造新世界。

paras.en: "Forming the protoplanetary disc in this situation is not easy and helps explain why these planets are so rare," Williams said. "To form a disc of material necessary to birth a planet, HS 0209+0832 likely required a companion star that pulled the ejected material back into orbit, rather than letting it escape."
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯说：“在这种情况下形成原行星盘并不容易，这有助于解释为什么这些行星如此罕见。” “为了形成行星诞生所需的物质盘，HS 0209+0832 可能需要一颗伴星将喷射出的物质拉回轨道，而不是让它逃逸。”

paras.en: Williams, J. T., Gänsicke, B. T., Stone, N. C., Koester, D., Davies, B. D. R., Tong, C., Wilson, D. J., Sahu, S., Swan, A., Beatty, T. G., Ramírez, S. H., Cunningham, T., & Long, K. S. (2026). Discovery of a second-generation planet candidate accreting onto a white dwarf. Nature Astronomy. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41550-026-02983-7
paras.zh: Williams, J. T.、Gänsicke, B. T.、Stone, N. C.、Koester, D.、Davies, B. D. R.、Tong, C.、Wilson, D. J.、Sahu, S.、Swan, A.、Beatty, T. G.、Ramírez, S. H.、Cunningham, T. 和 Long, K. S. (2026)。发现一颗第二代候选行星正在白矮星上吸积。自然天文学。 https://doi.org/10.1038/s41550-026-02983-7

paras.en: Harry is a U.K.-based senior staff writer at Live Science. He studied marine biology at the University of Exeter before training to become a journalist. He covers a wide range of topics including space exploration, planetary science, space weather, climate change, animal behavior and paleontology. His recent work on the solar maximum won "best space submission" at the 2024 Aerospace Media Awards and was shortlisted in the "top scoop" category at the NCTJ Awards for Excellence in 2023. He also writes Live Science's weekly Earth from space series.
paras.zh: 哈里是《Live Science》驻英国的高级撰稿人。在接受记者培训之前，他在埃克塞特大学学习海洋生物学。他涵盖的主题广泛，包括太空探索、行星科学、太空天气、气候变化、动物行为和古生物学。他最近关于太阳活动极大期的工作赢得了 2024 年航空航天媒体奖的“最佳太空作品”，并入围了 2023 年 NCTJ 卓越奖的“顶级独家新闻”类别。他还撰写了《Live Science》的每周地球从太空系列文章。

articles.title: 'We stocked an RV as an emergency bugout vehicle': Readers share how prepared they are for a disaster
articles.author: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry

paras.en: As the "super" El Niño is predicted to bring heavier storms and flooding to the U.S., experts recommend stocking up on food and other supplies. Floods and other disasters, like wildfires, are on the rise due to climate change, making disaster preparedness essential.
paras.zh: 由于“超级”厄尔尼诺现象预计会给美国带来更严重的风暴和洪水，专家建议储备食品和其他物资。由于气候变化，洪水和野火等其他灾害不断增加，因此备灾工作至关重要。

paras.en: But how prepared are people for a disaster?
paras.zh: 但人们对灾难做好了多少准备呢？

paras.en: Preparedness levels vary; some people keep an emergency kit full of food and first-aid supplies, while others have a planned meeting place designated as a safe space. Having a plan can help people feel better about unpredictable events. But not everyone has thought this far ahead.
paras.zh: 准备程度各不相同；有些人备有装满食物和急救用品的应急包，而另一些人则将计划好的聚会地点指定为安全空间。制定计划可以帮助人们更好地应对不可预测的事件。但并不是每个人都这么长远地考虑。

paras.en: Live Science recently asked readers how prepared they are for a natural disaster and what sort of plans or supplies they have on hand. Over 130 people responded to the poll, with 51% of readers choosing "I've got an emergency kit ready for when the unexpected happens."
paras.zh: 《生活科学》最近向读者询问了他们对自然灾害的准备情况以及他们手头上有哪些计划或物资。超过 130 人参与了这项民意调查，其中 51% 的读者选择“我已经准备好了应急包，以备意外发生时使用”。

paras.en: The comments reflected this majority, as one reader wrote, "We're on the edge of an area at risk for grass fires, so we bought/stocked an RV as an emergency bugout vehicle. Felt extreme initially, less so as time goes by. Gives us 3-5 days of margin before we need to resupply, with food, water and first aid for people and dogs."
paras.zh: 这些评论反映了这一大多数，正如一位读者所写，“我们位于草丛火灾风险地区的边缘，因此我们购买/储备了一辆房车作为紧急避难车辆。一开始感觉很极端，但随着时间的推移，情况有所缓解。在我们需要重新补给之前，给了我们 3-5 天的时间，为人和狗提供食物、水和急救。”

paras.en: Another commenter responded to the rest of the comments, writing, "This is just the begining [sic]. Get a greenhouse, plant food, learn to harvest water, build an outside toilet (for later), learn to be self sufficient. trade with your neighbors. Plant fruit trees, get solar panels and an electric transporation (bike, car whatever). Keep a de humidifier in your home. it's back to the 1930ie[s]."
paras.zh: 另一位评论者回应了其余的评论，写道：“这只是开始[原文如此]。建造一个温室，种植食物，学会收集水，建造一个室外厕所（供以后使用），学会自给自足。与邻居进行贸易。种植果树，获得太阳能电池板和电动交通工具（自行车、汽车等）。在家里放一个除湿器。这又回到了 1930 年代。”

paras.en: Do you agree with these readers? Let us know in the comments section.
paras.zh: 您同意这些读者的观点吗？请在评论部分告诉我们。

paras.en: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry is the Content Manager at Live Science. Formerly, she was the Content Manager at Space.com and before that the Science Communicator at JILA, a physics research institute. Kenna is also a book author, with her upcoming book 'Octopus X' scheduled for release in spring of 2027. Her beats include physics, health, environmental science, technology, AI, animal intelligence, corvids, and cephalopods.
paras.zh: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry 是 Live Science 的内容经理。此前，她曾担任 Space.com 的内容经理，此前曾担任物理研究所 JILA 的科学传播员。肯纳还是一名书籍作者，她即将出版的新书《章鱼 X》计划于 2027 年春季发行。她的研究领域包括物理、健康、环境科学、技术、人工智能、动物智能、鸦科动物和头足类动物。

articles.title: A Ship Carrying Stacks of Ancient Dishware Sank Off the Coast of Turkey 2,100 Years Ago. Its Ceramic Cargo Is Still Remarkably Intact

paras.en: More than 2,000 years ago, a ship full of fine tableware sank to the bottom of the Mediterranean Sea after departing from what is now Turkey. Last year, divers and archaeologists began excavating the wreck and its cargo, much of which is extremely well preserved. It includes stacks upon stacks of plates; bowls; and trays purpose-built for different foods, such as nuts, fish and soup.
paras.zh: 2000多年前，一艘满载精美餐具的船从现在的土耳其出发后沉入地中海海底。去年，潜水员和考古学家开始挖掘沉船及其货物，其中大部分保存得非常完好。它包括一叠又一叠的盘子；碗；以及专为不同食物（例如坚果、鱼和汤）而设计的托盘。

paras.en: “These artifacts, which have survived in good condition to the present day because of the clay placed between them when they were packed into crates, preserve evidence of Anatolia’s production expertise and the Mediterranean’s trading history,” Mehmet Nuri Ersoy, Turkey’s culture and tourism minister, announced in a social media post, per a translation by the state-run Anadolu Agency.
paras.zh: 土耳其文化和旅游部长穆罕默德·努里·埃尔索伊 (Mehmet Nuri Ersoy) 在社交媒体帖子中宣布：“这些文物由于在装箱时在它们之间放置了粘土，所以至今保存完好，保存了安纳托利亚生产专业知识和地中海贸易历史的证据。”

paras.en: Researchers from Turkey’s Akdeniz University first came across the wreck during a 2023 underwater archaeological survey near the town of Adrasan, along the country’s southern coast. A team led by underwater archaeologist Hakan Öniz began excavating the site last year, the university notes in a statement.
paras.zh: 土耳其阿克德尼兹大学的研究人员在 2023 年在该国南部海岸阿德拉桑镇附近进行的一次水下考古调查中首次发现了这艘沉船。该大学在一份声明中指出，由水下考古学家哈坎·奥尼兹领导的团队去年开始挖掘该遗址。

paras.en: The ship lays between 138 and 180 feet below the surface. Among the sand-buried wreckage, researchers found coins from the Anatolian city of Antioch that date to the first century B.C.E. From these, they deduced that the ship sank at least two millennia ago.
paras.zh: 该船位于海面以下 138 至 180 英尺处。在沙埋的残骸中，研究人员发现了来自安纳托利亚城市安条克的硬币，其历史可以追溯到公元前一世纪。由此，他们推断这艘船至少在两千年前沉没。

paras.en: The researchers sorted the thousands of ceramic artifacts into 122 different types of dishes: plates, bowls, trays and amphorae of varying sizes. The amphorae were probably made on the Aegean Islands, while the bulk of the plates and bowls were likely manufactured in the port of Rhosus, now the Turkish city of Arsuz. Rhosus was famous for its ceramics, which were known as rhosica vasa. The Roman statesman Cicero even mentioned the city in a letter to his friend Atticus in 50 B.C.E., calling the dishware “fine pottery.”
paras.zh: 研究人员将数千件陶瓷制品分类为 122 种不同类型的盘子：不同尺寸的盘子、碗、托盘和双耳细颈瓶。双耳细颈瓶可能是在爱琴海群岛制造的，而大部分盘子和碗可能是在罗苏斯港（现在的土耳其城市阿尔苏斯）制造的。罗苏斯以其陶瓷而闻名，被称为罗西卡瓦萨。罗马政治家西塞罗甚至在公元前 50 年写给朋友阿提克斯的信中提到了这座城市，称其餐具为“精美的陶器”。

paras.en: The Roman Empire started absorbing Anatolia more than a century before Cicero wrote that letter. The peninsula was among its first eastern conquests. Rome’s expansion would continue well past this pottery-making port, eventually reaching around the Black Sea.
paras.zh: 罗马帝国在西塞罗写这封信的一个多世纪前就开始吞并安纳托利亚。该半岛是其最早向东方征服的地区之一。罗马的扩张将继续远远超过这个陶器制造港口，最终到达黑海周围。

paras.en: Researchers believe that the wrecked ship was sailing within a trading network between Antioch, Greece and the Italian Peninsula. According to a 2023 paper published in the Journal of Maritime Archaeology, it likely sank on its way to Rome, after running aground on hidden shoals during a storm. Öniz and co-author Emre Okan, an archaeologist at Turkey’s Duzce University, wrote that the wreckage is among a “rare class of shipwrecks of which the cargo consists of a clearly defined ceramic class.”
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，失事船只当时正在希腊安条克和意大利半岛之间的贸易网络​​内航行。根据《海洋考古学杂志》2023 年发表的一篇论文，它很可能在暴风雨中在隐蔽的浅滩上搁浅后在前往罗马的途中沉没。奥尼兹和合著者、土耳其杜兹杰大学考古学家埃姆雷·奥坎写道，这艘残骸属于“罕见的沉船残骸，其中的货物由明确定义的陶瓷类组成”。

paras.en: The Akdeniz University team is still excavating the wreck, with the aid of underwater robots, per the statement. As Ersoy wrote in his post, “We are bringing 2,100-year-old tableware to light from the depths of the Mediterranean.”
paras.zh: 根据声明，阿克德尼兹大学团队仍在水下机器人的帮助下挖掘沉船。正如 Ersoy 在他的博文中所写，“我们正在将来自地中海深处的 2100 年历史的餐具带入人们的视线。”

articles.title: Like a Mythical Phoenix, This Planet May Have Risen From the Ashes of a Dead Star

paras.en: In 1999, the Hubble Space Telescope turned its gaze upon a white dwarf—a dense remnant of a star—and detected around 100 mysterious chemical features in its atmosphere. More than two decades later, astronomers have now taken another look at the enigmatic data and realized that it points to the presence of a very unusual cosmic body.
paras.zh: 1999 年，哈勃太空望远镜将目光转向一颗白矮星（恒星的致密残骸），并在其大气中检测到大约 100 种神秘的化学特征。二十多年后，天文学家再次审视了这些神秘的数据，并意识到它表明存在一个非常不寻常的宇宙天体。

paras.en: In a study published this week in Nature Astronomy, researchers reveal the possibility that a “second-generation” planet is orbiting the white dwarf. In other words, this world might have been born from the scraps of the dead star. If these findings are confirmed, the planet would be the first of its kind known to researchers and could provide insight into a potential future for our own solar system.
paras.zh: 在本周《自然天文学》杂志上发表的一项研究中，研究人员揭示了“第二代”行星围绕白矮星运行的可能性。换句话说，这个世界可能是从死亡恒星的碎片中诞生的。如果这些发现得到证实，这颗行星将是研究人员已知的第一颗行星，并且可以为我们太阳系的潜在未来提供洞察。

paras.en: After a small star runs out of nuclear fuel, it sheds its wrapping of gas and dust, leaving behind a core known as a white dwarf. The team suggests that a planet orbiting the white dwarf HS 0209+0832 came together from the accretion of its lost gas and dust, like a sort of astronomical phoenix.
paras.zh: 当一颗小恒星耗尽核燃料后，它会摆脱气体和尘埃的包裹，留下一个被称为白矮星的核心。研究小组认为，一颗围绕白矮星 HS 0209+0832 运行的行星是通过其失去的气体和尘埃的吸积而聚集在一起的，就像一种天文凤凰。

paras.en: “A phoenix is reborn from the ashes of its predecessor, and this planet is formed from the ashes of the star,” study co-author Jamie Williams, an astronomer at the University of Warwick in England, tells Science News’ Lisa Grossman.
paras.zh: “凤凰从其前身的灰烬中重生，而这颗行星是由恒星的灰烬形成的，”研究合著者、英国华威大学的天文学家杰米·威廉姆斯告诉《科学新闻》的丽莎·格罗斯曼。

paras.en: When Williams returned to Hubble’s 1999 data, he noticed that many of the mysterious chemical features could be niobium, a kind of metal used in jewelry and medical imaging devices. As opposed to many common elements, niobium is too heavy to be created by the fusion reactions that happen within a star.
paras.zh: 当威廉姆斯回顾哈勃 1999 年的数据时，他注意到许多神秘的化学特征可能是铌，一种用于珠宝和医学成像设备的金属。与许多常见元素相反，铌太重，无法通过恒星内发生的聚变反应产生。

paras.en: Instead, niobium forms “in the exotic conditions that briefly emerge inside dying stars,” study co-author Nicholas Stone, a theoretical astrophysicist at the University of Wisconsin–Madison, says in a NASA statement. As such, niobium is a marker for stellar death. And while this star’s death throes ejected material, including niobium, out to space, part of it formed into a gas giant planet, the researchers hypothesize.
paras.zh: 相反，铌是在“垂死恒星内部短暂出现的奇异条件下”形成的，该研究的合著者、威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校的理论天体物理学家尼古拉斯·斯通在美国宇航局的一份声明中表示。因此，铌是恒星死亡的标志。研究人员推测，虽然这颗恒星的垂死挣扎将包括铌在内的物质喷射到太空中，但其中一部分形成了一颗气态巨行星。

paras.en: It’s hard for planets to come together in these conditions, however, which partly explains why second-generation planets are exceptionally rare, Williams adds in a university statement. The gravity of another star was probably necessary to shape the expelled material into a planet-birthing disk.
paras.zh: 然而，行星在这种情况下很难聚集在一起，这在一定程度上解释了为什么第二代行星异常罕见，威廉姆斯在一份大学声明中补充道。另一颗恒星的引力可能需要将排出的物质塑造成行星诞生盘。

paras.en: Using NASA’s TESS satellite, the team recognized periodic changes in HS 0209+0832’s brightness that point to an orbiting planet passing in front of it. According to their estimations, this candidate planet—it’s not yet confirmed—is a gas giant with a close orbit of around 3.7 million miles. This is about ten times closer than Mercury’s orbit is to our sun, meaning the planet would be getting blasted by the relatively young white dwarf’s energy. That might be ripping off the planet’s external material and possibly turning it into a disk that rains debris back onto the white dwarf, which would explain why a large amount of niobium made its way into Hubble’s data.
paras.zh: 利用 NASA 的 TESS 卫星，研究小组识别出了 HS 0209+0832 亮度的周期性变化，这表明有一颗绕轨道运行的行星从它前面经过。根据他们的估计，这颗候选行星（尚未得到证实）是一颗气态巨行星，其近轨道约为 370 万英里。这大约比水星轨道到太阳的距离近十倍，这意味着这颗行星将被相对年轻的白矮星的能量摧毁。这可能会撕掉行星的外部物质，并可能将其变成一个圆盘，将碎片雨点带回白矮星，这可以解释为什么大量铌进入哈勃的数据。

paras.en: “We know of a large number of white dwarfs that are polluted by planetary material, which is similar in composition to rocks within our solar system,” Sarah Casewell, an observational astronomer at the University of Leicester in England, who did not participate in the study, tells CNN’s Jacopo Prisco. “However, in this case, the white dwarf is polluted by incredibly unusual material, and the composition of this material is similar to atoms we see being created as stars end their lives.”
paras.zh: “我们知道大量白矮星受到了行星物质的污染，这些行星物质的成分与我们太阳系内的岩石相似，”英国莱斯特大学的观测天文学家萨拉·凯斯韦尔（未参与这项研究）告诉美国有线电视新闻网的雅科波·普里斯科。 “然而，在这种情况下，白矮星受到了极其不寻常的物质的污染，这种物质的成分类似于我们看到的恒星结束生命时产生的原子。”

paras.en: If the planet does exist, its loss of material is not likely to make it wither away entirely. “Eventually the white dwarf will cool and then maintain a consistent temperature, with the planet in its stable habitable zone for millions of years,” Williams says in NASA’s statement.
paras.zh: 如果这颗行星确实存在，它的物质损失不太可能使其完全消失。威廉姆斯在美国宇航局的声明中说：“最终，白矮星将冷却，然后保持恒定的温度，使行星在稳定的宜居带中保持数百万年。”

paras.en: Moving forward, he plans to continue using Hubble to investigate second-generation planets and how they are born around dead stars. This research marks the first time that astronomers have found niobium in a white dwarf, but it might not necessarily be the last.
paras.zh: 展望未来，他计划继续利用哈勃望远镜研究第二代行星以及它们如何在死亡恒星周围诞生。这项研究标志着天文学家首次在白矮星中发现铌，但这不一定是最后一次。

paras.en: If the team’s results are confirmed, they could provide a model for understanding what might one day happen much closer to home. “The sun will eventually become a white dwarf, so we’re also looking at the future of the solar system here,” study co-author David Wilson, an astronomer at the University of Colorado Boulder, tells CNN. “Maybe the sun will get a new planet someday.”
paras.zh: 如果该团队的结果得到证实，他们可以提供一个模型来了解有一天在离家更近的地方可能会发生什么。研究合著者、科罗拉多大学博尔德分校的天文学家大卫·威尔逊告诉美国有线电视新闻网：“太阳最终将成为一颗白矮星，因此我们也在关注太阳系的未来。” “也许有一天太阳会拥有一颗新行星。”

articles.title: Two Chemists Win Nobel Prize for Unraveling a Mystery of Molecular 'Handedness,' Helping Drugmakers Develop Safer Medications

paras.en: Two scientists have been awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for their work untangling a perplexing puzzle about the “handedness” of molecules, allowing drugmakers to develop safer, more precisely targeted medicines. Chemists Henri Kagan of the University of Paris-Sud and Kenso Soai of the Tokyo University of Science were named Nobel laureates on October 7.
paras.zh: 两位科学家因其解决了分子“旋向性”这一令人费解的难题而获得诺贝尔化学奖，使制药商能够开发出更安全、更精确的靶向药物。 10 月 7 日，巴黎南大学化学家亨利·卡根 (Henri Kagan) 和东京理科大学化学家 Soai Kenso 被评为诺贝尔奖获得者。

paras.en: “The medicines we have today would not be possible without this chemistry,” Rigoberto Hernandez, president of the American Chemical Society and a chemist at the Johns Hopkins University, tells the Associated Press’ Adithi Ramakrishnan, Kostya Manenkov and Stefanie Dazio.
paras.zh: 美国化学会主席、约翰·霍普金斯大学化学家 Rigoberto Hernandez 告诉美联社记者 Adithi Ramakrishnan、Kostya Manenkov 和 Stefanie Dazio：“如果没有这种化学反应，我们今天的药物就不可能出现。”

paras.en: Kagan and Soai’s award-winning research centers on chirality, which derives from the Greek word for “hand.” Some molecules come in two forms that are mirror images of each other, just like our right and left hands. These mirror images, known as chiral forms, may look similar, but they can behave very differently. The chemical carvone, for instance, can smell like mint or caraway, depending on which version of it you sniff.
paras.zh: 卡根和索艾的获奖研究中心是手性，手性源自希腊语“手”。有些分子有两种形式，互为镜像，就像我们的右手和左手一样。这些镜像（称为手性形式）可能看起来相似，但它们的行为可能非常不同。例如，化学香芹酮闻起来像薄荷或香菜，具体取决于您闻到的版本。

paras.en: However, living organisms usually contain just one version of a molecule. The sugars in our DNA, for example, are right-handed, while most amino acids in your body’s proteins are left-handed. Their mirror-image counterparts, by contrast, are rarely found in nature. This phenomenon is known as homochirality, which derives from the Greek words for “same” and “hand.”
paras.zh: 然而，生物体通常只含有一种分子。例如，我们 DNA 中的糖是右旋的，而人体蛋白质中的大多数氨基酸是左旋的。相比之下，它们的镜像对应物在自然界中很少发现。这种现象被称为同手性，它源自希腊语中的“相同”和“手”。

paras.en: For decades, this chemical asymmetry confounded scientists. How do natural reactions in living organisms produce just one type of a molecule? And why did life’s building blocks evolve a preference for one version or the other?
paras.zh: 几十年来，这种化学不对称性让科学家们感到困惑。生物体中的自然反应如何只产生一种类型的分子？为什么生命的组成部分会进化出对其中一种版本的偏好？

paras.en: Deepening the conundrum, they couldn’t replicate this natural asymmetry in the lab. Their experiments produced equal amounts of each version of a molecule—a 50-50 right-handed and left-handed split.
paras.zh: 更进一步的是，他们无法在实验室中复制这种自然的不对称性。他们的实验产生了等量的每种分子——右旋分子和左旋分子各为 50-50。

paras.en: Thanks to Kagan and Soai, as well as numerous scientists who came before them, researchers are now closer to unraveling this mystery.
paras.zh: 感谢卡根和索艾，以及在他们之前的众多科学家，研究人员现在更接近解开这个谜团。

paras.en: Their work hinges on catalysts, or substances that can influence chemical reactions without being used up or permanently altered in the process. In 1986, Kagan reported that if an asymmetrical catalyst is introduced to a chemical reaction, it can cause the resulting molecule to be asymmetrical, too, producing more of the right-handed or left-handed version. The effect of the catalyst is nonlinear, meaning that a small imbalance in the catalyst can lead to a much larger imbalance in the handedness of the ensuing molecules.
paras.zh: 他们的工作取决于催化剂，或者可以影响化学反应而不会在过程中耗尽或永久改变的物质。 1986 年，卡根报告说，如果在化学反应中引入不对称催化剂，它也会导致所得分子不对称，从而产生更多的右旋或左旋分子。催化剂的作用是非线性的，这意味着催化剂中的微小不平衡可能会导致后续分子的旋向性发生更大的不平衡。

paras.en: Soai further tweaked the work and developed chemical reactions that can produce their own asymmetrical catalyst. These “autocatalytic reactions” amplify the imbalance of the ensuing molecule, essentially steering it toward right-handedness or left-handedness. In 2003, he finally published a paper describing a reaction—later dubbed the Soai reaction—in which only one of the mirror images made up the vast majority of the products.
paras.zh: Soai 进一步调整了工作并开发了可以产生自己的不对称催化剂的化学反应。这些“自催化反应”放大了随后产生的分子的不平衡，本质上将其转向右旋或左旋。 2003 年，他终于发表了一篇论文，描述了一种反应（后来被称为 Soai 反应），其中只有一个镜像构成了绝大多数产物。

paras.en: “Their discoveries led to a chemical reaction that spontaneously, without the involvement of other chiral molecules, creates only one mirror image,” said Heiner Linke, chair of the Nobel committee for chemistry and a physicist at Lund University in Sweden, during a livestream of the award announcement. “This is the first time this has happened since the processes that led to the chirality of life billions of years ago.”
paras.zh: 诺贝尔化学委员会主席、瑞典隆德大学物理学家海纳·林克在颁奖典礼直播中表示：“他们的发现导致了一种化学反应，在没有其他手性分子参与的情况下，自发地只产生一个镜像。” “自数十亿年前导致生命手性的过程以来，这是第一次发生这种情况。”

paras.en: Their work doesn’t explain how handedness arose in nature, nor why some molecules are naturally right-handed or left-handed. But it “provides a mechanism by which the problem could be solved,” Matthew Powner, an organic chemist at University College London, tells Nature.
paras.zh: 他们的工作没有解释自然界中旋手性是如何产生的，也没有解释为什么有些分子天生是右旋或左旋的。但它“提供了一种可以解决问题的机制”，伦敦大学学院的有机化学家马修·波纳告诉《自然》杂志。

paras.en: In the 1960s, drugmaker Eli Lilly used the left-handed version of a molecule to develop Novrad, a cough medicine, and the right-handed version to make Darvon, an opioid painkiller, per Science's Eric Hand. Their names are mirror images of each other, too.
paras.zh: 据《科学》杂志的埃里克·汉德 (Eric Hand) 报道，20 世纪 60 年代，制药商礼来 (Eli Lilly) 使用分子的左手版本开发了咳嗽药 Novrad，并使用右手版本的分子开发了阿片类止痛药 Darvon。他们的名字也是彼此的镜像。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Kagan and Soai’s research has had major practical implications for pharmacology. Their discoveries have helped drugmakers develop more targeted medicines with fewer side effects, reports STAT’s Annalisa Merelli.
paras.zh: 与此同时，卡根和索艾的研究对药理学具有重大的实际意义。 STAT 的 Annalisa Merelli 报道称，他们的发现帮助制药商开发出更具针对性且副作用更少的药物。

paras.en: Historically, drugs were often developed as “racemates,” meaning they contained a 50-50 mixture of the left- and right-handed versions of a molecule. While one version of the molecule might produce the desired therapeutic effect, the other might be harmless—or it could interact differently with the body and cause serious side effects.
paras.zh: 从历史上看，药物通常被开发为“外消旋体”，这意味着它们含有左旋分子和右旋分子 50-50 的混合物。虽然该分子的一种版本可能会产生所需的治疗效果，但另一种可能是无害的，或者它可能与身体发生不同的相互作用并导致严重的副作用。

paras.en: In recent years, however, pharmacologists have started producing drugs that are primarily one version of the molecule or the other.
paras.zh: 然而，近年来，药理学家开始生产主要是该分子的一种版本或另一种版本的药物。

paras.en: “To be able to selectively make handed molecules is absolutely critical, because life is handed, and the world is handed,” Hernandez tells Chemical & Engineering News’ Brianna Barbu. “So, if you can control the handedness of the therapeutic or the molecular system that you put out there, then that can lead to control of its function and its downstream effects.”
paras.zh: “能够选择性地制造手性分子绝对是至关重要的，因为生命是手性的，世界也是手性的，”埃尔南德斯告诉《化学与工程新闻》的布丽安娜·巴尔布。 “因此，如果你可以控制治疗药物或分子系统的手性，那么就可以控制其功能及其下游效应。”

paras.en: Soai was out shopping when he learned of his newly minted Nobel laureate status. “I’m very excited,” he said while calling into the award ceremony. “Of course, this is one of the most exciting days of my life. I’m very glad to share the award with Professor Henri Kagan.”
paras.zh: 当索艾得知自己刚刚获得诺贝尔奖时，他正在外出购物。 “我非常兴奋，”他在颁奖典礼上打电话时说道。 “当然，这是我一生中最激动人心的日子之一。我很高兴与亨利·卡根教授分享这一奖项。”

paras.en: Members of the Nobel committee and journalists couldn’t immediately reach Kagan. However, his daughter, Veronique Le Deunff, told Reuters’ Marie Mannes, Simon Johnson and Johan Ahlander she was “very happy” for her father, adding that “the creativity and originality of his work have opened up new avenues for research.”
paras.zh: 诺贝尔委员会成员和记者无法立即联系到卡根。然而，他的女儿 Veronique Le Deunff 告诉路透社的 Marie Mannes、Simon Johnson 和 Johan Ahlander，她为父亲“非常高兴”，并补充说“他的工作的创造力和原创性为研究开辟了新的途径。”

paras.en: The Nobel committees will continue revealing winners of their six award categories this week and early next week. Each award comes with 12 million Swedish kronor (about $1.2 million), which gets split among the laureates.
paras.zh: 诺贝尔委员会将在本周和下周初继续公布六个奖项类别的获奖者。每个奖项的奖金为 1200 万瑞典克朗（约合 120 万美元），由获奖者平分。

paras.en: Wireless Earbuds With Great Sound for $93 ($37 Off)
paras.zh: 音质极佳的无线耳机，现价 93 美元（立减 37 美元）

paras.en: These Soundpeats H3 wireless earbuds hit the sweet spot where value meets lossless audio, detailed sound, and clear voice audio for phone calls. No frills like heart-rate tracking. Just great sound and a low price.
paras.zh: 这些 Soundpeats H3 无线耳机完美结合了价值与无损音频、细腻的声音以及清晰的通话语音。没有心率追踪之类的多余装饰。只是美妙的声音和低廉的价格。

paras.en: You can't find a Kindle for under $100 anymore during Prime Day thanks to Amazon's price changes, but that doesn't mean you can't get a different e-reader instead. paras.zh: 由于亚马逊的价格变化，您在 Prime Day 期间再也找不到低于 100 美元的 Kindle，但这并不意味着您不能购买其他电子阅读器。在 Prime Day 期间打折的商品并不多，但 Xteink 推出的这款小巧可爱的袖珍读卡器非常小，可以吸附在某些智能手机上。

paras.en: The Best Personal Blender for $94 ($36 Off)
paras.zh: 最好的个人搅拌机，现价 94 美元（优惠 36 美元）

paras.en: The best personal blender on the market, bar none. This 1,200-watt Nutribullet Ultra is perfect for smoothies, protein shakes, and pestos or salsas. It's easy to clean and stow away, so it doesn't take up counter space. When you're done blending, put the lid on the jug, and it's now a drink cup that'll fit in most car cup holders.
paras.zh: 市场上最好的个人搅拌机，没有之一。这款 1,200 瓦 Nutribullet Ultra 非常适合制作冰沙、蛋白奶昔、香蒜酱或莎莎酱。它易于清洁和存放，因此不占用柜台空间。混合完成后，盖上壶盖，它现在就是一个适合大多数汽车杯架的饮料杯。

paras.en: Our favorite basket air fryer keeps temperature better than some thermometers. It crisps wings and fries without blasting them. If you want a great air fryer without spending a lot, this is it.
paras.zh: 我们最喜欢的篮子空气炸锅比某些温度计能更好地保持温度。它可以使鸡翅和薯条变脆，而不会炸裂它们。如果您想要一个很棒的空气炸锅而又不想花很多钱，那就是它了。

paras.en: Most vacuums under $100 aren't worth your time. But this little handheld model is a favorite of ours for cleaning cars, thanks to the long hose and handle. Regardless of what you're cleaning, it's easy to move around and get to hard-to-reach places like corners or deep trunks. There's also a useful charging stand that holds attachments and keeps the vacuum charged, which you'll want since it only holds a 15-minute charge (unfortunately normal for small vacuums like this).
paras.zh: 大多数 100 美元以下的吸尘器都不值得您花时间。但这款小型手持式模型因其长软管和手柄而成为我们清洁汽车的最爱。无论您要清洁什么，都可以轻松移动并到达难以到达的地方，例如角落或深处的树干。还有一个有用的充电支架，可以容纳附件并保持吸尘器充电，这是您所需要的，因为它只能充电 15 分钟（不幸的是，对于像这样的小型吸尘器来说这是正常的）。

paras.en: Your Own Indoor Garden for $92 ($28 Off)
paras.zh: 您自己的室内花园仅需 92 美元（优惠 28 美元）

paras.en: This is our favorite budget indoor gardening system, and it doesn't require expensive subscriptions or proprietary pods. It's great for growing greens or tomatoes indoors, and there's an optional companion app.
paras.zh: 这是我们最喜欢的预算室内园艺系统，它不需要昂贵的订阅或专有的吊舱。它非常适合在室内种植蔬菜或西红柿，并且有一个可选的配套应用程序。

paras.en: Holiday Lights You Can Leave Up for $90 ($27 Off)
paras.zh: 节日灯饰仅需 90 美元（立减 27 美元）

paras.en: Here's an affordable way to add some outdoor lighting to your apartment or house. You can use the app to add a splash of color to your exterior, or set up seasonal lighting for the holidays.
paras.zh: 这是一种为您的公寓或房屋添加户外照明的经济实惠的方法。您可以使用该应用程序为您的外部增添一抹色彩，或为假期设置季节性照明。

paras.en: Amazon's Echo Dot Max is powerful, with better sound than the rest of the range, and a built-in smart home hub. This deal isn't quite as good as it may seem, since Amazon recently increased prices on many of its products (the MSRP used to be $100). But Prime Day is still the best time to save on Amazon devices.
paras.zh: 亚马逊的 Echo Dot Max 功能强大，声音比该系列的其他产品更好，并且内置智能家居中心。这笔交易并不像看起来那么好，因为亚马逊最近提高了许多产品的价格（建议零售价以前为 100 美元）。但 Prime Day 仍然是在亚马逊设备上省钱的最佳时机。

paras.en: While our favorite portable Bluetooth speaker has been cheaper, we still think this is a decent deal. It delivers huge sound for its size and stays small and durable enough to sling in just about any bag. It offers IP68 water resistance, an easy-release strap, and a two-hour battery boost (or four if you reduce the bass). The Flip 7 also supports Auracast to sync with other new JBL models like the Clip 5 and Charge 6.
paras.zh: 虽然我们最喜欢的便携式蓝牙扬声器更便宜，但我们仍然认为这是一笔不错的交易。它的尺寸可提供巨大的声音，并且体积小且耐用，足以挂在任何包里。它具有 IP68 防水等级、易于释放的表带和两小时的电池续航时间（如果降低低音则可以续航四小时）。 Flip 7 还支持 Auracast 与其他新的 JBL 型号（例如 Clip 5 和 Charge 6）同步。

paras.en: A Comfortable, Cool Gaming Headset for $71 ($39 Off)

paras.en: This gaming headset is a favorite of WIRED reviewer Louryn Strampe. She's found it comfortable and lightweight for long gaming sessions, paired with surprisingly clear sound. It also comes in a couple of fun colors to add a little pop of fun to your desk (and head!)
paras.zh: 这款游戏耳机是《连线》评论员 Louryn Strampe 的最爱。她发现它在长时间的游戏过程中舒适且轻便，并且具有令人惊讶的清晰声音。它还具有几种有趣的颜色，为您的办公桌（和头部！）增添一点流行乐趣。

paras.en: A Screen-Free Kids’ Speaker for $82 ($28 Lff)
paras.zh: 无屏幕儿童音箱，售价 82 美元（28 美元）

paras.en: If you want a screen-free gift for any kid, the Yoto Player is a great choice. It's ideal for kids between 3 and 12, with physical cards that slot into the top of the device to trigger stories and music. It also has a cute pixel-art display on the front, a built-in night light, and even a thermometer.
paras.zh: 如果您想给孩子一份没有屏幕的礼物，Yoto Player 是一个不错的选择。它非常适合 3 到 12 岁的孩子，通过插入设备顶部的物理卡片来触发故事和音乐。它的正面还有一个可爱的像素艺术显示屏、一个内置夜灯，甚至还有一个温度计。

paras.en: SwitchBot is better known for robot vacuums, but it has been steadily building a smart home range. This lovely fan has a brushless motor, a rechargeable battery for cordless operation, and rare Matter compatibility with the add-on SwitchBot Hub 3 bridge ($120).
paras.zh: SwitchBot 以扫地机器人而闻名，但它一直在稳步打造智能家居系列。这款可爱的风扇配有无刷电机、用于无线操作的可充电电池，以及与附加 SwitchBot Hub 3 桥（120 美元）的罕见物质兼容性。

paras.en: A Great Outdoor Security Camera for $95 ($30 Off)
paras.zh: 一款出色的户外监控摄像头，仅需 95 美元（优惠 30 美元）

paras.en: Arlo's Pro 6 tops our best outdoor security cameras guide. It can record 2K video with a wide 160-degree field of view, and pairs with a swift-loading app that offers rich notifications, and supports two-factor authentication. The pricey catch is the subscription ($10 per month or $96 a year for a single camera, $20 per month or $216 a year for unlimited cameras).
paras.zh: Arlo 的 Pro 6 在我们的最佳户外安全摄像头指南中名列前茅。它可以录制具有 160 度宽视野的 2K 视频，并与快速加载的应用程序配合使用，提供丰富的通知，并支持双因素身份验证。价格昂贵的是订阅（单台相机每月 10 美元或每年 96 美元，无限相机每月 20 美元或每年 216 美元）。

paras.en: Smart plugs are useful for turning non-smart things, like lamps, into connected smart devices you can remote control and schedule. The three-piece set is on sale for a good price, and they’re Matter-compatible.
paras.zh: 智能插头可用于将非智能设备（例如灯）转变为可以远程控制和调度的联网智能设备。三件套正在以优惠的价格出售，并且它们与 Matter 兼容。

articles.title: Best October Prime Day Deals to Shop Before the Sale Ends (2026)
articles.author: Louryn Strampe

paras.en: Amazon’s fall Prime Day sale—also known as Big Deal Days 2026—is in its final hours. The sale started yesterday, October 6, and runs through midnight tonight, so don't wait if there's something you wanted to buy on sale. As with all Prime Day sales, you'll need to be an Amazon Prime member to take advantage of the discounts.
paras.zh: 亚马逊秋季 Prime Day 促销（也称为 2026 年大优惠日）已进入最后几个小时。促销活动于昨天（10 月 6 日）开始，一直持续到今晚午夜，所以如果您想购买特价商品，请不要等待。与所有 Prime Day 促销一样，您需要成为 Amazon Prime 会员才能享受折扣。

paras.en: It may only be October, but it's never too early to jump on that holiday gift shopping. We've combed through all the deals and found the best ones, based on our years of testing and reviewing. WIRED's picks for the best Prime Day deals only include products someone from our team has personally tested and reviewed. We track prices using several tools to avoid falling for fake discounts. There are no shoddy knockoffs or overpriced products among our recommendations, just good deals on great gear that we personally use ourselves.
paras.zh: 虽然现在才十月，但购买节日礼物永远不会太早。根据我们多年的测试和审查，我们梳理了所有交易并找到了最好的交易。 《连线》精选的最佳 Prime Day 优惠仅包括我们团队中的某人亲自测试和评论过的产品。我们使用多种工具跟踪价格，以避免陷入虚假折扣。我们的推荐中没有劣质仿冒品或价格过高的产品，只有我们自己使用的优质装备的超值优惠。

paras.en: Contributors: Louryn Strampe, Simon Hill, Nena Farrell, Kat Merck, Molly Higgins, Boutayna Chokrane, Luke Larsen, Harry Rabinowitz, Les Shu
paras.zh: 贡献者：Louryn Strampe、Simon Hill、Nena Farrell、Kat Merck、Molly Higgins、Boutayna Chokrane、Luke Larsen、Harry Rabinowitz、Les Shu

paras.en: As someone who’s tested dozens of laptops this year already, I still find myself recommending the MacBook Air M5 more than any other. It’s the most well-rounded laptop you can buy, sporting great performance, long battery life, and a razor-thin chassis. The price has gone up considerably over the past year, but that’s true of many of the best laptops. And now, it's at its lowest price since June, making it an absolute must-buy and the top of my list for Prime Day laptop deals. —Luke Larsen
paras.zh: 作为今年已经测试过数十台笔记本电脑的人，我仍然发现自己比其他任何人都更推荐 MacBook Air M5。它是您能买到的最全面的笔记本电脑，具有出色的性能、较长的电池寿命和超薄的底盘。在过去的一年里，价格大幅上涨，但许多最好的笔记本电脑都是如此。现在，它的价格处于 6 月份以来的最低水平，使其成为绝对必买产品，也是我的 Prime Day 笔记本电脑优惠清单中的首选。 ——卢克·拉森

paras.en: Apple AirPods Pro 3 are the best wireless earbuds for anyone with an iPhone. They’ve got best-in-class noise-canceling, an excellent transparency mode, clear and detailed audio quality, and a plethora of advanced features like built-in heart rate sensors and live translation. The heart rate sensors are particularly impressive—you can go on a run with just your phone and these earbuds and get accurate GPS, heart rate zone, and calorie data. —Harry Rabinowitz
paras.zh: Apple AirPods Pro 3 是 iPhone 使用者的最佳无线耳机。它们具有一流的降噪功能、出色的透明模式、清晰细致的音频质量，以及内置心率传感器和实时翻译等大量高级功能。心率传感器尤其令人印象深刻——您只需携带手机和耳机即可跑步，并获得准确的 GPS、心率区和卡路里数据。 ——哈里·拉比诺维茨

paras.en: The Mac Mini has been sold out for the majority of this year due to the rapid escalation of interest in using them as local, agentic AI machines. The brand-new M6 model is faster (and more expensive) than ever. But the fact that you can buy them at all right now feels significant, and Amazon has the best deal on the latest model you’ll find. —Luke Larsen
paras.zh: 由于人们对将 Mac Mini 用作本地代理人工智能机器的兴趣迅速升温，Mac Mini 今年大部分时间都已售空。全新的 M6 型号比以往更快（而且更昂贵）。但事实上，你现在就可以购买它们，这感觉很重要，而且亚马逊对你能找到的最新型号有最优惠的价格。 ——卢克·拉森

paras.en: Apple AirPods Max 2 are the best over-ear headphones for anyone with an iPhone, MacBook, and other Apple staples. They have some of the best sound quality, noise-canceling, and transparency modes of any headphone out there. They are pricey, but $120 off sticker price makes them more in-line with options from Sony and Bose.—Harry Rabinowitz
paras.zh: Apple AirPods Max 2 是任何拥有 iPhone、MacBook 和其他 Apple 产品的人的最佳入耳式耳机。它们拥有市面上所有耳机中最好的音质、降噪和通透模式。它们价格昂贵，但比标价低 120 美元，使它们更符合索尼和 Bose 的选择。-Harry Rabinowitz

paras.en: While almost all of Amazon's Kindles are on sale, the Colorsoft is one of the best. While it was also hit with a price hike at the end of August, with the base model rising to $290 from $250, you can get it for $100 off during Amazon's sale. It has everything we like about the Paperwhite, but with a color screen (and now with Dark Mode, which it originally lacked!). For only $20 more during Amazon Big Deal Days, I'd get the Colorsoft over the Paperwhite. —Nena Farrell
paras.zh: 虽然几乎所有亚马逊 Kindle 都在打折，但 Colorsoft 是最好的之一。虽然它在 8 月底也受到了涨价的影响，基本型号从 250 美元涨到了 290 美元，但在亚马逊促销期间你可以享受 100 美元的折扣。它拥有我们喜欢的 Paperwhite 的一切，但配备了彩色屏幕（现在有了深色模式，这是它最初所缺少的！）。在亚马逊大促销期间，只要多花 20 美元，我就能买到 Colorsoft，而不是 Paperwhite。 ——妮娜·法雷尔

paras.en: If you're looking to get the biggest discount on a new Kindle, the best sale is on the Kindle Scribe Colorsoft. It's got an 11-inch color screen and comes with a stylus to let it double as a digital notebook. It's the most expensive Kindle, but it also has the best discount during Amazon's sale event. —Nena Farrell
paras.zh: 如果您想获得新 Kindle 的最大折扣，Kindle Scribe Colorsoft 是最优惠的选择。它配备 11 英寸彩色屏幕，并配有手写笔，可兼作数字笔记本。它是最贵的Kindle，但在亚马逊促销活动期间它也有最好的折扣。 ——妮娜·法雷尔

paras.en: The most affordable Kindle is the 11th-gen base Kindle, but it's not as cheap as it used to be. It used to dip below $100 at these sale events, but Amazon raised prices for most Kindle models, so now this might be the best price we see going forward. While I'm not happy about it, I'd recommend getting it on sale versus waiting for it to go up even higher. —Nena Farrell
paras.zh: 最实惠的 Kindle 是第 11 代基础版 Kindle，但它不像以前那么便宜。在这些促销活动中，它的价格曾经跌破 100 美元，但亚马逊提高了大多数 Kindle 型号的价格，所以现在这可能是我们看到的未来最好的价格。虽然我对此并不满意，但我建议将其出售，而不是等待它涨得更高。 ——妮娜·法雷尔

paras.en: If you're bummed that there's no Kindle under $100 during Prime Day anymore, I have a solution for you. The Xteink X4 Pro Pocket E-Reader is a tiny e-reader with just a 4.3-inch display that fits in the palm of your hand (or your pocket!) It's easy to use, and you can send web pages and articles to it easily through the app. It doesn't have a built-in store, though, so it's harder to get ebooks onto it. —Nena Farrell
paras.zh: 如果您对 Prime Day 期间没有 100 美元以下的 Kindle 感到沮丧，我有一个解决方案。 Xteink X4 Pro 袖珍电子阅读器是一款微型电子阅读器，只有 4.3 英寸显示屏，适合放在手掌（或口袋！），使用方便，您可以通过应用程序轻松向其发送网页和文章。不过，它没有内置商店，因此很难在上面获取电子书。 ——妮娜·法雷尔

paras.en: This is the lowest price ever for the Nothing Headphone (1), an excellent, stylish pair of over-ear headphones with great sound and even better battery life: up to 35 hours with noise-canceling on or 80 hours with it off. The headphones have tactile controls on each earcup I personally love—things like a volume wheel, Bluetooth pairing button, on-off switch, and media control paddle. —Harry Rabinowitz
paras.zh: 这是 Nothing Headphone (1) 有史以来的最低价格，这是一款出色、时尚的包耳式耳机，具有出色的音质和更长的电池寿命：开启降噪功能时长达 35 小时，关闭降噪功能时长达 80 小时。这款耳机的每个耳罩上都有我个人喜欢的触觉控制装置，例如音量轮、蓝牙配对按钮、开关和媒体控制拨片。 ——哈里·拉比诺维茨

paras.en: Amazon launched two new Echo Show smart displays last year, and the Echo Show 11 was easily the better of the two. The sound is better, and the screen is larger—but not so large that it's a pain to put on a kitchen counter. Amazon did raise the price by $30 at the end of August, but this is still the lowest deal price I've seen for it since its launch. —Nena Farrell
paras.zh: 亚马逊去年推出了两款新的 Echo Show 智能显示器，而 Echo Show 11 无疑是两者中更好的。声音更好，屏幕更大，但又不会大到放在厨房柜台上很麻烦。亚马逊确实在 8 月底将价格提高了 30 美元，但这仍然是自推出以来我见过的最低交易价格。 ——妮娜·法雷尔

paras.en: The Echo Studio has been our favorite Echo speaker for the sound quality since the original model, and the second-generation version packs fantastic sound like its predecessor. I also love that its price didn't increase between the two generations, or after Amazon's price hike in August. It's still one of the more expensive models, even on sale, so I'd choose it only if you have a massive room you're trying to fill with sound. But it's also the only new Echo that didn't get a price increase, so this sale isn't just a trick of the numbers. —Nena Farrell
paras.zh: 自最初的型号以来，Echo Studio 就其音质一直是我们最喜欢的 Echo 扬声器，而第二代版本则像其前身一样提供美妙的声音。我还喜欢它的价格在两代之间没有上涨，或者在亚马逊八月份涨价之后也没有上涨。即使在打折，它仍然是较昂贵的型号之一，所以只有当你有一个巨大的房间并且想要充满声音时我才会选择它。但这也是唯一一款没有涨价的新款 Echo，因此这次促销不仅仅是数字上的骗局。 ——妮娜·法雷尔

paras.en: If you want a similar experience to the Skylight Calendar without worrying about the subscription fee, the Everblog HomeCal is the closest digital wall calendar I've found. It has a similar interface and menu options (calendar, meals, chores, etc) and allows you to set it up as a digital photo frame when you aren't using it. The photo upload tool is slower, but it's worth it to be free. —Nena Farrell
paras.zh: 如果您想要与 Skylight Calendar 类似的体验而不用担心订阅费，Everblog HomeCal 是我发现的最接近的数字挂历。它有类似的界面和菜单选项（日历、膳食、家务等），并允许您在不使用它时将其设置为数码相框。照片上传工具较慢，但免费是值得的。 ——妮娜·法雷尔

paras.en: A good smart plug is handy all over the house. I really like this set from TP-Link's Tapo brand because the plugs are Matter-certified, making them easy to pair with any existing smart home ecosystem, and have a small form factor so they won't block the other outlets. I like them best for controlling lamps that don't fit for a smart bulb, but you could use them for all kinds of things. —Nena Farrell
paras.zh: 一个好的智能插头在整个房子里都很方便。我真的很喜欢 TP-Link Tapo 品牌的这套插头，因为这些插头经过 Matter 认证，可以轻松与任何现有的智能家居生态系统配对，并且外形小巧，不会阻塞其他插座。我最喜欢它们用于控制不适合智能灯泡的灯，但您可以将它们用于各种用途。 ——妮娜·法雷尔

paras.en: If you want a really great, reliable automatic litter box but don’t need extras like AI recognition or an internal camera to watch, I think this is the best model. In fact, it’s the automatic litter box I recommend for most people. It’s an upgrade from the Petkit PuraMax 2 (which I also loved). It has a larger opening and better odor control than the previous model. It also has a connected app, where you can monitor usage and adjust settings from afar. At less than $400, this is a pretty cheap price point for a model of this caliber. —Molly Higgins
paras.zh: 如果你想要一个真正出色、可靠的自动垃圾箱，但不需要人工智能识别或内部摄像头等额外功能来观看，我认为这是最好的型号。事实上，这是我向大多数人推荐的自动垃圾箱。它是 Petkit PuraMax 2（我也很喜欢）的升级版。与之前的型号相比，它具有更大的开口和更好的气味控制。它还具有一个连接的应用程序，您可以在其中远程监控使用情况并调整设置。不到 400 美元，对于这种级别的型号来说是一个相当便宜的价格点。 ——莫莉·希金斯

paras.en: I’ve tested air purifiers that cost 10 times as much as this budget Levoit, but I keep coming back to this affordable pick. I really love the connected app, which lets me adjust settings like fan speed and modes from afar and check filter life. Plus, the app sends notifications when air quality is poor and updates when it reaches clean levels again. You can also see historical indoor air quality levels and the corresponding action the purifier took, which helps track patterns. It’s also compatible with Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant for voice control. —Molly Higgins
paras.zh: 我测试过价格是这个预算 Levoit 的 10 倍的空气净化器，但我总是回到这个实惠的选择。我真的很喜欢连接的应用程序，它可以让我远程调整风扇速度和模式等设置并检查过滤器寿命。此外，该应用程序会在空气质量较差时发送通知，并在空气质量再次达到清洁水平时更新。您还可以查看历史室内空气质量水平以及净化器采取的相应操作，这有助于跟踪模式。它还与 Amazon Alexa 或 Google Assistant 兼容以进行语音控制。 ——莫莉·希金斯

paras.en: With its OLED screen and a super-thin design, you'd never guess this laptop was as cheap as it is. The Qualcomm Snapdragon X chip inside is what makes it special though, offering great battery life and quiet performance. This particular deal gets you the 16-inch size with a full terabyte of storage (and 16 GB of RAM) for just $750. The touchpad is the main area where this laptop struggles and falls behind the MacBook Neo and Dell XPS 13. But the HP OmniBook 5 gets you extra memory and storage at a killer price. —Luke Larsen
paras.zh: 凭借其 OLED 屏幕和超薄设计，您绝对想不到这款笔记本电脑会如此便宜。内部的高通 Snapdragon X 芯片使其与众不同，提供了出色的电池寿命和安静的性能。这项特别优惠只需 750 美元即可让您获得 16 英寸尺寸和 1TB 存储空间（以及 16 GB RAM）。触摸板是这款笔记本电脑的主要不足之处，落后于 MacBook Neo 和戴尔 XPS 13。但 HP OmniBook 5 以惊人的价格为您提供额外的内存和存储空间。 ——卢克·拉森

paras.en: When it comes to monitors, all most people need is something reliable, comfortable to use, and not horrifically ugly. That’s underselling the Dell S2725HSM, despite its price. It’s a basic 1080p resolution, but it has really solid image quality, and it even comes with a 144-Hz refresh rate. All those features are heightened when it’s on sale for just $130, too. That’s the biggest price drop I’ve seen on this monitor in a while. —Luke Larsen
paras.zh: 当谈到显示器时，大多数人需要的只是可靠、使用舒适、而且不是太丑陋的东西。尽管戴尔 S2725HSM 价格低廉，但其销量仍低于其售价。它是基本的 1080p 分辨率，但具有非常稳定的图像质量，甚至还具有 144 Hz 刷新率。当它的售价仅为 130 美元时，所有这些功能都得到了加强。这是我一段时间以来在这款显示器上看到的最大降价幅度。 ——卢克·拉森

paras.en: Tilt-Pan-Zoom webcams like the Obsbot Tiny 3 are so much more than just a webcam for video calls. The gimbal gives the camera a huge range of motion, letting you dramatically expand what you can shoot compared to a standard webcam. It’s ideal for streamers, content creators, podcasters, and online educators—or really anyone who wants to show more of their room on video. On top of that, it also has tons of interesting AI features to play with. This is a rare discount on this top-shelf webcam, too. —Luke Larsen
paras.zh: 像 Obsbot Tiny 3 这样的倾斜-平移-缩放网络摄像头不仅仅是用于视频通话的网络摄像头。与标准网络摄像头相比，万向节为相机提供了巨大的运动范围，让您可以极大地扩展可以拍摄的内容。它非常适合主播、内容创作者、播客和在线教育工作者，或者任何想要在视频中展示更多房间的人。最重要的是，它还有大量有趣的人工智能功能可供使用。对于这款顶级网络摄像头来说，这也是难得的折扣。 ——卢克·拉森

paras.en: On its own, this is a decent 4K webcam with all the typical high-end webcam trappings. But this one has a trick up its sleeve: Being able to easily switch between portrait and landscape. And because it magnetically attaches to the mount, it works just as well in both modes. For anyone shooting social videos, it’s extremely handy. —Luke Larsen
paras.zh: 就其本身而言，这是一款不错的 4K 网络摄像头，具有所有典型的高端网络摄像头特征。但这有一个妙招：能够轻松地在纵向和横向之间切换。由于它通过磁性吸附在安装座上，因此在两种模式下都可以正常工作。对于任何拍摄社交视频的人来说，这都非常方便。 ——卢克·拉森

paras.en: Your laptop probably doesn’t have all the ports you might need. I like this one because it matches a MacBook pretty nicely, and provides nine ports in one, providing everything from hard-wired Ethernet to an HDMI to support an external 4K display. It’s useful enough to just leave on your desk or toss in your bag on trips. The peace of mind of knowing you won’t run ever be caught off guard without the port you need is priceless.—Luke Larsen
paras.zh: 您的笔记本电脑可能没有您可能需要的所有端口。我喜欢这个，因为它与 MacBook 非常匹配，并且提供九个端口合一，提供从硬连线以太网到 HDMI 的一切，以支持外部 4K 显示器。它非常有用，只需放在办公桌上或在旅行时扔进包里即可。知道自己不会在没有所需端口的情况下措手不及，这种安心是无价的。-卢克·拉森

paras.en: This tri-band Wi-Fi 7 mesh is the best subscription-free mesh system for most people. A two-pack will be enough to cover most homes, and each router has two 10-Gbps Ethernet ports, one Gigabit port, and a USB 3.0 port. Asus allows you to tinker with and configure everything and offers comprehensive security software and parental controls at no extra cost (you can even redeem a free year of NordVPN service with this mesh). Clip the on-page coupon to save. —Simon Hill
paras.zh: 对于大多数人来说，这款三频 Wi-Fi 7 网格是最好的免订阅网格系统。两件装就足以覆盖大多数家庭，每个路由器都有两个 10 Gbps 以太网端口、一个千兆位端口和一个 USB 3.0 端口。华硕允许您修补和配置所有内容，并提供全面的安全软件和家长控制，无需额外费用（您甚至可以使用此网格兑换一年免费的 NordVPN 服务）。夹住页面优惠券以保存。 ——西蒙·希尔

paras.en: Our current pick for the best Android tablet, the Galaxy Tab S10 FE comes in cheaper than the iPad despite having lots of advanced features. Most notably, it comes with the S Pen stylus bundled in, making it a a great notetaking device to take on the go. —Luke Larsen
paras.zh: 我们目前选择的最佳 Android 平板电脑 Galaxy Tab S10 FE 尽管具有许多高级功能，但其价格比 iPad 便宜。最值得注意的是，它配备了 S Pen 手写笔，使其成为一款适合随身携带的出色笔记设备。 ——卢克·拉森

paras.en: This soundbar plus subwoofer is a fantastic way to upgrade your TV audio system for a reasonable price, especially at 25 percent off. The Polk Signa S4 is one of our favorite soundbars for that very reason: It’s simple, easy to use, sounds great, and doesn’t cost an arm and a leg. Sure, it doesn’t have more advanced features like Wi-Fi connectivity, voice assistant support, or multi-speaker surround sound. But if you’re coming from built-in TV speakers, this is a great first upgrade. —Harry Rabinowitz
paras.zh: 这款条形音箱加低音炮是以合理的价格升级您的电视音频系统的绝佳方式，尤其是 25% 的折扣。 Polk Signa S4 是我们最喜欢的条形音箱之一，原因如下：它简单、易于使用、听起来很棒，而且价格低廉。当然，它没有 Wi-Fi 连接、语音助手支持或多扬声器环绕声等更高级的功能。但如果您使用的是内置电视扬声器，那么这是一次很棒的首次升级。 ——哈里·拉比诺维茨

paras.en: The best Samsung phones are on sale. If you want an Android phone with real power, but prefer something that’s not too big, the Samsung Galaxy S26 is tough to beat. It’s fast, has a bright and sharp screen, a reliable triple-camera system, and good battery life. You also get seven years of software support, and the base model has jumped to 256 GB of storage. This has been cheaper, but with prices on the rise across the market, I’m not sure when it will dip again. This is still a decent discount. —Simon Hill
paras.zh: 最好的三星手机正在促销。如果您想要一款功能强大的 Android 手机，但又喜欢不太大的手机，那么三星 Galaxy S26 是您的最佳选择。它速度快、屏幕明亮、锐利、可靠的三摄像头系统以及良好的电池续航时间。您还可以获得七年的软件支持，基本型号的存储空间已跃升至 256 GB。这已经更便宜了，但随着市场价格的上涨，我不确定什么时候会再次下跌。这还是一个不错的折扣。 ——西蒙·希尔

paras.en: The Google Pixel 11 is the value sweet spot in Google’s new lineup, especially with this hefty discount. It combines a great camera, strong battery life, and solid performance with Qi2 25W support and slick contextual AI features. —Simon Hill
paras.zh: 谷歌 Pixel 11 是谷歌新产品系列中性价比最高的一款，尤其是在如此大的折扣下。它结合了出色的摄像头、强大的电池续航时间、稳定的性能以及 Qi2 25W 支持和流畅的上下文 AI 功能。 ——西蒙·希尔

paras.en: My all-time favorite robot vacuum is often on sale, but this is the lowest the price it ever goes (and used to only go as low as $800, so don't miss it!) The Shark PowerDetect UV Reveal uses a UV light to spot stains and spills on your floor and will go back to scrub them away after doing its regular clean. It's the smartest one I've tried in 2026 by a long shot, and little announcements from the base station make it easy to know when the vacuum is just cleaning versus handling stains. —Nena Farrell
paras.zh: 我一直以来最喜欢的机器人真空吸尘器经常打折，但这是它有史以来的最低价格（以前只低至 800 美元，所以不要错过它！） Shark PowerDetect UV Reveal 使用紫外线来发现地板上的污渍和溢出物，并在定期清洁后返回将它们擦掉。这是我在 2026 年尝试过的最聪明的一款，基站发出的小通知让我很容易知道吸尘器何时只是在清洁，什么时候在处理污渍。 ——妮娜·法雷尔

paras.en: Roborock has been launching new robot vacuums left and right, particularly in its more affordable Qrevo line, and one of the best we've tested is the Qrevo Curv 2 Flow. It's a great vacuum with a roller mop and 20,000 Pa of suction, and its little base station feels sleek and painless to add to your home. —Nena Farrell
paras.zh: Roborock 一直在左右推出新的机器人真空吸尘器，特别是在其更实惠的 Qrevo 系列中，我们测试过的最好的产品之一是 Qrevo Curv 2 Flow。它是一款出色的真空吸尘器，配有滚筒拖把和 20,000 Pa 的吸力，其小型底座感觉时尚且轻松，可轻松添加到您的家中。 ——妮娜·法雷尔

paras.en: I usually see a lot of Dyson vacuums on sale during events like these, and the slightly older Dyson V15 is often one of them. Now that there are newer models, the V15's sale price is just under $600, and it's a good price for a Dyson vacuum that comes with both a hard floor and all-floor cleaner head, plus a crevice tool. There's an LCD screen too, which you won't find on Dyson's new, more affordable models. —Nena Farrell
paras.zh: 我通常会在此类活动中看到很多戴森吸尘器打折，稍旧的戴森 V15 往往就是其中之一。现在有了更新的型号，V15 的售价略低于 600 美元，对于配备硬地板和全地板清洁头以及缝隙吸嘴的戴森吸尘器来说，这是一个不错的价格。还有液晶显示屏，这是戴森新的、更实惠的型号上找不到的。 ——妮娜·法雷尔

paras.en: Why settle for a dull black brick when you can snag translucent tech that looks like it came from a Cyberpunk world? This isn’t just the best-looking power bank, it’s also functionally awesome. It can supply up to 170 watts, has an ample 24,000-mAh capacity, and scores an IP66 rating for water resistance, meaning there’s no need to worry about rain. —Simon Hill
paras.zh: 当你能获得看起来像是来自赛博朋克世界的半透明技术时，为什么要选择暗淡的黑砖呢？这不仅是外观最好的移动电源，而且功能也很棒。它的供电功率高达 170 瓦，拥有 24,000 mAh 的充足容量，并获得 IP66 防水等级，这意味着无需担心雨水。 ——西蒙·希尔

paras.en: The Smartish Side Hustle is one of our favorite MagSafe wallets. These kinds of wallets can be tricky to use in daily life, but this wallet is designed to pop cards out for you, saving time at the register. This price is the best we've tracked. —Louryn Strampe
paras.zh: Smartish Side Hustle 是我们最喜欢的 MagSafe 钱包之一。这些类型的钱包在日常生活中使用起来可能很棘手，但这款钱包的设计可以为您弹出卡片，从而节省收银时间。这个价格是我们追踪过的最好价格。 ——卢琳·斯特兰普

paras.en: An affordable OLED TV is rare, but this newly launched model from Sony is an exception during this sale. It's Sony's entry-level OLED TV, and while it might have fewer bells and whistles than the Sony Bravia 8 II, it's far easier on your wallet and still delivers a rich picture with deep black tones and excellent color contrast. It also has Google Gemini built in, which you can use to control the picture, change settings, flip inputs, and ask about obscure sci-fi movies from the ’70s. —John Brandon
paras.zh: 价格实惠的 OLED 电视很少见，但索尼新推出的这款电视在本次促销中是个例外。它是索尼的入门级 OLED 电视，虽然它可能比索尼 Bravia 8 II 少了一些花哨的功能，但它更便宜，而且仍然提供具有深黑色调和出色色彩对比度的丰富图像。它还内置了 Google Gemini，您可以用它来控制图像、更改设置、翻转输入以及询问 70 年代晦涩的科幻电影。 ——约翰·布兰登

paras.en: This screen-free play stage and speaker for kids is enormous fun. Simply slot one of the wooden cartridges in the top and pop wooden character pieces on the circular soundstage, divided into four sections, to change the audio it plays. This basic functionality allows for a clever variety of themed add-on packs, including classical music and a cooking game.
paras.zh: 这个无屏幕的儿童游戏舞台和扬声器非常有趣。只需将其中一个木制唱头插入顶部，然后在圆形音场上弹出木制角色部件（分为四个部分），即可更改其播放的音频。这一基本功能允许巧妙地添加各种主题附加包，包括古典音乐和烹饪游戏。

paras.en: If you’re looking to cut down on food waste but don’t want to deal with smelly compost containers and mess, FoodCycler 3 is one of my top picks for this purpose. Put your peels, cores, and wilted herbs into the included 3.5-liter countertop bucket; when it’s full, seat it right in the machine, which will then grind and dry your scraps to a fine powder. You can then top-dress your lawn with the resultant “Foodilizer,” put it in your yard waste bin, or even mix it with soil (1:10 ratio) to use in your garden. —Kat Merck
paras.zh: 如果您想减少食物浪费，但又不想处理堆肥容器的臭味和混乱，那么 FoodCycler 3 是我为此目的的首选之一。将果皮、果核和枯萎的香草放入随附的 3.5 升台面桶中；当它装满时，将其直接放入机器中，然后机器会将您的废料研磨并干燥成细粉。然后，您可以用所得的“Foodilizer”对草坪进行追肥，将其放入院子的垃圾桶中，甚至与土壤（1:10 的比例）混合以在花园中使用。 ——凯特·默克

paras.en: My parents bought this bread machine years ago because it was one of the only models with a ceramic pan and no suspicious nonstick coatings. They handed it down to me, and I still have it. It works flawlessly, turning out ball-shaped 1-, 1.5-, or 2-lb. loaves. It doesn’t have as much versatility as higher-end machines like the Zojirushi Virtuoso, which does a better job with specialty breads, but if you’re interested in making your own basic, preservative-free loaves without having to mess with starters, kneading, and all-day rising schedules, this machine is the best value out there. —Kat Merck
paras.zh: 我的父母几年前买了这台面包机，因为它是唯一带有陶瓷锅且没有可疑不粘涂层的型号之一。他们把它传给了我，我仍然保留着它。它工作完美，可生产 1 磅、1.5 磅或 2 磅的球形。面包。它不像象印 Virtuoso 这样的高端机器具有那么多的多功能性，象印 Virtuoso 在制作特色面包方面做得更好，但如果你有兴趣制作自己的基本、不含防腐剂的面包，而不必搞乱开胃菜、揉捏和全天发酵时间表，那么这台机器是最有价值的。 ——凯特·默克

paras.en: The Solo Stove Pi Prime is an excellent pizza oven, with an elegant and functional design that is more round than oval. It's propane-powered and has solid wind shielding, and it won't take up too much space in your backyard. —Louryn Strampe
paras.zh: Solo Stove Pi Prime 是一款出色的披萨烤箱，采用优雅且实用的设计，圆形多于椭圆形。它由丙烷驱动，具有坚固的防风罩，并且不会在您的后院占用太多空间。 ——卢琳·斯特兰普

paras.en: This is a solid deal on the best automatic latte and cappuccino maker we've tested. The Rivelia is user-friendly and easy to use, and it even has a built-in milk frother in addition to the grinder. We also like the touchscreen display and consistently tasty results. —Louryn Strampe
paras.zh: 对于我们测试过的最好的自动拿铁和卡布奇诺咖啡机来说，这是一笔划算的交易。 Rivelia 界面友好且易于使用，除了研磨机之外，它甚至还配有内置奶泡器。我们还喜欢触摸屏显示屏和始终如一的美味结果。 ——卢琳·斯特兰普

paras.en: Athletic Greens has a newer formula with a few additional ingredients, but the Classic formula is cheaper than we've seen before. This brand doesn't go on sale often. I noticed smoother digestion and higher energy levels when I tested this greens powder, which can be a beneficial way to supplement your diet in addition to whole fruits and veggies. —Louryn Strampe
paras.zh: Athletic Greens 有一个更新的配方，添加了一些额外的成分，但经典配方比我们以前见过的更便宜。这个牌子不经常打折。当我测试这种绿色粉末时，我注意到消化更顺畅，能量水平更高，除了完整的水果和蔬菜之外，这也是补充饮食的有益方式。 ——卢琳·斯特兰普

paras.en: I've tried many mobile gaming controllers, and the Backbone One remains the best. It feels great, it's fast and tactile, and the app makes finding new games easy. This price comes within $5 of the best we've seen. —Louryn Strampe
paras.zh: 我尝试过很多移动游戏控制器，Backbone One 仍然是最好的。感觉很棒，速度快且有触觉，而且该应用程序使寻找新游戏变得容易。这个价格与我们见过的最好价格相差不到 5 美元。 ——卢琳·斯特兰普

paras.en: In the world of PC gaming, this keyboard truly qualifies as a classic. It’s a few years old at this point, but this wireless, mechanical gaming keyboard is extremely balanced and well-made. The tenkeyless layout gives you everything you need without overtaking your desk (or getting in the way of your mouse hand), and the design has some flash without overdoing it. —Luke Larsen
paras.zh: 在电脑游戏领域，这款键盘确实堪称经典。虽然它已经有几年的历史了，但这款无线机械游戏键盘非常平衡且制作精良。无钥匙布局为您提供所需的一切，而不会占用您的办公桌（或妨碍您的鼠标手），并且设计有一些闪光但不过分。 ——卢克·拉森

paras.en: The Steelcase Gesture is our recommendation for a premium office chair. If you want something that feels a little more luxurious and cushy, it's a very safe bet. It still has several elegant points of adjustment and the foam seat is plush and comfortable. —Louryn Strampe
paras.zh: Steelcase Gesture 是我们推荐的优质办公椅。如果您想要感觉更奢华、更舒适的东西，这是一个非常安全的选择。它仍然有几个优雅的调节点，泡沫座椅柔软舒适。 ——卢琳·斯特兰普

paras.en: The wee little Lit Hero is GoPro's smallest, lightest, cheapest action camera. It's my favorite GoPro for selfies thanks to the included light. The cluster of four LEDs next to the lens ensures this camera keeps you well-lit in every scene. The Lit Hero isn't quite as capable video-wise as the Hero 13 Black (also on sale, see below), but it can shoot 4K at 60 fps, and the battery held up for a respectable 101 minutes during my test (shooting a 4K 60 fps video). —Scott Gilbertson
paras.zh: 小巧的 Lit Hero 是 GoPro 最小、最轻、最便宜的运动相机。由于附带的灯，它是我最喜欢的自拍 GoPro。镜头旁边的四个 LED 灯组确保这款相机在每个场景中都能保持良好的照明。 Lit Hero 在视频方面的能力不如 Hero 13 Black（也在销售，见下文），但它可以以 60 fps 拍摄 4K，并且在我的测试中（拍摄 4K 60 fps 视频），电池续航时间长达 101 分钟。 ——斯科特·吉尔伯森

paras.en: The Theragun Relief is our budget Theragun pick, and during Prime Day, it’s an even cheaper buy. It’s an older 2023 model, but massage guns don’t need the latest features to be effective. You get three attachments and three speed settings, and it’s half the weight of the Pro Plus, making it much easier to pack for travel. I’ve seen the price drop even lower, but $120 is still a solid discount on one of our favorite percussive guns. —Boutayna Chokrane
paras.zh: Theragun Relief 是我们在 Theragun 的预算之选，在 Prime Day 期间，它的价格甚至更便宜。这是 2023 年的较旧型号，但按摩枪不需要最新功能即可发挥作用。您可以获得三个附件和三种速度设置，而且它的重量是 Pro Plus 的一半，使其更容易打包旅行。我见过价格降得更低，但对于我们最喜欢的一款冲击枪来说，120 美元仍然是一个不错的折扣。 ——布泰纳·乔克兰

paras.en: The Theragun Mini Plus is our favorite portable massage gun. It’s not only compact and TSA-approved, but it also features heat therapy. At $238, it’s at the lowest price I’ve seen, making this the ideal time to snag one if you were considering it. The Mini Plus is also compatible with the Cold Plus and Vibration Plus attachments, which are both sold separately. —Boutayna Chokrane
paras.zh: Theragun Mini Plus 是我们最喜欢的便携式按摩枪。它不仅结构紧凑且获得 TSA 批准，而且还具有热疗功能。售价 238 美元，是我见过的最低价格，如果你正在考虑的话，现在是入手的理想时机。 Mini Plus 还与 Cold Plus 和 Vibration Plus 附件兼容，这两种附件均单独出售。 ——布泰纳·乔克兰

paras.en: Already the most affordable Apple Watch in the lineup, the SE 3 is the sleeper hit of the Apple Watch lineup. It's the most affordable (even more so on sale), yet it has many of the same day-to-day features of its pricier siblings, including an always on display, health and fitness tracking, and seamless syncing with your iPhone. —Harry Rabinowitz
paras.zh: SE 3 已经是 Apple Watch 系列中最实惠的一款，也是 Apple Watch 系列中的热门产品。它是最实惠的（打折时更是如此），但它具有许多与价格较高的兄弟产品相同的日常功能，包括始终显示、健康和健身跟踪以及与 iPhone 无缝同步。 ——哈里·拉比诺维茨

paras.en: Smart scales can be tough to justify when they cost hundreds of dollars, but $69 off makes our top pick even easier to recommend. The Withings Body Comp is among the most advanced smart scales we’ve tested, with a companion app that can track data for up to eight users. It’s also meant to last a lifetime; WIRED reviewer Christopher Null has Withings info dating back to 2010 and plans to keep the streak going. —Boutayna Chokrane
paras.zh: 智能秤售价数百美元，很难证明其合理性，但 69 美元的折扣让我们的首选产品更容易推荐。 Withings Body Comp 是我们测试过的最先进的智能体重秤之一，其配套应用程序可以跟踪最多八个用户的数据。它也意味着可以持续一生； 《连线》评论员 Christopher Null 拥有可追溯到 2010 年的 Withings 信息，并计划继续保持这一势头。 ——布泰纳·乔克兰

paras.en: WIRED contributing reviewer Christopher Null has tried a lot of pool-cleaning robots, and this is his favorite. It offers flawless cleaning of your floors, walls, and waterline, plus an app and a battery with six hours of charge underwater. It also floats when it’s done, so you don’t have to fish it up from the bottom. The only downside—aside from its heft—is the price, but this is a genuinely good sale, so worth snagging at this price if you’ve been considering it. —Kat Merck
paras.zh: 《连线》特约评论员 Christopher Null 尝试过很多泳池清洁机器人，而这是他最喜欢的。它可以完美清洁您的地板、墙壁和水线，并配有应用程序和可在水下充电 6 小时的电池。完成后它也会浮在水面上，所以你不必把它从水底捞上来。除了它的重量之外，唯一的缺点是价格，但这确实是一次很好的销售，所以如果您一直在考虑的话，那么值得以这个价格购买。 ——凯特·默克

paras.en: As someone who’s tested dozens of sets of packing cubes, I believe these to be the best you can buy on Amazon. Compression, label windows, lots of color options, breathability, privacy—this six-piece set has it all. This particular package gets you four rectangular cubes with handles, plus a shoe bag and double-open drawstring bag for dirty clothes or bulkier items. Everything you need for fitting the maximum amount in your carry-on. —Kat Merck
paras.zh: 作为测试过数十套包装立方体的人，我相信这些是您可以在亚马逊上购买的最好的。压缩、标签窗、多种颜色选择、透气性、隐私性——这套六件套拥有一切。这个特殊的包装为您提供四个带手柄的矩形立方体，再加上一个鞋袋和一个双开抽绳袋，用于存放脏衣服或大件物品。满足您随身携带的最大数量所需的一切。 ——凯特·默克

paras.en: If you’re looking for the most reliable smart bird feeder at the best price, you won’t do better than Birdfy’s original plastic feeder. Birdfy recently surpassed 1 million units sold and continues to advance its app with new features, including the ability to identify multiple birds on a feeder at once. The plastic feeder body comes with blue or yellow accents and is a bit lightweight, so you’ll want to make sure to mount it away from squirrels who could damage it. This model comes with an auxiliary solar panel and has no paywalled subscription features, so you won’t have to stress about hidden post-purchase fees. —Kat Merck
paras.zh: 如果您正在寻找最可靠、价格最优惠的智能喂鸟器，那么 Birdfy 原装塑料喂鸟器是您的最佳选择。 Birdfy 最近销量超过 100 万台，并继续以新功能推进其应用程序，包括同时识别喂食器上的多只鸟的能力。塑料喂食器主体带有蓝色或黄色装饰，并且有点轻，因此您需要确保将其安装在远离可能损坏它的松鼠的地方。该型号配有辅助太阳能电池板，并且没有付费订阅功能，因此您不必担心隐藏的购买后费用。 ——凯特·默克

paras.en: One of my favorite products I tested this year, this smart nesting box features a camera both inside and outside, so you can see all the comings and goings of any bird families that decide to move in. Mine had black-capped chickadees, but the Duo comes with different sized holes (and corresponding metal predator guards to prevent chewing) to appeal to different species. You can also raise the floor up or down to change the cavity size. I wouldn’t recommend this in hot climates due to the black-painted side and lack of ventilation, but otherwise it’s a must-buy if you love birds. —Kat Merck
paras.zh: 这款智能巢箱是我今年测试过的我最喜欢的产品之一，它的内部和外部都有摄像头，因此您可以看到决定搬进来的任何鸟类家族的所有来往。我的巢箱中有黑顶山雀，但 Duo 带有不同大小的孔（以及相应的金属捕食者防护装置，以防止咀嚼）以吸引不同的物种。您还可以升高或降低地板来改变空腔尺寸。我不会在炎热的气候下推荐它，因为它的侧面漆成黑色，而且缺乏通风，但如果你喜欢鸟类，它是必须购买的。 ——凯特·默克

paras.en: If you want to brighten up your holiday season, the Philips Hue Festavia are the best smart Christmas lights you can buy. This 65-foot string is easy to drape on an indoor or outdoor tree (the lights are IP54 rated) and sports 250 tiny LEDs. You can pick any color, animate with twinkly effects, and even tune white to find your preferred color temperature. Cozy and classy, these smart string lights can be scheduled with different colors or effects for different times of day, paired with other Hue lights, or synced with music. —Simon Hill
paras.zh: 如果您想照亮您的假期，飞利浦 Hue Festavia 是您可以购买的最佳智能圣诞灯。这根 65 英尺长的灯串很容易挂在室内或室外的树上（灯的防护等级为 IP54），并配有 250 个微型 LED。您可以选择任何颜色，使用闪烁效果制作动画，甚至可以调整白色以找到您喜欢的色温。这些智能灯串舒适而优雅，可以在一天中的不同时间安排不同的颜色或效果，与其他 Hue 灯配对，或与音乐同步。 ——西蒙·希尔

articles.title: The Best Prime Day Apple Deals (2026) Are About to Expire
articles.author: Louryn Strampe

paras.en: Amazon Prime Day is one of the easiest times of year to save on Apple devices. Many Apple gadgets go on sale often, but Prime Day Apple deals frequently drop prices down to as low as we’ve seen—if not exceeding previous best discounts entirely.
paras.zh: 亚马逊 Prime Day 是一年中购买 Apple 设备最容易省钱的时段之一。许多苹果产品经常打折，但苹果会员日促销活动经常将价格降到我们所见过的最低水平——如果没有完全超过之前的最佳折扣的话。

paras.en: You won’t find deals on the brand-new iPhone, but if you’re shopping for AirPods, Apple Watches, iPads, MacBooks, and third-party accessories, you’re in the right spot. But only hours remain as Prime Day comes to a close, so jump on it quick.
paras.zh: 您找不到全新 iPhone 的促销信息，但如果您要购买 AirPods、Apple Watch、iPad、MacBook 和第三方配件，那么您来对地方了。但随着 Prime Day 即将结束，只剩下几个小时了，所以赶快行动吧。

paras.en: For more savings, be sure to check out all the Absolute Best Prime Day Deals we've found so far.
paras.zh: 为了获得更多优惠，请务必查看我们迄今为止发现的所有绝对最佳 Prime Day 优惠。

paras.en: - The AirPods deal you’ve been waiting for: AirPods Pro 3 for $179 ($70 off)
paras.zh: - 您一直在等待的 AirPods 优惠：AirPods Pro 3 仅需 179 美元（立减 70 美元）

paras.en: - The best MacBook deal: MacBook Air M5 for $1,099 ($200 off)
paras.zh: - MacBook 最佳优惠：MacBook Air M5 仅需 1,099 美元（优惠 200 美元）

paras.en: - The best impulse buy: Anker Nano Power Bank for $20 ($7 off)
paras.zh: - 最佳冲动购买：Anker Nano Power Bank 售价 20 美元（优惠 7 美元）

paras.en: - The best mobile controller for your iPhone: Backbone One for $64 ($16 off)
paras.zh: - 最适合 iPhone 的移动控制器：Backbone One 售价 64 美元（优惠 16 美元）

paras.en: - The best MagSafe wallet: Smartish Side Hustle Wallet for $23 ($12 off)
paras.zh: - 最好的 MagSafe 钱包：Smartish Side Hustle 钱包，售价 23 美元（优惠 12 美元）

paras.en: The Apple AirPods Pro 3 are the best wireless earbuds for iPhone users. They fall to this price quite frequently, but WIRED readers continually purchase them, and this deal is still better than paying full price. They have detailed sound, great noise cancellation and transparency modes, a built-in heart rate sensor, and live translation.
paras.zh: Apple AirPods Pro 3 是 iPhone 用户的最佳无线耳机。它们经常跌至这个价格，但《连线》杂志的读者不断购买它们，这笔交易仍然比支付全价更好。它们具有细腻的声音、出色的降噪和透明模式、内置心率传感器和实时翻译。

paras.en: The AirPods Max 2 are sleek, stylish, and on sale for a match of the second-best deal we've seen. They've dropped to $399 a couple of times, but this deal is still worth considering if these are the headphones you want. The battery life could be better, and we wish there were custom EQ options, but we like them overall.
