articles.title: LMT Group and Novaspace partner to develop strategy for 5G/6G satellite communications hub in Latvia
articles.author: Novaspace

paras.en: Noordwijk, the Netherlands | September 22, 2026 – During the international Industry Space Days 2026 event at the European Space Agency’s ESTEC facility in Noordwijk, the Netherlands, the Latvian Mobile Telephone (LMT) Group and the globally leading space consultancy Novaspace signed a cooperation agreement on the development of a concept for telecommunications innovation platform for Latvia to link the national connectivity sector with the international satellite industry. The initiative follows the successful ESA 5G/6G Non-Terrestrial Network Hub model and will explore Latvia’s potential role within this network.
paras.zh: 荷兰诺德韦克 | 2026 年 9 月 22 日 – 在欧洲航天局位于荷兰诺德韦克的 ESTEC 设施举行的 2026 年国际工业航天日活动期间，拉脱维亚移动电话 (LMT) 集团和全球领先的航天咨询公司 Novaspace 签署了一项合作协议，为拉脱维亚开发电信创新平台概念，以将国家连接部门与国际卫星行业连接起来。该举措遵循成功的 ESA 5G/6G 非地面网络中心模型，并将探索拉脱维亚在该网络中的潜在作用。

paras.en: Signing the agreement marks a pivotal step toward creating a hub for developing an internationally competitive telecommunications sector in Latvia. The hub will strategically bring LMT into the space industry and impact the emergence of a wider Latvia’s space innovation ecosystem in next-generation satellite technologies, products, and services tailored to commercial applications, resilient critical infrastructure, security, digitalization and green transition. Essentially, the hub will attract national and international cooperation, funding and talent.
paras.zh: 该协议的签署标志着拉脱维亚在创建一个发展具有国际竞争力的电信行业的中心方面迈出了关键一步。该中心将战略性地将 LMT 引入航天工业，并影响拉脱维亚更广泛的航天创新生态系统的出现，包括针对商业应用、弹性关键基础设施、安全、数字化和绿色转型量身定制的下一代卫星技术、产品和服务。从本质上讲，该中心将吸引国内和国际合作、资金和人才。

paras.en: The next generation of mobile communications is closely linked to the rapid growth of the space economy globally. The space infrastructure is already gradually enhancing terrestrial networks, and the 6G era of telecommunications will seamlessly link terrestrial and non-terrestrial networks. The rationale for such development is efficient and resilient connectivity, especially essential in scenarios involving severe weather, power outages or physical infrastructure disruptions.
paras.zh: 下一代移动通信与全球航天经济的快速增长密切相关。太空基础设施已经在逐步增强地面网络，电信的6G时代将无缝连接地面和非地面网络。这种开发的理由是高效且有弹性的连接，在涉及恶劣天气、停电或物理基础设施中断的情况下尤其重要。

paras.en: This initiative builds upon LMT Group’s strategic expansion of its track record in connectivity innovation. LMT is already collaborating with ESA and satellite operator Sateliot to pioneer energy efficient dual-mode satellite Internet of Things (IoT) connectivity, enabled by Latvia’s associate membership in ESA. The hardware and software to be developed will cover the current market gap in devices that can seamlessly switch between terrestrial and satellite networks. The planned 5G/6G NTN hub is a natural next step in scaling LMT’s technological footprint within Europe’s space ecosystem.
paras.zh: 这一举措建立在 LMT 集团对其连接创新业绩进行战略扩展的基础上。 LMT 已经与 ESA 和卫星运营商 Sateliot 合作，在拉脱维亚作为 ESA 准会员的支持下，率先推出节能双模卫星物联网 (IoT) 连接。即将开发的硬件和软件将弥补目前可在地面和卫星网络之间无缝切换的设备的市场空白。计划中的 5G/6G NTN 中心是扩大 LMT 在欧洲太空生态系统中技术足迹的自然下一步。

paras.en: “LMT has long evolved beyond traditional mobile operations into a full-scale technology innovator. As we prepare for the 6G era, integrating satellite communications into our infrastructure and service portfolio is essential. Our goal is to ensure resilient, secure communications for new commercial services and for critical infrastructure under any circumstances, to produce exportable space technologies and develop services that contribute to digitalization and green transition. Partnering with Novaspace will allow us to define Latvia’s unique value proposition within the European space ecosystem and expand local high-tech expertise,” Ingmārs Pūķis, VP & Member of the Management Board at LMT.
paras.zh: “LMT 早已超越传统的移动运营，成为全面的技术创新者。在我们为 6G 时代做准备时，将卫星通信集成到我们的基础设施和服务组合中至关重要。我们的目标是确保在任何情况下为新的商业服务和关键基础设施提供弹性、安全的通信，以生产可出口的空间技术并开发有助于数字化和绿色转型的服务。与 Novaspace 的合作将使我们能够在欧洲空间生态系统中定义拉脱维亚的独特价值主张，并扩展当地的高科技专业知识。” Ingmārs Pūķis，LMT 副总裁兼管理委员会成员。

paras.en: The agreement was signed under the EU-funded FIERCE Ecosystem Building Programme, in which LMT participates as an innovation intermediary and Novaspace provides strategic support and space-market expertise. Through the programme, Novaspace will work directly with LMT to define and validate the concept, guiding LMT towards a Latvian 5G/6G terrestrial and non-terrestrial network (TN/NTN) hub. The joint effort will focus on identifying Latvia’s distinctive regional value proposition and connecting the future hub with the wider European 5G/6G and NTN ecosystem, rather than replicating existing European initiatives.
paras.zh: 该协议是在欧盟资助的 FIERCE 生态系统建设计划下签署的，LMT 作为创新中介参与其中，Novaspace 提供战略支持和太空市场专业知识。通过该计划，Novaspace 将直接与 LMT 合作定义和验证这一概念，指导 LMT 建设拉脱维亚 5G/6G 地面和非地面网络 (TN/NTN) 中心。此次共同努力将侧重于确定拉脱维亚独特的区域价值主张，并将未来的枢纽与更广泛的欧洲 5G/6G 和 NTN 生态系统连接起来，而不是复制现有的欧洲举措。

paras.en: “At Novaspace, we are delighted to partner with LMT Group through the FIERCE project. The strength of Europe’s space sector depends on active participation across all Member States, and Latvia is well positioned both to benefit from and contribute to Europe’s growing space economy. Flagship European programmes such as Copernicus, Galileo, EGNOS and IRIS² are creating new opportunities for innovation, resilient connectivity and commercial growth. Drawing on Novaspace’s global market expertise, we look forward to supporting LMT in defining a distinctive role for Latvia within Europe’s 5G/6G and non-terrestrial network ecosystem,” Gabrielle Brophy, Senior Manager at Novaspace.
paras.zh: “在 Novaspace，我们很高兴通过 FIERCE 项目与 LMT 集团合作。欧洲航天领域的实力取决于所有成员国的积极参与，而拉脱维亚处于有利地位，既能从欧洲不断增长的航天经济中受益，又能为欧洲不断增长的航天经济做出贡献。哥白尼、伽利略、EGNOS 和 IRIS² 等欧洲旗舰项目正在为创新、弹性连接和商业增长创造新的机会。利用 Novaspace 的全球市场专业知识，我们期待支持 LMT 定义一个独特的Novaspace 高级经理 Gabrielle Brophy 表示：“拉脱维亚在欧洲 5G/6G 和非地面网络生态系统中发挥着重要作用。”

paras.en: The planned hub will be developed together with research and industry partners in the region. This collaborative framework will help retain and grow specialized engineering and scientific competencies in the Baltic region.
paras.zh: 规划中的中心将与该地区的研究和行业合作伙伴共同开发。这一合作框架将有助于保留和发展波罗的海地区的专业工程和科学能力。

paras.en: The signing ceremony in Noordwijk was attended by representatives of the European Space Agency, Novaspace, the Latvian embassy in the Netherlands, the Ministry of Education and Science of the Republic of Latvia, the Investment and Development Agency of Latvia, Novaspace in representation of the FIERCE project and LMT.
paras.zh: 欧洲航天局、Novaspace、拉脱维亚驻荷兰大使馆、拉脱维亚共和国教育和科学部、拉脱维亚投资和发展局、代表 FIERCE 项目的 Novaspace 和 LMT 的代表出席了在诺德韦克举行的签字仪式。

articles.title: Agile Space Industries Strengthens Board and Corporate Development to Support Continued Growth
articles.author: Agile Space Industries

paras.en: DURANGO, Colo., Oct. 5, 2026 — Agile Space Industries today announced that Jonathan Baliff has joined its Board of Directors, bringing extensive experience in aerospace, finance, and corporate leadership. His appointment, alongside the addition of Theo Squires as Director of Strategy & Corporate Development, strengthens Agile’s ability to execute its long-term growth strategy, support capital formation, and pursue strategic opportunities as the company continues to scale.
paras.zh: 科罗拉多州杜兰戈，2026 年 10 月 5 日 — Agile Space Industries 今天宣布 Jonathan Baliff 加入其董事会，带来了航空航天、金融和企业领导方面的丰富经验。他的任命以及 Theo Squires 担任战略与企业发展总监的任命，增强了雅居乐执行长期增长战略、支持资本形成以及随着公司规模不断扩大而寻求战略机遇的能力。

paras.en: Agile is entering its next phase with growing opportunities across the commercial and national security space. In particular, the company’s recent selection for the SpaceWERX Strategic Funding Increase (STRATFI) program reflects support for adding the ability to supply complete propulsion subsystems. As Agile expands its capabilities and production capacity, the company is also strengthening the financial and strategic foundation needed to support its long-term objectives.
paras.zh: 敏捷正在进入下一阶段，商业和国家安全领域的机会越来越多。特别是，该公司最近选择的 SpaceWERX 战略资金增加 (STRATFI) 计划反映了对增加提供完整推进子系统的能力的支持。随着敏捷公司扩大其能力和生产能力，该公司也在加强支持其长期目标所需的财务和战略基础。

paras.en: “Agile has built significant momentum, and our next phase of growth requires the financial capability and oversight to match our technical expertise,” said Chris Pearson, CEO of Agile Space Industries. “Jonathan’s experience in aerospace, capital formation and corporate transformation, combined with Theo’s focus on strategy and corporate development, will help us evaluate new opportunities, make strategic investments and position Agile for sustainable, long-term growth.”
paras.zh: Agile Space Industries 首席执行官克里斯·皮尔森 (Chris Pearson) 表示：“敏捷已经建立了强大的势头，我们下一阶段的增长需要与我们的技术专长相匹配的财务能力和监督。” “乔纳森在航空航天、资本形成和企业转型方面的经验，加上西奥对战略和企业发展的关注，将帮助我们评估新的机会，进行战略投资，并为敏捷的可持续、长期增长做好准备。”

paras.en: Jonathan Baliff Joins Board of Directors
paras.zh: 乔纳森·巴利夫 (Jonathan Baliff) 加入董事会

paras.en: Baliff brings extensive experience across aerospace, finance, and corporate leadership. A former U.S. Air Force aviator and engineer, he currently serves as an operating partner at Genesis Park, where he played a central role in the formation and financing of Redwire Corporation and later served as its chief financial officer. He previously served as president and CEO of Bristow Group and held senior leadership positions at NRG Energy and Credit Suisse. His experience raising capital, guiding strategic investments, and leading organizations through periods of growth and transformation will support Agile as the company continues to scale.
paras.zh: 巴利夫在航空航天、金融和企业领导方面拥有丰富的经验。他曾是美国空军飞行员和工程师，目前担任 Genesis Park 的运营合伙人，在 Redwire Corporation 的组建和融资过程中发挥了核心作用，后来担任该公司的首席财务官。他此前曾担任 Bristow Group 总裁兼首席执行官，并在 NRG Energy 和 Credit Suisse 担任高级领导职务。他在筹集资金、指导战略投资以及领导组织经历成长和转型时期的经验将为敏捷公司的不断扩张提供支持。

paras.en: “Agile has proven it has the technology and operational expertise to compete, win, and profitably grow in a rapidly evolving space market,” said Baliff. “Our customers and capital providers will partner with us as we scale Agile’s technology, expand capacity, and efficiently deploy capital to support the company’s growth. I look forward to working with Chris, our proven team and board to help Agile capitalize on the significant opportunities ahead.”
paras.zh: 巴利夫表示：“敏捷已经证明，它拥有在快速发展的太空市场中竞争、获胜并实现盈利增长的技术和运营专业知识。” “我们的客户和资本提供商将与我们合作，扩展 Agile 的技术、扩大产能并有效部署资本，以支持公司的发展。我期待与我们久经考验的团队和董事会 Chris 合作，帮助 Agile 抓住未来的重大机遇。”

paras.en: Expanding Corporate Development to Support Long-Term Strategy
paras.zh: 扩大企业发展以支持长期战略

paras.en: Squires serves as Agile’s Director of Strategy & Corporate Development. Before joining Agile, he served as an intelligence officer in the Royal Australian Navy, where his work included a bilateral space program involving the United States and Australia. He also worked at Boston Consulting Group, advising advanced manufacturing companies on strategy and operations. At Agile, his experience supports capital formation, strategic investments and potential acquisitions of complementary technologies and capabilities to support the company’s broader growth strategy.
paras.zh: Squires 担任 Agile 的战略与企业发展总监。在加入敏捷之前，他曾在澳大利亚皇家海军担任情报官，其工作包括涉​​及美国和澳大利亚的双边太空计划。他还曾在波士顿咨询集团工作，为先进制造公司提供战略和运营方面的咨询。在敏捷，他的经验支持资本形成、战略投资以及互补技术和能力的潜在收购，以支持公司更广泛的增长战略。

paras.en: “Scaling advanced propulsion hardware requires both technical innovation and a disciplined approach to capital investment,” said Squires. “Our focus is on building a financial foundation to support higher-rate production while identifying strategic opportunities that complement Agile’s existing capabilities. We see significant potential to expand what we can offer customers as the space propulsion market continues to evolve.”
paras.zh: “扩展先进的推进硬件需要技术创新和严格的资本投资方法，”斯奎尔斯说。 “我们的重点是建立财务基础以支持更高的生产速度，同时寻找补充敏捷现有能力的战略机会。随着太空推进市场的不断发展，我们看到了扩大我们为客户提供服务的巨大潜力。”

paras.en: As part of the board’s evolution, Tom Rubin is departing Agile’s Board of Directors and will continue to support the company in an advisory capacity.
paras.zh: 作为董事会发展的一部分，汤姆·鲁宾 (Tom Rubin) 将离开敏捷董事会，并将继续以顾问身份为公司提供支持。

paras.en: During his board service, Rubin contributed valuable legal expertise and counsel as Agile navigated a period of significant growth. The company is grateful for his contributions and looks forward to continuing to benefit from his experience and institutional knowledge in his advisory role.
paras.zh: 在担任董事会职务期间，鲁宾为敏捷公司度过了一段显着增长的时期，贡献了宝贵的法律专业知识和建议。该公司感谢他的贡献，并期待继续受益于他在顾问角色中的经验和机构知识。

paras.en: Agile Space Industries develops advanced chemical propulsion solutions that enable spacecraft to move, maneuver, and operate in space. From early concepts to the high-rate production of flight hardware, Agile brings together propulsion expertise, additive manufacturing, and in-house testing to rapidly solve complex challenges and accelerate delivery. Agile partners with leading aerospace companies and the U.S. Government on spacecraft and launch vehicle programs. Learn more at agilespaceindustries.com.
paras.zh: Agile Space Industries 开发先进的化学推进解决方案，使航天器能够在太空中移动、机动和运行。从早期概念到飞行硬件的高速生产，Agile 汇集了推进专业知识、增材制造和内部测试，以快速解决复杂的挑战并加速交付。 Agile 与领先的航空航天公司和美国政府就航天器和运载火箭项目开展合作。请访问agilespaceindustries.com 了解更多信息。

articles.title: Resource competition intensifies with surge in megaconstellations
articles.author: Hope Hodge Seck

paras.en: Amazon wants more than 5,000 satellites in orbit. Blue Origin has proposed another 5,400. Chinese companies have filed plans encompassing vastly more. Elon Musk has talked about a constellation numbering 1 million.
paras.zh: 亚马逊希望在轨卫星数量超过 5,000 颗。 Blue Origin 还提出了另外 5,400 个。中国公司已经提交了包含更多内容的计划。埃隆·马斯克曾谈到过一个数量为 100 万的星座。

paras.en: There is one issue: building all of them.
paras.zh: 有一个问题：建造所有这些。

paras.en: The unprecedented rush to put satellites into low Earth orbit is colliding with shortages of specialized components and materials, suppliers struggling to keep up and competition from the booming artificial intelligence industry. The squeeze is forcing satellite companies to rethink designs, accept delays and confront a more fundamental question about the timelines for what’s possible.
paras.zh: 将卫星送入近地轨道的空前热潮正与专业部件和材料的短缺、供应商的疲软以及蓬勃发展的人工智能行业的竞争相冲突。这种挤压迫使卫星公司重新考虑设计，接受延误，并面对一个更根本的问题，即可能发生的事情的时间表。

paras.en: Competition for scarce resources and supplies amid surging demand is forcing tradeoffs in industry that threaten to delay launches and may push companies out of the market or trigger greater consolidation.
paras.zh: 在需求激增的情况下，对稀缺资源和供应的竞争正在迫使行业进行权衡，这可能会推迟发布，并可能将公司赶出市场或引发更大的整合。

paras.en: “Companies right now are just looking at where they might be able to take additional risk,” said Steve Jordan Tomaszewski, vice president of space systems for the Aerospace Industries Association. He participated in a supply chain analysis with audit firm PricewaterhouseCoopers earlier this year that involved talking to dozens of industry representatives.
paras.zh: 航空航天工业协会太空系统副总裁史蒂夫·乔丹·托马泽斯基 (Steve Jordan Tomaszewski) 表示：“公司现在只是在考虑在哪些方面可以承担额外的风险。”今年早些时候，他参加了审计公司普华永道的供应链分析，其中涉及与数十名行业代表的交谈。

paras.en: Tomaszewski said supply chain challenges have companies looking for “where they can maybe downgrade something to not using a space-qualified component … Maybe they’re okay waiting a year for a certain type of valve because they know that’s going to be something they really have to deliver on.”
paras.zh: Tomaszewski 表示，供应链挑战让公司寻找“他们可以将某些产品降级到不使用符合太空要求的组件……也许他们可以为某种类型的阀门等待一年，因为他们知道这将是他们真正必须交付的东西。”

paras.en: The 54-page analysis isolated nine critical components contributing to supply chain bottlenecks due to an inability to keep up with demand, ranging from valves and actuators to switchgears and transformers. The report incorporated insights from about 30 professionals representing various parts of the satellite supply chain.
paras.zh: 这份长达 54 页的分析列出了由于无法满足需求而导致供应链瓶颈的九个关键组件，从阀门和执行器到开关设备和变压器。该报告融合了代表卫星供应链各个部分的约 30 名专业人士的见解。

paras.en: “We hear from companies that because demand is so high and capacity is not keeping up with demand,” Tomaszewski said. “That’s what’s forcing them to really make some of those hard decisions.”
paras.zh: “我们从公司那里得知，由于需求如此之高，而产能却跟不上需求，”托马泽夫斯基说。 “这就是迫使他们真正做出一些艰难决定的原因。”

paras.en: According to some estimates, the next few years could mean the nearly 19,000 satellites now in LEO joined by 70,000 more. And while analysts who spoke with SpaceNews were, across the board, unwilling to speak to companies’ plans and challenges on the record, they agreed that the coming demand signal will only exacerbate already-felt bottlenecks around limited and necessary resources.
paras.zh: 根据一些估计，未来几年可能意味着近 19,000 颗卫星目前位于近地轨道上，届时将增加 70,000 颗。尽管接受《SpaceNews》采访的分析师普遍不愿公开谈论公司的计划和挑战，但他们一致认为，即将到来的需求信号只会加剧有限和必要资源方面已经存在的瓶颈。

paras.en: As space companies face a ramp-up in competition from Earth-based data centers for the minerals and materials they need to launch megaconstellations, experts say something’s got to give, in the form of delays, industry consolidation, material substitutions or favorable new policies. And, amid increasing global instability, certain industry shocks could be sudden and severe.
paras.zh: 由于航天公司面临着来自地球数据中心对发射巨型星座所需的矿物和材料的激烈竞争，专家表示，必须采取一些措施，例如延迟、行业整合、材料替代或有利的新政策。而且，在全球不稳定因素日益增加的情况下，某些行业冲击可能是突然且严重的。

paras.en: One bottleneck stems from access to the rare earth minerals that are crucial for electronic components.
paras.zh: 一个瓶颈源于对电子元件至关重要的稀土矿物的获取。

paras.en: Carla Filotico, partner and managing director at the European consulting firm Novaspace, told SpaceNews she’s particularly concerned about gallium nitride (GaN) and germanium, two minerals used to build high-efficiency solar cells. For common satellite materials like aluminum, the possibility of running out isn’t much of a concern, she said.
paras.zh: 欧洲咨询公司 Novaspace 的合伙人兼董事总经理 Carla Filotico 告诉 SpaceNews，她特别担心氮化镓 (GaN) 和锗，这两种用于制造高效太阳能电池的矿物。她说，对于铝等常见卫星材料来说，用完的可能性并不大。

paras.en: “If we assume an average of 500 kilos of mass per satellite, and we make a pure calculation of the amount of aluminum necessary, we can say that, from the primary aluminum production that is currently quite large globally, this space sector is still a niche,” Filotico said.
paras.zh: 菲洛蒂科说：“如果我们假设每颗卫星的平均质量为 500 公斤，并纯粹计算所需的铝量，我们可以说，从目前全球相当大的原铝产量来看，这个航天领域仍然是一个利基市场。”

paras.en: Space applications make up a few percent of the market demand for GaN, on the other hand, and China’s chokehold on production, at around 98%, leaves U.S. and European companies vulnerable, she said. China is also a dominant producer of germanium, for which space applications make up an even larger market share.
paras.zh: 她表示，另一方面，太空应用仅占 GaN 市场需求的几个百分点，而中国对 GaN 产量的控制（约 98%）使美国和欧洲公司处于弱势。中国也是锗的主要生产国，其空间应用占据了更大的市场份额。

paras.en: She added that any restrictions on gallium export could cause a shortage for the space sector that could hit at any time.
paras.zh: 她补充说，对镓出口的任何限制都可能导致航天领域随时可能出现短缺。

paras.en: Even aluminum has become more scarce and costly amid shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz caused by the U.S.-Iran conflict.
paras.zh: 由于美伊冲突导致霍尔木兹海峡航运中断，就连铝也变得更加稀缺和昂贵。

paras.en: “Supply chain resilience has been a topic that has been very popular since COVID, but it’s just accelerated with more and more of these conflicts and disruptions,” said Doug Anderson, a partner at PwC’s Operations and Supply Chain Services practice who collaborated on the joint AIA report on space supply chain bottlenecks, released in March.
paras.zh: 普华永道运营和供应链服务业务合伙人道格·安德森 (Doug Anderson) 表示：“自新冠肺炎疫情以来，供应链弹性一直是一个非常热门的话题，但随着越来越多的冲突和干扰，供应链的弹性正在加速。”他参与撰写了 3 月份发布的美国建筑师协会关于太空供应链瓶颈的联合报告。

paras.en: “The Strait of Hormuz has impacted aluminum, has impacted helium. These are things that are very important for the space supply chain,” he said.
paras.zh: “霍尔木兹海峡影响了铝，也影响了氦。这些对于太空供应链来说非常重要，”他说。

paras.en: It’s a problem with a dangling threat but no clear solution, although the last year has seen efforts to establish new mineral supply pipelines, such as a May 2025 agreement between defense prime RTX and Emirates Global Aluminum to start up gallium production in Abu Dhabi. Filotico said the worst of the resource squeeze is likely to be felt in the next five years, with the planned peak of the new constellation launch wave set to hit by 2030.
paras.zh: 这是一个悬而未决的问题，但没有明确的解决方案，尽管去年人们努力建立新的矿产供应管道，例如国防总理 RTX 与阿联酋全球铝业公司于 2025 年 5 月达成协议，在阿布扎比启动镓生产。 Filotico表示，未来五年可能会感受到最严重的资源紧张，计划中的新星座发射浪潮将在2030年达到峰值。

paras.en: A trade disruption or geopolitical crisis that disrupts access to GaN and germanium “could certainly cause space sector shortage,” Filotico said.
paras.zh: 菲洛蒂科表示，贸易中断或地缘政治危机会扰乱获取 GaN 和锗的渠道，“肯定会导致航天部门短缺”。

paras.en: And megaconstellations, due to the realities of scaling and maintenance, exacerbate the hazard of a sudden disruption to mineral supply. At one to two solar arrays per satellite, a single megaconstellation can easily require 10,000-20,000 solar panels.
paras.zh: 而巨型星座，由于规模和维护的现实，加剧了矿产供应突然中断的危险。每颗卫星配备一到两个太阳能电池阵列，单个巨型星座很容易需要 10,000-20,000 个太阳能电池板。

paras.en: “We are talking about thousands of satellites per company per year at least, because you need to replenish the satellites every four or five years, depending on the orbital height,” Filotico said.
paras.zh: “我们谈论的是每家公司每年至少有数千颗卫星，因为你需要每四到五年补充一次卫星，具体取决于轨道高度，”菲洛蒂科说。

paras.en: The PwC-AIA analysis earlier this year revealed, among other things, that parts shortages are due not only to an inability to move faster and produce more, but also an unwillingness to do so.
paras.zh: 普华永道-友邦保险今年早些时候的分析显示，零部件短缺不仅是因为无法更快地行动和生产更多，而且还因为不愿意这样做。

paras.en: The report described suppliers who were passing up changes to bid on space work, “citing high complexity requirements and low return on effort.” It described one case specifically in which a legacy supplier opted not to rebid on making composite overwrapped pressure vessels, needed to store high pressure gases, because the work would take about one-third of all the available engineering time while only generating “low single-digit revenue.”
paras.zh: 该报告描述了那些放弃太空工作投标变更的供应商，“理由是复杂性要求高，工作回报率低”。它特别描述了一个案例，其中一家传统供应商选择不再重新投标制造需要储存高压气体的复合材料包裹压力容器，因为这项工作将占用所有可用工程时间的大约三分之一，同时只能产生“低个位数的收入”。

paras.en: At the Air Force Association’s Air Space & Cyber conference in September, Gurpartap “GP” Sandhoo, director of the Space Development Agency, said his organization continues to face supply-chain throughput and quality problems as it builds out its missile-tracking and data-transport constellations.
paras.zh: 在 9 月份的空军协会航空航天与网络会议上，太空发展局局长 Gurpartap“GP”Sandhoo 表示，他的组织在建设导弹跟踪和数据传输星座时继续面临供应链吞吐量和质量问题。

paras.en: “We have had a demand signal, but the quality control and being able to produce things at scale has been a challenge,” Sandhoo said.
paras.zh: “我们已经收到了需求信号，但质量控制和大规模生产一直是一个挑战，”桑德胡说。

paras.en: He pointed to optical communications hardware and focal-plane arrays as areas where suppliers have struggled with throughput, as well as the difficulty of manufacturing hardware that can withstand launch.
paras.zh: 他指出，光通信硬件和焦平面阵列是供应商在吞吐量方面苦苦挣扎的领域，以及制造能够承受发射的硬件的难度。

paras.en: Compounding the challenges, Tomaszewski said, are a surfeit of parts pipelines with just one or two suppliers, leading to single points of failure, and new customer competition in the form of AI data centers.
paras.zh: Tomaszewski 表示，只有一两个供应商的零件管道过多，导致单点故障以及人工智能数据中心形式的新客户竞争，这使得挑战更加复杂。

paras.en: Some suppliers are approaching changing buying patterns by designing parts that can scale to perform in both critical and risk-tolerant mission scenarios, Ken Stoler, a space business development lead for Arrow said on SpaceNews’ Space Minds podcast. He argued that a strong supply chain must be resilient and diverse.
paras.zh: Arrow 太空业务开发主管肯·斯托勒 (Ken Stoler) 在 SpaceNews 的 Space Minds 播客中表示，一些供应商正在通过设计可扩展以在关键和风险承受任务场景中执行的零件来改变购买模式。他认为，强大的供应链必须具有弹性和多样性。

paras.en: The demand for data centers has notably increased even in the months since the supply chain report was released, he said, and the builders of those centers may represent a more attractive and profitable customer for suppliers of critical components than satellite constellation-makers. With switchgears and transformers specifically, the report found AI companies were “gobbling these things up at scale” and creating years-long parts backlogs.
paras.zh: 他表示，即使在供应链报告发布后的几个月内，对数据中心的需求也显着增加，对于关键组件供应商来说，这些中心的建设者可能比卫星星座制造商更具吸引力和利润更高。报告发现，特别是开关设备和变压器，人工智能公司正在“大规模吞噬这些东西”，并造成长达数年的零件积压。

paras.en: “For a space company to come in and say, ‘Hey, we want to buy 10 of these for a new factory’ — compare that to … a big artificial intelligence company or data center company buying 10,000 of these things,” Tomaszewski said.
paras.zh: “对于一家航天公司来说，‘嘿，我们想为新工厂购买 10 个这样的东西’——与……一家大型人工智能公司或数据中心公司购买 10,000 个这样的东西相比，”Tomaszewski 说。

paras.en: “The scale of it, even with the surge in space, isn’t big enough to kind of change the trajectory of where those electrical boxes are going.”
paras.zh: “即使空间激增，它的规模也不足以改变这些配电箱的运行轨迹。”

paras.en: A challenge to broader efforts to ensure space companies have what they need to execute on their launch plans is a consistent and continual way to measure available resources, he said. There’s no guarantee, he added, that the nine critical components highlighted in March would still be at the top of the list today, and no simple way to find out.
paras.zh: 他表示，确保航天公司拥有执行发射计划所需资源的更广泛努力所面临的挑战是衡量可用资源的一致且持续的方法。他补充说，不能保证 3 月份强调的九个关键组成部分今天仍然位于列表的首位，而且没有简单的方法可以找出答案。

paras.en: “It’s been the problem with space that there hasn’t been kind of consistent awareness of where those issues are across programs, across you know national security space, civil space and commercial space,” Tomaszewski said.
paras.zh: 托马谢夫斯基说：“太空问题一直存在，人们对这些问题在各个项目、国家安全太空、民用太空和商业太空中的具体位置缺乏一致的认识。”

paras.en: That kind of data could also make it easier to enact policy interventions. For example, Tomaszewski proposes a “skip the line” authority that would allow the space industrial base to get in front of data centers and other competitors for resources.
paras.zh: 此类数据还可以使政策干预措施的实施变得更加容易。例如，托马斯泽夫斯基提出了一种“免排队”权限，允许航天工业基地领先于数据中心和其他竞争对手获取资源。

paras.en: “If we want to deliver on all these great capabilities from space and explore the solar system and beat China, you know, back to the moon, we might need to make sure that space is prioritized amongst all the other national priorities that we have,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“如果我们想从太空发挥所有这些强大的能力，探索太阳系并击败中国，重返月球，我们可能需要确保太空在我们所有其他国家优先事项中占据优先地位。”

paras.en: Tomaszewski said he was encouraged by steps from the federal Office of Space Commerce to allow government and industry players to strategize over supply chain issues and discuss possible regulatory moves that could help.
paras.zh: 托马斯泽夫斯基表示，联邦太空商务办公室采取的措施让他感到鼓舞，这些措施允许政府和行业参与者就供应链问题制定战略，并讨论可能有帮助的监管举措。

paras.en: “One big thing I think really still needs to get figured out is where the belly button is for fixing supply chain issues, especially at different government agencies,” he said. “Supply chain is a challenge because it is everybody’s problem, but it’s also nobody’s problem.”
paras.zh: “我认为真正需要弄清楚的一件大事是解决供应链问题的肚脐在哪里，特别是在不同的政府机构，”他说。 “供应链是一个挑战，因为它是每个人的问题，但也不是任何人的问题。”

paras.en: Another unspoken reality, according to multiple experts, is that some megaconstellation launch plans simply won’t come to fruition, at least not as originally envisioned. Space-watchers expect to see an increase in vertical integration, in which larger companies fold parts of their supply chain into themselves. But they also anticipate industry consolidation, along with some companies dropping out of the market as they find themselves unable to achieve their objectives on their own.
paras.zh: 多位专家表示，另一个不言而喻的现实是，一些巨型星座发射计划根本不会实现，至少不会像最初设想的那样。太空观察家期望看到垂直整合的增加，即大公司将部分供应链纳入自身。但他们也预计行业整合，一些公司会因为发现自己无法实现自己的目标而退出市场。

paras.en: “Ten, 12 years ago, when the applications were submitted with the FCC for constellations of low Earth orbit satellites, no one expected all of them to move forward, and some of them just decided not to move forward with their plans,” said Doug Stroup, president of the Satellite Industry Association. “I suspect that we’ll see some of the same thing happening with respect to the recent round of applications that have been filed.”
paras.zh: 卫星工业协会主席道格·斯特鲁普 (Doug Stroup) 表示：“10 年、12 年前，当向 FCC 提交近地轨道卫星星座申请时，没有人期望所有这些卫星都会向前推进，其中一些只是决定不再推进他们的计划。” “我怀疑我们会在最近一轮提交的申请中看到一些同样的事情发生。”

paras.en: This article first appeared in the October 2026 issue of SpaceNews Magazine.
paras.zh: 本文首次发表于 2026 年 10 月号《太空新闻》杂志。

paras.en: EDITOR’S NOTE: An earlier version of this story misspelled Steve Jordan Tomaszewski. It has been updated.
paras.zh: 编者注：这个故事的早期版本拼写错误了 Steve Jordan Tomaszewski。它已经更新了。

articles.title: NASA’s SpaceX 35th Commercial Resupply Mission Overview
articles.author: Mark A. Garcia

paras.en: NASA and SpaceX are targeting no earlier than Tuesday, Oct. 13 to launch scientific investigations, supplies, and equipment to the International Space Station.
paras.zh: NASA 和 SpaceX 的目标是不早于 10 月 13 日星期二向国际空间站发射科学研究、物资和设备。

paras.en: Loaded with more than 6,300 pounds of supplies, the SpaceX Dragon spacecraft will lift off aboard the company’s Falcon 9 rocket from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida. Following its arrival to the orbital complex, Dragon will autonomously dock to the space-facing port of the space station’s Harmony module.
paras.zh: SpaceX Dragon 飞船装载着超过 6,300 磅的补给品，将搭乘该公司的 Falcon 9 火箭从佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角太空部队站的 40 号航天发射场升空。抵达轨道综合体后，“龙”号将自动对接至空间站和谐舱面向太空的端口。

paras.en: NASA will stream launch and docking coverage through a variety of platforms. Learn where to watch online:
paras.zh: 美国宇航局将通过各种平台直播发射和对接报道。了解在哪里在线观看：

paras.en: For more than 25 years, the International Space Station has supported research by scientists from more than 110 countries, enabling more than 4,000 experiments in microgravity. Research conducted aboard the station helps advance long-duration missions to the Moon as part of the Artemis program and to Mars, while also providing multiple benefits to humanity.
paras.zh: 25 年来，国际空间站支持了来自 110 多个国家的科学家的研究，实现了 4,000 多项微重力实验。在该空间站上进行的研究有助于推进阿耳忒弥斯计划一部分的长期月球任务和火星任务，同时也为人类带来多种好处。

paras.en: In addition to cargo for the crew aboard the space station, Dragon will deliver several new science experiments, including:
paras.zh: 除了为空间站上的宇航员运送货物外，“龙”号还将运送一些新的科学实验，包括：

paras.en: With LambdaVision-1, NASA is testing how to manufacture artificial eye retinas in microgravity, building them one thin layer at a time. Reduced settling in microgravity may create more uniform, stable layers, potentially improving implants’ performance. These artificial retinas could help restore vision for patients with currently incurable retinal diseases on Earth.
paras.zh: NASA 正在通过 LambdaVision-1 测试如何在微重力下制造人造眼视网膜，一次制作一层薄薄的视网膜。减少微重力沉降可能会产生更均匀、稳定的层，从而有可能提高植入物的性能。这些人造视网膜可以帮助地球上患有目前无法治愈的视网膜疾病的患者恢复视力。

paras.en: NASA will use the Stellar Spheroids experiment to study how microgravity affects the growth and function of 3D human heart tissue models. Researchers will assess whether microgravity improves the formation of advanced vascular networks. Results could help researchers develop more realistic heart tissue models for disease research and support larger‑scale drug testing on future space missions.
paras.zh: NASA 将利用恒星球体实验来研究微重力如何影响 3D 人体心脏组织模型的生长和功能。研究人员将评估微重力是否可以改善高级血管网络的形成。研究结果可以帮助研究人员开发更真实的心脏组织模型用于疾病研究，并支持未来太空任务中更大规模的药物测试。

paras.en: Using non-traditional elements, ELF-Unconventional Glass 2 studies how glass forms in microgravity. Researchers will observe molten behavior in space, then return solid samples to Earth for detailed analysis. These unconventional glasses could offer higher strength, improved optical capabilities, and greater durability for spacecraft, habitats, and other exploration technologies.
paras.zh: ELF-Unconventional Glass 2 使用非传统元素研究玻璃在微重力下如何形成。研究人员将观察太空中的熔融行为，然后将固体样本带回地球进行详细分析。这些非常规玻璃可以为航天器、栖息地和其他探索技术提供更高的强度、改进的光学功能和更高的耐用性。

paras.en: The MINDS experiment studies brain organoids to better understand inflammation linked to neurodegenerative diseases. The investigation uses “organoid villages,” which combine cells from multiple people to better represent patient diversity. Results could help identify new treatment targets for diseases like Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, and multiple sclerosis.
paras.zh: MINDS 实验研究大脑类器官，以更好地了解与神经退行性疾病相关的炎症。该调查使用“类器官村”，它将多个人的细胞结合起来，以更好地代表患者的多样性。结果可以帮助确定阿尔茨海默氏症、帕金森氏症和多发性硬化症等疾病的新治疗靶点。

paras.en: NASA astronauts Anil Menon and Jessica Watkins will monitor the Dragon spacecraft’s arrival. It will remain docked to the orbiting laboratory for about a month before splashing down in the Pacific Ocean, returning critical science and hardware to teams on Earth.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局宇航员阿尼尔·梅农和杰西卡·沃特金斯将监测龙飞船的抵达。它将在轨道实验室停留大约一个月，然后落入太平洋，将关键科学和硬件返回给地球上的团队。

paras.en: International Space Station Roll-Out Solar Arrays (IROSA) – The final pair of IROSAs that will be installed on the space station, completing the augmentation of its power system to support critical operations, including its safe and controlled deorbit.
paras.zh: 国际空间站卷出式太阳能电池阵列 (IROSA) – 将安装在空间站上的最后一对 IROSA，完成其电力系统的增强，以支持关键操作，包括安全和受控的脱轨。

paras.en: Collapsible Continency Urinal and supporting hardware – A demonstration and test unit supporting NASA’s Artemis III mission.
paras.zh: 可折叠失禁小便器和支持硬件——支持 NASA 阿尔忒弥斯 III 任务的演示和测试装置。

paras.en: Canadarm2 joint flight support equipment – A large foam clamshell will fly empty to return the failed robotic arm joint that was replaced during a June 30 spacewalk. After its return to Earth, teams will analyze the joint on the ground.
paras.zh: Canadaarm2 联合飞行支持设备——一个大型泡沫蛤壳将空空飞行，以返回在 6 月 30 日太空行走期间更换的故障机械臂关节。返回地球后，团队将在地面上分析接头。

paras.en: Additional equipment launching includes a toilet dose pump, a toilet pretreat quality sensor, and a robot micro-conical tool used for space station maintenance and utilization tasks with external replacement units and payloads.
paras.zh: 发射的其他设备包括厕所剂量泵、厕所预处理质量传感器和机器人微型锥形工具，用于空间站维护和使用任务以及外部更换单元和有效载荷。

paras.en: When Dragon returns in mid‑November, it will bring back the failed joint on the Canadarm2 for analysis and refurbishment, a spacesuit for ground refurbishment, a fluid- and pressure-control pump assembly from the urine processor, and a filtration unit for the water processor assembly.
paras.zh: 当 Dragon 于 11 月中旬返回时，它将带回 Canadaarm2 上出现故障的接头进行分析和翻新、一套用于地面翻新的宇航服、来自尿液处理器的流体和压力控制泵组件以及用于水处理器组件的过滤单元。

articles.title: NASA Sets Coverage for SpaceX 35th Station Resupply Launch, Arrival
articles.author: Lauren E. Low

paras.en: NASA and SpaceX are targeting 6:33 a.m. EDT, Tuesday, Oct. 13, for the next launch to deliver science investigations, supplies, and equipment, including the final set of International Space Station Roll-Out Solar Arrays, to the space station. This is the 35th SpaceX commercial resupply services mission to the orbital complex for NASA.
paras.zh: NASA 和 SpaceX 的目标是美国东部时间 10 月 13 日星期二上午 6:33 进行下一次发射，向空间站运送科学研究、物资和设备，包括最后一套国际空间站滚出式太阳能电池阵列。这是 SpaceX 为 NASA 执行的第 35 次商业补给服务任务。

paras.en: NASA also will host a media teleconference on Thursday, Oct. 8 that will preview the cargo resupply flight, as well as provide a post-splashdown update for the agency’s SpaceX Crew-12 mission, which will have returned to Earth from the space station Thursday morning.
paras.zh: NASA 还将于 10 月 8 日星期四举办媒体电话会议，预览货物补给飞行，并提供该机构 SpaceX Crew-12 任务的溅落后最新信息，该任务将于周四早上从空间站返回地球。

paras.en: Loaded with more than 6,300 pounds of supplies, a SpaceX Dragon spacecraft on a Falcon 9 rocket will lift off from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida. Dragon will dock autonomously around 11 a.m. on Thursday, Oct. 15, to the space-facing port of the station’s Harmony module.
paras.zh: 搭载猎鹰 9 号火箭的 SpaceX Dragon 飞船装载着超过 6,300 磅的补给品，将从佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角太空部队站的 40 号航天发射场升空。 Dragon 将于 10 月 15 日星期四上午 11 点左右自主停靠在空间站 Harmony 模块面向太空的端口。

paras.en: NASA’s live launch and docking coverage will stream through a variety of platforms. Learn where to watch online:
paras.zh: NASA 的现场发射和对接报道将通过各种平台进行直播。了解在哪里在线观看：

paras.en: In addition to the solar arrays, the Dragon spacecraft will deliver hardware to manufacture artificial retinas in microgravity to help restore vision on Earth and 3D heart tissues models to advance large‑scale drug testing on future missions. The spacecraft will carry materials to study how a new type of glass forms in microgravity and brain organoids that could reveal treatment targets for neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, and multiple sclerosis.
paras.zh: 除了太阳能电池阵列之外，龙飞船还将提供硬件来制造微重力下的人造视网膜，以帮助恢复地球上的视力，并提供 3D 心脏组织模型，以推进未来任务中的大规模药物测试。该航天器将携带材料来研究新型玻璃在微重力和大脑类器官中如何形成，从而揭示阿尔茨海默氏症、帕金森氏症和多发性硬化症等神经退行性疾病的治疗目标。

paras.en: The Dragon spacecraft is scheduled to remain at the space station until mid-November when it will depart the orbiting laboratory and return to Earth with time-critical research and cargo, splashing down off the coast of California.
paras.zh: 龙飞船计划在空间站停留到 11 月中旬，届时它将离开轨道实验室，带着时间紧迫的研究成果和货物返回地球，落在加利福尼亚海岸附近。

paras.en: NASA’s mission coverage is as follows (all times Eastern and subject to change based on real-time operations):
paras.zh: NASA 的任务范围如下（所有时间均为东部时间，并可能根据实时操作而变化）：

paras.en: 1:15 p.m.: International Space Station briefing for Crew-12 return, and SpaceX’s 35th Commercial Resupply Services launch with the following participants:
paras.zh: 下午 1:15：国际空间站关于 Crew-12 返回的简报以及 SpaceX 第 35 次商业补给服务发射，参与者如下：

paras.en: - Bill Spetch, deputy manager of Commercial, Low Earth Orbit Program
paras.zh: - Bill Spetch，近地轨道项目商业副经理

paras.en: - Dr. Liz Warren, deputy chief scientist, NASA’s International Space Station Office
paras.zh: - Liz Warren 博士，美国宇航局国际空间站办公室副首席科学家

paras.en: - Lee Echerd, senior mission manager, Customer Operations and Integration, SpaceX
paras.zh: - Lee Echerd，SpaceX 客户运营和集成高级任务经理

paras.en: - Andreas Mogensen, leader, Human Exploration Group, ESA (European Space Agency)
paras.zh: - 安德烈亚斯·摩根森 (Andreas Mogensen)，欧洲航天局 (ESA) 人类探索小组组长

paras.en: To participate in the teleconference, media must contact the NASA Johnson Space Center newsroom for call details by 12 p.m., Oct. 8, at: jsccommu@mail.nasa.gov or 281-483-5111. To ask questions, media must dial in no later than 10 minutes before the start of the call. The agency’s media credentialing policy is available online.
paras.zh: 要参加电话会议，媒体必须在 10 月 8 日中午 12 点之前联系 NASA 约翰逊航天中心新闻编辑室，了解通话详细信息，联系方式：jsccommu@mail.nasa.gov 或 281-483-5111。如需提问，媒体必须在通话开始前 10 分钟内拨通。该机构的媒体认证政策可在线获取。

paras.en: Launch day coverage of the mission will be available on the NASA website. Coverage will include live streaming and blog updates beginning no earlier than 6 a.m. on Oct. 13, as the countdown milestones occur. On-demand streaming video on NASA+ and photos of the launch will be available shortly after liftoff. For questions about countdown coverage, contact the NASA Kennedy Space Center newsroom at 321-867-2468. Follow countdown coverage on our International Space Station blog for updates.
paras.zh: 该任务的发射日报道将在美国宇航局网站上发布。报道将包括直播和博客更新，时间不早于 10 月 13 日早上 6 点，即倒计时里程碑的发生。 NASA+ 上的点播流媒体视频和发射照片将在发射后不久提供。有关倒计时报道的问题，请联系 NASA 肯尼迪航天中心新闻编辑室：321-867-2468。关注我们的国际空间站博客上的倒计时报道以获取更新。

paras.en: Members of the public can register to attend this launch virtually. NASA’s virtual guest program for this mission also includes curated launch resources, notifications about related opportunities or changes, and a stamp for the NASA virtual guest passport following launch.
paras.zh: 公众可以通过虚拟方式注册参加此次发布会。 NASA 针对此次任务的虚拟访客计划还包括精心策划的发射资源、有关相关机会或变化的通知，以及发射后为 NASA 虚拟访客护照盖上的印章。

articles.title: Fighting Drought in Texas Cotton Country

paras.en: For many longtime cotton farmers in the Texas High Plains, the 2026 drought sparked flashbacks to catastrophic harvests of the past. Miserably dry seasons forced farmers in America's largest cotton-producing region to abandon massive portions of their dryland crop, including 72 percent in 2022 and 66 percent in 2011.
paras.zh: 对于德克萨斯州高平原的许多长期棉农来说，2026 年的干旱让他们回想起过去灾难性的收成。悲惨的旱季迫使美国最大棉花产区的农民放弃了大部分旱地作物，包括 2022 年的 72% 和 2011 年的 66%。

paras.en: But in some ways, farmers felt the drought in 2026 entered new territory. "This is the first year that we've had cotton completely die," said Lacy Cotter-Vardeman, a farmer based in Lubbock County whose family has worked the land there for several generations. "I was just talking to our insurance people, and they said they'd never seen this before," she said, adding that roughly 90 percent of her dryland cotton was dead.
paras.zh: 但在某些方面，农民们感觉2026年的干旱进入了新的领域。 “今年是棉花完全枯死的第一年，”拉伯克县的农民莱西·科特-瓦德曼 (Lacy Cotter-Vardeman) 说，他的家族几代人都在当地耕种土地。 “我刚刚与我们的保险人员交谈，他们说他们以前从未见过这种情况，”她说，并补充说她的旱地棉花大约 90% 都死了。

paras.en: Satellite images highlight the scale of the problem in Lubbock and adjacent counties. Brown, parched crops and vacant plots dominated the landscape on September 9, 2026, when the OLI (Operational Land Imager) on Landsat 8 captured the image above (right). In contrast, much greener landscapes prevailed on September 22, 2025 (left), when the sensor captured an image of the same area during a more typical year with a relatively healthy harvest.
paras.zh: 卫星图像凸显了拉伯克及邻近县问题的严重性。 2026 年 9 月 9 日，当 Landsat 8 上的 OLI（操作陆地成像仪）拍摄到上图（右）时，棕色、干枯的农作物和空地占据了景观。相比之下，2025 年 9 月 22 日（左）呈现出更加绿色的景观，当时传感器在收成相对健康的更典型年份捕获了同一地区的图像。

paras.en: Subtler signs of the drought are also visible. With groundwater growing scarce in the High Plains aquifer, many farmers in the region have started irrigating just one-half or one-third of their center-pivot fields, explained Tillery Timmons-Sims, an agricultural conservationist who owns land in Brownfield, Texas, and used to grow cotton. In the imagery, these appear as green semicircles and quarter circles.
paras.zh: 干旱的微妙迹象也显而易见。农业保护主义者蒂勒里·蒂蒙斯·西姆斯 (Tillery Timmons-Sims) 解释说，随着高地平原含水层的地下水日益稀缺，该地区的许多农民已开始只灌溉其中心枢纽田地的二分之一或三分之一。他在德克萨斯州布朗菲尔德拥有土地，曾用于种植棉花。在图像中，它们显示为绿色半圆和四分之一圆。

paras.en: Note also the many shallow water features known as playa lakes—sometimes called mud holes, buffalo wallows, and lagoons—scattered throughout the image. Some, like Double Lakes and Mound Lake, are fairly large, but most of the more than 19,300 playa lakes in the Texas High Plains are quite small, less than 30 acres.
paras.zh: 还要注意许多浅水特征，称为普拉亚湖（有时称为泥洞、水牛洼地和泻湖），散布在图像中。有些湖泊（如双湖 (Double Lakes) 和芒德湖 (Mound Lake)）相当大，但德克萨斯高平原 19,300 多个普拉亚湖中的大多数都相当小，面积不到 30 英亩。

paras.en: Many of these ephemeral lakes were dry in September 2026, unlike the previous year. Playa lakes are critical in this water-stressed region because the clay-lined features, if active, collect rainfall and provide pathways for water to seep underground and recharge the aquifer below, the region's primary source of irrigation water. However, some 80 percent are so modified by tilling or buried with sediment that they no longer function that way.
paras.zh: 与前一年不同，许多短暂湖泊在 2026 年 9 月已经干涸。普拉亚湖在这个水资源紧张的地区至关重要，因为粘土衬里的特征如果活跃，就会收集降雨，并为水渗入地下提供通道，为下面的含水层补给，而含水层是该地区灌溉水的主要来源。然而，大约 80% 的植物因耕作或被沉积物掩埋而发生了如此大的改变，以致它们不再以这种方式发挥作用。

paras.en: Farmers in this region operate along the eastern margin of the aquifer, which has declined sharply in recent decades. According to U.S. Geological Survey data, the water table across much of Lubbock County has dropped by between 25 and 100 feet since 1950, around when people began drawing large volumes of water from the aquifer to irrigate. Losses have been even more extreme (150 feet or more) in counties to the north, including Parmer, Castro, Swisher, and Briscoe.
paras.zh: 该地区的农民沿着含水层东部边缘作业，该含水层近几十年来急剧下降。根据美国地质调查局的数据，自 1950 年（当时人们开始从含水层抽取大量水进行灌溉）以来，拉伯克县大部分地区的地下水位已经下降了 25 至 100 英尺。北部各县的损失更为严重（150 英尺或更多），包括帕尔默、卡斯特罗、斯威舍和布里斯科。

paras.en: The aquifer's long-term decline, combined with the 2026 drought, left many wells "pumping air" this summer for some of the farmers Timmons-Sims knows. "We simply don’t have groundwater to fall back on anymore," she said. Many farmers she knows thought that water might run out during the next generation; instead, it's "happening now," she said. For Cotter-Vardeman, the problem couldn't be more tangible. Many of her irrigation wells stopped working in August.
paras.zh: 含水层的长期下降，加上 2026 年的干旱，导致蒂蒙斯-西姆斯认识的一些农民今年夏天不得不“抽空气”。 “我们根本没有地下水可以依靠了，”她说。她认识的许多农民都认为，水可能会在下一代耗尽。相反，这“正在发生”，她说。对于科特-瓦德曼来说，这个问题再明显不过了。她的许多灌溉井在八月份停止了工作。

paras.en: Rains in September and October, aided by a strong El Niño in the Pacific, are bringing needed moisture to the region, but they haven’t been enough, according to analysis from the U.S. Drought Monitor. "It will take about 7 inches of rain over a three-month period to 'end' the current drought," said Jonathan Case, a meteorologist at NASA’s Marshall Space Flight Center and one of the Drought Monitor’s authors.
paras.zh: 根据美国干旱监测机构的分析，九月和十月的降雨，在太平洋强烈厄尔尼诺现象的帮助下，为该地区带来了所需的水分，但还不够。美国宇航局马歇尔太空飞行中心的气象学家、《干旱监测》的作者之一乔纳森·凯斯说：“三个月内需要大约 7 英寸的降雨量才能‘结束’当前的干旱。”

paras.en: The deteriorating aquifer is one of the reasons Timmons-Sims stopped farming in 2007. She now spends most of her time searching for ways to keep farms in business, such as converting irrigated croplands to grasslands to earn water credits, developing alternative energy projects, adopting water-efficient techniques, and working with conservation organizations to plan for the long term.
paras.zh: 含水层恶化是蒂蒙斯-西姆斯 2007 年停止耕作的原因之一。她现在把大部分时间都花在寻找维持农场经营的方法上，例如将灌溉农田改造成草地以获得水信用、开发替代能源项目、采用节水技术以及与保护组织合作制定长期规划。

paras.en: Through that work, the Sandhills Area Research Association, a conservation organization she helps run, partnered with NASA Acres, a research consortium that connects farmers with NASA science to address agricultural challenges.
paras.zh: 通过这项工作，她帮助运营的保护组织沙丘地区研究协会与 NASA Acres 合作，NASA Acres 是一个将农民与 NASA 科学联系起来以应对农业挑战的研究联盟。

paras.en: In August, a NASA Acres listening tour brought NASA officials to Cotter-Vardeman's farm in Slaton, a vineyard in Meadow, and parched cotton fields in Kress (below). At each stop, the conversation returned to water: how to preserve the ailing aquifer, and how farmers could manage their land in ways that would help restore playa lakes and return billions of gallons of water to the aquifer.
paras.zh: 8 月，NASA 的 Acres 聆听之旅将 NASA 官员带到了斯拉顿 (Slaton) 的科特-瓦德曼 (Cotter-Vardeman) 农场、梅多 (Meadow) 的葡萄园和克雷斯 (Kress) 干旱的棉田（下图）。在每一站，谈话都回到了水：如何保护患病的含水层，以及农民如何以有助于恢复普拉亚湖并将数十亿加仑的水返回到含水层的方式管理他们的土地。

paras.en: The playa lakes around Lubbock were among the first scientific topics researchers studied after Landsat 1 launched in 1972. One early analysis by a Texas Tech geoscientist highlighted the Double Lakes playa (shown above), estimating that monitoring lakes from space would cost just a fraction of what ground surveys would.
paras.zh: 拉伯克周围的普拉亚湖是研究人员在 1972 年 Landsat 1 发射后研究的首批科学课题之一。德克萨斯理工大学地球科学家的一项早期分析强调了双湖普拉亚（如上图所示），估计从太空监测湖泊的成本只是地面调查的一小部分。

paras.en: More recently, a team of Texas Tech University researchers used a deep learning framework to identify and track changes affecting thousands of playa lakes over three decades. Their results, published in September 2026, showed that since 1995, playa lakes declined significantly in 15 of the 45 counties analyzed, highlighting the water challenges facing farmers like Cotter-Vardeman, a member of NASA Harvest's Farm Innovation Ambassador Team (FIAT).
paras.zh: 最近，德克萨斯理工大学的一组研究人员使用深度学习框架来识别和跟踪三十年来影响数千个普拉亚湖泊的变化。他们于 2026 年 9 月发布的结果显示，自 1995 年以来，在所分析的 45 个县中，有 15 个县的普拉亚湖水位显着下降，突显了像 NASA Harvest 农场创新大使团队 (FIAT) 成员科特-瓦德曼 (Cotter-Vardeman) 等农民所面临的水挑战。

paras.en: In Texas, Timmons-Sims and the FIAT team are working to connect farmers and NASA scientists, making it easier for farmers to use NASA data to decide what and when to plant, how to use cover crops and irrigation, and how to manage sediment and playa lakes. "We're simply running out of time and water," Timmons-Sims said. "Farmers need information, innovation, optimization, and solutions—and they need it now."
paras.zh: 在德克萨斯州，蒂蒙斯-西姆斯和菲亚特团队正在努力将农民和 NASA 科学家联系起来，让农民更容易使用 NASA 数据来决定种植什么和何时种植、如何使用覆盖作物和灌溉，以及如何管理沉积物和普拉亚湖。 “我们的时间和水都快用完了，”蒂蒙斯-西姆斯说。 “农民需要信息、创新、优化和解决方案——他们现在就需要。”

articles.title: World News in Brief: Child migrants in Europe, Greenland forced contraception scandal, FAO hunger updates

paras.en: World News in Brief: Child migrants in Europe, Greenland forced contraception scandal, FAO hunger updates
paras.zh: 世界新闻简讯：欧洲儿童移民、格陵兰强迫避孕丑闻、粮农组织饥饿最新情况

paras.en: Just over 31,000 children arrived in Greece, Italy, Spain, Bulgaria and Malta last year – 25 per cent less than in 2024.
paras.zh: 去年，有超过 31,000 名儿童抵达希腊、意大利、西班牙、保加利亚和马耳他，比 2024 年减少了 25%。

paras.en: Of more than 4,600 teenagers and young adults aged 15 to 24 surveyed, nearly half reported suffering physical violence.
paras.zh: 在接受调查的 4,600 多名 15 至 24 岁青少年和年轻人中，近一半表示遭受过身体暴力。

paras.en: One of the main routes migrants take today is the through the central Mediterranean from Libya and Tunisia in northern Africa to Italy, according to the UN migration agency, IOM.
paras.zh: 据联合国移民机构国际移民组织称，当今移民采取的主要路线之一是从北非的利比亚和突尼斯穿过地中海中部到达意大利。

paras.en: IOM spokesperson Kennedy Omondi said there has to be stronger cooperation between European countries and those along migration routes to protect children travelling alone.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织发言人肯尼迪·奥蒙迪表示，欧洲国家与移民沿线国家之间必须加强合作，以保护单独旅行的儿童。

paras.en: “The latest data in our report shows how vulnerable children are subjected to violence and exploitation when safe pathways are limited and they are forced to rely on smugglers,” the spokesperson said.
paras.zh: “我们报告中的最新数据显示，当安全途径有限且被迫依赖走私者时，弱势儿童如何遭受暴力和剥削，”发言人说。

paras.en: Among the adolescents and young adults who made the journey, 28 per cent said they had been held against their will and 17 per cent said they had been forced into work. Almost eight in 10 are male.
paras.zh: 在踏上这段旅程的青少年和年轻人中，28% 的人表示他们是在违背自己意愿的情况下被拘留的，17% 的人表示他们是被迫工作的。几乎十分之八是男性。

paras.en: One 19-year-old migrant worker from Bangladesh cited in the report said his boss in Libya took away his passport and forced him into slave labour, hitting him when he was considered not to be working hard enough.
paras.zh: 报告中援引一名来自孟加拉国的 19 岁移民工人说，他在利比亚的老板拿走了他的护照，强迫他做苦工，当他被认为工作不够努力时，就会打他。

paras.en: A 20-year-old woman from Liberia said she arrived in Algeria where she was raped and forced to work as a cleaner. Seven months’ pregnant, she escaped on a boat to Spain.
paras.zh: 一名来自利比里亚的 20 岁妇女说，她抵达阿尔及利亚后遭到强奸，并被迫做清洁工。怀孕七个月的她乘船逃往西班牙。

paras.en: Most cases of abuse occurred in Libya, according to IOM. More than 20,000 of the 31,100 children who reached Europe along mixed migration routes last year arrived without a parent or guardian, according to a joint report with the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) and refugee agency, UNHCR.
paras.zh: 据国际移民组织称，大多数虐待案件发生在利比亚。根据联合国儿童基金会 (UNICEF) 和难民署 UNHCR 的一份联合报告，去年沿着混合移民路线到达欧洲的 31,100 名儿童中，有 20,000 多名儿童在没有父母或监护人的情况下抵达。

paras.en: IOM Director General Amy Pope called for stronger cooperation between European countries and States along migration routes to protect children travelling alone. Ms. Pope also called for action to tackle the smuggling and criminal networks that exploit them.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织总干事艾米·波普呼吁欧洲国家与移民沿线国家加强合作，以保护单独旅行的儿童。波普女士还呼吁采取行动打击利用他们的走私和犯罪网络。

paras.en: Greenland scandal: UN experts warn against minimising abuse
paras.zh: 格陵兰丑闻：联合国专家警告不要尽量减少虐待行为

paras.en: Independent UN human rights experts have warned that attempts to downplay the forced contraception of thousands of Inuit women and girls in Greenland threaten any prospect of genuine redress.
paras.zh: 联合国独立人权专家警告说，试图淡化格陵兰岛数千名因纽特妇女和女孩的强制避孕问题可能会威胁到真正补救的前景。

paras.en: The concerns follow a dissenting report by two former members of an expert group appointed by Greenland’s Government.
paras.zh: 格陵兰岛政府任命的专家组的两名前成员提出了异议报告，引发了这些担忧。

paras.en: It concluded there were no empirical grounds to assume that Danish or Greenlandic authorities intentionally and systematically inserted intrauterine devices without consent.
paras.zh: 其结论是，没有任何经验依据可以假设丹麦或格陵兰当局在未经同意的情况下故意和系统地插入宫内节育器。

paras.en: The two governments have already recognised that the Indigenous women and girls endured the practice for decades in public care institutions and have apologised.
paras.zh: 两国政府已经认识到土著妇女和女童在公共护理机构中忍受了数十年的这种做法，并已道歉。

paras.en: But, the independent experts – who receive no salary for their work and are not UN staff – said true remedy cannot be achieved without “a clear, accurate and undisputed record of historical facts”.
paras.zh: 但是，独立专家——他们的工作没有工资，也不是联合国工作人员——表示，如果没有“清晰、准确和无可争议的历史事实记录”，就无法实现真正​​的补救措施。

paras.en: They urged Denmark to make compensation schemes more accessible linguistically and culturally, ensure women with disabilities are not forgotten and address wider abuses such as forced adoption and the removal of Inuit children from their parents.
paras.zh: 他们敦促丹麦让补偿计划在语言和文化上更容易实现，确保残疾妇女不被遗忘，并解决更广泛的虐待问题，例如强迫收养和将因纽特儿童从父母身边带走。

paras.en: “Their dignity, voices and rights must remain at the centre of all efforts toward truth, justice, healing and reconciliation,” the Human Rights Council-appointed experts said.
paras.zh: 人权理事会任命的专家表示：“他们的尊严、声音和权利必须始终成为追求真相、正义、治愈与和解的所有努力的中心。”

paras.en: The UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) has called for urgent funding to help families in the Near East and North Africa to keep growing food and earning a living as conflict, displacement and climate pressures deepen hunger.
paras.zh: 联合国粮食及农业组织（粮农组织）呼吁紧急提供资金，帮助近东和北非的家庭在冲突、流离失所和气候压力加剧饥饿之际继续种植粮食和谋生。

paras.en: More than 45 million people across the region face crisis-level hunger or worse.
paras.zh: 该地区有超过 4500 万人面临危机级别的饥饿或更严重的情况。

paras.en: At the same time, funding shortfalls are limiting support to protect food production.
paras.zh: 与此同时，资金短缺限制了对保护粮食生产的支持。

paras.en: In Sudan, where 19.5 million people face high levels of acute food insecurity, only 23 per cent of the $193 million needed under the 2026–2028 emergency response plan has been funded. In Yemen, FAO has secured less than one per cent of the $87.9 million it requires for 2027.
paras.zh: 在苏丹，1950 万人面临严重的严重粮食不安全状况，2026-2028 年紧急应对计划所需的 1.93 亿美元中，仅获得了 23%。在也门，粮农组织已获得 2027 年所需 8,790 万美元的不到百分之一。

paras.en: In Lebanon, more than one million people were displaced after the March 2026 escalation, and more than 22 per cent of agricultural land has reportedly been damaged.
paras.zh: 在黎巴嫩，2026 年 3 月冲突升级后，超过 100 万人流离失所，据报道超过 22% 的农田遭到破坏。

paras.en: “Investing early in seeds, livestock, water and other agricultural support can protect livelihoods, prevent hunger from deepening and reduce humanitarian needs over time,” said FAO Deputy Director-General Beth Bechdol.
paras.zh: “尽早投资于种子、牲畜、水和其他农业支持可以保护生计，防止饥饿加深，并随着时间的推移减少人道主义需求，”粮农组织副总干事贝丝·贝克多尔说。

articles.title: ‘No plague case’ in Siberia, Russia tells WHO as assessments continue

paras.en: ‘No plague case’ in Siberia, Russia tells WHO as assessments continue
paras.zh: 俄罗斯告诉世卫组织西伯利亚“没有鼠疫病例”，评估仍在继续

paras.en: Health authorities in Russia say there is “no plague case” in Siberia following reports last week that a lab technician had died of pneumonia of an unknown origin in the region, World Health Organization (WHO) officials said on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织（WHO）官员周三表示，上周有报道称，一名实验室技术员死于该地区不明原因的肺炎，俄罗斯卫生当局表示，西伯利亚“没有出现鼠疫病例”。

paras.en: Russian regulators told WHO on Tuesday that there was no evidence pneumonic plague played a part in her death and that no pathogens had been detected, agency chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said. About 200 of her contacts have been placed in quarantine.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯监管机构负责人谭德塞表示，俄罗斯监管机构周二告诉世卫组织，没有证据表明肺鼠疫与她的死亡有关，也没有发现任何病原体。她的约 200 名接触者已被隔离。

paras.en: Further requests for information have been sent to Russian authorities, he added, noting that the lab is part of an institute in Irkutsk that studies dangerous pathogens, including plague, which occurs naturally in wild animals in the area.
paras.zh: 他补充说，已向俄罗斯当局发送了进一步的信息请求，并指出该实验室是伊尔库茨克一家研究所的一部分，该研究所研究危险的病原体，包括在该地区野生动物中自然发生的鼠疫。

paras.en: When reports emerged last week of a possible pneumonic plague outbreak in Irkutsk, WHO immediately began monitoring and carrying out risk assessments.
paras.zh: 当上周有报道称伊尔库茨克可能爆发肺鼠疫时，世卫组织立即开始监测和进行风险评估。

paras.en: Maria Van Kerkhove, who heads WHO’s department of epidemic and pandemic threat management, said the health agency has reached out to Russia for details on lab results, tests and further analysis.
paras.zh: 世卫组织流行病和大流行威胁管理部门负责人玛丽亚·范科霍夫表示，该卫生机构已与俄罗斯联系，以获取有关实验室结果、测试和进一步分析的详细信息。

paras.en: She said the request included further information regarding media reports of another suspicious pneumonia death in the region.
paras.zh: 她说，请求包括有关该地区另一起可疑肺炎死亡的媒体报道的更多信息。

paras.en: Acknowledging that the world has a “heightened attention to risk” because of the 2020 COVID-19 global pandemic that killed more than 20 million people, Dr. Van Kerkhove said “we want to put out fair, factual information and when we don’t have an answer, we say so.”
paras.zh: Van Kerkhove 博士承认，由于 2020 年 COVID-19 全球大流行导致超过 2000 万人死亡，全世界“对风险的高度关注”，他表示“我们希望提供公平、真实的信息，当我们没有答案时，我们就会这么说。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, WHO has offered support to Russia and expects further answers from Moscow in the coming days, she said, emphasising that the agency will share new information as soon as it becomes available.
paras.zh: 与此同时，世卫组织已向俄罗斯提供支持，并期望莫斯科在未来几天内给出进一步答复，她说，并强调该机构将在获得新信息后立即分享。

paras.en: Cases of the deadly plague infection, which is caused by the Yersinia pestis bacteria usually found in small mammals and their fleas, are reported around the world every year, Dr. Van Kerkhove said.
paras.zh: 范科霍夫博士说，这种致命的鼠疫感染病例是由通常在小型哺乳动物及其跳蚤中发现的鼠疫耶尔森氏菌引起的，每年世界各地都有报道。

paras.en: Nearly 4,000 cases and 423 deaths were reported across 10 countries between 2019 and 2025, according to a WHO report.
paras.zh: 根据世界卫生组织的一份报告，2019 年至 2025 年间，10 个国家报告了近 4,000 例病例和 423 例死亡。

paras.en: Highly contagious pneumonic plague occurs when bacteria infect the lungs and it “can trigger severe epidemics through person-to-person transmission via respiratory particles”, according to WHO.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织表示，当细菌感染肺部时，就会发生高度传染性的肺鼠疫，它“可以通过呼吸道颗粒在人与人之间传播，从而引发严重的流行病”。

paras.en: If left untreated, the disease can be fatal within 18 to 24 hours of its onset.
paras.zh: 如果不及时治疗，这种疾病可能会在发病后 18 至 24 小时内致命。

paras.en: But common antibiotics for enterobacteria can effectively cure the disease if they are delivered early, the UN health agency said.
paras.zh: 但联合国卫生机构表示，如果尽早使用针对肠杆菌的常见抗生素，则可以有效治愈这种疾病。

paras.en: - Bubonic plague is the most common clinical form of plague and less common but severe forms include septicaemic and pneumonic plague
paras.zh: - 腺鼠疫是鼠疫最常见的临床形式，不太常见但严重的形式包括败血症和肺鼠疫

paras.en: - The disease is transmitted between animals and humans through the bite of infected fleas, direct contact with infected tissues and inhalation of infected respiratory particles
paras.zh: - 该疾病通过受感染跳蚤叮咬、直接接触受感染组织以及吸入受感染呼吸道颗粒在动物和人类之间传播

paras.en: - Plague has a case-fatality ratio of 30 to 60 per cent for the bubonic type, and it is always fatal for pneumonic and septicaemic strains when left untreated
paras.zh: - 腺鼠疫型鼠疫的病死率为 30% 至 60%，如果不及时治疗，肺炎型和败血症型鼠疫总是致命的

paras.en: - Antibiotic treatment is effective against plague bacteria, so early diagnosis and treatment can save lives
paras.zh: - 抗生素治疗对鼠疫细菌有效，因此早期诊断和治疗可以挽救生命

paras.en: - Human plague remains endemic in several countries, with most of nearly 4,000 reported cases between 2019 and 2025 located in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Madagascar
paras.zh: - 人间鼠疫在多个国家仍然流行，2019 年至 2025 年报告的近 4,000 例病例中大部分发生在刚果民主共和国和马达加斯加

articles.title: Ukraine: UN condemns latest attacks and calls for civilian protection

paras.en: Ukraine: UN condemns latest attacks and calls for civilian protection
paras.zh: 乌克兰：联合国谴责最新袭击并呼吁保护平民

paras.en: The UN Humanitarian Coordinator for Ukraine on Wednesday called for an end to attacks against civilians following further overnight strikes by Russian forces that reportedly killed at least 19 in the Chernihiv Region.
paras.zh: 联合国驻乌克兰人道主义协调员周三呼吁停止针对平民的袭击，此前俄罗斯军队连夜发动袭击，据报道切尔尼戈夫地区至少有 19 人死亡。

paras.en: Among the dead in Pryluky were five children, three of them babies, according to the latest information from local authorities. One of the children died along with his mother and grandmother.
paras.zh: 根据地方当局的最新信息，普雷卢基的死者中有五名儿童，其中三名婴儿。其中一名孩子与他的母亲和祖母一起去世。

paras.en: At least 50 others were reportedly injured when residential buildings were struck. The casualty toll is expected to rise as rescue operations continue.
paras.zh: 据报道，住宅楼遭到袭击，至少有 50 人受伤。随着救援行动的继续，伤亡人数预计还会上升。

paras.en: The overnight wave of attacks also reportedly killed around 25 others and injured dozens of civilians in Kremenchuk in the Poltava region, Kyiv and Oleksandriia in the Kirovohrad region.
paras.zh: 据报道，在波尔塔瓦地区的克列缅丘克、基辅和基洛沃拉德地区的亚历山德里亚，夜间的袭击浪潮还造成约 25 人死亡，数十名平民受伤。

paras.en: According to the latest data, 15,280 civilians were killed or injured in Ukraine during the first eight months of this year.
paras.zh: 最新数据显示，今年前8个月，乌克兰有15280名平民伤亡。

paras.en: “Families must never live through the horror of seeing their children placed in constant danger or buried under the rubble of their own homes. This pattern of increasing harm to civilians must end,” the UN’s top official in the country Matthias Schmale said in a statement.
paras.zh: 联合国驻该国高级官员马蒂亚斯·施梅尔（Matthias Schmale）在一份声明中表示：“家庭绝不能忍受看到自己的孩子持续处于危险之中或被埋在自己家园的废墟下的恐惧。这种对平民伤害日益增加的模式必须结束。”

paras.en: On 5 and 6 October, airstrikes hit a hospital in Kryvyi Rih and ambulances in Kramatorsk, injuring health workers.
paras.zh: 10 月 5 日至 6 日，克里沃罗格的一家医院和克拉马托尔斯克的救护车遭到空袭，造成医护人员受伤。

paras.en: Ukrainian Red Cross workers were also injured while travelling to assist people affected by an attack in Zaporizhzhia.
paras.zh: 乌克兰红十字会工作人员在前往扎波罗热援助受袭击影响的人们时也受伤。

paras.en: “Civilians, including children, homes and essential civilian infrastructure are protected under international humanitarian law,” Mr. Schmale reiterated.
paras.zh: “包括儿童、家庭和重要民用基础设施在内的平民受到国际人道法的保护，”施梅尔先生重申。

paras.en: Briefing journalists in New York Wednesday, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric said the Secretary-General strongly condemned the ongoing attacks. He also expressed deep concern over the rising number of civilian casualties.
paras.zh: 周三，联合国发言人斯特凡·杜雅里克在纽约向记者通报情况时表示，秘书长强烈谴责正在发生的袭击事件。他还对平民伤亡人数不断增加深表关切。

paras.en: “All attacks targeting civilians and civilian infrastructure, wherever they occur, are a violation of international humanitarian law and must end immediately,” Mr. Dujarric said.
paras.zh: 杜雅里克表示：“所有针对平民和民用基础设施的袭击，无论发生在何处，都违反了国际人道主义法，必须立即停止。”

paras.en: Humanitarian teams in Ukraine reported that attacks and frontline hostilities over the previous 24 hours had caused more than 150 civilian casualties.
paras.zh: 乌克兰人道主义救援队报告称，过去 24 小时内发生的袭击和前线敌对行动已造成 150 多名平民伤亡。

paras.en: During the first eight months of this year, the UN and its humanitarian partners assisted 1.5 million people affected by strikes across Ukraine, as attacks continue to intensify and spread to areas farther from the front lines.
paras.zh: 今年前八个月，随着袭击继续加剧并蔓延到远离前线的地区，联合国及其人道主义合作伙伴援助了乌克兰各地受袭击影响的 150 万人。

articles.title: 'Sandpapergate' Q&A: The 2018 ball-tampering scandal explained

paras.en: Sandpapergate: 2018 ball-tampering scandal explained as Australia return to South Africa for Test cricket
paras.zh: Sandpapergate：2018年篡球丑闻解释为澳大利亚返回南非参加板球测试

paras.en: What was 'Sandpapergate', who was involved and what were the punishments? Ball-tampering scandal from 2018 in focus as Australia return to South Africa for Test series for first time since; watch live on Sky Sports Cricket from 7.30am Friday (8.30am first ball)
paras.zh: 什么是“砂纸门”？涉及的人有哪些？处罚是什么？ 2018 年的球篡改丑闻成为焦点，澳大利亚自此以来首次返回南非参加系列测试；周五上午 7.30 观看天空体育板球直播（上午 8.30 第一球）

paras.en: It was the ball-tampering scandal that rocked world - and particularly Australian - cricket.
paras.zh: 篡球丑闻震惊了世界，尤其是澳大利亚板球界。

paras.en: For the first time since 'Sandpapergate', which resulted in Steve Smith, David Warner and Cameron Bancroft receiving bans for the roles they played in the plot to alter the condition of the ball, Australia are preparing for a Test series in South Africa.
paras.zh: 自从“沙纸门”事件导致史蒂夫·史密斯、大卫·华纳和卡梅伦·班克罗夫特因在改变球状况的阴谋中扮演的角色而受到禁令以来，澳大利亚首次准备在南非进行系列测试。

paras.en: Ahead of the first Test in Durban from Friday, live on Sky Sports from 7.30am (8.30am first ball), here is an explainer of what transpired in Cape Town and its subsequent fallout…
paras.zh: 在周五于德班举行的第一次测试之前，天空体育从上午 7.30 开始直播（上午 8.30 第一场球），以下是开普敦发生的事情及其后续影响的解释……

paras.en: - 'Sandpapergate' adds to intrigue of South Africa vs Australia
paras.zh: - “沙纸门”增加了南非对澳大利亚的阴谋

paras.en: - Sky Sports to Australia and England's tours of South Africa
paras.zh: - 天空体育报道澳大利亚和英格兰的南非之旅

paras.en: - Get the latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract
paras.zh: - 获取最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播

paras.en: That was the name given to the March 2018 ball-tampering scandal during Australia's Test tour of South Africa after Bancroft was caught on camera trying to rough up one side of the ball with sandpaper in order the make it swing through the air.
paras.zh: 这是 2018 年 3 月澳大利亚南非测试赛期间发生的球篡改丑闻，当时班克罗夫特被镜头拍到试图用砂纸打磨球的一侧，以使其在空中摆动。

paras.en: The incident occurred on day three of the third Test in Cape Town while South Africa were batting in their second innings, with Bancroft aiming to hide the sandpaper, which he initially said was a piece of tape, in his trousers after realising he had been spotted.
paras.zh: 这起事件发生在开普敦第三次测试的第三天，当时南非队正在第二局击球，班克罗夫特意识到自己被发现后，打算将砂纸藏在裤子里，他最初说这是一块胶带。

paras.en: At the end of the day's play, Bancroft and Australia captain Smith admitted to ball-tampering in a press conference - albeit not to the use of sandpaper at that stage - with Smith saying the plan had been cooked up by the 'leadership group' at lunch.
paras.zh: 在一天的比赛结束时，班克罗夫特和澳大利亚队队长史密斯在新闻发布会上承认了对球的篡改——尽管当时没有使用砂纸——史密斯表示该计划是“领导小组”在午餐时制定的。

paras.en: Smith and vice-captain Warner stood down from their leadership roles for the remainder of the Cape Town Test but still took to the field as the Baggy Greens, now captained by Tim Paine, slumped to a 322-run defeat after being rolled for just 107 in their second innings - Warner top-scoring with 32, Bancroft making 26 and Smith seven.
paras.zh: 史密斯和副队长华纳在开普敦测试的剩余比赛中不再担任领导职务，但仍然上场，现在由蒂姆·潘恩担任队长的松松绿队在第二局仅得到107分后，以322分落败——华纳以32分获得最高分，班克罗夫特得到26分，史密斯得到7分。

paras.en: Smith, Warner and Bancroft were sent home ahead of the fourth Test, in which Australia were hammered by 492 runs to fall to a 3-1 series defeat, and later received hefty bans from international and domestic cricket, ranging from nine months to a year.
paras.zh: 史密斯、华纳和班克罗夫特在第四次测试赛前被送回家，澳大利亚队在第四次测试赛中以 492 分的成绩惨败，系列赛以 3-1 落败，随后受到国际和国内板球比赛的严厉禁赛，从九个月到一年不等。

paras.en: They were each found by Cricket Australia to have engaged in conduct against the spirit of the game and harmful to its interests.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚板球协会发现他们的行为违反了比赛精神并损害了其利益。

paras.en: Warner was found to have led the plot to alter the condition of the ball, including guiding Bancroft on how to use the sandpaper.
paras.zh: 华纳被发现主导了改变球状况的阴谋，包括指导班克罗夫特如何使用砂纸。

paras.en: He was slapped with a one-year ban and told he would never be considered for a leadership position within the team again.
paras.zh: 他被禁赛一年，并被告知他永远不会再被考虑担任球队的领导职务。

paras.en: Smith - who would go on to be succeeded permanently by Paine as captain - was also suspended for 12 months after failing to prevent a plan he was aware of and making misleading comments.
paras.zh: 史密斯——后来由潘恩永久接任队长——也因未能阻止他所知道的计划并发表误导性言论而被停赛 12 个月。

paras.en: He was also informed he would not be able to take a leadership role until at least 12 months after the conclusion of his ban.
paras.zh: 他还被告知，在禁令结束后至少 12 个月内，他将无法担任领导职务。

paras.en: Smith and Warner were removed from the 2018 IPL, where they were due to play for - and initially captain - Rajasthan Royals and SunRisers Hyderabad respectively, while Bancroft saw Somerset cancel the deal he had signed to play county cricket.
paras.zh: 史密斯和华纳被从 2018 年 IPL 中除名，他们原本分别为拉贾斯坦皇家队和海得拉巴 SunRisers 效力并担任最初的队长，而班克罗夫特则看到萨默塞特取消了他签署的参加县板球比赛的协议。

paras.en: Australia coach Darren Lehmann was among the collateral damage.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚教练达伦·莱曼（Darren Lehmann）也是附带损害之一。

paras.en: Lehmann - now coaching Northamptonshire in county cricket, leading the Steelbacks to the 2026 T20 Blast title - was cleared of any involvement in the ball-tampering scandal but opted to resign after the fourth and final Test against South Africa.
paras.zh: 莱曼目前在北安普敦郡担任郡板球教练，带领钢背队夺得 2026 年 T20 Blast 冠军。莱曼被澄清与球篡改丑闻无关，但在第四次也是最后一次对阵南非的测试后选择辞职。

paras.en: Without Smith, Warner and Bancroft, Australia would go on to lose Test series away to Pakistan and at home to India, before a 2-0 win in Sri Lanka preceded their comeback series - the 2-2 Ashes draw in England in the summer of 2019.
paras.zh: 如果没有史密斯、华纳和班克罗夫特，澳大利亚将继续在客场输给巴基斯坦和主场输给印度的测试系列赛中失利，然后在斯里兰卡以2-0获胜，然后在他们的复出系列赛之前——2019年夏天在英格兰2-2灰烬杯战平。

paras.en: Some argued that the sanctions meted out were too severe, including former India internationals Gautam Gambhir and Harbhajan Singh and broadcaster and ex-Hampshire captain Mark Nicholas - a view shared by the late, great Shane Warne.
paras.zh: 一些人认为实施的制裁过于严厉，其中包括前印度国脚高塔姆·甘比尔和哈巴詹·辛格，以及广播员和前汉普郡队长马克·尼古拉斯——已故伟大的肖恩·沃恩也持同样的观点。

paras.en: Leg-spin legend Warne, who died in 2022, said while it was "embarrassing" for Australia to be caught up in the scandal, he felt worldwide "hysteria" led to a punishment "not fitting the crime".
paras.zh: 转腿传奇人物沃恩于 2022 年去世，他表示，虽然澳大利亚卷入这起丑闻“令人尴尬”，但他认为全世界的“歇斯底里”导致了“与罪行不符”的惩罚。

paras.en: Smith and Bancroft gave emotional press conferences on their returns to Australia after being sent home, while Bancroft later admitted he had considered quitting and becoming a yoga teacher during his enforced break from the game.
paras.zh: 史密斯和班克罗夫特在被送回澳大利亚后举行了激动人心的新闻发布会，而班克罗夫特后来承认，在被迫退出比赛期间，他曾考虑过退出并成为一名瑜伽老师。

paras.en: While all three players went on to represent Australia again - Smith is still doing so - Bancroft's international career arguably never truly recovered with the opener's two Tests at the start of the 2019 Ashes his, at this point, last international matches.
paras.zh: 尽管所有三名球员都再次代表澳大利亚参赛（史密斯仍然这样做），但班克罗夫特的国际职业生涯可以说从未真正恢复过来，因为他在 2019 年灰烬杯开始时进行了揭幕战的两次测试，这是他最后的国际比赛。

paras.en: Warner, who retired from internationals in 2024, applied to have his lifetime captaincy ban lifted but then revoked that in 2022.
paras.zh: 华纳于 2024 年从国家队退役，他申请解除终身队长禁令，但随后于 2022 年撤销。

paras.en: The suspension was ultimately lifted and he went on to lead Sydney Thunder in the Big Bash League.
paras.zh: 禁赛最终被解除，他继续带领悉尼雷霆队参加大狂欢联赛。

paras.en: How does Smith reflect on 'Sandpapergate'?
paras.zh: 史密斯如何看待“砂纸门”？

paras.en: Speaking to News Corp recently, Smith said: "That was a traumatic experience in my life and when I hear the flash of a camera it makes me revisit that, in a way.
paras.zh: 史密斯最近在接受新闻集团采访时表示：“那是我一生中一次痛苦的经历，当我听到相机的闪光时，在某种程度上让我重新审视这段经历。

paras.en: "The 24-48 hours after being told I was getting banned for a year, going through the airport in Johannesburg getting absolutely mobbed, and then flying back and doing a press conference... I still have little flashbacks here and there of it.
paras.zh: “在被告知我将被禁赛一年后的 24 到 48 小时内，我穿过约翰内斯堡的机场，被围攻，然后飞回来参加新闻发布会……我仍然时不时地回忆起这件事。

paras.en: "I felt like I was kind of thrown to the wolves through [Johannesburg] airport. I didn't have any support there at all.
paras.zh: “我感觉自己在约翰内斯堡机场就像被扔进了狼群。我在那里根本没有任何支持。

paras.en: "It was certainly a difficult period, particularly the initial few days after. The mental state I was in was not great.
paras.zh: “这确实是一段艰难的时期，尤其是之后的最初几天。我的精神状态不太好。

paras.en: "That's somewhere I'd like not to get to again, but I certainly learned from that and have been able to move forward with my life.
paras.zh: “那是我不想再去的地方，但我确实从中吸取了教训，并且能够继续我的生活。

paras.en: "I've tried to kind of erase a lot of 2018 and what happened. I can't remember a lot about the series. I've tried to block most of it out of my memory bank."
paras.zh: “我试图抹去2018年的很多事情以及发生的事情。我记不起很多关于这个系列的事情了。我试图把大部分内容从我的记忆库中删除。”

paras.en: What reactions can Australia expect in South Africa?
paras.zh: 澳大利亚在南非会有何反应？

paras.en: Australia have returned to South Africa since 'Sandpapergate' but only for white-ball cricket with a proposed Test tour in 2021 cancelled due to Covid-19.
paras.zh: 自“砂纸门”以来，澳大利亚已返回南非，但仅限白球板球比赛，拟议的 2021 年测试巡回赛因 Covid-19 而取消。

paras.en: England fans regularly teased their Ashes rivals after the ball-tampering scandal, with some dressing up as sandpaper to make their point, so what sort of response can Smith and the current players expects from South Africa supporters?
paras.zh: 在球篡改丑闻发生后，英格兰球迷经常嘲笑他们的灰烬杯对手，有些人打扮成砂纸来表达自己的观点，那么史密斯和现任球员可以期望南非支持者做出什么样的反应呢？

paras.en: Former Proteas all-rounder Shaun Pollock told the Sky Sports Cricket Podcast: "I don't think it'll be overly hostile.
paras.zh: 前 Proteas 全能选手肖恩·波洛克 (Shaun Pollock) 告诉天空体育板球播客：“我认为这不会过于敌对。

paras.en: "Over here, there's been quite a few replays of the [2018] series over the last few weeks, just to create a bit of animosity, I suppose, but when you play against Australia, people in South Africa won't need a reason to have a go at them about some particular reason.
paras.zh: “在过去的几周里，[2018]系列赛在这里重播了很多次，我想只是为了制造一点敌意，但是当你对阵澳大利亚时，南非人不需要理由因为某些特定原因而对他们进行攻击。

paras.en: "I'm sure there'll be a few people coming dressed up in accordance with 'Sandpapergate', I'm sure there'll be some continual reminding of it, but I don't think it'll be over the top or too intense."
paras.zh: “我确信会有一些人按照‘沙纸门’打扮起来，我确信会有一些不断的提醒，但我不认为这会太过分或太激烈。”

paras.en: Finally, is there any more to come out over 'Sandpapergate'?
paras.zh: 最后，还有关于“砂纸门”的更多内容吗？

paras.en: While Cricket Australia found only Warner, Smith and Bancroft were party to the plot, Bancroft said in an interview in 2021 that it was "self-explanatory" bowlers in the team had to be aware the ball was being meddled with.
paras.zh: 虽然澳大利亚板球协会发现只有华纳、史密斯和班克罗夫特参与了这一阴谋，但班克罗夫特在 2021 年的一次采访中表示，球队中的投球手必须意识到球正在被干扰，这是“不言自明的”。

paras.en: Cricket Australia said they were open to investigating any new information brought to light.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚板球协会表示，他们愿意调查任何曝光的新信息。

paras.en: The whole episode is one Australia will want to forget but will likely never be allowed to.
paras.zh: 整个事件是澳大利亚想要忘记的，但很可能永远不会被允许。
