paras.en: It would involve a doubling of the defence budget in nominal terms from £70bn in 2026 to £151bn in 2035, according to the Transition Security Project, a research centre which was spun out of Common Wealth, a thinktank with close links to Andy Burnham.
paras.zh: 根据过渡安全项目（Transition Security Project）的说法，名义上的国防预算将增加一倍，从 2026 年的 700 亿英镑增加到 2035 年的 1510 亿英镑。该项目是一个从 Common Wealth 分拆出来的研究中心，Common Wealth 是一家与安迪·伯纳姆（Andy Burnham）关系密切的智库。

paras.en: Using figures from 2024/25, the study estimated that about 23% of the military budget for that year was spent on overseas commitments, costing just over £14bn, with the real figure likely to be higher. About £2.8bn was spent outside Europe, including bases in places like Cyprus, Kenya and Oman and elsewhere as “strategic hubs” for projecting UK military power.
paras.zh: 该研究利用2024/25年度的数据估计，当年约23%的军事预算用于海外承诺，成本略高于140亿英镑，实际数字可能更高。大约28亿英镑花费在欧洲以外的地方，包括塞浦路斯、肯尼亚和阿曼等地的基地以及其他作为投射英国军事力量的“战略中心”的基地。

paras.en: The report says this makes the UK the most overseas-committed military among European Nato members, even if France has more personnel posted abroad. The Dip seems unlikely to reverse this, talking about ongoing commitments in a series of continents.
paras.zh: 报告称，这使得英国成为欧洲北约成员国中海外投入最多的军队，尽管法国在海外派驻了更多人员。考虑到一系列大陆的持续承诺，经济衰退似乎不太可能扭转这一局面。

paras.en: It questions whether more of the new money should be used for domestic defence, and whether the focus on overseas missions has even made the UK safer.
paras.zh: 它质疑是否应该将更多的新资金用于国内国防，以及对海外任务的关注是否会让英国变得更安全。

paras.en: Since 2001, the study said, the UK has spent more than £51bn in modern terms on military interventions in Iraq, Afghanistan, Libya and elsewhere.
paras.zh: 研究称，自2001年以来，英国在伊拉克、阿富汗、利比亚和其他地方的军事干预上花费了超过510亿英镑（按现代标准计算）。

paras.en: “Britain’s decision to maintain a global network of military bases and force projection capabilities, combined with high levels of waste in the military procurement system, raise serious questions about how it is allocating public investment,” it says, urging the government to “review its military posture, prioritising defence over the global projection of military force”.
paras.zh: 报告称：“英国决定维持全球军事基地网络和兵力投送能力，加上军事采购系统中的大量浪费，引发了人们对其如何分配公共投资的严重质疑。”并敦促政府“审查其军事态势，将防御置于全球军事力量投送之上”。

paras.en: Kevin Cashman, a researcher at Transition Security Project, who co-authored the report, said: “Britain should not pour more money into a bloated military sector geared towards alignment with the United States while Washington starts wars around the world that drive up our bills.”
paras.zh: 该报告的合著者、过渡安全项目研究员凯文·卡什曼表示：“英国不应该向臃肿的军事部门投入更多资金，以与美国结盟，而华盛顿却在世界各地发动战争，增加我们的开支。”

paras.en: Khem Rogaly, the co-director of the organisation, and also a co-author, said: “The billions of pounds Britain wastes on global military deployments every year symbolise its destructive, outdated foreign policy.
paras.zh: 该组织联合主任兼合著者坎·罗加利表示：“英国每年在全球军事部署上浪费数十亿英镑，这象征着其破坏性的、过时的外交政策。

paras.en: “Britain should end its support for these attempts at global policing. Instead, it should focus its military resources on defence and its public investment on health, housing and the climate emergency.”
paras.zh: “英国应该停止对这些全球警务尝试的支持。相反，它应该将军事资源集中在国防上，将公共投资集中在健康、住房和气候紧急情况上。”

paras.en: There is an awareness of the importance of avoiding waste among defence officials, including the risk that an arbitrary focus on reaching a certain level of spending could exacerbate this.
paras.zh: 国防官员已经认识到避免浪费的重要性，包括武断地关注达到一定支出水平可能会加剧这种浪费的风险。

paras.en: The intention is to focus instead on what is necessary – primarily on preparing the UK for a possible war in Europe.
paras.zh: 其目的是把重点放在必要的事情上 — — 主要是让英国为可能发生的欧洲战争做好准备。

articles.title: Veteran Indian actor Nana Patekar dies at 75

paras.en: Veteran Indian actor Nana Patekar, known for his intense performances and distinct dialogue delivery, has died at the age of 75 in Goa, his son Malhar told BBC Marathi.
paras.zh: 印度资深演员纳纳·帕特卡 (Nana Patekar) 以其激烈的表演和独特的对白而闻名，他的儿子马尔哈 (Malhar) 告诉 BBC Marathi，他在果阿去世，享年 75 岁。

paras.en: One of the most recognisable faces of Indian cinema, Patekar won three National Film Awards and became known for playing complex, often volatile characters. He was also a prominent figure in Marathi language cinema and theatre.
paras.zh: 帕特卡是印度电影界最知名的面孔之一，曾获得三项国家电影奖，并因扮演复杂且反复无常的角色而闻名。他也是马拉地语电影和戏剧领域的杰出人物。

paras.en: He was rushed to hospital after being found unconscious at his home in Goa in the early hours of Thursday.
paras.zh: 周四凌晨，他在果阿的家中被发现昏迷不醒，被送往医院。

paras.en: "Despite 45 minutes of continuous CPR, he could not be revived," Dr Shekhar Salkar of Manipal Hospital in Goa told ANI news agency.
paras.zh: 果阿马尼帕尔医院的谢卡尔·萨尔卡医生告诉 ANI 通讯社：“尽管进行了 45 分钟的连续心肺复苏，他还是无法苏醒。”

paras.en: On Thursday, Prime Minister Narendra Modi led tributes to the actor, praising Patekar's versatility and outspoken personality.
paras.zh: 周四，印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪向这位演员致敬，称赞帕特卡的多才多艺和直言不讳的个性。

paras.en: Patekar portrayed characters that would "remain etched in the memory of generations", Modi wrote on X, adding that his death had left "a vast void in the artistic world".
paras.zh: 莫迪在 X 上写道，帕特卡描绘的人物将“铭刻在几代人的记忆中”，并补充说他的去世给“艺术世界留下了巨大的空白”。

paras.en: Bollywood star Akshay Kumar, who appeared alongside Patekar in the comedy film Welcome, remembered him as a rare performer whose voice, intensity and honesty could command an audience's attention.
paras.zh: 与帕特卡一起出演喜剧电影《欢迎》的宝莱坞明星阿克谢·库马尔 (Akshay Kumar) 回忆道，帕特卡是一位罕见的表演者，他的声音、强度和诚实可以吸引观众的注意力。

paras.en: Patekar made his debut with the film Gaman in 1978 and continued to play smaller roles in several films. But the intensity that he brought on the screen was hard to miss and soon he landed a role in Parinda in 1989, making him a household name across India. His portrayal of the volatile, gritty gangster Anna won him his first National Film Award and the Filmfare Award.
paras.zh: 帕特卡于 1978 年凭借电影《Gaman》首次亮相，并继续在多部电影中扮演小角色。但他在银幕上带来的激情不容忽视，很快他于 1989 年在《Parinda》中获得了一个角色，使他成为全印度家喻户晓的人物。他对反复无常、坚韧不拔的黑帮安娜的刻画为他赢得了第一个国家电影奖和 Filmfare 奖。

paras.en: He didn't look back after this and played many memorable characters in several films through the 1990s. The range of the characters he played showcased the depth of his acting talent and mastery over his craft.
paras.zh: 此后他并没有回头，在 20 世纪 90 年代的多部电影中扮演了许多令人难忘的角色。他扮演的角色范围广泛，展示了他深厚的表演天赋和对技艺的掌握。

paras.en: His portrayal of Major Chauhan in Prahaar â a film he also directed â won him praise. Then there was the villainous character of Majid Khan in Angaar, the patriotic firebrand of Tirangaa, and, most notably, Pratap Narayan Tilak in Krantiveer, for which he won the national award for best actor.
paras.zh: 他在自己执导的电影《普拉哈尔》中饰演的乔汉少校赢得了赞誉。然后是《安加尔》中的反派角色马吉德·汗，蒂兰加的爱国煽动者，以及最著名的《克兰蒂维尔》中的普拉塔普·纳拉扬·蒂拉克，他因此获得了国家最佳男主角奖。

paras.en: Just when critics thought that playing loud characters was his mainstay, he proved them wrong by delivering a mesmerising performance in Khamoshi as a person who could not hear or speak.
paras.zh: 就在评论家们认为他的主要角色是扮演响亮的角色时，他在《卡莫什》中饰演一个听不见或说不出话的人，用令人着迷的表演证明了他们的错误。

paras.en: Director Prakash Jha's Rajneeti in 2010 added another dimension to his acting as his portrayal of an astute politician was delivered with perfection.
paras.zh: 2010 年，导演普拉卡什·贾 (Prakash Jha) 饰演的《拉吉尼蒂》(Rajneeti) 为他的表演增添了另一个维度，完美地诠释了一位精明的政治家。

paras.en: The breadth of Patekar's career showcases the wide range of his work. He has played gangsters, soldiers, policemen, politicians, patriots, villains, comic characters and tragic figures, while moving between Hindi and Marathi cinema and sometimes also working behind the camera as a director and writer.
paras.zh: 帕特卡职业生涯的广度展示了他工作的广泛性。他扮演过黑帮、士兵、警察、政治家、爱国者、恶棍、喜剧人物和悲剧人物，同时在印地语和马拉地语电影之间穿梭，有时也在幕后担任导演和编剧。

paras.en: His three national awards for Parinda, Krantiveer and Agni Sakshi are a testament to his career.
paras.zh: 他为 Parinda、Krantiveer 和 Agni Sakshi 获得的三项国家奖项证明了他的职业生涯。

paras.en: Patekar was also an influential figure in both Marathi and Hindi theatre. Before cinema made him a familiar face, he spent years working in theatre, where he developed his gritty style of dialogue delivery and also mastered the intensity he brought to his on-screen characters.
paras.zh: 帕特卡也是马拉地语和印地语戏剧界的一位有影响力的人物。在电影让他成为人们熟悉的面孔之前，他在剧院工作了多年，在那里他发展了坚韧的对话风格，并掌握了他为银幕角色带来的强度。

paras.en: Purush and Hamidabai Chi Kothi were two of his most famous plays. Despite being successful in films, he remained active in theatre throughout his professional life.
paras.zh: 《普鲁什》和《哈米达拜奇科蒂》是他最著名的两部戏剧。尽管在电影方面取得了成功，但他在整个职业生涯中仍然活跃在戏剧领域。

paras.en: Patekar was also known for his activism and didn't mince his words while criticising the government of the day. He was direct, and almost brazen and unapologetic, when it came to criticising ministers and their policies and that too quite publicly.
paras.zh: 帕特卡也因其激进主义而闻名，在批评当时的政府时毫不拐弯抹角。当谈到批评部长及其政策时，他是直接的，几乎是厚颜无耻的，毫无歉意的，而且是公开批评。

paras.en: Issues related to farmers were particularly close to his heart.
paras.zh: 他特别关心与农民有关的问题。

paras.en: His work moved beyond just giving statements. In 2015 he and actor Makarand Anaspure established the Naam Foundation, which has worked on farmer welfare and water conservation in Maharashtra.
paras.zh: 他的工作不仅仅是发表声明。 2015 年，他和演员 Makarand Anaspure 成立了 Naam 基金会，致力于马哈拉施特拉邦的农民福利和水资源保护。

paras.en: But his career was not without controversies.
paras.zh: 但他的职业生涯并非没有争议。

paras.en: In 2018, allegations of sexual harassment made by actor Tanushree Dutta against Patekar over an alleged incident on a film set a decade earlier helped spark India's #MeToo movement. Patekar denied the allegations.
paras.zh: 2018 年，演员塔努什里·杜塔 (Tanushree Dutta) 对帕特卡 (Patekar) 提出性骚扰指控，指控其在十年前拍摄的电影中发生性骚扰事件，引发了印度的 #MeToo 运动。帕特卡否认了这些指控。

paras.en: In 2019, he was cleared of the charges after police said they had not found sufficient evidence against him.
paras.zh: 2019年，警方称没有找到对他不利的足够证据后，他被洗清了罪名。

articles.title: US and Lebanon protecting wanted Syrian general, BBC finds

paras.en: A former Syrian general wanted for crimes against humanity, external is being bankrolled and protected by the US and Lebanese authorities, a BBC News investigation has found.
paras.zh: 英国广播公司新闻调查发现，一名因危害人类罪而被通缉的前叙利亚将军正在受到美国和黎巴嫩当局的资助和保护。

paras.en: Bassam al-Hassan, who oversaw Syria's chemical weapons programme and was a senior adviser to former President Bashar al-Assad, is being harboured in Lebanon following the Assad regime's collapse in 2024.
paras.zh: 巴萨姆·哈桑 (Bassam al-Hassan) 负责监督叙利亚的化学武器计划，曾担任前总统巴沙尔·阿萨德 (Bashar al-Assad) 的高级顾问，2024 年阿萨德政权垮台后，他被藏匿在黎巴嫩。

paras.en: An investigation by the BBC and the US broadcaster NPR has discovered that Hassan has been allowed to remain there under an arrangement involving the FBI, and other US and Lebanese authorities. This is because of his willingness to provide information about the abduction of American journalist Austin Tice in Syria in 2012, as well as additional intelligence, we have been told.
paras.zh: BBC 和美国广播公司 NPR 的一项调查发现，根据联邦调查局以及美国和黎巴嫩其他当局的安排，哈桑被允许留在那里。据我们所知，这是因为他愿意提供有关 2012 年美国记者奥斯汀·泰斯在叙利亚被绑架的信息以及更多情报。

paras.en: Last month the BBC revealed Tice's abduction had been a planned operation, with Hassan in the chain of command.
paras.zh: 上个月，英国广播公司透露，泰斯的绑架是一次有计划的行动，哈桑在指挥系统中。

paras.en: Officials from two different branches of Syria's new government have told the BBC they want Hassan returned to face trial, but that US authorities want him kept in Lebanon, and they say there is little Damascus can do about this.
paras.zh: 叙利亚新政府两个不同部门的官员告诉英国广播公司，他们希望哈桑返回接受审判，但美国当局希望将他留在黎巴嫩，他们表示大马士革对此无能为力。

paras.en: We asked the FBI, the CIA and Lebanon's General Directorate of General Security to comment on our findings. Only the FBI responded, declining to comment and instead directing us to a past statement that said its focus remained on establishing the facts around the Tice case and securing his return.
paras.zh: 我们要求联邦调查局、中央情报局和黎巴嫩安全总局对我们的调查结果发表评论。只有联邦调查局做出了回应，拒绝发表评论，而是将我们引向过去的一份声明，该声明称其重点仍然是查明泰斯案件的事实并确保他返回。

paras.en: In response to our findings, Phil Elwood, spokesperson for the Tice family said: "If what you are saying is true, the fact that our tax dollars are being used to furnish a comfortable life for someone associated with the use of chemical weapons on Syrian civilians, who claims to have had Austin Tice executed, is offensive.
paras.zh: 泰斯家族发言人菲尔·埃尔伍德在回应我们的调查结果时表示：“如果你说的是真的，那么我们的税款被用来为与对叙利亚平民使用化学武器有关的人提供舒适的生活，而他声称已处决了奥斯汀·泰斯，这一事实是令人反感的。”

paras.en: "This is nothing less than aiding and abetting the escape of a wanted war criminal. The Syrians deserve justice and he should be returned to stand trial."
paras.zh: “这无异于帮助和教唆一名被通缉的战犯逃跑。叙利亚人应该得到正义，他应该被送回接受审判。”

paras.en: Josh Baker enters a dangerous world of fear, greed and betrayal as he uncovers what happened in one of the biggest missing-person cases of our time - the abduction of Austin Tice.
paras.zh: 乔什·贝克 (Josh Baker) 揭开了我们这个时代最大的失踪人员案件之一——奥斯汀·泰斯 (Austin Tice) 绑架案的真相，他进入了一个充满恐惧、贪婪和背叛的危险世界。

paras.en: As part of a years-long investigation featured in the new BBC podcast: Where is Austin Tice? Series 3 of I'm Not A Monster Presents, the BBC has reviewed a detailed record of a meeting between Hassan, FBI and CIA representatives, and Lebanese security officials, where Tice's case is discussed.
paras.zh: 作为 BBC 新播客中长达数年调查的一部分：奥斯汀·泰斯在哪里？在《我不是怪物》第三季中，BBC 查阅了哈桑、联邦调查局和中央情报局代表以及黎巴嫩安全官员之间的一次会议的详细记录，其中讨论了泰斯的案件。

paras.en: In it, Hassan is offered "residency", "protection" and help securing his "living needs" in return for information, primarily about Tice.
paras.zh: 在其中，哈桑获得了“居住权”、“保护”并帮助满足他的“生活需求”，以换取主要是关于泰斯的信息。

paras.en: Sources with knowledge of the arrangement confirmed this was the case, and described to us how Hassan receives money from the US authorities through an intermediary, making it harder to trace. Hassan is sanctioned by the US government.
paras.zh: 了解这一安排的消息人士证实了情况确实如此，并向我们描述了哈桑如何通过中间人从美国当局收到资金，从而使其更难以追踪。哈桑受到美国政府的制裁。

paras.en: Yet people connected to the Tice investigation say they have seen little evidence it has significantly advanced since Hassan began providing information as part of this agreement. The deal is believed to have been struck in the spring of 2025.
paras.zh: 然而，与泰斯调查有关的人士表示，自从哈桑开始作为协议的一部分提供信息以来，他们几乎没有看到任何证据表明泰斯调查取得了重大进展。据信该交易已于 2025 年春季达成。

paras.en: Sources with knowledge of the investigation have expressed concerns that Hassan's arrangement with the US could continue indefinitely, at significant expense but with little gain.
paras.zh: 了解调查情况的消息人士表示担心，哈桑与美国的安排可能会无限期地持续下去，代价高昂，但收效甚微。

paras.en: Hassan is not the only Syrian regime official whose connection to the Tice case has seemingly afforded him financial payments or assistance for living abroad.
paras.zh: 哈桑并不是唯一一位与泰斯案有联系的叙利亚政权官员，他似乎为他提供了海外生活的经济报酬或援助。

paras.en: One former regime member said he had received money from the FBI multiple times in exchange for his co-operation on Tice's case. It was "not in his interest to share all the information all at once," he told the BBC, "in order to be able to drag out how long he can continue to receive payments from them [the US authorities]".
paras.zh: 一名前政权成员表示，他曾多次从联邦调查局收到金钱，以换取他在泰斯案件上的合作。他告诉英国广播公司，“为了能够继续从他们（美国当局）那里收到付款而拖延多久”，“一次性分享所有信息不符合他的利益”。

paras.en: Another former regime member connected to the Tice case claimed he was living in Lebanon under the "patronage" of the US authorities, citing this as the reason he could not speak to us about Tice.
paras.zh: 另一名与泰斯案件有关的前政权成员声称，他在美国当局的“庇护”下生活在黎巴嫩，并以此为理由无法向我们谈论泰斯的情况。

paras.en: The BBC spoke to a former senior Lebanese intelligence official who confirmed that Lebanese intelligence does have arrangements with the Americans, and that these types of payments have and do take place when both agencies have overlap in cases, but said he had no knowledge of payments involving the Tice case.
paras.zh: 英国广播公司采访了一位前黎巴嫩高级情报官员，他证实黎巴嫩情报部门确实与美国有安排，并且当两个机构的案件重叠时，这些类型的付款已经并且确实发生，但他表示他不知道涉及泰斯案件的付款情况。

paras.en: Following the fall of the Assad regime in early December 2024, Hassan is believed to have initially escaped to Iran.
paras.zh: 2024 年 12 月初阿萨德政权垮台后，据信哈桑最初逃往伊朗。

paras.en: A Syrian businessman, with strong connections to both the former regime and the Lebanese authorities, told the BBC that negotiations had then taken place - involving the US, Lebanon, and Iran - to bring Hassan to Lebanon.
paras.zh: 一名与前政权和黎巴嫩当局都有密切联系的叙利亚商人告诉英国广播公司，随后美国、黎巴嫩和伊朗就将哈桑带到黎巴嫩进行了谈判。

paras.en: The businessman, who asked to remain anonymous, said Hassan was valuable, not only because of what he is believed to know about Tice, but because of his knowledge of Syria's chemical weapons programme and its military relationship with Iran - secrets that US intelligence was allegedly interested in.
paras.zh: 这位要求匿名的商人表示，哈桑很有价值，不仅因为据信他了解泰斯的情况，还因为他了解叙利亚的化学武器计划及其与伊朗的军事关系——据称美国情报部门对这些秘密感兴趣。

paras.en: Hassan told US investigators last year that Tice had been executed on former President Assad's orders, but several people with knowledge of the investigation have questioned the details of his account. Hassan has provided a potential location for Tice's remains, but when the site was searched, nothing was found - according to multiple sources familiar with the dig - casting doubt on the validity of some of Hassan's information.
paras.zh: 哈桑去年告诉美国调查人员，泰斯是根据前总统阿萨德的命令被处决的，但一些了解调查情况的人士对他的叙述细节提出了质疑。哈桑提供了泰斯遗骸的潜在位置，但据多位熟悉挖掘情况的消息人士称，搜查该地点时却什么也没找到，这让人对哈桑的一些信息的有效性产生了怀疑。

paras.en: There are questions, however, over how thoroughly the site was searched. Two sources who said they had intimate knowledge of the operation told the BBC that US authorities stopped digging before the search had been completed, possibly because of security concerns.
paras.zh: 然而，该网站的搜索彻底程度存在疑问。两名自称对这次行动非常了解的消息人士告诉英国广播公司，美国当局在搜索完成之前就停止了挖掘，可能是出于安全考虑。

paras.en: When the BBC managed to reach Hassan by phone last year to ask for an interview, he directed us to seek permission for him to speak from the FBI and CIA at the US embassy in Beirut.
paras.zh: 去年，当英国广播公司设法通过电话联系哈桑要求采访时，他指示我们向联邦调查局和中央情报局寻求允许他在美国驻贝鲁特大使馆发表讲话。

paras.en: Our investigation has found that other Syrian officials connected to the Tice case have also apparently found refuge abroad.
paras.zh: 我们的调查发现，与泰斯案有关的其他叙利亚官员显然也在国外寻求庇护。

paras.en: They include Mohammad Makhlouf, who reported to Hassan in Syria and was connected to Tice's detention - now believed to be residing in Lebanon. And Sakr Rustom, Hassan's nephew who was involved in Tice's abduction, now believed to be moving between the UAE and Lebanon. When the BBC attempted to speak to Rustom about Tice's case, he said he "preferred to focus on matters of the future".
paras.zh: 其中包括穆罕默德·马赫卢夫（Mohammad Makhlouf），他在叙利亚向哈桑汇报工作，并与泰斯的拘留有关，目前据信居住在黎巴嫩。参与绑架泰斯事件的哈桑的侄子萨克尔·鲁斯托姆 (Sakr Rustom) 目前据信正在阿联酋和黎巴嫩之间移动。当英国广播公司试图与鲁斯托姆谈论泰斯的案件时，他说他“更愿意关注未来的问题”。

paras.en: Ghassan Nassour, a former general in Syria's Republican Guard, is said by former members of the National Defence Forces to have presided over the jail Tice was held in, and is believed to be living in the UAE with his family, we have been told.
paras.zh: 我们获悉，叙利亚共和国卫队前将军加桑·纳苏尔（Ghassan Nassour）据说曾担任泰斯所在监狱的监狱长，据信他与家人住在阿联酋。

articles.title: Margaret Hamilton, whose software helped land Apollo 11 on the Moon, dies at 90

paras.en: The computer scientist behind groundbreaking research that helped land Nasa's astronauts on the Moon, has died aged 90.
paras.zh: 帮助 NASA 宇航员登陆月球的突破性研究背后的计算机科学家去世，享年 90 岁。

paras.en: Margaret Hamilton was a trailblazer in her field, leading the team who developed the software for Nasa's Apollo missions, which coined the term "software engineering".
paras.zh: 玛格丽特·汉密尔顿 (Margaret Hamilton) 是该领域的开拓者，领导团队为美国宇航局阿波罗任务开发软件，并创造了“软件工程”一词。

paras.en: Hamilton's former employer, the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), confirmed her death, adding she died on 30 September.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿的前雇主麻省理工学院 (MIT) 证实了她的死亡，并补充说她于 9 月 30 日去世。

paras.en: "To say Hamilton was a pioneer - to say she was ahead of her time - would be a dramatic understatement," MIT said in its statement, before acknowledging that she was a software engineer before it was mainstream.
paras.zh: 麻省理工学院在声明中表示：“说汉密尔顿是一位先驱——说她领先于她的时代——这将是一种戏剧性的轻描淡写。”然后承认她在软件成为主流之前就已经是一名软件工程师了。

paras.en: Hamilton worked at MIT from 1959 until the mid-1970s and managed the Software Engineering Division.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿从 1959 年到 20 世纪 70 年代中期在麻省理工学院工作，管理软件工程部门。

paras.en: It was in this division that she led a team of engineers writing and testing all onboard in-flight software for Nasa's Apollo 11 project that guided US astronauts Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin to land safely on the Moon.
paras.zh: 正是在这个部门，她领导了一个工程师团队为美国宇航局阿波罗 11 号项目编写和测试所有机载飞行软件，该项目引导美国宇航员尼尔·阿姆斯特朗和巴兹·奥尔德林安全登陆月球。

paras.en: "I was attracted both by the sheer idea and the fact that it had never been done before. I was the first programmer to join and the first woman they hired," she told the Guardian in 2019.
paras.zh: “我被这个纯粹的想法和以前从未做过的事实所吸引。我是第一个加入的程序员，也是他们雇用的第一位女性，”她在 2019 年告诉卫报。

paras.en: In 1969, moments before the historic Apollo 11 Moon landing, an onboard computer raised an alarm, signalling an error was occurring.
paras.zh: 1969 年，历史性的阿波罗 11 号登月前不久，机载计算机发出警报，表明发生了错误。

paras.en: The error detected the computer was overloaded, and for a moment it looked like the complex landing might not be achieved.
paras.zh: 错误检测到计算机超载，一时看起来复杂的着陆可能无法实现。

paras.en: But Hamilton and her team had planned for such an error by engineering "priority-driven software" to shut down any background tasks and favour the most important - the Moon landing - according to MIT.
paras.zh: 但据麻省理工学院称，汉密尔顿和她的团队已经计划通过设计“优先级驱动软件”来关闭所有后台任务并支持最重要的任务——登月——来应对这种错误。

paras.en: The team's famous software engineering was immortalised in a 1969 photograph of Hamilton standing beside the stack of printed code that towered beside her.
paras.zh: 该团队著名的软件工程在 1969 年的一张照片中永垂不朽，这张照片中汉密尔顿站在她身旁高耸的一堆打印代码旁边。

paras.en: In 2016, Hamilton's life work was honoured by Barack Obama with the Presidential Medal of Freedom for her contribution to science and space travel.
paras.zh: 2016 年，汉密尔顿一生的工作被巴拉克·奥巴马授予总统自由勋章，以表彰她对科学和太空旅行的贡献。

paras.en: At the time, Obama said Hamilton "symbolises that generation of unsung women who helped send humankind into space".
paras.zh: 当时，奥巴马称汉密尔顿“象征着帮助人类进入太空的那一代无名女性”。

paras.en: Hamilton, born in Indiana in 1936, first studied mathematics at the University of Michigan in 1955 before moving to Earlham College where she got a BA in mathematics in 1958.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿 1936 年出生于印第安纳州，1955 年首先在密歇根大学学习数学，然后转到厄勒姆学院，并于 1958 年获得数学学士学位。

paras.en: She then moved to Boston, Massachusetts, a year later with her husband and originally took the job at MIT to support her husband during his law degree.
paras.zh: 一年后，她与丈夫搬到了马萨诸塞州波士顿，最初在麻省理工学院工作是为了支持丈夫攻读法律学位。

paras.en: From the 1970s onwards, Hamilton used her expertise to found her own software businesses, including Hamilton Technologies, which is still based in Massachusetts.
paras.zh: 从 20 世纪 70 年代起，汉密尔顿利用她的专业知识创立了自己的软件企业，其中包括汉密尔顿技术公司，该公司的总部仍位于马萨诸塞州。

paras.en: "We are saddened by her death, but grateful for the opportunity to have celebrated her extraordinary achievements throughout her long life", Earlham College said in a statement on social media.
paras.zh: 厄勒姆学院在社交媒体上发表声明称：“我们对她的去世感到悲痛，但很高兴有机会庆祝她漫长一生中取得的非凡成就。”

paras.en: "Her pioneering spirit and remarkable legacy will continue to inspire generations of Earlhamites," the statement said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“她的开拓精神和卓越的遗产将继续激励一代又一代的厄勒姆人。”

paras.en: Hamilton is survived by her daughter, a son-in-law, two grandsons and four great-grandchildren, according to MIT.
paras.zh: 据麻省理工学院称，汉密尔顿身后留下了她的女儿、女婿、两个孙子和四个曾孙。

articles.title: 1,000-mile-long cloud that forms and vanishes on Mars every day obeys 'exotic physics' never seen on Earth
articles.author: Harry Baker

paras.en: A 1,000-mile-long (1,600 kilometers) Martian cloud that emerges and then quickly disappears from the Red Planet's sky nearly every day is even weirder than scientists realized. New simulations suggest that the eerie apparition can only be explained using "exotic physics" that have been theorized but never seen on Earth or anywhere else in the solar system.
paras.zh: 几乎每天都有1000英里（ 1600公里）长的火星云从红色星球的天空中出现，然后迅速消失，这比科学家们意识到的还要奇怪。新的模拟表明，这种令人毛骨悚然的幽灵只能用“异国物理学”来解释，这些物理学已经被理论化，但在地球或太阳系的其他任何地方都从未见过。

paras.en: The mysterious floating mass, dubbed the Arsia Mons Elongated Cloud (AMEC), frequently emerges above Arsia Mons, a 12-mile-tall (20 km) extinct volcano located in the Tharsis region, just south of the Red Planet's equator. The water vapor cloud was first spotted in 2018 by the European Space Agency's Mars Express orbiter and has since appeared nearly every morning throughout Mars' spring and summer, when increased solar radiation triggers strong surface winds. But it lasts only a few hours each day, before fully evaporating.
paras.zh: 这个被称为阿尔西亚蒙斯拉长云 (AMEC) 的神秘漂浮物经常出现在阿尔西亚蒙斯上空，阿尔西亚蒙斯是一座 12 英里（20 公里）高的死火山，位于红色星球赤道以南的塔尔西斯地区。欧洲航天局的火星快车轨道飞行器于 2018 年首次发现了这种水蒸气云，此后在火星春季和夏季几乎每天早上都会出现这种水蒸气云，此时太阳辐射的增加会引发强烈的表面风。但它每天只持续几个小时，然后就完全蒸发。

paras.en: The AMEC can stretch up to 1,100 miles (1,800 km) long, around one-twelfth of Mars' circumference. For context, that is roughly twice the length of the U.K. or the distance between New York City and Miami.
paras.zh: AMEC可以延伸到1100英里（ 1800公里）长，大约是火星周长的十二分之一。就上下文而言，这大约是英国长度或纽约市与迈阿密之间距离的两倍。

paras.en: Although the Red Planet is no stranger to giant dust clouds and occasional "iridescent streaks" of carbon dioxide, it is almost completely devoid of atmospheric water vapor. That makes it extremely rare for puffy, Earth-like clouds to form there, let alone ones so vast. As a result, scientists have struggled to explain this whacky weather.
paras.zh: 虽然这颗红色星球对巨大的尘埃云和偶尔的二氧化碳“虹彩条纹”并不陌生，但它几乎完全没有大气中的水蒸气。这使得在那里形成浮肿的地球状云极为罕见，更不用说如此巨大的云了。因此，科学家们一直在努力解释这种古怪的天气。

paras.en: But in a new study published Wednesday (Oct. 7) in the journal Nature Geoscience, researchers used Mars Express data to create new simulations in an effort to finally explain the AMEC. Initially, the team struggled to recreate the puzzling phenomenon. But when they abandoned traditional meteorological principles in favor of a more out-of-the-box explanation, they were eventually successful.
paras.zh: 但在周三（ 10月7日）发表在《自然地球科学》杂志上的一项新研究中，研究人员利用火星快车数据创建了新的模拟，以最终解释AMEC。最初，该团队努力重现这种令人费解的现象。但是，当他们放弃传统的气象学原理，转而采用更开箱即用的解释时，他们最终取得了成功。

paras.en: "To create the AMEC in our modelling, we found that we needed to include some exotic physics … physics that, while included in textbooks, is treated as theoretical and usually thought not to happen in nature," study first author Jorge Hernández-Bernal, a planetary scientist at the University of the Basque Country in Spain who was affiliated with Sorbonne University in Paris at the time of the study, said in a statement. "Once we included this physics in our simulations, the AMEC emerged just as we hoped."
paras.zh: “为了在我们的模型中创建 AMEC，我们发现我们需要纳入一些奇异的物理……这些物理虽然包含在教科书中，但被视为理论，通常被认为不会在自然界中发生，”该研究的第一作者豪尔赫·埃尔南德斯-贝尔纳尔（Jorge Hernández-Bernal）在一份声明中说，他是西班牙巴斯克大学的行星科学家，在研究时隶属于巴黎索邦大学。 “一旦我们将这种物理现象纳入我们的模拟中，AMEC 正如我们所希望的那样出现了。”

paras.en: The AMEC is an orographic cloud, meaning it forms as strong winds push water vapor up and over a raised structure, such as a mountain. Similar clouds also exist on Earth, including the "Levanter" cloud, which occasionally forms above the Rock of Gibraltar in southern Europe. However, the Martian equivalent cannot be explained by the same processes that occur on our planet.
paras.zh: AMEC是一种地形云，这意味着它随着强风将水蒸气推向山脉等隆起结构而形成。地球上也存在类似的云，包括“Levanter”云，它偶尔会在欧洲南部的直布罗陀岩石上方形成。然而，火星等价物不能用我们星球上发生的相同过程来解释。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: On Earth, clouds form via a process called heterogeneous nucleation, in which moist air cools and condenses into ice crystals that form around tiny atmospheric particles, such as dust, salt, pollen or soot. But while Mars has plenty of atmospheric dust, that's not what's happening there.
paras.zh: 在地球上，云层通过称为异质成核的过程形成，其中潮湿的空气冷却并凝结成冰晶，形成微小的大气颗粒，如尘埃、盐、花粉或烟灰。但是，虽然火星上有大量的大气尘埃，但这并不是那里发生的事情。

paras.en: "For the AMEC, it seems that cloud formation takes place without needing any of this 'stuff' [in the air]," said Hernández-Bernal, who has been studying the AMEC for the past six years. "Water vapour turns directly into icy cloud particles without any middle step. It's akin to droplets of condensation appearing in the middle of a room, rather than on a window."
paras.zh: 过去六年一直在研究AMEC的Hernández-Bernal说： “对于AMEC来说，似乎云的形成不需要[在空中]的任何这种'东西'。” “水蒸气直接变成冰冷的云粒，没有任何中间步骤。它类似于凝结水滴出现在房间中间，而不是窗户上。”

paras.en: The researchers call this "homogeneous nucleation" and say it has never been seen before in a planetary atmosphere. "It's wholly unexpected," Hernández-Bernal added.
paras.zh: 研究人员称之为“均匀成核” ，并表示它以前从未在行星大气层中见过。“这完全出乎意料，”埃尔南德斯-伯纳尔补充道。

paras.en: Other scientists previously predicted that homogeneous nucleation could occur in Earth's upper atmosphere or in the skies above Venus. However, this has been deemed highly unlikely because it requires humidity levels roughly 100,000 times greater than those on our planet's surface.
paras.zh: 其他科学家此前曾预测，均匀成核可能发生在地球上层大气或金星上空。然而，这被认为是不太可能的，因为它需要的湿度水平大约是我们星球表面湿度的10万倍。

paras.en: Given that modern-day Mars is almost completely devoid of water, it may seem unlikely that its humidity levels could reach such lofty heights. However, the Mars Express data tells a different story.
paras.zh: 鉴于现代火星几乎完全没有水，其湿度水平似乎不太可能达到如此高的高度。然而，火星快车的数据讲述了一个不同的故事。

paras.en: As wind rises up the slopes of Arsia Mons, which is more than twice as tall as Mount Everest, it creates a powerful wave that shoots air into the upper atmosphere at tremendous speed. The researchers calculated that the temperature of this air can drop by up to 54 degrees Fahrenheit (30 degrees Celsius) in just 10 minutes. This not only makes it easy to freeze but also greatly increases the humidity within the wave, allowing homogeneous nucleation to take place, the simulations show.
paras.zh: 随着风从比珠穆朗玛峰高两倍以上的阿尔西亚山脉的斜坡上升起，它产生了一股强大的波浪，以惊人的速度将空气喷射到高层大气中。研究人员计算出，这种空气的温度可以在短短10分钟内下降高达54华氏度（ 30摄氏度）。模拟显示，这不仅易于冻结，而且还大大增加了波浪内的湿度，允许发生均匀的成核。

paras.en: So where does all this water come from? Some of it is already in the atmosphere, but some likely originates at the summit of Arsia Mons, which is covered with a thick layer of frost, the researchers suggested.
paras.zh: 那么这些水是从哪里来的呢？研究人员建议，其中一些已经存在于大气中，但有些可能起源于Arsia Mons的山顶，那里覆盖着厚厚的霜层。

paras.en: The new simulations mark a big step forward in our understanding of the AMEC and wider Martian meteorology.
paras.zh: 新的模拟标志着我们对AMEC和更广泛的火星气象学的理解向前迈出了一大步。

paras.en: "We don't have nearly as much information about Mars' atmosphere as we do about Earth's, so reproducing the AMEC to this degree is a big success for the model," Hernández-Bernal said.
paras.zh: Hernández-Bernal说： “我们对火星大气层的信息几乎没有我们对地球大气层的信息那么多，因此将AMEC复制到这个程度对该模型来说是一个巨大的成功。”

paras.en: The findings would not have been possible without the Mars Express orbiter, which used three instruments — the Visual Monitoring Camera, the High Resolution Stereo Camera and the OMEGA instrument — to map out how the AMEC takes shape and evolves every day. It is also one of the only Mars spacecraft that can see Arsia Mons in daylight.
paras.zh: 如果没有火星快车轨道飞行器，这些发现是不可能的。火星快车轨道飞行器使用了三种仪器--视觉监控相机、高分辨率立体相机和欧米茄仪器--来绘制AMEC的形状和日常演变。它也是唯一可以在白天看到Arsia Mons的火星飞船之一。

paras.en: "Mars Express discovered the AMEC, has followed up and monitored it for years, and is now helping reveal the secrets of its formation," Colin Wilson, the project scientist for Mars Express, who was not involved in the new study, said in the statement.
paras.zh: “火星快车发现了AMEC ，多年来一直在跟踪和监测它，现在正在帮助揭示其形成的秘密，”没有参与这项新研究的火星快车项目科学家科林威尔逊在声明中说。

paras.en: The discovery is also a reminder that, despite sharing the same basic principles, weather systems do not behave the same on other worlds as they do on Earth, which could have big implications for solar system exploration and the hunt for extraterrestrial life on distant exoplanets.
paras.zh: 这一发现也提醒我们，尽管具有相同的基本原理，但天气系统在其他星球上的行为与在地球上的行为不同，这可能对太阳系探索和在遥远的系外行星上寻找外星生命产生重大影响。

paras.en: "While clouds on Earth and Mars seem to be governed by the same 'rules', understanding this exotic Martian cloud required exotic physics — and this may be true elsewhere in the cosmos," Wilson said.
paras.zh: 威尔逊说： “虽然地球和火星上的云似乎受相同的'规则'支配，但理解这种异国情调的火星云需要异国情调的物理学—这可能在宇宙的其他地方也是如此。”

paras.en: Hernández-Bernal, J., Määttänen, A., Spiga, A., & Forget, F. (2026). Homogeneous ice nucleation from water vapour suggested by elongated clouds on Mars. Nature Geoscience. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41561-026-02089-9
paras.zh: Hernández-Bernal, J., Määttänen, A., Spiga, A., & Forget, F. (2026)。火星上细长云所建议的水蒸气均匀冰核。自然地球科学。https://doi.org/10.1038/s41561-026-02089-9

paras.en: Harry is a U.K.-based senior staff writer at Live Science. He studied marine biology at the University of Exeter before training to become a journalist. He covers a wide range of topics including space exploration, planetary science, space weather, climate change, animal behavior and paleontology. His recent work on the solar maximum won "best space submission" at the 2024 Aerospace Media Awards and was shortlisted in the "top scoop" category at the NCTJ Awards for Excellence in 2023. He also writes Live Science's weekly Earth from space series.
paras.zh: 哈里是《Live Science》驻英国的高级撰稿人。在接受记者培训之前，他在埃克塞特大学学习海洋生物学。他涵盖的主题广泛，包括太空探索、行星科学、太空天气、气候变化、动物行为和古生物学。他最近关于太阳活动极大期的工作赢得了 2024 年航空航天媒体奖的“最佳太空作品”，并入围了 2023 年 NCTJ 卓越奖的“顶级独家报道”类别。他还撰写了《Live Science》的每周地球从太空系列文章。

articles.title: 'It looks like a chimera' — 168 million years ago, a strange platypus-like mammal relative lived in China alongside dinosaurs
articles.author: Chris Simms

paras.en: A newly discovered platypus-like creature is the largest-known mammal relative from the entire Jurassic period, a new study finds — although it still only weighed as much as a Chihuahua.
paras.zh: 一项新的研究发现，一种新发现的类似鸭嘴兽的生物是整个侏罗纪时期已知的最大的哺乳动物亲戚，尽管它的重量仍然只有吉娃娃犬那么重。

paras.en: The critter, which hunted salamanders in the freshwater lakes and rivers of what is now Inner Mongolia, China, lived during the mid-Jurassic between 168 million and 163 million years ago. It seems to be the earliest known mammal-type animal that lived a semiaquatic life.
paras.zh: 这种生物生活在 1.68 亿至 1.63 亿年前的侏罗纪中期，在现在的中国内蒙古的淡水湖泊和河流中捕食蝾螈。它似乎是已知最早的半水生哺乳动物。

paras.en: Researchers unearthed the delicate and detailed fossil in 2016, which revealed that the animal likely weighed about 2.2 to 4.4 pounds (1 to 2 kilograms). It was large for a mammal relative during the Jurassic, but its name, Megacauda sungei, was inspired by its tail: Megacauda means "big tail." The discovery was detailed in a study published on Wednesday (Oct. 7) in the journal Nature.
paras.zh: 研究人员于 2016 年出土了这块精致而细致的化石，结果显示该动物的重量可能约为 2.2 至 4.4 磅（1 至 2 公斤）。对于侏罗纪时期的哺乳动物亲戚来说，它的体型很大，但它的名字 Megacauda sungei 的灵感来自于它的尾巴：Megacauda 的意思是“大尾巴”。周三（10 月 7 日）《自然》杂志上发表的一项研究详细介绍了这一发现。

paras.en: The furry predator had a mix of features seen in modern-day animals, with a broad, flattened tail that marks it as a powerful swimmer, and short hind legs with relatively long feet.
paras.zh: 这种毛茸茸的捕食者具有现代动物的特征，宽而扁平的尾巴标志着它是一个强大的游泳者，后腿较短，脚相对较长。

paras.en: "It's like a chimera," study co-author Zhe-Xi Luo, a paleontologist at the University of Chicago, told Live Science. "The back half of this animal is very much like a platypus. As are the limbs, which would be capable of swimming or digging tunnels in river banks."
paras.zh: “它就像一个嵌合体，”研究合著者、芝加哥大学古生物学家罗哲熙告诉《生活科学》。 “这种动物的后半部分非常像鸭嘴兽。四肢也很像，能够在河岸游泳或挖掘隧道。”

paras.en: But the teeth "are definitely not like a platypus," Luo said. It possessed robust canines and shearing cheek-teeth that would cut and chew meat in a different way from modern carnivorous mammals. "It's a predator with gigantic and very specialized canines," Luo said. "So, it's partly otter-like and partly platypus-like."
paras.zh: 但这些牙齿“绝对不像鸭嘴兽，”罗说。它拥有强壮的犬齿和剪切颊齿，能够以与现代肉食哺乳动物不同的方式切割和咀嚼肉。 “它是一种掠食者，拥有巨大且非常专业的犬齿，”罗说。 “所以，它部分像水獭，部分像鸭嘴兽。”

paras.en: Tiny bits of vertebrate bones found in what would have been the animal's stomach and the surrounding fossil beds hint that M. sungei dined on salamanders, Luo said.
paras.zh: 罗说，在该动物的胃和周围的化石床中发现的微小脊椎动物骨头表明，双溪大蜥蜴以蝾螈为食。

paras.en: He added that M. sungei may have sheltered in burrows on land in the temperate plant-filled climate, and hunted in lakes and rivers for fish and invertebrates.
paras.zh: 他补充说，在温带植物丛生的气候下，双溪巨蜥可能在陆地上的洞穴中躲避，并在湖泊和河流中捕猎鱼类和无脊椎动物。

paras.en: Another notable aspect of the fossil is its throat. Modern mammals, including humans, have hyoid bones in the throat arranged in a "U"-shaped saddle. These help us use throat muscles to swallow chewed food one chunk at a time, instead of gulping down huge bites or whole prey. The structures also enable babies to suckle their mother's milk.
paras.zh: 该化石的另一个值得注意的方面是它的喉咙。现代哺乳动物，包括人类，喉咙里的舌骨呈“U”形鞍状排列。这些帮助我们利用喉咙肌肉一次吞下一大块咀嚼过的食物，而不是吞下一大口或整个猎物。这些结构还使婴儿能够吮吸母乳。

paras.en: M. sungei seems to have had the apparatus needed to do this, study co-author Thomas Martin, a paleontologist at the University of Bonn in Germany, told Live Science.
paras.zh: 研究合著者、德国波恩大学古生物学家托马斯·马丁 (Thomas Martin) 告诉《生活科学》杂志，M.sungei 似乎拥有做到这一点所需的设备。

paras.en: "This is an incredibly important evolutionary innovation," Luo said, adding that this capability is one of the things that helped early mammals diversify into carnivores, insectivores, herbivores or omnivores to take advantage of all sorts of foods.
paras.zh: 罗说：“这是一项极其重要的进化创新。”他补充说，这种能力是帮助早期哺乳动物多样化为食肉动物、食虫动物、食草动物或杂食动物以利用各种食物的能力之一。

paras.en: Finding this in M. sungei suggests that the apparatus needed for suckling milk and swallowing had already evolved by the Middle Jurassic (around 174 million to 164 million years ago), Martin said.
paras.zh: 马丁说，在 M.sungei 中发现这一点表明，哺乳和吞咽所需的器官在中侏罗世（大约 1.74 亿至 1.64 亿年前）就已经进化出来。

paras.en: This is before marsupials like kangaroos and placental mammals like primates and bears are thought to have diverged from each other 160 million years ago, after descending from an egg-laying common ancestor that lived approximately 180 million years ago.
paras.zh: 据认为，袋鼠等有袋动物和灵长类动物和熊等胎盘哺乳动物在 1.6 亿年前彼此分化，它们是生活在大约 1.8 亿年前的产卵共同祖先的后代。

paras.en: "Now we push the history of it back to before the split of modern marsupials and modern eutherian [placental] mammals," Luo said.
paras.zh: “现在我们把它的历史推回到现代有袋动物和现代真兽（胎盘）哺乳动物分裂之前，”罗说。

paras.en: "Neonatal suckling behaviour was previously thought of as being a hallmark of advanced mammals, but it now appears to have evolved well before then, in the common ancestor of docodontans and mammals at least 165 million years ago," said Sue Hand, a vertebrate paleontologist at the University of New South Wales in Australia who wasn’t involved in the study.
paras.zh: 未参与这项研究的澳大利亚新南威尔士大学脊椎动物古生物学家苏·汉德（Sue Hand）表示：“新生儿吮吸行为以前被认为是高级哺乳动物的标志，但现在看来，这种行为似乎早在1.65亿年前就已经在齿齿兽类和哺乳动物的共同祖先中进化出来了。”

paras.en: M. sungei is from an extinct lineage of docodonts, which are relatives of mammals from the dinosaur-dominated Jurassic and Cretaceous periods, living between about 200 million and 120 million years ago.
paras.zh: M.sungei 属于已灭绝的Docodonts 谱系，它们是恐龙主导的侏罗纪和白垩纪时期哺乳动物的近亲，生活在大约2 亿至1.2 亿年前。

paras.en: Docodonts adapted to a wide variety of habitats. For example, there was the Jurassic tree-dwelling shrew-like docodont called Microdocodon gracilis, and Docofossor brachydactylus, a tunnel-digger with shovel-like paws. Luo was also part of the team that described a semiaquatic "Jurassic beaver", Castorocauda lutrasimilis, which lived 164 million years ago.
paras.zh: Docodon可适应各种栖息地。例如，有一种名为Microdocodon gracilis的侏罗纪树栖虾状牙本植物，还有一种名为Docofossor brachydactylus的爪子像铲子一样的隧道挖掘机。Luo也是描述半水生“侏罗纪海狸” Castorocauda lutrasimilis的团队成员，该海狸生活在1.64亿年前。

paras.en: "It seems that an aquatic lifestyle arose often in early mammal-like species," said Tim Flannery, a mammalogist at the Australian Museum Research institute who wasn't involved in the work.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚博物馆研究所的哺乳动物学家蒂姆·弗兰纳里（ Tim Flannery ）说： “水生生活方式似乎经常出现在早期的哺乳动物物种中，他没有参与这项工作。”

paras.en: If anything, the newly described "spectacular fossil" shows that docodonts were wide-ranging during the dinosaur age, Hand told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: Hand在一封电子邮件中告诉Live Science ，如果有的话，新描述的“壮观的化石”表明，在恐龙时代， docodonts的范围很广。

paras.en: "This very detailed study adds to accumulating evidence that mammaliaforms occupied a wide range of ecological niches long before the evolution of living mammals," Hand said.
paras.zh: Hand说： “这项非常详细的研究进一步积累了证据，证明哺乳动物在哺乳动物进化之前就占据了广泛的生态位。”

paras.en: Li, Y., Li, P., Neander, A., I., Zhang, H., Zhou, C., Martin, T., & Luo, Z. (2026a). A Jurassic mammaliaform swimmer and transformation of the mammalian pharynx. Nature. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-11107-0
paras.zh: Li, Y., Li, P., Neander, A., I., Zhang, H., Zhou, C., Martin, T., & Luo, Z. (2026a).侏罗纪哺乳动物游泳运动员和哺乳动物咽部的转化。自然。https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-11107-0

paras.en: Chris Simms is a freelance journalist who previously worked at New Scientist for more than 10 years, in roles including chief subeditor and assistant news editor. He was also a senior subeditor at Nature and has a degree in zoology from Queen Mary University of London. In recent years, he has written numerous articles for New Scientist and in 2018 was shortlisted for Best Newcomer at the Association of British Science Writers awards.
paras.zh: Chris Simms是一名自由撰稿人，曾在New Scientist工作超过10年，担任过首席副主编和助理新闻编辑等职务。他还是Nature的高级副主编，并拥有伦敦玛丽女王大学的动物学学位。近年来，他为《新科学家》撰写了大量文章，并于2018年入围英国科学作家协会最佳新人奖。

articles.title: Scientists discover the genetic secrets that may have helped Jonathan the tortoise live to 194 years old
articles.author: Lauren Schneider

paras.en: The remote south Atlantic island of St. Helena boasts an international celebrity: the tortoise Jonathan, the oldest living land animal. At 194 years old, he has outlasted the expected lifespan for an Aldabra giant tortoise (Aldabrachelys gigantea) by about a century. Now, scientists have identified a range of unique genetic and epigenetic traits that may hold the key to this longevity.
paras.zh: 偏远的南大西洋圣赫勒拿岛拥有一位国际名人：乔纳森乌龟，它是现存最古老的陆地动物。他已经 194 岁了，比亚达伯拉象龟 (Aldabrachelys gigantea) 的预期寿命多了大约一个世纪。现在，科学家们已经确定了一系列独特的遗传和表观遗传特征，这些特征可能是长寿的关键。

paras.en: The new research zoomed in on Jonathan's genes, as well as the chemical tags that sit on top of DNA molecules, known as "epigenetic markers." These markers help control which genes are activated and to what degree. The analysis finds that Jonathan's genes associated with mitochondrial function are in great shape, epigenetically speaking, which suggests that they've played a big role in the tortoise's success.
paras.zh: 这项新研究重点关注乔纳森的基因，以及 DNA 分子顶部的化学标签，即“表观遗传标记”。这些标记有助于控制哪些基因被激活以及激活的程度。分析发现，从表观遗传学的角度来看，乔纳森与线粒体功能相关的基因状态良好，这表明它们在乌龟的成功中发挥了重要作用。

paras.en: While mitochondrial function has long been linked to longevity and mitochondrial dysfunction has been tied to disease, Jonathan offers fresh insight into that dynamic, said study co-author Stephen Clark, chief scientist of the Kallel Foundation, a nonprofit in Nashville researching drug targets to promote human longevity.
paras.zh: 研究合著者、纳什维尔非营利组织卡勒尔基金会的首席科学家斯蒂芬·克拉克表示，虽然线粒体功能长期以来与长寿有关，而线粒体功能障碍与疾病有关，但乔纳森对这种动态提供了新的见解。

paras.en: Clark and colleagues published their findings Wednesday (Oct. 7) in the journal Science Advances.
paras.zh: 克拉克和同事于周三（10 月 7 日）在《科学进展》杂志上发表了他们的发现。

paras.en: Decoding Jonathan's secrets to long life
paras.zh: 解读乔纳森的长寿秘诀

paras.en: Nearly a decade ago, the researchers enlisted Joe Hollins, the vet tasked with Jonathan's care, to collect samples from the record-setting animal. Island authorities forbade the vet from drawing the tortoise's blood, fearing the risk of an infection.
paras.zh: 大约十年前，研究人员聘请了负责照顾乔纳森的兽医乔·霍林斯(Joe Hollins)，从这只创纪录的动物身上采集样本。岛上当局禁止兽医为乌龟抽取血液，担心有感染的风险。

paras.en: "I didn't want to be the doctor that killed Jonathan," Clark told Live Science. Hollins collected samples via cheek swab instead.
paras.zh: “我不想成为杀死乔纳森的医生，”克拉克告诉《生活科学》。霍林斯改为通过脸颊拭子收集样本。

paras.en: When the samples arrived in the U.S., the researchers sequenced them, but when their computers kept crashing, they discovered that the DNA had been isolated from bacteria in Jonathan's mouth rather than the tortoise's own cells.
paras.zh: 当样本到达美国后，研究人员对它们进行了测序，但当他们的计算机不断崩溃时，他们发现DNA是从乔纳森嘴里的细菌中分离出来的，而不是从乌龟自己的细胞中分离出来的。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Clark "had to go back and beg" for permission to collect more data, he said. The vet then sent cheek scrape samples, which are collected with a slightly different tool than cheek swabs. This time, the DNA was in fact from Jonathan.
paras.zh: 克拉克说，他“不得不回去乞求”允许收集更多数据。然后，兽医发送了脸颊刮擦样本，收集样本的工具与脸颊拭子略有不同。这一次，DNA确实来自乔纳森。

paras.en: The DNA isolated from those cheek tissue samples was more fragmented than it would have been in a blood sample, so the researchers filled in the gaps using an existing reference genome from a 36-year-old Aldabra tortoise named Tank. They also compared Jonathan's DNA to that of a Galápagos tortoise (Chelonoidis abingdoni) named Lonesome George, who was believed to be over 100 years old at the time of his death in 2012.
paras.zh: 从这些面颊组织样本中分离出的 DNA 比血液样本中的 DNA 更加碎片化，因此研究人员使用来自 36 岁亚达伯拉象龟 Tank 的现有参考基因组来填补这些空白。他们还将乔纳森的 DNA 与一只名叫“孤独乔治”的加拉帕戈斯象龟 (Chelonoidis abingdoni) 的 DNA 进行了比较，据信后者在 2012 年去世时已经 100 多岁了。

paras.en: The team found that, compared to Tank and Lonesome George, Jonathan carried 287 unique variants of genes that had previously been linked to aging-related pathways. These included genes involved in DNA repair and the function of telomeres — the protective tips at the end of chromosomes that tend to shorten with age.
paras.zh: 研究小组发现，与坦克和孤独的乔治相比，乔纳森携带 287 个独特的基因变体，这些基因先前与衰老相关途径有关。其中包括参与DNA修复和端粒功能的基因——端粒是染色体末端的保护性尖端，随着年龄的增长往往会缩短。

paras.en: These pathways are also related to aging processes in humans, highlighting a "broader signature of aging" across species, Greer Dolby, an assistant professor of biology at The University of Alabama at Birmingham, who was not involved with the study, told Live Science.
paras.zh: 未参与这项研究的阿拉巴马大学伯明翰分校生物学助理教授格里尔·杜比（Greer Dolby）告诉《生活科学》杂志，这些途径也与人类的衰老过程有关，凸显了跨物种的“更广泛的衰老特征”。

paras.en: The researchers also looked at epigenetic changes, including DNA methylation, which is when a chemical tag called a methyl group binds the DNA. Certain patterns of DNA methylation can function as a "clock" in that they reflect an organism's biological age; scientists have recently harnessed these patterns in the study of human aging. In this case, the team compared the DNA methylation across Jonathan's genome to that of young and old Aldabra tortoises.
paras.zh: 研究人员还研究了表观遗传变化，包括 DNA 甲基化，即甲基化化学标签与 DNA 结合的情况。 DNA甲基化的某些模式可以起到“时钟”的作用，因为它们反映了生物体的生物年龄。科学家最近利用这些模式来研究人类衰老。在这种情况下，研究小组将乔纳森的基因组 DNA 甲基化与年轻和年老的亚达伯拉象龟进行了比较。

paras.en: The methylation patterns were more disordered in the older tortoises, reflecting random changes acquired over time, the researchers found. Scientists call this phenomenon "methylation entropy." For most genes, Jonathan's DNA methylation patterns were more disordered than those of the young tortoises. But in a suite of genes tied to mitochondrial function — specifically the bits of those genes that switch them "on" — Jonathan had more organized methylation patterns. That might keep expression of these genes consistent over time, the researchers theorized.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，老年陆龟的甲基化模式更加无序，反映了随着时间的推移而发生的随机变化。科学家将这种现象称为“甲基化熵”。对于大多数基因来说，乔纳森的 DNA 甲基化模式比幼龟的更加无序。但在一系列与线粒体功能相关的基因中——特别是那些“开启”线粒体功能的基因片段——乔纳森拥有更有组织的甲基化模式。研究人员推测，随着时间的推移，这可能会使这些基因的表达保持一致。

paras.en: Mitochondria produce energy that cells need to function properly, repair themselves and reduce further damage to DNA. "Keeping the entropy low in these mitochondrial genes, or keeping pristine mitochondria, is likely to be a contributor to longevity," Clark said.
paras.zh: 线粒体产生细胞正常运作、自我修复和减少 DNA 进一步损伤所需的能量。克拉克说：“保持这些线粒体基因的熵较低，或者保持原始线粒体，可能有助于长寿。”

paras.en: However, the authors couldn't determine a causal relationship — they didn't run any tests that could definitively prove that Jonathon's lack of entropy in these genes explains his long life. Clark argued that additional experiments on a blood sample from Jonathan could offer a more comprehensive view of his genome.
paras.zh: 然而，作者无法确定因果关系——他们没有进行任何测试来明确证明乔纳森这些基因中缺乏熵解释了他的长寿。克拉克认为，对乔纳森的血液样本进行额外的实验可以提供对他的基因组的更全面的了解。

paras.en: Jonathan's full genetic profile can't be known until after the tortoise's death, when researchers can collect DNA from more tissues, said Vincent Lynch, a professor of biology at the University at Buffalo, who was not involved with the study.
paras.zh: 未参与这项研究的布法罗大学生物学教授文森特·林奇 (Vincent Lynch) 表示，乔纳森的完整基因谱要等到乌龟死后才能得知，届时研究人员可以从更多组织中收集 DNA。

paras.en: "Some organs are more susceptible to different diseases of old age than other ones, and that happens because mutations accumulate over time," he told Live Science. "We would ideally like to know what those mutations are in those specific tissues."
paras.zh: 他告诉《生活科学》杂志：“一些器官比其他器官更容易受到不同老年疾病的影响，这是因为突变随着时间的推移而积累。” “我们理想地想知道这些特定组织中的突变是什么。”

paras.en: Furthermore, Lynch questioned whether entropy was a useful characterization of age-related DNA methylation patterns, as methylation can be unpredictable. That said, he agreed that the genes flagged in the study offer helpful data for future work on longevity.
paras.zh: 此外，Lynch 质疑熵是否是与年龄相关的 DNA 甲基化模式的有用表征，因为甲基化可能是不可预测的。尽管如此，他同意该研究中标记的基因为未来的长寿研究提供了有用的数据。

paras.en: More experiments are needed to determine whether these mitochondrial genes actually play a role in longevity across all Aldabra tortoises, let alone in other animals, or if Jonathan is just an outlier.
paras.zh: 需要更多的实验来确定这些线粒体基因是否真的在所有亚达伯拉陆龟的长寿中发挥作用，更不用说在其他动物中，或者乔纳森是否只是一个异常值。

paras.en: "Maybe Jonathan is just really good at being old," Lynch said.
paras.zh: “也许乔纳森真的很擅长变老，”林奇说。

paras.en: Vasivil, B., Schmidt, D.P., Jones, A., Kapatral, V., Ford, J.M., Taylor, M.L., Colwell, M., Hollins, J., Pascucci, S., Weissenow, K., Rost, B., Notion, P., Gerlach, J., Terwilliger, T.C., Hung, L-W., Jensen, L.J., Reed, K., Robeck, T.R., Horvath, S., Faulk, C., Ma, Y., Clark, S.W. (2026). Epigenetic insights into extreme longevity in the world's oldest terrestrial animal, Jonathan. Science Advances. 12. https://www.doi.org/10.1126/sciadv.adw8887
paras.zh: Vasivil, B.、Schmidt, D.P.、Jones, A.、Kapatral, V.、Ford, J.M.、Taylor, M.L.、Colwell, M.、Hollins, J.、Pascucci, S.、Weissenow, K.、Rost, B.、Notion, P.、Gerlach, J.、Terwilliger, T.C.、Hung, L-W.、Jensen, L.J.、里德, K.、Robeck, T.R.、Horvath, S.、Faulk, C.、Ma, Y.、Clark, S.W. （2026）。对世界上最古老的陆生动物乔纳森的超长寿命的表观遗传学见解。科学进步。 12. https://www.doi.org/10.1126/sciadv.adw8887

paras.en: Lauren Schneider is a health and science journalist based in New York. She earned a bachelor's degree in neuroscience at The University of Texas at Austin and has a master's degree in science journalism from NYU. Her work has been published in The Transmitter and EOS, among other places.
paras.zh: 劳伦·施奈德 (Lauren Schneider) 是一位驻纽约的健康和科学记者。她在德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校获得神经科学学士学位，并在纽约大学获得科学新闻硕士学位。她的作品曾发表在 The Transmitter 和 EOS 等网站上。
