articles.title: Furyk reveals USA gameplan: 'We should be thinking Ryder Cup all the time!'

paras.en: Ryder Cup: Jim Furyk urges Team USA veterans to "step up" to boost bid for historic away win over Europe at Adare Manor
paras.zh: 莱德杯：吉姆·福瑞克敦促美国队老将“站出来”，以提高在阿黛尔庄园客场战胜欧洲队的历史性胜利

paras.en: Ryder Cup captains Luke Donald and Jim Furyk spoke to Sky Sports on the latest Sky Sports Golf podcast, recorded at Adare Manor in Ireland ahead of the 2027 contest; Donald chases a third consecutive Ryder Cup win for Team Europe over Team USA, captained by Furyk
paras.zh: 莱德杯队长卢克·唐纳德和吉姆·福瑞克在最新的天空体育高尔夫播客中接受了天空体育的采访，该播客在 2027 年比赛之前在爱尔兰阿黛尔庄园录制；唐纳德带领欧洲队击败由福瑞克担任队长的美国队，力争连续第三次赢得莱德杯

paras.en: Team USA captain Jim Furyk has urged his veterans to "step up" and take players "under their wing" to help them end their Ryder Cup losing streak on European soil.
paras.zh: 美国队队长吉姆·福瑞克敦促他的老将们“挺身而出”，将球员“置于自己的保护之下”，以帮助他们结束在欧洲土地上莱德杯的连败。

paras.en: Furyk captains the United States at Adare Manor next September, live on Sky Sports, having previously guided Team USA to defeat in the 2018 contest at Le Golf National before leading them to 2024 Presidents Cup victory over the Internationals in Montreal.
paras.zh: 福瑞克将于明年 9 月在天空体育直播的阿黛尔庄园担任美国队队长，此前他曾带领美国队在 2018 年国家高尔夫比赛中失利，随后带领美国队在蒙特利尔举行的 2024 年总统杯中战胜了国际队。

paras.en: The former US Open champion has been involved in every American Ryder Cup team in some capacity since 1997, with Team USA heading to Ireland for the centenary edition looking to claim a first away victory over Team Europe in 34 years.
paras.zh: 这位前美国公开赛冠军自 1997 年以来一直以某种身份参加了每一支美国莱德杯球队，美国队前往爱尔兰参加百年纪念赛，希望在 34 年来首次客场战胜欧洲队。

paras.en: - Can Europe win the Ryder Cup again? Dates, format and key info
paras.zh: - 欧洲能否再次赢得莱德杯？日期、格式和关键信息

paras.en: - Ryder Cup 2027: Europe's qualifying schedule for Adare Manor
paras.zh: - 2027 年莱德杯：阿黛尔庄园欧洲预选赛赛程

paras.en: - Get latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract on NOW
paras.zh: - 立即获取最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播

paras.en: Furyk's tasks include trying to create a strong team unity within the American team and improving their abysmal foursomes record, having lost 26 of their last 34 matches in the format, although he has already identified other growth areas.
paras.zh: 福瑞克的任务包括努力在美国队内部建立强大的团队团结，并改善他们糟糕的四人二球赛记录，在过去的 34 场比赛中输掉了 26 场，尽管他已经确定了其他增长领域。

paras.en: "If you saw our team room and you see they travel together, these guys get along well and they're fine, but we haven't got it done from a team perspective," Furyk told Sky Sports.
paras.zh: “如果你看到我们的团队房间，你会看到他们一起旅行，这些人相处得很好，他们很好，但我们还没有从团队的角度完成这件事，”福瑞克告诉天空体育。

paras.en: "I think we're going to go top to bottom (to improve things). We're going to start with the captains, getting them (the players) in better pairings and getting them more prepared in the way we practice and get ready.
paras.zh: “我认为我们将从上到下（以改进事情）。我们将从队长开始，让他们（球员）更好地配对，并让他们在我们的训练和准备方式中做好更多准备。

paras.en: "The way we look at it throughout the year, it's not like you throw these guys together 12 days out in advance and then you figure it out! This is a process and it's something we need to be thinking about all year long in 2027.
paras.zh: “从我们全年的角度来看，这并不是说你提前 12 天把这些人放在一起，然后你就想出来了！这是一个过程，是我们在 2027 年全年都需要思考的事情。

paras.en: "I need my veterans to step up, take some of the younger players under their wing and play practice rounds with them. Let them know what the Ryder Cup is all about, what they can expect on that first tee and get them excited about making this team.
paras.zh: “我需要我的老将挺身而出，将一些年轻球员纳入麾下，与他们一起打练习轮。让他们知道莱德杯的意义是什么，他们在第一洞发球台上可以期待什么，让他们对加入这支球队感到兴奋。

paras.en: "That process is not a one-month window. For us it needs to be a 24-month window, if that makes sense. We should be thinking about the Ryder Cup all the time and it's something I'd like to put in place."
paras.zh: “这个过程不是一个月的窗口。对我们来说，如果有意义的话，它需要一个 24 个月的窗口。我们应该一直考虑莱德杯，这是我想要落实的事情。”

paras.en: Furyk has served as a vice-captain for the last three Ryder Cups since losing 17.5-10.5 at Le Golf National in 2018, where he admitted his captain's picks left him without "horses for the course".
paras.zh: 自2018年在国家高尔夫俱乐部以17.5-10.5落败以来，福瑞克一直担任过去三届莱德杯的副队长，他承认队长的选择让他“没有马匹”。

paras.en: He said in a pre-Ryder Cup press conference on Tuesday he would "do more than any American team has in the past" to deny counterpart Luke Donald a historic three-peat, with Furyk prepared to draw from past experiences of being involved with Team USA.
paras.zh: 他在周二莱德杯赛前的新闻发布会上表示，他将“比过去任何一支美国球队都做得更多”，以阻止对手卢克·唐纳德获得历史性的三连冠，福瑞克准备从过去与美国队的比赛中吸取经验。

paras.en: "You would have to be arrogant to say 'no, we didn't win, but I do it exactly the same!'," Furyk added when asked about learnings from the 2018 loss. "Of course you wouldn't!
paras.zh: 当被问及从 2018 年失利中吸取的教训时，福瑞克补充道：“你必须傲慢地说‘不，我们没有赢，但我也这么做了！’”。 “你当然不会！

paras.en: "I was getting started in that captaincy career back then. I'd played in a lot of events, but sitting on the other side as a captain is a totally different process and a totally different outlook on teams.
paras.zh: “当时我刚刚开始队长生涯。我参加过很多赛事，但作为队长坐在另一边是一个完全不同的过程，对球队的看法也完全不同。

paras.en: "I think I've grown as a leader. I think I've been a backboard for some of our captains along the way, with the experience I've had.
paras.zh: “我认为我作为一名领导者已经成长。我认为凭借我所拥有的经验，我一路走来一直是我们一些队长的篮板。

paras.en: "To have that opportunity now to come back as captain for a Ryder Cup, and maybe pave the way for the future for this American team, is something I'm very proud to be asked to do. I take it very, very seriously."
paras.zh: “现在有机会以队长身份重返莱德杯，也许可以为这支美国队的未来铺平道路，我很自豪被要求这样做。我非常非常认真地对待它。”

paras.en: Donald: I don't want an American win on my watch!
paras.zh: 唐纳德：我不希望美国队在我的任期内获胜！

paras.en: Furyk claimed in Tuesday's press conference his side were "underdogs" heading to next year's contest, despite likely having a stronger side based on the world rankings, while Donald is keen to lead Europe to more success in the biennial contest.
paras.zh: 福瑞克在周二的新闻发布会上声称，他的球队在明年的比赛中是“失败者”，尽管根据世界排名可能有更强的球队，而唐纳德则热衷于带领欧洲在两年一度的比赛中取得更大的成功。

paras.en: "I think we have a good process in place with a great team, people who work really hard behind the scenes, but every Ryder Cup is different," Donald told Sky Sports.
paras.zh: “我认为我们有一个很好的流程，有一支伟大的团队，人们在幕后非常努力，但每一届莱德杯都是不同的，”唐纳德告诉天空体育。

paras.en: "It's a unique course, different players usually and you've got to bring something new, different aspects to make it fun and different aspects to get them in the right frame of mind.
paras.zh: “这是一个独特的球场，通常会有不同的球员，你必须带来一些新的、不同的方面，让它变得有趣，并通过不同的方面让他们处于正确的心态。

paras.en: "Those decisions are ongoing and really churning around the brain, but hopefully we'll be ready. I expect there to be a few changes this year. I think that's good, to have a little bit of freshness, bring on the next generation of players and get them involved.
paras.zh: “这些决定正在进行中，并且确实在大脑中翻腾，但希望我们能做好准备。我预计今年会发生一些变化。我认为这很好，有一点新鲜感，培养下一代球员并让他们参与其中。

paras.en: "As I've said many times, I think home Ryder Cups still offer the most pressure to protect that record that we have - it's no small feat. Someone's American team are bound to win away at some point - I just don't want it to be on my watch!
paras.zh: “正如我多次说过的那样，我认为主场莱德杯仍然为我们提供了最大的压力来保护我们所拥有的记录 - 这不是一件小事。某人的美国队一定会在某个时候客场获胜 - 我只是不希望它在我的监督下！

paras.en: "We've had a lot of success the last four years and we'll take that confidence into this one. We understand that we've defended home soil very well and I think that's something to lean into.
paras.zh: “过去四年我们取得了很多成功，我们将把这种信心带入今年。我们知道我们很好地捍卫了主场，我认为这是值得依靠的。

paras.en: "The underdog is just a mentality thing for us - we want to prove we can beat the might of the United States. "
paras.zh: “失败者对我们来说只是一种心态——我们想证明我们可以击败美国的力量。”

paras.en: Who will win the 2027 Ryder Cup? Watch the centenary edition live from September 17-19 on Sky Sports. Get the latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract.

articles.title: Flydubai pilot attacked captain with cockpit’s crash ax in attempted terrorist act, UAE official says
articles.author: Jonathan Dienst

paras.en: TEL AVIV — A Flydubai pilot attacked his flight captain using a crash ax and tried to take control of the aircraft’s controls in an attempted terrorist attack, an official with the United Arab Emirates said Saturday.
paras.zh: 特拉维夫——阿拉伯联合酋长国的一名官员周六表示，一名迪拜航空飞行员用一把坠毁斧袭击了他的机长，并试图控制飞机的控制装置，以发动一次未遂的恐怖袭击。

paras.en: The suspect is Omani citizen Hamam al-Hammami, multiple sources from three agencies briefed on the investigation and a diplomat in the Middle East told NBC News. Authorities have not officially released the identity.
paras.zh: 来自三个了解调查情况的机构的多位消息人士和一名中东外交官告诉 NBC 新闻，嫌疑人是阿曼公民哈马姆·哈马米 (Hamam al-Hammami)。当局尚未正式公布该身份。

paras.en: The Wall Street Journal, citing sources familiar with the matter, reported that al-Hammami had “previously been banned from flying by Oman over concerns he had adopted radical ideological views.”
paras.zh: 《华尔街日报》援引知情人士的话报道称，哈马米“此前曾因担心他采取激进的意识形态观点而被阿曼禁止乘坐飞机”。

paras.en: Oman Air did not immediately respond to a request for comment on whether he previously worked for the company.
paras.zh: 阿曼航空没有立即回应有关他是否曾在该公司工作的置评请求。

paras.en: Emirati officials are leading investigations into the midair incident, which occurred Wednesday on a flight carrying 174 mostly Israeli passengers from Dubai to Tel Aviv. A crash was averted, according to eyewitnesses and Israeli officials, when crew and passengers were able to enter the cabin and subdue the attacker.
paras.zh: 阿联酋官员正在领导对这起空中事件的调查，该事件发生在周三，一架载有 174 名乘客（其中大部分是以色列乘客）从迪拜飞往特拉维夫的航班上。据目击者和以色列官员称，当机组人员和乘客进入机舱并制服袭击者时，事故得以避免。

paras.en: “Investigations into the incident aboard Flydubai flight FZ1073 revealed that the co-pilot attempted to carry out a terrorist act,” UAE Attorney General Hamad Saif Al Shamsi said in an update on Saturday.
paras.zh: 阿联酋总检察长哈马德·赛义夫·沙姆西 (Hamad Saif Al Shamsi) 在周六的更新中表示：“对迪拜航空 FZ1073 航班上事件的调查显示，副驾驶试图实施恐怖行为。”

paras.en: “The co-pilot began executing his plan during the flight, attacking the captain inside the flight deck using a crash axe and attempting to take control of the aircraft’s flight controls,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“副驾驶在飞行过程中开始执行他的计划，用一把坠毁斧攻击驾驶舱内的机长，并试图控制飞机的飞行控制装置。”

paras.en: Al-Hammami was transferred from Saudi Arabia to Abu Dhabi on Thursday, the Saudi Interior Ministry said. The statement said his health had “improved,” but his medical condition was unclear.
paras.zh: 沙特内政部表示，哈马米于周四从沙特阿拉伯转移到阿布扎比。声明称他的健康状况已经“改善”，但目前尚不清楚他的健康状况。

paras.en: Al Shamsi said investigations were ongoing to “establish the full circumstances, motives, and any links related to the incident.”
paras.zh: 阿尔·沙姆西表示，调查正在进行中，以“查明与该事件相关的全部情况、动机以及任何联系”。

paras.en: Israeli government spokesman David Mencer said Friday that Israeli investigators would “join their Emirati counterparts in investigating this attempted mass murder and establishing precisely what happened, his motives and background.”
paras.zh: 以色列政府发言人大卫·门瑟周五表示，以色列调查人员将“与阿联酋同行一起调查这起未遂的大规模谋杀案，并确定到底发生了什么、他的动机和背景。”

paras.en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Friday: “As time passes, the picture becomes clearer: The attacker had undergone Islamist radicalization. He came to crash the plane, along with its passengers.”
paras.zh: 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡周五表示：“随着时间的推移，情况变得更加清晰：袭击者已经经历了伊斯兰激进化。他是来撞毁飞机以及机上乘客的。”

paras.en: He did not say how he reached that conclusion, but added: “We are investigating whether he was sent, and whoever sent him will pay a very heavy price.”
paras.zh: 他没有透露他是如何得出这个结论的，但补充道：“我们正在调查他是否是被派去的，无论是谁派他来的，都将付出非常惨重的代价。”

paras.en: Netanyahu’s spokesman Doron Spielman told NBC News that the suspect “talks on his social media about killing Jews.”
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡的发言人多伦·斯皮尔曼 (Doron Spielman) 告诉 NBC 新闻，嫌疑人“在社交媒体上谈论杀害犹太人”。

paras.en: The flight captain, Indian national Capt. Smit Machchhar, spoke for the first time Friday from a hospital in Abu Dhabi.
paras.zh: 机长、印度国民上尉斯密特·马赫恰尔周五在阿布扎比的一家医院首次发表讲话。

paras.en: Flydubai pilot speaks out follow mid-air attack
paras.zh: 迪拜航空飞行员在空中袭击事件后发表讲话

paras.en: Machchhar was widely praised for his efforts to prevent the plane from crashing by opening the cockpit door and allowing passengers and crew members to rush in.
paras.zh: 马赫恰尔因打开驾驶舱门并允许乘客和机组人员冲进去来防止飞机坠毁而受到广泛赞扬。

paras.en: Speaking from his hospital bed, Machchhar said he had been “severely injured” and “could sense that the aircraft was going down.”
paras.zh: 马赫恰尔在病床上表示，他“受了重伤”，并且“感觉到飞机正在坠落”。

paras.en: “I was acting for my own life, but at the same time, I knew I couldn’t let all of them die,” he said on a video call released by India’s Prime Minister Narendra Modi, adding that he told himself to “give just one last push” to the cockpit door.
paras.zh: “我是为了自己的生命而行动，但同时，我知道我不能让他们所有人都死，”他在印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪发布的视频通话中说道，并补充说，他告诉自己要“最后一推”驾驶舱门。

paras.en: The Indian Embassy in Abu Dhabi called Machchhar the “Indian braveheart,” saying in an X post Saturday that he “remains under excellent medical care & is recovering well.”
paras.zh: 印度驻阿布扎比大使馆称马赫恰尔为“印度勇敢的心”，并在周六的 X 帖子中表示，他“仍然得到良好的医疗护理，并且恢复良好”。

paras.en: The deputy prime minister of the United Arab Emirates, Hamdan bin Mohammed, posted photos on X after visiting Machchhar in the hospital in which he’s seen kissing the pilot’s head and shaking his hand. Machchhar, with one arm in a cast and medical dressings on his head, appears awake and smiling.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯联合酋长国副总理哈姆丹·本·穆罕默德在医院探望马赫恰尔后在 X 上发布了照片，照片中他亲吻了飞行员的头并与他握手。马赫恰尔的一只手臂打着石膏，头上缠着医用敷料，看上去很清醒，面带微笑。

paras.en: “From us, and from the leadership of the nation, he has our full appreciation and praise,” he wrote.
paras.zh: 他写道：“我们以及国家领导人对他表示充分的赞赏和赞扬。”

paras.en: Ayelet Epstein, a 47-year-old Israeli, told NBC News that her 14-year-old daughter asked if they were going to die when they heard shouting and “a huge fall started.”
paras.zh: 47 岁的以色列人阿耶莱特·爱泼斯坦 (Ayelet Epstein) 告诉 NBC 新闻，当她 14 岁的女儿听到喊叫声并“开始剧烈坠落”时，她问她们是否会死。

paras.en: “I told her, no, I don’t think so, we’re going to be OK,” she said, adding that “I was trying to rationalize things in a hopeful way for her.”
paras.zh: “我告诉她，不，我不这么认为，我们会没事的，”她说，并补充道，“我试图以一种对她充满希望的方式合理化事情。”

paras.en: Epstein thanked Machchhar “from the bottom of my heart” for saving their lives, lauding his bravery.
paras.zh: 爱泼斯坦“从心底”感谢马赫恰尔拯救了他们的生命，并称赞他的勇敢。

paras.en: A Flydubai spokesperson said Saturday: “We recognise that there are many questions at this stage; however, the circumstances surrounding the incident are still under investigation. We are therefore not in a position to comment further beyond our published statements.”
paras.zh: 迪拜航空发言人周六表示：“我们认识到现阶段存在很多问题；然而，事件相关情况仍在调查中。因此，除了我们已发表的声明外，我们无法进一步发表评论。”

paras.en: “We remain fully committed to supporting the ongoing investigation and are in close coordination with the relevant government authorities and regulators,” the spokesperson added.
paras.zh: 该发言人补充说：“我们仍然全力支持正在进行的调查，并与相关政府当局和监管机构密切协调。”

paras.en: President Donald Trump told reporters Thursday that there would be renewed strikes against Iran if it was behind the attack.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周四告诉记者，如果伊朗是此次袭击的幕后黑手，美国将再次对伊朗发动袭击。

paras.en: “You just ask them,” he said. “They know what happened. They’ll be hit very hard.”
paras.zh: “你只要问他们就行了，”他说。 “他们知道发生了什么。他们会受到非常沉重的打击。”

paras.en: There are no indications that Iran directed or was involved in the attack, a senior U.S. official briefed on the Israeli investigation told NBC News.
paras.zh: 一位了解以色列调查情况的美国高级官员告诉 NBC 新闻，没有迹象表明伊朗指挥或参与了这次袭击。

paras.en: Raf Sanchez and Shira Pinson reported from Tel Aviv. Freddie Clayton reported from London. Tom Winter and Jonathan Dienst reported from New York.
paras.zh: 拉夫·桑切斯和希拉·平森从特拉维夫报道。弗雷迪·克莱顿从伦敦报道。汤姆·温特和乔纳森·迪恩斯特从纽约报道。

articles.title: U.S. Marine arrested on suspicion of killing Japanese woman in Okinawa
articles.author: Freddie Clayton

paras.en: A U.S. service member is in custody on suspicion of killing a Japanese national on the island of Okinawa.
paras.zh: 一名美国军人因涉嫌在冲绳岛杀害一名日本公民而被拘留。

paras.en: Lance Cpl. Devin Jacob Ballard, 20, is suspected of killing Anna Yagi, 39, in a hotel in Naha, the capital of the southernmost prefecture, on Saturday and taking her wallet and backpack, local police told the Reuters news agency. Ballard denied the allegations, police said.
paras.zh: 兰斯下士。当地警方告诉路透社，20 岁的德文·雅各布·巴拉德 (Devin Jacob Ballard) 涉嫌周六在最南端县首府那霸市的一家酒店杀害了 39 岁的安娜·八木 (Anna Yagi)，并抢走了她的钱包和背包。警方称，巴拉德否认了这些指控。

paras.en: The Marine was stationed at Futenma Air Station on Okinawa Island, police said, adding that he was arrested at 1 a.m. local time Sunday.
paras.zh: 警方称，这名海军陆战队员驻扎在冲绳岛普天间机场，并补充说他于当地时间周日凌晨 1 点被捕。

paras.en: “An investigation is underway to determine the facts of the case, the United States is communicating and cooperating with the Government of Japan and local authorities,” the U.S. Embassy in Tokyo said Sunday on X.
paras.zh: 美国驻东京大使馆周日表示，“调查正在进行中，以确定案件事实，美国正在与日本政府和地方当局进行沟通与合作。”

paras.en: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi described the death as an alleged robbery and murder.
paras.zh: 日本首相高市早苗将这起死亡事件描述为涉嫌抢劫和谋杀。

paras.en: “The occurrence of such an extremely brutal and heinous incident is a matter of profound regret, and as the Government of Japan, we have lodged a strong protest with the U.S. side,” she said on social media.
paras.zh: 她在社交媒体上表示：“发生如此极其残暴、令人发指的事件令人深感遗憾，作为日本政府，我们已向美方提出强烈抗议。”

paras.en: Japan’s Defense Ministry said it was “deeply outraged by the extremely brutal and heinous crime committed by a U.S. Marine.”
paras.zh: 日本防卫省表示“对美国海军陆战队犯下的极其残忍和令人发指的罪行深感愤怒”。

paras.en: It said on X that it had made “a firm demand for stricter discipline, thorough measures to prevent recurrence.”
paras.zh: 其于X日表示，已“坚决要求严明纪律，采取彻底措施，防止再次发生”。

paras.en: The III Marine Expeditionary Force, a combat force of the U.S. Marine Corps headquartered in Okinawa, said it was cooperating with Japanese authorities in response to “allegations of serious criminal actions by a Marine.”
paras.zh: 总部位于冲绳的美国海军陆战队第三远征军表示，正在与日本当局合作，应对“海军陆战队严重犯罪行为的指控”。

paras.en: “The Marine Corps takes these allegations very seriously and expects every Marine to adhere to the highest standards of behavior,” it posted on X. “The Marine is in custody of local authorities while investigations proceed.”
paras.zh: “海军陆战队非常严肃地对待这些指控，并希望每一位海军陆战队队员都能遵守最高的行为标准，”它在 X 上发布。“在调查进行期间，该海军陆战队队员已被地方当局拘留。”

paras.en: Approached for further comment, the Pentagon referred NBC News to the Marines’ statement.
paras.zh: 在寻求进一步评论时，五角大楼将 NBC 新闻转介给海军陆战队的声明。

paras.en: U.S. Ambassador to Japan George Glass said he had spoken with Japan’s Foreign Affairs Ministry and Okinawa Gov. Genta Koja, “pledging full cooperation as the investigation continues.”
paras.zh: 美国驻日本大使乔治·格拉斯表示，他已与日本外务省和冲绳县知事小贾元太进行了交谈，“承诺在调查继续进行时全力配合”。

paras.en: There are 18,000 U.S. Marines based in Japan, the majority of them stationed in Okinawa, just 60 miles from Taiwan at its closest point. The U.S. held the island from the end of World War II until 1972, and the presence of the U.S. military has often stirred resentment among residents.
paras.zh: 有 18,000 名美国海军陆战队员驻扎在日本，其中大部分驻扎在冲绳岛，距离台湾最近的地点仅 60 英里。从二战结束到 1972 年，美国一直控制着该岛，美军的存在经常引起居民的不满。

paras.en: The 1995 abduction and rape of a 12-year-old girl by three U.S. servicemen sparked mass protests, as tens of thousands of people took to the streets, forcing Washington and Tokyo to discuss ways to reduce the U.S. military presence on the island.
paras.zh: 1995年，三名美国军人绑架并强奸了一名12岁女孩，引发了大规模抗议，数万人走上街头，迫使华盛顿和东京讨论如何减少美国在岛上的军事存在。

articles.title: 200 people enter medical observation after worker at Russian anti-plague lab dies
articles.author: Janis Mackey Frayer

paras.en: The death of a worker at an anti-plague laboratory in Russia has prompted officials to put at least one hospital facility under quarantine and nearly 200 people reportedly under medical observation as of Monday.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯一家抗鼠疫实验室的一名工作人员死亡，促使官员对至少一家医院设施进行隔离，据报道截至周一已有近 200 人接受医学观察。

paras.en: The female staffer at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia and the Far East died from a “pneumonia of undetermined” origin last week, according to the regional governor, Igor Kobsev.
paras.zh: 伊尔库茨克西伯利亚和远东地区抗鼠疫研究所的一名女工作人员上周死于“不明原因的肺炎”，伊尔库茨克地区州长伊戈尔·科布采夫表示。

paras.en: He said no “microorganisms linked to the employee’s professional activities were detected” in her body, and that there had been “no new cases” of illness among other employees of the lab.
paras.zh: 他说，在她的体内“没有检测到与该员工的职业活动有关的微生物”，实验室的其他员工也“没有新的病例”。

paras.en: “The sanitary-epidemiological situation” in the area “is currently stable,” Kobsev said.
paras.zh: 科布采夫说，该地区“卫生流行病学状况”目前“稳定”。

paras.en: On Friday, Maksim Modin, mayor of the Shelekhov municipal district near the border with Mongolia, said that the inpatient facility where the worker is said to have been treated had been closed for quarantine. Russian media cited officials saying that nearly 200 people who had been in contact with the woman had been placed under precautionary medical observation.
paras.zh: 周五，靠近蒙古边境的谢列霍夫市市长马克西姆·莫丁表示，据称这名工人接受治疗的住院设施已关闭进行隔离。俄罗斯媒体援引官员的话称，近200名与该女子有过接触的人已接受预防性医学观察。

paras.en: Russian media outlets have named the woman and identified her as being 28 years old. These details have not been confirmed by officials.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯媒体已公布这名女子的姓名，确认她今年 28 岁。这些细节尚未得到官方证实。

paras.en: Meanwhile, there have been calls internationally for more information and greater transparency from Moscow.
paras.zh: 与此同时，国际上也有人呼吁莫斯科提供更多信息并提高透明度。

paras.en: “Many details have not been confirmed,” a State Department spokesman said. “We encourage Russian authorities to share accurate information quickly and openly.” The spokesman said there had been “reports of a fatal case of suspected pneumonic plague” in Irkutsk oblast.
paras.zh: “许多细节尚未得到证实，”国务院发言人表示。 “我们鼓励俄罗斯当局快速、公开地分享准确的信息。”该发言人表示，伊尔库茨克州有“一例疑似肺鼠疫死亡病例的报告”。

paras.en: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Monday that even though there is “very limited travel between the U.S. and Russia,” if “something like that gets out, it could quickly spread.” So the U.S. government is “watching and monitoring it closely,” he added. “I don’t think it’s cause for alarm, but it is cause for focus and a cause just to keep an eye on it.”
paras.zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥周一表示，尽管“美国和俄罗斯之间的旅行非常有限”，但如果“类似的事情传出去，它可能会迅速蔓延。”他补充说，因此美国政府正在“密切关注和监控”。 “我不认为这值得警惕，但它值得关注，值得密切关注。”

paras.en: The World Health Organization said in a statement that it was aware of reports that a lab worker had died of “severe pneumonia” but that “no cause of death has been officially confirmed.”
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织在一份声明中表示，它获悉一名实验室工作人员死于“严重肺炎”的报道，但“尚未正式确认死因”。

paras.en: Asked by NBC News in Moscow whether the Kremlin was following these events, President Vladimir Putin’s spokesman, Dmitry Peskov, said Rospotrebnadzor, Russia’s consumer welfare service, was handling the investigation.
paras.zh: 莫斯科的 NBC 新闻被问及克里姆林宫是否在关注这些事件时，弗拉基米尔·普京总统的发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫表示，俄罗斯消费者福利服务机构 Rospotrebnadzor 正在处理调查。

paras.en: “It is their official statements that should be relied upon — rather than paying heed to various rumors, speculations and the like,” he said. “Rospotrebnadzor employs highly qualified professionals in this field, so let us heed their official statements.”
paras.zh: “应该依赖他们的官方声明，而不是关注各种谣言、猜测等，”他说。 “Rospotrebnadzor 雇佣了该领域的高素质专业人士，所以让我们留意他们的官方声明。”

paras.en: Dr. Ashish Jha, the White House’s former Covid response coordinator, told NBC News that “much more” information and transparency were needed from Moscow. He said that if this is an isolated case of pneumonic plague and no one else dies, “it will probably end there.”
paras.zh: 白宫前新冠疫情应对协调员阿什什·贾博士 (Ashish Jha) 告诉 NBC 新闻，莫斯科需要提供“更多”信息和透明度。他说，如果这是一起孤立的肺鼠疫病例，没有其他人死亡，“事情可能就会结束。”

paras.en: But “it’s actually very hard” for pneumonic plague to spread from person to person, Jha said. “We may see a few more people get infected, but the chances that this becomes a larger outbreak, let alone a global pandemic, is exceedingly low,” he said.
paras.zh: 但贾说，肺鼠疫在人与人之间传播“实际上非常困难”。他说：“我们可能会看到更多人被感染，但这成为更大规模疫情爆发的可能性非常低，更不用说全球大流行了。”

paras.en: “If there were weapons programs, biological weapons programs in these labs, that would be much more concerning to me,” he said. “We need to understand that now.”
paras.zh: “如果这些实验室里有武器计划、生物武器计划，那对我来说会更令人担忧，”他说。 “我们现在需要明白这一点。”

paras.en: The pneumonic plague is caused by the same bacteria as the bubonic plague and can spread from person to person through airborne respiratory droplets, typically from sneezing or coughing. Medical experts say cases require rapid treatment with powerful antibiotics to prevent fatalities.
paras.zh: 肺鼠疫是由与腺鼠疫相同的细菌引起的，可以通过空气中的呼吸道飞沫（通常是打喷嚏或咳嗽）在人与人之间传播。医学专家表示，病例需要使用强效抗生素进行快速治疗，以防止死亡。

paras.en: From 2019 to 2025, 10 countries reported more than 3,800 suspected human plague cases to the WHO, the agency said last week. Six of the countries ended up having confirmed cases, most of them in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Madagascar, with 423 deaths.
paras.zh: 该机构上周表示，从 2019 年到 2025 年，有 10 个国家向世界卫生组织报告了 3800 多例疑似人间鼠疫病例。其中六个国家最终出现确诊病例，其中大部分在刚果民主共和国和马达加斯加，死亡人数为 423 人。

articles.title: Inquiry hears delegate felt he 'brought danger' to his family after CFMEU comments
articles.author: Will Murray

paras.en: A commission of inquiry into the CFMEU in Queensland has heard union members made sinister comments about the family of an Australian Workers Union delegate.
paras.zh: 昆士兰州 CFMEU 调查委员会听到工会成员对澳大利亚工人工会代表的家人发表了险恶的评论。

paras.en: James Downie told the inquiry the comments came during a sustained campaign of intimidation by CFMEU members against the AWU.
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·唐尼 (James Downie) 在调查中表示，这些言论是在 CFMEU 成员针对 AWU 进行持续恐吓活动期间发表的。

paras.en: An organiser with the Australian Workers Union has recounted the moment a CFMEU member allegedly made sinister comments about his young family during a confrontation near a Brisbane work site.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚工人联盟的一名组织者讲述了一名 CFMEU 成员据称在布里斯班工地附近的一次冲突中对他年轻的家人发表了险恶评论的那一刻。

paras.en: James Downie told the Queensland inquiry into the CFMEU the comments came during a sustained campaign of harassment and intimidation by the CFMEU against members of the rival union during visits to work sites.
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·唐尼 (James Downie) 告诉昆士兰州 CFMEU 调查，这些言论是在 CFMEU 在视察工地期间对敌对工会成员进行持续骚扰和恐吓活动期间发表的。

paras.en: In mid-2023, Mr Downie and a colleague went to visit the Cross River Rail development in Woolloongabba when they were set upon by a large group of CFMEU members.
paras.zh: 2023 年年中，唐尼先生和一位同事前往参观乌龙戈巴的跨河铁路开发项目，当时遭到一大群 CFMEU 成员的袭击。

paras.en: The CFMEU men allegedly screamed insults at them as they tried to exit the site, ripped at Mr Downie's backpack, and started shoving him as he tried to cross Stanley Street and into the safety of a nearby shopping centre.
paras.zh: 据称，当他们试图离开现场时，CFMEU 男子对他们大声辱骂，撕扯唐尼先生的背包，并在他试图穿过斯坦利街进入附近购物中心的安全地带时开始推搡他。

paras.en: As he crossed, he said he was nearly pushed into traffic.
paras.zh: 他说，当他过马路时，他差点被推入车流中。

paras.en: "They charged at me with such force that I was bumped off the pedestrian walkway and there was a large truck … coming at me," he said.
paras.zh: “他们冲向我的力量如此之大，以至于我被从人行道上撞了下来，还有一辆大卡车……向我冲来，”他说。

paras.en: "I had to throw my body back at the pedestrian crossing to get back onto the street, because if I hadn't, I would've been hit by the truck."
paras.zh: “我必须把身体扔到人行横道上才能回到街上，因为如果我不这样做，我就会被卡车撞到。”

paras.en: He said the truck was so close he felt the wind on his backpack.
paras.zh: 他说卡车离他太近了，他感觉到风吹在他的背包上。

paras.en: "After that I just started running," he said.
paras.zh: “从那以后我就开始跑步，”他说。

paras.en: Mr Downie told the inquiry the CFMEU mob cornered the two AWU representatives at the stairs leading into the shopping centre. The moment was captured on CCTV and played to the hearing.
paras.zh: 唐尼先生在调查中表示，CFMEU 暴徒将两名 AWU 代表困在通往购物中心的楼梯上。这一刻被闭路电视捕捉到并在听证会上播放。

paras.en: During this interaction, Mr Downie said the CFMEU men were trying to goad him into fighting them.
paras.zh: 在这次互动中，唐尼先生表示，CFMEU 人员试图怂恿他与他们作战。

paras.en: When he refused, Mr Downie said they asked: "Is that what you teach your kids?"
paras.zh: 当他拒绝时，唐尼先生说他们问：“你就是这么教你的孩子的吗？”

paras.en: He said he told the men he had no kids, to which he says one replied, "we know you have two sons".
paras.zh: 他说他告诉这些人他没有孩子，其中一人回答说：“我们知道你有两个儿子”。

paras.en: "Then they gave the name of my sons and where they went to school, and to daycare, and my patterns and what I did in my personal life."
paras.zh: “然后他们给出了我儿子的名字、他们在哪里上学、去日托中心、我的生活方式以及我在个人生活中所做的事情。”

paras.en: Counsel assisting the inquiry asked Mr Downie what he was thinking at that moment.
paras.zh: 协助调查的律师询问唐尼先生当时在想什么。

paras.en: "That my job had crossed over to my personal life, and I'd brought danger to my family," he responded.
paras.zh: “我的工作已经影响了我的个人生活，我给我的家人带来了危险，”他回答道。

paras.en: Mr Downie said another member of the CFMEU then told the others the "message has been sent" and they dispersed.
paras.zh: 唐尼表示，CFMEU 的另一名成员随后告诉其他人“消息已发送”，然后他们就散去了。

paras.en: The inquiry heard about several hostile interactions between the CFMEU and AWU around this time.
paras.zh: 调查获悉，CFMEU 和 AWU 之间在此期间发生了几次敌对互动。

paras.en: On several occasions CFMEU members physically blocked AWU delegates from entering sites to visit their members.
paras.zh: CFMEU 成员曾多次以实际行动阻止 AWU 代表进入现场探望其成员。

paras.en: Some of these interactions were captured on phone footage and played to the hearing.
paras.zh: 其中一些互动被电话录像记录下来并在听证会上播放。

paras.en: During these incidents, large groups of CFMEU members can be heard yelling insults at the AWU delegates and daring them to try and push past their blockades.
paras.zh: 在这些事件中，可以听到大批 CFMEU 成员对 AWU 代表大喊大叫，并鼓励他们尝试突破封锁。

paras.en: Mr Downie said on one occasion, out the front of the Cultural Centre bus stop upgrade, he was told "take a step forward, you're not getting through, I'm a boxing champion, I'll put you out straight away".
paras.zh: 唐尼先生说，有一次，在文化中心公交车站升级前，他被告知“向前一步，你进不去，我是拳击冠军，我会立即把你赶出去”。

paras.en: Fearing for their safety, Mr Downie said they decided to leave without visiting members.
paras.zh: 由于担心自己的安全，唐尼表示，他们决定在不拜访成员的情况下离开。

articles.title: Lawyers for man who stabbed wife to death say no evidence he'd be violent again
articles.author: Harry Frost

paras.en: The ACT Supreme Court has heard arguments as it prepares to decide a nominal sentence for Canberra man Manfred Uhle.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚首都领地最高法院在准备对堪培拉男子曼弗雷德·乌勒（Manfred Uhle）作出象征性判决时听取了辩论。

paras.en: Uhle stabbed his wife Wanda Uhle to death in their home in 2024 and was found unfit to plead, though the courts were satisfied the elements for murder were met.
paras.zh: 2024 年，乌勒在家中刺死了妻子万达·乌勒 (Wanda Uhle)，并被认定不适合认罪，但法庭认为符合谋杀罪的要件。

paras.en: The court reserved its decision for a later date.
paras.zh: 法院保留稍后作出决定。

paras.en: Lawyers for an elderly man who stabbed his wife to death in their home in Canberra's south have said there is no evidence to suggest he would act violently again.
paras.zh: 一名在堪培拉南部家中刺死妻子的老人的律师表示，没有证据表明他会再次采取暴力行为。

paras.en: Police found the body of Wanda Uhle, 78, on the floor of the couple's Gordon property, covered by a doona in June 2024.
paras.zh: 2024 年 6 月，警方在戈登夫妇的房产地板上发现了 78 岁的旺达·乌勒 (Wanda Uhle) 的尸体，尸体上盖着被子。

paras.en: Manfred Uhle was taken into custody at the home of a family member in Fadden a short time later and charged with murder.
paras.zh: 不久后，曼弗雷德·乌勒在法登的一名家庭成员家中被拘留，并被指控犯有谋杀罪。

paras.en: He had told family members that he had fought with Mrs Uhle, believing she had had an affair with their neighbour, something the ACT Supreme Court found there was no evidence of.
paras.zh: 他告诉家人，他与乌勒夫人发生争执，认为她与邻居有染，但澳大利亚首都地区最高法院认为没有证据证明这一点。

paras.en: Now 88 years old, and with a likely diagnosis of dementia, he was found unfit to plead earlier this year.
paras.zh: 现年 88 岁的他可能被诊断出患有痴呆症，今年早些时候被发现不适合出庭辩护。

paras.en: It meant that rather than a trial, the case proceeded by way of a special hearing.
paras.zh: 这意味着案件不是通过审判，而是通过特别听证会的方式进行。

paras.en: Last month, Justice Andrew Muller ruled he was satisfied beyond reasonable doubt the elements for the offence of murder had been met.
paras.zh: 上个月，安德鲁·穆勒法官裁定，毫无疑问，他确信谋杀罪的要素已经得到满足。

paras.en: The court will set a nominal sentence, but the ACT Civil and Administrative Tribunal will determine how Uhle is cared for in future.
paras.zh: 法院将名义上判处徒刑，但首都领地民事和行政法庭将决定乌勒未来的照顾方式。

paras.en: Today, prosecutor Sam McLaughlin said there was currently no other option than jail for accommodating Uhle.
paras.zh: 今天，检察官萨姆·麦克劳克林表示，目前除了监禁乌勒之外别无选择。

paras.en: And he argued the nominal sentence must reflect the seriousness of the crime, regardless of Uhle's condition at the time of the killing.
paras.zh: 他认为，名义刑罚必须反映犯罪的严重性，无论乌勒在被杀时的状况如何。

paras.en: "Clearly the offender's reduced moral culpability cannot overwhelm the sentencing exercise," Mr McLaughlin said.
paras.zh: 麦克劳克林表示：“显然，罪犯道德罪责的减轻不能压倒量刑。”

paras.en: "The irresistible finding of the court must be, particularly given the admissions made by Mr Uhle later in the day, that the accused must have intended to cause the death of the deceased.
paras.zh: “法院不可抗拒的结论是，特别是考虑到乌勒先生当天晚些时候的承认，被告一定是有意造成死者死亡。

paras.en: "The victim was, of course, significantly vulnerable, not only because of her advanced age but because at the commission of the offence she was asleep in bed.
paras.zh: “当然，受害者非常脆弱，不仅因为她年事已高，还因为犯罪时她正在床上睡着。

paras.en: Mr McLaughlin told the court Uhle's "prognosis is poor" and his conditions were likely to worsen, presenting a risk to the community.
paras.zh: 麦克劳林先生告诉法庭，乌勒的“预后很差”，他的病情可能会恶化，给社区带来风险。

paras.en: "The predictor of the future is the past," he said.
paras.zh: “未来的预测是过去，”他说。

paras.en: Defence lawyer Jan de Bruin said no alternative to jail had yet been found to accommodate his client.
paras.zh: 辩护律师Jan de Bruin表示，除了入狱之外，还没有找到其他办法来容纳他的当事人。

paras.en: But he argued there had been no allegations of Uhle acting violently during his time in custody, including while being treated in hospital, and said he would present very limited risks if accommodated in a suitable aged care facility.
paras.zh: 但他辩称，没有任何指控称乌勒在被拘留期间（包括在医院接受治疗期间）有暴力行为，并表示如果被安置在合适的老年护理机构中，他面临的风险非常有限。

paras.en: "This is a fairly unique type of case … there is nothing similar to this case I could find searching through case law," Dr de Bruin said.
paras.zh: “这是一个相当独特的案件……我在判例法中找不到任何与此案件类似的案件，”德布鲁因博士说。

paras.en: "General deterrence and specific deterrence have little weight here."
paras.zh: “一般威慑和具体威慑在这里没有什么意义。”

paras.en: The court reserved its decision for a later date.
paras.zh: 法院保留稍后作出决定。

paras.en: Uhle remains in custody in Canberra's jail.
paras.zh: 乌勒仍被关押在堪培拉监狱。

articles.title: Man charged over damage to Tasmania's Parliament House, Hobart casino

paras.en: A 44-year-old man has been charged after allegedly breaking several windows and two glass doors at Parliament House in Hobart on Saturday night.
paras.zh: 一名 44 岁男子因涉嫌周六晚上打破霍巴特议会大厦的几扇窗户和两扇玻璃门而受到指控。

paras.en: Police were called about 11.20pm after 10 windows and two glass doors were damaged, including the front door to Parliament House.
paras.zh: 晚上 11 点 20 分左右，警方接到报警，发现 10 扇窗户和两扇玻璃门被损坏，其中包括国会大厦的前门。

paras.en: Police allege the Dover man was also involved in breaking 26 glass panels at the Wrest Point Convention and Entertainment Centre in the early hours of Monday morning, in the Hobart suburb of Sandy Bay.
paras.zh: 警方称，周一凌晨，这名多佛男子还参与了在霍巴特郊区桑迪湾的瑞斯特角会议和娱乐中心打破 26 块玻璃板的事件。

paras.en: "Significant repairs and replacement costs are expected in both incidents," Tasmania Police said in a statement.
paras.zh: 塔斯马尼亚警方在一份声明中表示：“这两起事件预计将产生大量维修和更换费用。”

paras.en: "Following investigations, police obtained a warrant for the man's arrest.
paras.zh: “经过调查，警方获得了对该男子的逮捕令。

paras.en: "He was located and arrested in Hobart on Tuesday, 6 October, before being taken to Hobart Police Station."
paras.zh: “10 月 6 日星期二，他在霍巴特被发现并被捕，然后被带到霍巴特警察局。”

paras.en: The man was charged with offences relating to the destruction of property and will next appear in the Hobart Magistrates Court in January.
paras.zh: 该男子被指控犯有破坏财产罪，将于明年一月在霍巴特地方法院出庭。

paras.en: Repairs on the damaged windows at Parliament House began on Sunday morning.
paras.zh: 国会大厦受损窗户的修复工作于周日上午开始。

articles.title: Big Brother U.K. sparks backlash after housemates debate trans rights
articles.author: Griffin Jaeger

paras.en: Big Brother U.K. sparks backlash after housemates debate trans rights
paras.zh: 英国老大哥在室友辩论跨性别权利后引发强烈反对

paras.en: Fans on social media split, with some accusing contestants of transphobia
paras.zh: 社交媒体上的粉丝意见不一，一些人指责参赛者有变性恐惧症

paras.en: Viewers of Big Brother U.K. are criticizing its contestants after the show aired a tense debate about transgender rights, pronouns, single-sex bathrooms and trans athletes in sports.
paras.zh: 《英国老大哥》节目播出了有关变性人权利、代词、单一性别卫生间和体育运动中跨性别运动员的紧张辩论后，观众开始批评其参赛者。

paras.en: It happened during Sunday night's episode of the reality competition series — one of more than 60 editions of the franchise worldwide — where a group of strangers called "house guests" or "housemates" live together for several weeks in a custom-built house, completely cut off from the outside world. Filmed 24/7, they compete in challenges and survive weekly evictions to outlast everyone else and win a cash prize.
paras.zh: 这件事发生在周日晚上的真人秀系列节目中——该系列节目全球有 60 多个版本之一——一群被称为“房客”或“室友”的陌生人在一座定制的房子里一起生活了几个星期，完全与外界隔绝。 24/7 全天候拍摄，他们在挑战中竞争并在每周的驱逐中幸存下来，比其他人坚持得更久并赢得现金奖励。

paras.en: Two new contestants joined the house that night: Twinks Burnett, 36, and Catrin Richards, 23. The debate, which was posted on the show's official social media, began after Burnett started a conversation about LGBTQIA+ allyship and gender identity.
paras.zh: 当晚，两名新参赛者加入了节目：36 岁的 Twinks Burnett 和 23 岁的 Catrin Richards。这场辩论在节目官方社交媒体上发布，是在 Burnett 开始谈论 LGBTQIA+ 盟友关系和性别认同后开始的。

paras.en: Housemate Philip Regan, who is gay, said he was in favour of freedom of speech, arguing, "You can't say anything, and it's wrong."
paras.zh: 同性恋室友菲利普·里根表示，他支持言论自由，并辩称：“你不能说什么，这是错误的。”

paras.en: "Me, growing up, my generation, it was 'him' and 'he,'" said Regan, 53, referring to gender pronouns. "Now, everything's different."
paras.zh: 53 岁的里根在谈到性别代词时说道：“在我的成长过程中，在我这一代人中，都是‘他’和‘他’。” “现在，一切都不同了。”

paras.en: He went on to say, "If you want to be classed as a fridge, you're classed as a fridge."
paras.zh: 他接着说：“如果你想被归类为冰箱，那你就被归类为冰箱。”

paras.en: Burnett countered by saying it was "no one else's business to tell you who you are, what your sexuality is and we should never assume who anyone is until they tell you," with which several of the guests, including Regan, appeared to agree.
paras.zh: 伯内特反驳说，“没有人有权告诉你你是谁，你的性取向是什么，在他们告诉你之前，我们永远不应该假设任何人是谁”，包括里根在内的几位客人似乎同意这一点。

paras.en: On the subject of whether transgender women should be allowed to use women's washrooms, another house guest — Rochelle Rackham — said, "I wouldn't be happy with a transgender in the toilet with me."
paras.zh: 在谈到跨性别女性是否应该被允许使用女性洗手间的问题时，另一位房客罗谢尔·拉克姆 (Rochelle Rackham) 表示，“如果跨性别女性和我一起上厕所，我会感到不高兴。”

paras.en: Burnett concluded that building community was the most important step in bridging these differences.
paras.zh: 伯内特得出的结论是，建立社区是弥合这些差异的最重要的一步。

paras.en: Microphones picked up another conversation later that night where Regan told another housemate that Burnett was trying to "cause trouble" by bringing up transgender protections.
paras.zh: 那天晚上晚些时候，麦克风又听到了另一段对话，里根告诉另一位室友，伯内特试图通过提出跨性别保护问题来“制造麻烦”。

paras.en: Viewers call out contestants for exchange
paras.zh: 观众喊出选手进行交流

paras.en: The moment drew calls on social media for the network ITV to reprimand Rackham and Regan, with many accusing the two of transphobia and questioning why the network chose to air the conversation.
paras.zh: 这一时刻在社交媒体上引起了人们的呼吁，要求英国独立电视台谴责拉克姆和里根，许多人指责两人有变性恐惧症，并质疑该电视台为何选择播出这段对话。

paras.en: In the show's previous season, a contestant received a formal warning from producers for misgendering a fellow cast member.
paras.zh: 在该剧的上一季中，一名参赛者因误判其他演员的性别而收到制片人的正式警告。

paras.en: "Have ITV entirely scrapped the diversity and inclusion training this year?" one user wrote on X.
paras.zh: “ITV 今年是否完全取消了多元化和包容性培训？”一位用户在 X 上写道。

paras.en: "The homophobia is palpable and the transphobia is obvious! I’m so sorry for a trans person watching this show tonight, I can’t imagine how that’s made you feel," wrote another.
paras.zh: 另一位网友写道：“对同性恋的恐惧是显而易见的，对跨性别者的恐惧也是显而易见的！我对今晚观看这个节目的跨性别者感到非常抱歉，我无法想象这让你有什么感受。”

paras.en: Other fans defended the show's choice, saying that the Big Brother franchise has always sought out to capture raw, unscripted human interactions and that removing the conversation would have amounted to censorship.
paras.zh: 其他粉丝为该剧的选择进行了辩护，称《老大哥》系列一直致力于捕捉原始的、即兴的人类互动，删除对话就相当于审查。

paras.en: "Some of these views aren't great but BB is about getting normal, everyday people with different views to live together, and a lot of people won't have the same views as you," a third wrote.
paras.zh: 第三位写道：“其中一些观点并不好，但 BB 是让持不同观点的普通人生活在一起，很多人不会有与你相同的观点。”

paras.en: On the show's Instagram account, some praised Burnett for starting the conversation.
paras.zh: 在节目的 Instagram 账户上，一些人称赞伯内特开启了这场对话。

paras.en: The aired conversation mirrors the U.K.'s polarized landscape on trans issues, with ongoing debates about the legal definition of sex under the country's Equality Act, trans athletes' inclusion in sports as well as access to gender-affirming care.
paras.zh: 播出的对话反映了英国在跨性别问题上的两极分化，目前关于该国《平等法案》中性别的法律定义、跨性别运动员参与体育运动以及获得性别肯定护理的机会的争论仍在继续。

paras.en: Last year, the U.K. Supreme Court ruled that the legal definition of a "woman" — defined for anti-discrimination purposes — only applied to those assigned female at birth, excluding trans women. The court said trans people would not be disadvantaged by the decision, though advocacy groups disagreed.
paras.zh: 去年，英国最高法院裁定，“女性”的法律定义（出于反歧视目的而定义）仅适用于出生时被指定为女性的人，不包括跨性别女性。法院表示，跨性别者不会因这一决定而处于不利地位，尽管倡导团体不同意。

paras.en: - British Supreme Court unanimously rules legal definition of a 'woman' excludes trans women's identities
paras.zh: - 英国最高法院一致裁定“女性”的法律定义排除跨性别女性的身份

paras.en: - England bans transgender women from playing on women's soccer teams
paras.zh: - 英格兰禁止变性女性参加女子足球队

paras.en: Soon after the ruling, trans women were banned from playing on women's soccer teams in England.
paras.zh: 裁决后不久，跨性别女性就被禁止参加英格兰女子足球队。

paras.en: The controversy also comes as the Big Brother franchise is about to get a Canadian revival. Since debuting in the Netherlands in the late 1990s, the show has been adapted for dozens of countries, finding success everywhere from Brazil to the U.K. and India to Australia.
paras.zh: 这场争议也发生在《老大哥》系列即将在加拿大复兴之际。自 20 世纪 90 年代末在荷兰首播以来，该剧已在数十个国家进行了改编，从巴西到英国，从印度到澳大利亚，在各地都取得了成功。

paras.en: Following a two-year hiatus, Bell Media announced that Big Brother Canada is officially returning to screens, with a new season starting in April 2027.
paras.zh: 时隔两年后，贝尔媒体宣布《老大哥加拿大》将正式重返银幕，新一季将于 2027 年 4 月开播。

paras.en: The network's deal also includes the 12 earlier seasons of the show, plus the French-language series Big Brother Célébrités.
paras.zh: 该网络的协议还包括该剧的前 12 季，以及法语剧集《老大哥名人》。

paras.en: Anyone who has experienced homophobia, transphobia or is affected by these descriptions can look for support through 2SLGBTQ+ services on the It Gets Better Canada’s website.
paras.zh: 任何经历过同性恋恐惧症、变性恐惧症或受这些描述影响的人都可以通过 It Gets Better Canada 网站上的 2SLGBTQ+ 服务寻求支持。

paras.en: With files from Reuters, The Associated Press and CBC's Jessica Wong.
paras.zh: 路透社、美联社和加拿大广播公司 (CBC) 的杰西卡·黄 (Jessica Wong) 提供的文件。

articles.title: California couple arrested on child abuse charges in connection with surrogacy probe

paras.en: California couple arrested on child abuse charges in connection with surrogacy probe
paras.zh: 加州夫妇因与代孕调查有关的虐待儿童指控而被捕

paras.en: Accused couple plead not guilty, deny all allegations during court appearance
paras.zh: 被告夫妇不认罪，出庭时否认所有指控

paras.en: An extremely wealthy Chinese immigrant and his wife amassed a brood of 21 children through a surrogacy scheme and raised them in a "house of horrors," prosecutors alleged Tuesday.
paras.zh: 检察官周二称，一名极其富有的中国移民和他的妻子通过代孕计划聚集了 21 个孩子，并将他们抚养在“恐怖之屋”。

paras.en: Guojun Xuan, 66, and his wife, Silvia Zhang, 39, were arrested at their sprawling mansion in Arcadia, Calif., a city about 21 kilometres northeast of downtown Los Angeles.
paras.zh: 66 岁的Guojun Xu 和他 39 岁的妻子 Silvia Zhang 在他们位于加利福尼亚州阿卡迪亚的豪宅中被捕，阿卡迪亚位于洛杉矶市中心东北约 21 公里处的城市。

paras.en: The children suffered daily beatings from cruel nannies as the couple watched over a network of surveillance cameras and laughed, according to prosecutors. The couple allegedly recruited women across the country to serve as surrogates, promising them that they were just looking for another child to grow their family.
paras.zh: 据检察官称，孩子们每天都遭受残酷保姆的殴打，这对夫妇通过监控摄像头网络观看并大笑。据称，这对夫妇在全国各地招募女性作为代孕妈妈，并向她们承诺，她们只是在寻找另一个孩子来养家糊口。

paras.en: The couple face several counts of child abuse as well as conspiracy to commit child abuse, accessory after the fact and dissuading a witness, according to Los Angeles County district attorney Nathan Hochman.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶县地方检察官内森·霍奇曼 (Nathan Hochman) 表示，这对夫妇面临多项虐待儿童罪，以及串谋虐待儿童、事后同谋以及劝阻证人等罪名。

paras.en: "This case is unprecedented. It is horrific," he said during a morning news conference. "The physical abuse, beating and punishment that these very young children received is despicable."
paras.zh: “这起案件是史无前例的。太可怕了，”他在早间新闻发布会上说。 “这些年幼的孩子所受到的身体虐待、殴打和惩罚是卑鄙的。”

paras.en: In an afternoon court appearance in nearby Pasadena, Calif., the couple pleaded not guilty and denied all allegations via a Mandarin interpreter. Prosecutors sought $100 million US bail per person because of the serious nature of the charges and because they are flight risks.
paras.zh: 下午，这对夫妇在加利福尼亚州帕萨迪纳附近出庭，否认有罪，并通过普通话翻译否认了所有指控。由于指控性质严重且存在潜逃风险，检察官寻求每人 1 亿美元的保释金。

paras.en: The couple have over 200 personal and 70 corporate bank accounts with annual transfers of $250 million US, deputy district attorney MacKenzie Teymouri said.
paras.zh: 地区副检察官 MacKenzie Teymouri 表示，这对夫妇拥有 200 多个个人银行账户和 70 个公司银行账户，每年转账金额达 2.5 亿美元。

paras.en: - Mothers' legal win in Italy IVF case seen as 'historic day' for 2SLGBTQ+ parenting rights
paras.zh: - 母亲们在意大利 IVF 案件中取得的法律胜利被视为 2SLGBTQ+ 育儿权利的“历史性的一天”

paras.en: - Report outlines how Indigenous survivors of coerced sterilization can pursue new pregnancies
paras.zh: - 报告概述了强迫绝育的原住民幸存者如何寻求新的怀孕

paras.en: Both were said to have U.S., Mexican and Chinese passports, though investigators have not determined if they are all legitimate; prosecutors said they used fake passports to create some of the bank accounts.
paras.zh: 据说两人都持有美国、墨西哥和中国护照，但调查人员尚未确定他们是否都是合法的；检察官称，他们使用假护照开设了一些银行账户。

paras.en: Inside the couple's home, investigators found a bank statement showing more than $70 million US in one account along with assets such as antique sculptures and specialty alcohol that added up to nearly $10 million US, according to Teymouri.
paras.zh: 泰穆里称，调查人员在这对夫妇的家中发现了一份银行对账单，显示一个账户中有超过 7000 万美元的资金，以及古董雕塑和特种酒等资产，总计近 1000 万美元。

paras.en: L.A. County Superior Court Judge Kerry White set bail at $20 million US each with home detention and a protective order against visiting their children.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶县高等法院法官克里·怀特 (Kerry White) 为每人设定了 2000 万美元的保释金，并给予家庭拘留和禁止探视孩子的保护令。

paras.en: Mitchell Krems, the couple's attorney, called the bail amount "absurd" for the type of charges his clients face and said Zhang's health should be taken into consideration.
paras.zh: 这对夫妇的律师米切尔·克雷姆斯 (Mitchell Krems) 称，对于他的客户面临的此类指控，保释金额“荒谬”，并表示应该考虑到张的健康状况。

paras.en: Zhang, who appeared in court in a wheelchair, has a rare form of leukemia and is recovering from a bone marrow transplant, Krems said.
paras.zh: 克雷姆斯说，坐在轮椅上出庭的张患有一种罕见的白血病，正在从骨髓移植中恢复。

paras.en: Fifteen children were removed from the opulent home last year after an allegation of abuse, and another six living elsewhere were also located. They ranged in age from two months to 13 years, with most between one and three.
paras.zh: 去年，由于受到虐待指控，15 名儿童被从这座豪华住宅中带走，另有 6 名住在其他地方的儿童也被找到。他们的年龄从两个月到十三岁不等，大多数在一岁到三岁之间。

paras.en: Police believe Zhang gave birth to one or two of the children, while the rest were carried and delivered by surrogates.
paras.zh: 警方认为，张某生下了其中一两个孩子，其余孩子则由代孕妈妈抱生。

paras.en: A July 2025 photo shows an aerial view of the Arcadia, Calif., home of Silvia Zhang and Guojun Xuan. (Jae C. Hong/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 2025 年 7 月的照片显示了西尔维娅·张和宣国军的家加利福尼亚州阿卡迪亚的鸟瞰图。 （Jae C. Hong/美联社）

paras.en: Hochman said the couple set up an agency, Mark Surrogacy, that they operated from their home and used to hire surrogates throughout the U.S.
paras.zh: 霍奇曼说，这对夫妇成立了一家名为“马克代孕”的机构，他们在家中运营该机构，并在美国各地雇佣代孕妈妈。

paras.en: But prosecutors said the couple misled the women, telling some that they could not conceive and others that they only had one child and wanted one more to complete their family.
paras.zh: 但检察官表示，这对夫妇误导了这些妇女，告诉一些妇女她们无法怀孕，而另一些妇女则表示她们只有一个孩子，希望再生一个孩子来让家庭更加完整。

paras.en: "The house could only be described as a house of horrors for these incredible young children," Hochman said.
paras.zh: 霍奇曼说：“对于这些令人难以置信的年幼的孩子来说，这所房子只能被形容为恐怖之屋。”

paras.en: Zhang and Xuan were first arrested in May 2025 after a hospital reported that their two-month-old infant had a traumatic head injury, the result of a nanny at the home violently shaking the baby, according to Arcadia police.
paras.zh: 据阿卡迪亚警方称，张和宣于 2025 年 5 月首次被捕，此前一家医院报告称，他们两个月大的婴儿因家中保姆剧烈摇晃婴儿而导致头部外伤。

paras.en: Police did not file charges at the time, saying they needed to complete the investigation.
paras.zh: 警方当时没有提出指控，称他们需要完成调查。

paras.en: Hochman said the couple set up three rooms they called learning centres, where the children spent several hours a day sitting at desks under the supervision of nannies.
paras.zh: 霍奇曼说，这对夫妇设立了三个被他们称为学习中心的房间，孩子们每天在保姆的监督下坐在课桌前几个小时。

paras.en: Through an extensive surveillance system, including motion-activated cameras, the couple watched as the nannies subjected the children to physical abuse including daily beatings, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，通过包括动作激活摄像头在内的广泛监控系统，这对夫妇目睹了保姆对孩子们进行身体虐待，包括每天的殴打。

paras.en: In one video, Xuan enters one of the rooms and tells a nanny to strike a child harder, and in another he joins the nanny in hitting the child, Hochman said.
paras.zh: 霍奇曼说，在一段视频中，宣进入其中一个房间，告诉保姆用力打孩子，而在另一段视频中，他和保姆一起打孩子。

paras.en: The nannies were allegedly told "not to leave any physical marks on the children," and when police arrived to investigate in May 2025, the children were told to deny they had been beaten.
paras.zh: 据称，保姆被告知“不要在孩子们身上留下任何身体痕迹”，当警察于 2025 年 5 月到达调查时，孩子们被告知否认自己曾被殴打。

paras.en: After examining the surveillance footage, police issued an arrest warrant for Chunmei Li, the nanny seen hurting the two-month-old infant, but she could not be found. However, she fled to Tijuana, Mexico, and then China.
paras.zh: 警方在查看监控录像后，对伤害两个月大婴儿的保姆李春梅发出了逮捕令，但找不到她。然而，她逃到了墨西哥蒂华纳，然后又逃到了中国。

paras.en: After the children were taken into state custody, Xuan and Zhang were allowed supervised visits. During one such visit, Zhang read to a child and wrote in the book, "Tell them you're happy with me, tell them you want to come home," lead prosecutor Teymouri said.
paras.zh: 孩子们被国家拘留后，宣和张被允许接受监督探视。在一次这样的访问中，张给一个孩子读书，并在书中写道，“告诉他们你和我在一起很高兴，告诉他们你想回家，”首席检察官泰穆里说。

paras.en: Krems said it was "patently false" that Xuan was involved in beating any of the children and blamed all the abuse on the nannies.
paras.zh: 克雷姆斯表示，宣参与殴打任何孩子的说法“明显是错误的”，并将所有虐待行为归咎于保姆。

paras.en: "My client, Mr. Xuan, intervened swiftly," Krems said. "He fired the nanny, excised her from the house."
paras.zh: “我的客户宣先生迅速介入，”克雷姆斯说。 “他解雇了保姆，把她赶出了家门。”

paras.en: When asked about the couple's motivation, Hochman said that was part of the ongoing investigation, as was the parentage of each child.
paras.zh: 当被问及这对夫妇的动机时，霍赫曼表示，这是正在进行的调查的一部分，每个孩子的父母也是如此。

paras.en: Krems, Xuan's attorney, previously told ABC7 that his client's goal was to raise children who become productive adults.
paras.zh: 宣的律师克雷姆斯此前告诉ABC7，他的委托人的目标是抚养孩子成为有生产力的成年人。

paras.en: "The reason he has all these children is because he wants them to contribute to society. He is not a man who is self-indulgent," Krems said. "Some who are wealthy might spend on jewelry or cars, but he is actually spending his resources to help his children become educated."
paras.zh: “他之所以拥有这些孩子，是因为他希望他们为社会做出贡献。他不是一个自我放纵的人，”克雷姆斯说。 “一些有钱人可能会花钱买珠宝或汽车，但他实际上是在用自己的资源来帮助他的孩子接受教育。”

paras.en: After Tuesday's court hearing, he said Xuan and Zhang immigrated from China to exercise their freedom and have as many children as they want.
paras.zh: 周二的法庭听证会后，他表示，宣和张从中国移民是为了行使自由，并想生几个孩子就生几个孩子。

paras.en: "If they were white, if they were Elon Musk, and they weren't Chinese, they wouldn't experience this level of scrutiny," Krems said.
paras.zh: 克雷姆斯说：“如果他们是白人，如果他们是埃隆·马斯克，而且他们不是中国人，他们就不会经历这种程度的审查。”

paras.en: Surrogacy is an arrangement in which a woman agrees to carry and deliver a child for another person or couple, often after an embryo transfer.
paras.zh: 代孕是指妇女同意为另一个人或夫妇生育孩子的一种安排，通常是在胚胎移植之后。

paras.en: There is no comprehensive federal law in the U.S. regulating it, leaving most rules to the individual states.
paras.zh: 美国没有全面的联邦法律对其进行监管，大部分规则由各个州决定。

paras.en: California is considered to be surrogacy-friendly because it has clear laws governing the process. Both sides are required to have lawyers, and there must be a written, notarized contract before an embryo transfer takes place.
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州被认为对代孕友好，因为它有明确的法律来管理代孕过程。双方都必须有律师，并且在胚胎移植之前必须有经过公证的书面合同。

paras.en: At least eight women came forward to say they were aggressively pursued to serve as surrogates. The women, many of them first-time surrogates, said they were given misleading or incomplete information about the couple's family situation and intentions.
paras.zh: 至少有八名女性站出来表示，她们被积极寻求担任代孕妈妈。这些女性中的许多人都是第一次代孕，她们表示，她们获得的关于这对夫妇的家庭情况和意图的信息存在误导性或不完整。

paras.en: Krems denied that the couple lied to surrogates about their intentions.
paras.zh: 克雷姆斯否认这对夫妇向代理人撒谎了他们的意图。

paras.en: The district attorney's office said a federal investigation was ongoing.
paras.zh: 地区检察官办公室表示，联邦调查正在进行中。

articles.title: Fitness influencer apologizes after hitching a bike ride in the Berlin Marathon
articles.author: Natalie Stechyson

paras.en: Fitness influencer apologizes after hitching a bike ride in the Berlin Marathon
paras.zh: 健身影响者在柏林马拉松赛上骑自行车后道歉

paras.en: Chinese influencer Abeeeer was also dropped by her sponsor, Brooks
paras.zh: 中国网红 Abeeeer 也被她的赞助商 Brooks 放弃

paras.en: There's so much to love about marathon season.
paras.zh: 马拉松赛季有很多值得热爱的地方。

paras.en: The gripping accounts of elite athletes pushing themselves to the very limit. The tales of runners uplifting and supporting each other to cross the finish line. The heartache when dreams are dashed.
paras.zh: 优秀运动员将自己推向极限的扣人心弦的故事。跑步者互相鼓励、互相支持冲过终点线的故事。梦想破灭时的心痛。

paras.en: And then there are the people who might think, "Well, maybe no one will notice..." at a global event.
paras.zh: 还有一些人可能会想，“好吧，也许没有人会注意到……”在一场全球活动中。

paras.en: In that vein, a Chinese fitness influencer has apologized and been dropped by her sponsor after being photographed hitching a ride on a bike during the 42.2-kilometre Berlin Marathon last week.
paras.zh: 本着这种精神，一位中国健身网红上周在 42.2 公里的柏林马拉松比赛中被拍到骑自行车后，已道歉并被赞助商取消。

paras.en: Images of the influencer from the Sept. 27 race were first posted by the Official Marathon Time Integrity Unit (OMTIU) Instagram account, which calls out questionable race performances. In posts from Oct. 1, the account noted that her fastest time was recorded between the 35- and 40-kilometre marks, around the time "she was spotted on the back of a bike."
paras.zh: 这位 9 月 27 日比赛影响者的照片首先由官方马拉松计时诚信单位 (OMTIU) Instagram 账户发布，该账户指出了可疑的比赛表现。在 10 月 1 日的帖子中，该账户指出，她的最快成绩是在 35 公里到 40 公里之间记录的，大约在“她被发现骑在自行车后面”的时间。

paras.en: A composite image of three Instagram stories posted Oct. 1 by The Official Marathon Time Integrity Unit (OMTIU) that allege to show a Chinese influencer hitching a ride in the Berlin Marathon, her times, and a finish line photo from the Sept. 27 race. (@officialunofficialtime/Instagram)
paras.zh: 官方马拉松计时诚信单位 (OMTIU) 于 10 月 1 日发布的三个 Instagram 故事的合成图像，据称显示了一位中国网红在柏林马拉松赛上搭便车、她的时间以及 9 月 27 日比赛的终点线照片。 （@officialunofficialtime/Instagram）

paras.en: CBC News has reached out to OMTIU to ask how it obtained the photo and to the Berlin Marathon for confirmation, but has not yet received a response.
paras.zh: CBC新闻已联系OMTIU询问其如何获得这张照片，并联系柏林马拉松进行确认，但尚未收到回复。

paras.en: The influencer, who goes by Abeeeer on the popular Chinese social media platform Rednote, or Xiaohongshu, posted a "sincere apology" to her 520,000 followers Saturday for violating the rules. She explained that she had been feeling physically unwell during the race but acknowledged that was not an excuse.
paras.zh: 这位在中国流行的社交媒体平台小红书上使用 Abeeeer 的网红周六因违反规则向她的 52 万粉丝发布了“诚挚的歉意”。她解释说，她在比赛期间感到身体不适，但承认这不是借口。

paras.en: "My behaviour to take a shortcut was disrespectful to the spirit of the marathon," she wrote in Chinese.
paras.zh: “我抄近路的行为是对马拉松精神的不尊重，”她用中文写道。

paras.en: "I intentionally concealed this fact during my public sharing after the race. That was a truly dishonest behaviour."
paras.zh: “我在赛后的公开分享中故意隐瞒了这一事实，这确实是一种不诚实的行为。”

paras.en: The bib number shown in the images is registered to Yuanyuan Sun of China, who recorded a finishing time of 4:53:46.
paras.zh: 图片中显示的号码布由中国选手孙媛媛登记，她的完赛时间为 4:53:46。

paras.en: - Australian athlete apologizes for racing with diarrhea, forfeits the Beijing competition she won
paras.zh: - 澳大利亚运动员为腹泻比赛道歉，并放弃她赢得的北京比赛资格

paras.en: - Berlin Marathon winner limped to finish line after rupturing Achilles tendon chasing world mark
paras.zh: - 柏林马拉松冠军在追逐世界纪录时因跟腱断裂一瘸一拐地冲向终点

paras.en: Multiple media outlets report that she had previously posted about earning a PB, or personal best, on her social media, but has since deleted her Berlin Marathon posts other than the apology.
paras.zh: 多家媒体报道称，她此前曾在社交媒体上发布过有关获得 PB（个人最好成绩）的帖子，但此后除了道歉之外，她删除了柏林马拉松的帖子。

paras.en: One of her sponsors, Brooks, confirmed with CBC News that it dropped a runner after becoming "aware of the situation involving a Brooks China collaborator and the 2026 Berlin Marathon."
paras.zh: 她的赞助商之一布鲁克斯 (Brooks) 向 CBC 新闻证实，在“意识到涉及布鲁克斯中国合作者和 2026 年柏林马拉松的情况”后，该公司放弃了一名参赛者。

paras.en: "After verifying the facts, Brooks China terminated its relationship with the individual," Brooks told CBC in a statement Tuesday.
paras.zh: 布鲁克斯周二在一份声明中告诉加拿大广播公司：“在核实事实后，布鲁克斯中国终止了与该人的关系。”

paras.en: "Brooks believes running should be grounded in integrity, fairness, and respect for competition."
paras.zh: “布鲁克斯认为跑步应该建立在诚信、公平和尊重竞争的基础上。”

paras.en: A general view as runners compete during the 2026 BMW Berlin-Marathon on September 27, 2026 in Berlin, Germany. Over 56,000 participant from 162 nations took part in the 52nd edition of Berlin Marathon. (Maja Hitij/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 2026 年 9 月 27 日在德国柏林举行的 2026 年 BMW 柏林马拉松比赛中，参赛选手的全景图。来自162个国家的超过56,000名参赛者参加了第52届柏林马拉松比赛。 （玛雅·希蒂/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: More than 56,000 runners from 162 countries entered the 2026 Berlin Marathon. It's known for being the flattest course of the official Abbott World Marathon Majors — and therefore the fastest. About 50,000 people crossed the finish line.
paras.zh: 来自162个国家的超过56,000名跑者报名参加2026年柏林马拉松。它以雅培世界马拉松大满贯官方赛事中最平坦的赛道而闻名，因此也是速度最快的赛道。大约有 50,000 人冲过终点线。

paras.en: And while it's not known whether anyone else attempted a shortcut this year, marathon cheating is nothing new, and what's know as course-cutting is one of the more common tactics.
paras.zh: 虽然不知道今年是否还有其他人尝试走捷径，但马拉松作弊并不是什么新鲜事，所谓的“抄近道”是更常见的策略之一。

paras.en: - THE BUZZER Remembering when Rosie Ruiz stole the Boston Marathon from a Canadian
paras.zh: - 蜂鸣器 还记得罗西·鲁伊兹 (Rosie Ruiz) 从加拿大人手中偷走了波士顿马拉松赛冠军

paras.en: - She was set to win the U.S. women's half marathon. Then a guide car made a wrong turn
paras.zh: - 她有望赢得美国女子半程马拉松比赛。然后引导车转错了方向

paras.en: One of the more infamous course-cutting examples is Rosie Ruiz, who was the first woman to cross the finish line of the 1980 Boston Marathon. She was crowned with a laurel wreath and didn't even seem tired.
paras.zh: 罗西·鲁伊斯 (Rosie Ruiz) 是最著名的抄近路例子之一，她是 1980 年波士顿马拉松比赛中第一位冲过终点线的女性。她头戴月桂花环，看上去一点也不疲倦。

paras.en: Officials later determined that she had emerged from the crowd near the end of the race and run only about the final mile. She had qualified for Boston after taking the subway for most of the 1979 New York City marathon.
paras.zh: 官员们后来确定她是在比赛接近尾声时从人群中出现的，只跑了最后一英里。 1979 年纽约市马拉松比赛的大部分时间她都乘坐地铁，因此获得了波士顿马拉松的参赛资格。

paras.en: In 2011, Rob Sloan placed third in the U.K.'s gruelling Kielder Marathon. It was later revealed that he had ridden a bus for part of the course.
paras.zh: 2011 年，罗布·斯隆 (Rob Sloan) 在英国艰苦的基尔德马拉松比赛中获得第三名。后来透露，他在部分课程中乘坐了公共汽车。

paras.en: In 2023, Scottish ultramarathoner Joasia Zakrzewski finished third in a 50-mile race but was later disqualified for riding part of the course in a car.
paras.zh: 2023 年，苏格兰超级马拉松运动员 Joasia Zakrzewski 在一场 50 英里比赛中获得第三名，但后来因开车参加部分赛程而被取消资格。

paras.en: The same year, the Mexico City Marathon disqualified some 11,000 runners for cutting sections of the course, including by using cars, bikes and public transit.
paras.zh: 同年，墨西哥城马拉松赛取消了约 11,000 名跑步者的参赛资格，原因是他们擅自缩短赛程，包括使用汽车、自行车和公共交通。

articles.title: Bosnia election: New steps to prevent electoral fraud, but nationalist parties remain on top

paras.en: Bosnia and Herzegovina went to the polls on October 4 with new technology that was meant to end years of vote-rigging.
paras.zh: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那于 10 月 4 日使用新技术进行投票，旨在结束多年来的选举舞弊行为。

paras.en: Chief among the abuses was the casting of ballots in the name of deceased voters who had lingered for years on outdated voter rolls.
paras.zh: 其中最主要的滥用行为是以已故选民的名义投票，这些选民多年来一直在过时的选民名册上徘徊。

paras.en: At just over 40%, turnout was the lowest since the Bosnian War ended in 1995, in part because the old tricks no longer worked.
paras.zh: 投票率略高于 40%，是 1995 年波斯尼亚战争结束以来的最低水平，部分原因是老把戏不再奏效。

paras.en: In earlier elections, allegations kept surfacing that votes were being cast in the name of people who had died or long since moved abroad. Others said voters cast their ballot multiple times or that blank ballots were added after polls closed to make the turnout look higher.
paras.zh: 在早些时候的选举中，不断有指控称，选票是以已去世或早已移居国外的人的名义进行的。其他人表示，选民多次投票，或者在投票结束后添加空白选票，以使投票率看起来更高。

paras.en: The voter registry, packed with names of people who had passed away or left the country, was the perfect tool for all of this.
paras.zh: 选民登记处记录着已去世或离开该国的人的姓名，是实现这一切的完美工具。

paras.en: This time, however, every polling station used biometric fingerprint checks.
paras.zh: 然而，这一次，每个投票站都使用了生物指纹检查。

paras.en: This represented a clear step forward in making voter identification far harder to manipulate.
paras.zh: 这代表着在使选民身份更难以操纵方面向前迈出了明显的一步。

paras.en: Still, the biggest story of this election is not technical. Three nationalist parties won, each within its own community: the SNSD among Serbs, the SDA among Bosniaks and the HDZ BiH among Croats.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，这次选举最大的故事并不是技术性的。三个民族主义政党获胜，每个政党都在自己的社区内：塞族人中的少女社会党、波斯尼亚人中的社会民主党和克罗地亚人中的波黑民主联盟。

paras.en: The dead may have been struck from the voter rolls, but political trends have not shifted.
paras.zh: 死者可能已从选民名册中剔除，但政治趋势并未改变。

paras.en: For readers who know Bosnia only vaguely, a little background helps: The 1995 Dayton Peace Agreement ended the war, but it also split the country into two entities: Republika Srpska, which has a Serb majority, and the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, which has a Bosniak-Croat majority.
paras.zh: 对于对波斯尼亚知之甚少的读者来说，了解一点背景知识会有所帮助：1995 年的《代顿和平协议》结束了战争，但它也将这个国家分裂为两个实体：塞族占多数的塞族共和国和波黑克族占多数的波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那联邦。

paras.en: A three-member presidency runs the state, and each of the three peoples elects its own member.
paras.zh: 国家由三名总统组成，三个民族各自选举自己的成员。

paras.en: That is why elections here are rarely about wages and prices and are instead almost always about who is perceived to be a threat.
paras.zh: 这就是为什么这里的选举很少关注工资和物价，而几乎总是关注谁被视为威胁。

paras.en: Republika Srpska and the return of a fallen leader
paras.zh: 塞族共和国和倒下领导人的回归

paras.en: For Milorad Dodik, the most powerful Serb politician in Bosnia, this election was a political resurrection.
paras.zh: 对于波斯尼亚最有权势的塞族政治家米洛拉德·多迪克来说，这次选举是一次政治复兴。

paras.en: In 2025, Dodik was barred from holding public office for six years after being convicted of defying the high representative, the top international envoy overseeing the 1995 peace process.
paras.zh: 2025 年，多迪克因藐视高级代表（负责监督 1995 年和平进程的最高国际特使）而被定罪，被禁止担任公职六年。

paras.en: He was sanctioned by the US in 2022, although those sanctions were lifted late last year. Even so, his party, the SNSD, virtually swept the board in Republika Srpska.
paras.zh: 他于 2022 年受到美国制裁，不过这些制裁已于去年年底解除。即便如此，他的政党少女社会党实际上在塞族共和国大获全胜。

paras.en: Savo Minic became president of Republika Srpska, and Zeljka Cvijanovic kept the Serb seat in the presidency. Both are members of the SNSD.
paras.zh: 萨沃·米尼奇成为塞族共和国总统，泽利卡·奇维贾诺维奇保留了塞族总统席位。两人都是少女时代成员。

paras.en: The party also did very well in the entity's parliament. Neither the sanctions nor Dodik's conviction and the loss of his mandate hurt the party. Voters were not choosing an individual. They were choosing their "side."
paras.zh: 该党在实体议会中也表现出色。制裁、多迪克的定罪和失去授权都没有伤害该党。选民并不是在选择一个人。他们正在选择自己的“立场”。

paras.en: Dodik lost no time in declaring what comes next.
paras.zh: 多迪克立即宣布了接下来要做的事情。

paras.en: He announced a return to what he refers to as the "original Dayton." In practice, that means undoing the powers the state has gained since 1995 — from the judiciary to the army. To an outside observer, that sounds like a technical phrase. In reality, it is a program for dismantling the state step by step.
paras.zh: 他宣布回归他所说的“原来的代顿”。实际上，这意味着撤销国家自 1995 年以来获得的权力——从司法部门到军队。对于外部观察者来说，这听起来像是一个技术术语。实际上，这是一个逐步瓦解国家的计划。

paras.en: "That means we are returning the army to Republika Srpska, the border police, the intelligence service and everything that the high representatives once took away," said Dodik.
paras.zh: 多迪克说：“这意味着我们将把军队、边防警察、情报部门以及高级代表曾经夺走的一切归还塞族共和国。”

paras.en: The opposition offered no serious resistance. It was divided and had no convincing message.
paras.zh: 反对派没有提出严重抵抗。它存在分歧，没有令人信服的信息。

paras.en: Voters who did not want Dodik had nowhere to turn, so most stayed home. Low turnout favored the side with the most disciplined party machine.
paras.zh: 不想要多迪克的选民无处可去，所以大多数人都呆在家里。低投票率有利于拥有最有纪律的政党机器的一方。

paras.en: That raises a question that will shape what happens in Bosnia in the coming year. Dodik's conviction kept him out of the direct race in these elections. But for months, there has been talk of a way out.
paras.zh: 这就提出了一个问题，它将影响波斯尼亚来年发生的事情。多迪克的定罪使他无法参加这些选举的直接竞选。但几个月来，一直有人在讨论解决办法。

paras.en: If representatives of the SNSD and the HDZ BiH enter the presidency, they could pardon him — whatever the third member decides. Bosnian media have reported that this was a pre-election deal between Dodik and the HDZ BiH leader, Dragan Covic. Dodik could then return as prime minister of Republika Srpska, a post he has held before.
paras.zh: 如果少女时代和波黑民主自由联盟的代表进入主席职位，他们可以赦免他——无论第三位成员如何决定。波斯尼亚媒体报道称，这是多迪克和波黑 HDZ 领导人德拉甘·乔维奇之间的选举前协议。多迪克随后可能会重新担任塞族共和国总理，他此前曾担任过这一职位。

paras.en: Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina: Troika defeated
paras.zh: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那联邦：“三驾马车”被击败

paras.en: The picture in the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina is different, but the outcome is the same.
paras.zh: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那联邦的情况有所不同，但结果是一样的。

paras.en: The parties of the so-called "Troika," a multi-ethnic liberal political alliance, suffered a defeat. They came to power at this level after the international high representative, a foreigner with the authority to impose laws, changed the election law.
paras.zh: 多民族自由主义政治联盟“三驾马车”的政党遭受了失败。他们是在国际高级代表（一位有权实施法律的外国人）修改了选举法之后上台执政的。

paras.en: Voters saw no benefit from that experiment. The SDA, the largest Bosniak nationalist party, won the most seats and did well.
paras.zh: 选民们认为该实验没有带来任何好处。最大的波斯尼亚民族主义政党SDA赢得了最多席位并且表现良好。

paras.en: The paradox is that SDA president Bakir Izetbegovic lost the race for the presidency. He is the son of Alija Izetbegovic, Bosnia's first president and one of the signatories of the Dayton agreement. The winner was Denis Becirovic of the Social Democrats (SDP), who kept the Bosniak seat.
paras.zh: 矛盾的是，SDA主席巴基尔·伊泽特贝戈维奇在总统竞选中失败了。他是波斯尼亚第一任总统阿利贾·伊泽特贝戈维奇的儿子，也是代顿协议的签署者之一。获胜者是社会民主党（SDP）的丹尼斯·贝西罗维奇（Denis Becirovic），他保住了波斯尼亚克族席位。

paras.en: So, the party won the election, but its leader lost. The son of the man who signed Dayton is now shut out of the institution Dayton created.
paras.zh: 因此，该党赢得了选举，但其领导人失败了。签署代顿的人的儿子现在被排除在代顿创建的机构之外。

paras.en: "The future of our region lies not in adopting the Russian model but the European one. The message to the EU: Help Bosnia. Let the will of the people be the law of the land," Becirovic said as he declared victory.
paras.zh: “我们地区的未来不在于采用俄罗斯模式，而在于采用欧洲模式。向欧盟发出的信息是：帮助波斯尼亚。让人民的意志成为这片土地的法律，”贝西罗维奇在宣布胜利时说道。

paras.en: The same pattern holds among Croats. Darijana Filipovic of the HDZ BiH, their strongest nationalist party, won the Croat seat in the presidency for her party. Filipovic spent years as an aide to Covic, the Bosnian Croat leader.
paras.zh: 克罗地亚人也有同样的情况。波黑最强大的民族主义政党 HDZ 的达里贾娜·菲利波维奇 (Darijana Filipovic) 为该党赢得了克罗地亚总统席位。菲利波维奇多年来一直担任波斯尼亚克族领导人乔维奇的助手。

paras.en: "HDZ BiH has shown it is brave enough to take a road others would not dare. Who would have dared to nominate me? To some too young, but a surprise to everyone," Filipovic said after the vote.
paras.zh: 菲利波维奇在投票后表示：“波黑 HDZ 已经表明它有足够的勇气走一条别人不敢走的路。谁敢提名我？对一些太年轻的人来说，但对每个人来说都是一个惊喜。”

paras.en: Three peoples, three nationalist parties, three victories, and not one conversation about how to keep people in the country.
paras.zh: 三个民族，三个民族主义政党，三场胜利，却没有一次关于如何让人们留在这个国家的对话。

paras.en: The most important thing about these elections is not the numbers but the makeup of the presidency. Two women will sit in it: Cvijanovic of the SNSD and Filipovic of the HDZ BiH. Anyone who tries to sell that as a breakthrough for women in politics has missed the point.
paras.zh: 这些选举最重要的不是数字，而是总统职位的构成。两名女性将坐在里面：少女时代的 Cvijanovic 和波黑 HDZ 的 Filipovic。任何试图将其视为女性从政的突破的人都没有抓住要点。

paras.en: Both come from parties that, in different ways, do not want the state in its current form. Both could also decide the fate of a man convicted of defying the international oversight of Dayton.
paras.zh: 两者都来自以不同方式不希望国家处于当前形式的政党。两者还可能决定一名因违反代顿国际监督而被定罪的人的命运。

paras.en: The HDZ BiH has long demanded a third, Croat entity. The SNSD wants autonomy for Republika Srpska. One side wants to split the state into three, the other into two, but they share the aim of making it smaller.
paras.zh: 波黑 HDZ 长期以来一直要求建立第三个克罗地亚实体。少女时代希望塞族共和国获得自治权。一方希望将国家一分为三，另一方则希望将国家一分为二，但他们的共同目标是缩小国家规模。

paras.en: So, the presidency, which should symbolize a shared state, is again made up of people who feel like guests in it.
paras.zh: 因此，本应象征共同国家的总统职位，却再次由那些感觉自己像客人一样的人组成。

paras.en: All of this is happening as the Western Balkans again becomes a stage for rivalry between Russia, the EU and the US. Dodik openly thanked both Vladimir Putin and Donald Trump after his party's victory.
paras.zh: 所有这一切都发生在西巴尔干地区再次成为俄罗斯、欧盟和美国之间竞争的舞台之际。多迪克在其政党获胜后公开感谢弗拉基米尔·普京和唐纳德·特朗普。

paras.en: Bosnia has entered a new electoral era with new technology and old politics. Young people are leaving the country in droves. The dead no longer vote, but the living have stopped believing that anything can be different.
paras.zh: 波斯尼亚进入了一个拥有新技术和旧政治的新选举时代。年轻人成群结队地离开这个国家。死者不再投票，但生者不再相信任何事情都会有所不同。

articles.title: Three years of Israel’s genocide in Gaza: In numbers

paras.en: Three years have passed since Israel launched its genocide against Palestinians in Gaza.
paras.zh: 以色列对加沙巴勒斯坦人发动种族灭绝已经过去了三年。

paras.en: Israel’s assault began on October 7, 2023, after Hamas’s armed wing, the Qassam Brigades, and other Palestinian groups attacked southern Israel, killing 1,139 people and taking about 240 captive.
paras.zh: 以色列的攻击始于 2023 年 10 月 7 日，此前哈马斯的武装派别卡萨姆旅和其他巴勒斯坦团体袭击了以色列南部，造成 1,139 人死亡，约 240 人被俘。

paras.en: Israel responded with relentless bombardment and turned its 16-year blockade into a total stranglehold.
paras.zh: 以色列以无情的轰炸作为回应，将16年的封锁变成了全面勒索。

paras.en: A “ceasefire” took effect on October 10, 2025, but attacks and killings have continued.
paras.zh: “停火”于2025年10月10日生效，但袭击和杀戮仍在继续。

paras.en: Three years of Israeli attacks have killed at least 74,000 Palestinians, including at least 21,000 children. That is about one in every 30 people, or 3 percent of the pre-war population.
paras.zh: 以色列三年来的袭击已造成至少 74,000 名巴勒斯坦人死亡，其中包括至少 21,000 名儿童。这大约是每 30 人中就有 1 人，即战前人口的 3%。

paras.en: The Palestinian Ministry of Health counts only deaths recorded at hospitals or officially registered. The true toll is likely much higher, as it excludes the thousands still buried under rubble or missing.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦卫生部仅统计医院记录或正式登记的死亡人数。真实死亡人数可能要高得多，因为它不包括仍埋在瓦砾下或失踪的数千人。

paras.en: More than 175,000 people have been injured, about one in every 13 people in Gaza.
paras.zh: 超过 175,000 人受伤，约占加沙每 13 人就有 1 人受伤。

paras.en: A conservative WHO estimate suggests roughly 24 percent of the injured have life-changing injuries requiring long-term rehabilitation, a quarter of them children.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织的保守估计表明，大约 24% 的伤者患有改变生活的伤害，需要长期康复，其中四分之一是儿童。

paras.en: Gaza’s few remaining health facilities are overwhelmed and running on dwindling supplies.
paras.zh: 加沙仅存的几家医疗机构已经不堪重负，且供应不断减少。

paras.en: Since the “ceasefire” took effect on October 10, 2025, Israel has violated it with near-daily attacks, killing more than 1,000 people.
paras.zh: 自2025年10月10日“停火”生效以来，以色列违反停火协议，几乎每天都会发动袭击，造成1000多人死亡。

paras.en: An Al Jazeera analysis found Israel attacked Gaza on 325 of the past 361 days, leaving only 36 days with no reported attacks, deaths or injuries.
paras.zh: 半岛电视台分析发现，在过去 361 天中，以色列有 325 天袭击了加沙，只有 36 天没有报告袭击、死亡或受伤的情况。

paras.en: Despite continuing attacks, the US insists that the “ceasefire” is still holding.
paras.zh: 尽管袭击不断，美国坚称“停火”仍然有效。

paras.en: Since the “ceasefire” took effect at noon on October 10, Israel has killed at least 1,460 Palestinians and injured 5,116, according to the latest figures from the Palestinian Ministry of Health.
paras.zh: 据巴勒斯坦卫生部最新数据，自10月10日中午“停火”生效以来，以色列已造成至少1460名巴勒斯坦人死亡、5116人受伤。

paras.en: 94 percent of all hospitals and clinics damaged
paras.zh: 94% 的医院和诊所受损

paras.en: Israel has attacked nearly all of Gaza’s hospitals and healthcare facilities.
paras.zh: 以色列袭击了加沙几乎所有的医院和医疗设施。

paras.en: After three years, 94 percent are fully or partially out of service, leaving patients without essential care, according to the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA). Only 42 of 666 facilities are still functioning.
paras.zh: 根据联合国人道主义事务协调办公室 (OCHA) 的数据，三年后，94% 的医院全部或部分停止服务，使患者无法获得基本护理。 666 个设施中只有 42 个仍在运行。

paras.en: Under the Fourth Geneva Convention, hospitals must not be attacked, and international humanitarian law gives medical units and personnel special protection. Under the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court, intentionally attacking a hospital is a war crime.
paras.zh: 根据《日内瓦第四公约》，医院不得受到攻击，国际人道法给予医疗单位和人员特殊保护。根据国际刑事法院罗马规约，故意袭击医院属于战争罪。

paras.en: 91 percent of Gaza’s households face water insecurity
paras.zh: 91% 的加沙家庭面临水不安全问题

paras.en: Since October 2023, Israel has systematically targeted Gaza’s already fragile water infrastructure, striking wells, pipelines, desalination plants and sewage systems.
paras.zh: 自 2023 年 10 月以来，以色列系统性地针对加沙本已脆弱的供水基础设施，攻击水井、管道、海水淡化厂和污水系统。

paras.en: UN experts say most of the water and sanitation network has been damaged or destroyed. Local authorities report shattered pipes and wells either contaminated by sewage or cut off by fighting and displacement.
paras.zh: 联合国专家表示，大部分供水和卫生设施网络已遭到破坏或摧毁。地方当局报告称，管道和水井被破碎，要么被污水污染，要么因战斗和流离失所而被切断。

paras.en: Nearly half of Gaza’s population now survives on less than six litres (1.6 gallons) of water a day for drinking and cooking. The emergency minimum for “short-term survival” is 20 litres (5.3 gallons).
paras.zh: 目前，加沙近一半人口每天的饮用和做饭用水不足六升（1.6 加仑）。 “短期生存”的紧急情况最低限度为 20 升（5.3 加仑）。

paras.en: The destruction across Gaza is near total, with 82 percent of all structures destroyed.
paras.zh: 加沙各地的破坏已接近全部，82% 的建筑物被毁。

paras.en: According to OCHA, entire neighbourhoods have been wiped out, leaving 1.98 million Palestinians displaced. That is 90 percent of the population.
paras.zh: 据人道协调厅称，整个社区已被夷为平地，导致 198 万巴勒斯坦人流离失所。那是90%的人口。

paras.en: Newly updated Google Maps satellite imagery shows the scale of destruction across the besieged Gaza Strip nearly three years into Israel’s genocidal war.
paras.zh: 最新更新的谷歌地图卫星图像显示了以色列种族灭绝战争近三年来，被围困的加沙地带的破坏规模。

paras.en: Gaza’s education system has collapsed. About 93 percent of schools need complete reconstruction, according to OCHA, leaving more than 700,000 students without access to formal education.
paras.zh: 加沙的教育系统已经崩溃。据 OCHA 称，约 93% 的学校需要彻底重建，导致超过 70 万学生无法接受正规教育。

paras.en: At least 63 university buildings have been destroyed, and those still standing are being used as shelters for displaced people.
paras.zh: 至少 63 所大学建筑被毁，那些仍然矗立的大学建筑被用作流离失所者的避难所。

paras.en: Nearly 300 journalists and media workers have been killed in Gaza since October 7, including 12 from Al Jazeera, according to the Shireen Abu Akleh Observatory.
paras.zh: 据 Shireen Abu Akleh 天文台称，自 10 月 7 日以来，已有近 300 名记者和媒体工作者在加沙被杀，其中包括半岛电视台的 12 名记者和媒体工作者。

paras.en: These are the Al Jazeera staff members killed by Israeli attacks:
paras.zh: 这些是在以色列袭击中丧生的半岛电视台工作人员：

paras.en: Israel bars foreign media from Gaza, apart from a few reporters embedded with its soldiers under strict military censorship.
paras.zh: 以色列禁止外国媒体进入加沙，只有少数记者与以色列士兵一起接受严格的军事审查。

articles.title: Finland orders halt to work on Google data centre sites

paras.en: A Finnish government authority has ordered work on two Google data centre sites to stop until compulsory environmental impact assessments have been completed.
paras.zh: 芬兰政府当局已下令停止两个谷歌数据中心站点的施工，直到完成强制性环境影响评估。

paras.en: The United States tech giant announced in September a 13 billion euro ($14.6bn) investment in digital infrastructure in Finland over the next two years to power its artificial intelligence (AI) ambitions.
paras.zh: 这家美国科技巨头于 9 月宣布，未来两年将向芬兰数字基础设施投资 130 亿欧元（146 亿美元），以推动其人工智能 (AI) 雄心壮志。

paras.en: Google has called the data centre projects in the municipalities of Muhos, Vaala, Kajaani and Hamina its single biggest investment in Europe.
paras.zh: 谷歌将穆霍斯、瓦拉、卡亚尼和哈米纳等市的数据中心项目称为其在欧洲最大的单笔投资。

paras.en: But the Finnish Supervisory Agency (LVV), which is responsible for environmental issues, said it had demanded that Tuike Finland, the company representing Google, “immediately suspend, and no later than 23 October 2026, all preparatory measures that would significantly alter the environment in connection with the planned data centre projects in Muhos and Kajaani”.
paras.zh: 但负责环境问题的芬兰监管机构（LVV）表示，已要求谷歌的代表公司Tuike芬兰“立即且不迟于2026年10月23日暂停与计划中的穆霍斯和卡亚尼数据中心项目相关的所有可能显着改变环境的准备措施”。

paras.en: The agency has been investigating whether Tuike Finland cleared hundreds of hectares of forest in Muhos and Kajaani without a mandatory environmental impact assessment.
paras.zh: 该机构一直在调查图伊克芬兰是否在没有进行强制性环境影响评估的情况下砍伐了穆霍斯和卡亚尼数百公顷的森林。

paras.en: The head of LVV’s environment department, Tommi Muilu, said trees have been removed, topsoil stripped, site roads and storage areas constructed and ditches altered.
paras.zh: LVV 环境部门负责人托米·穆伊鲁 (Tommi Muilu) 表示，树木已被砍伐，表土被剥离，工地道路和储存区已被修建，沟渠也已被改造。

paras.en: Hanna Halmeenpaa, chair of the Finnish Association for Nature Conservation, told the AFP news agency that “nature sites which should be preserved” had been logged in a deforested area of more than 300 hectares (741 acres).
paras.zh: 芬兰自然保护协会主席汉娜·哈尔明帕 (Hanna Halmeenpaa) 告诉法新社，“应该保护的自然遗址”已被砍伐，面积超过 300 公顷（741 英亩）的森林被砍伐。

paras.en: Tuike Finland must provide an explanation and detail how it intends to proceed by October 14.
paras.zh: Tuike Finland 必须在 10 月 14 日之前提供解释并详细说明其打算如何进行。

paras.en: It could face “enforcement proceedings” if it fails to comply, LVV said.
paras.zh: LVV 表示，如果不遵守规定，可能会面临“执法程序”。

paras.en: Google spokesman Sondre Ronander acknowledged in a statement to AFP the company’s shortcomings and said it would “study the LVV’s findings and follow their guidance”.
paras.zh: 谷歌发言人 Sondre Ronander 在给法新社的一份声明中承认该公司的缺陷，并表示将“研究 LVV 的调查结果并遵循他们的指导”。

paras.en: Ronander said Google was “advancing” its landscaping and biodiversity plans, which included tree planting across 130 hectares (53 acres) at Muhos.
paras.zh: 罗纳德表示，谷歌正在“推进”其景观美化和生物多样性计划，其中包括在穆霍斯种植 130 公顷（53 英亩）的树木。

paras.en: The Nordic region has for years been a magnet for data centres due to its cool climate, abundant low-carbon electricity and reliable power grids, but AI builders are now facing greater scrutiny from consumers and politicians.
paras.zh: 北欧地区多年来因其凉爽的气候、丰富的低碳电力和可靠的电网而一直吸引着数据中心，但人工智能建设者现在面临着消费者和政界人士更严格的审查。

paras.en: Opposition parties last month called for a national permit system to prevent power shortages and soaring energy prices.
