articles.title: Archaeologists discover a child's skull built into the floor of a 2,500-year-old Scandinavian house
articles.author: Kristina Killgrove

paras.en: Archaeologists have unearthed evidence that men, women and children were subjected to violence within their communities in ancient Scandinavia — and that these victims were buried in unusual places, such as pits or wells or under a family's house or yard.
paras.zh: 考古学家发现的证据表明，在古代斯堪的纳维亚半岛，男人、女人和儿童在他们的社区内遭受过暴力，而且这些受害者被埋在不寻常的地方，比如坑或井，或者在家庭的房子或院子下面。

paras.en: During the Scandinavian Iron Age and Viking Age (from roughly 500 B.C. to A.D. 1050), violent encounters between individuals and communities steadily increased, resulting in archaeological evidence of elite warrior burials and mass graves from battles.
paras.zh: 在斯堪的纳维亚铁器时代和维京时代（大约从公元前 500 年到公元 1050 年），个人和社区之间的暴力冲突不断增加，考古证据表明精英战士的墓葬和战争造成的万人坑。

paras.en: To better understand the context of violence in the Iron and Viking ages, researchers analyzed 192 human bones from people buried in domestic areas at settlements in what are now Denmark, Norway and Sweden.
paras.zh: 为了更好地了解钢铁和海盗时代暴力的背景，研究人员分析了192具人骨，这些人骨来自现在丹麦、挪威和瑞典定居点的家庭居住区。

paras.en: "The fact is that not all bodies ended up in monumental burial mounds in the Iron and Viking Ages, or even in more modest urnfields and cemeteries," the researchers wrote in a study published Sept. 28 in the Journal of Archaeological Method and Theory. Rather, some bodies — or pieces of bodies — were placed in postholes, pits, floors, wells, houses, yards and feasting halls.
paras.zh: 研究人员在9月28日发表在“考古方法与理论杂志”上的一项研究中写道： “事实是，并非所有尸体最终都落入了铁海盗时代的纪念性墓地，甚至是更温和的墓地和墓地。”相反，一些尸体--或尸体碎片--被放置在邮筒、坑、地板、井、房屋、院子和宴会厅中。

paras.en: The archaeologists discovered that at least 12 of the individuals had sustained a violent injury around the time of death. Half of those cases involved head trauma, while four people suffered multiple injuries. Most of the victims of violence were adult males, but there were two females and a child as well.
paras.zh: 考古学家发现，至少有 12 人在死亡时遭受了暴力伤害。其中一半病例涉及头部外伤，四人多处受伤。大多数暴力受害者是成年男性，但也有两名女性和一名儿童。

paras.en: In one Iron Age house in Denmark, built sometime between 500 and 1 B.C., archaeologists discovered a frontal bone from the skull of a child who died between the ages of 2 and 4 years old.
paras.zh: 在丹麦一座建于公元前500年至公元前1年的铁器时代的房子里，考古学家从一名2至4岁儿童的头骨中发现了一块额骨。

paras.en: "Our DNA analyses show that it is a small boy who has been cut with a sword," study first author Marianne Hem Eriksen, an archaeologist at the National Museum of Denmark, said in a translated statement. "The child's skull was placed on the floor of a house where people continued to live. This means that someone has walked over a child's skull day after day."
paras.zh: 研究第一作者、丹麦国家博物馆考古学家玛丽安·海姆·埃里克森 (Marianne Hem Eriksen) 在一份翻译声明中表示：“我们的 DNA 分析显示，这是一名被剑砍伤的小男孩。” “孩子的头骨被放在人们继续居住的房子的地板上。这意味着有人日复一日地走过孩子的头骨。”

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Radiocarbon dating revealed that the child's skull is significantly older than the house itself, by as many as two centuries, suggesting the bone may have been kept for some time before being placed in the house floor, according to the study.
paras.zh: 根据这项研究，放射性碳测年显示，孩子的头骨比房子本身大得多，长达两个世纪，这表明骨骼可能在放入房屋地板之前已经保存了一段时间。

paras.en: At a Viking Age site dated to around 750 to 1050, archaeologists found a young woman's skull in a well near a cluster of four small houses. "The woman's skull bore traces of blows and was buried in a well," Eriksen said. She may have been cut or slashed with a sword or ax and, like the child, her bones may have been kept for a significant amount of time before being buried in the well. "These glimpses of lives lived from the past show how fascinatingly different people must have thought about life and death," Eriksen said.
paras.zh: 在大约 750 年至 1050 年的维京时代遗址，考古学家在四间小房子附近的一口井里发现了一个年轻女子的头骨。埃里克森说：“这名女子的头骨上有被击打的痕迹，被埋在一口井里。”她可能是被剑或斧头砍伤的，和孩子一样，她的骨头在被埋在井里之前可能已经保存了很长一段时间。埃里克森说：“这些对过去生活的一瞥表明，不同的人对生与死的思考一定是多么令人着迷。”

paras.en: And at the Viking Age site of Gammel Lejre, a royal feasting hall that many experts consider to be the inspiration for the epic Old English poem "Beowulf," archaeologists found the burial of a man whose skeleton bore numerous blunt force injuries, several of which had healed, and which attested to a difficult and likely painful life. His skeleton was discovered directly south of the feasting hall.
paras.zh: 在维京时代的Gammel Lejre遗址，一个被许多专家认为是史诗般的古英语诗歌“Beowulf”的灵感来源的皇家宴会厅，考古学家发现了一个人的埋葬，他的骨骼承受了许多钝器伤害，其中一些已经愈合，并证明了一个艰难而可能痛苦的生活。他的骨架是在宴会厅正南发现的。

paras.en: The study of bones in domestic areas "opens up a completely new understanding of Iron Age society, of the occurrence of violence and of the handling of the dead," Eriksen said. "The results show a much greater complexity in the everyday life and world of imagination of the time than we often attribute to Iron Age people."
paras.zh: 埃里克森说，对国内地区骨骼的研究“开辟了对铁器时代社会，暴力发生和对死者的处理的全新理解”。“结果显示，与我们通常归因于铁器时代的人相比，日常生活和当时的想象力世界要复杂得多。”

paras.en: But it is unclear exactly why these particular people were the victims of violence and why they were buried in such unusual ways. One possible scenario, the researchers wrote in the study, is that these were victims of violent domestic encounters rather than warfare. Their deaths may also have been the result of socially acceptable corporal punishment or some form of aggression within the community.
paras.zh: 但目前尚不清楚这些特定的人为什么是暴力的受害者，以及为什么他们以如此不寻常的方式被埋葬。研究人员在研究中写道，一种可能的情况是，这些人是家庭暴力而不是战争的受害者。他们的死亡也可能是社会可接受的体罚或社区内某种形式的侵略的结果。

paras.en: Given the increase in social inequality and rise in violence in the Iron and Viking ages, the researchers suspect that precarious community members may have been targeted.
paras.zh: 鉴于钢铁和维京时代社会不平等的加剧和暴力的增加，研究人员怀疑不稳定的社区成员可能成为目标。

paras.en: "Not all lives were equally grieved and commemorated in the Iron and Viking Ages of Scandinavia," the researchers wrote. "We may question whether some lives were already considered disposable."
paras.zh: 研究人员写道： “在斯堪的纳维亚半岛的铁器时代和维京时代，并非所有的生命都同样悲伤和纪念。” “我们可能会质疑一些生命是否已经被认为是一次性的。”

paras.en: Eriksen, M.H., Tamorri, V., Louka, V., Tollefsen, E., Kay, K., Appleby, J. (2026). Broken bodies in domestic spaces: Direct and structural violence in an atypical mortuary dataset from Iron and Viking Age Scandinavia. Journal of Archaeological Method and Theory 34. https://doi.org/10.1007/s10816-026-09817-w
paras.zh: Eriksen, M.H.、Tamorri, V.、Louka, V.、Tollefsen, E.、Kay, K.、Appleby, J. (2026)。家庭空间中的破碎尸体：来自铁器和维京时代斯堪的纳维亚半岛的非典型太平间数据集中的直接和结构性暴力。考古方法与理论杂志 34。https://doi.org/10.1007/s10816-026-09817-w

paras.en: See how much you know about ancient norsemen with our Viking quiz!
paras.zh: 通过我们的维京测验，了解您对古代挪威人的了解程度！

paras.en: Kristina Killgrove is a staff writer at Live Science with a focus on archaeology and paleoanthropology news. Her articles have also appeared in venues such as Forbes, Smithsonian, and Mental Floss. Kristina holds a Ph.D. in biological anthropology and an M.A. in classical archaeology from the University of North Carolina, as well as a B.A. in Latin from the University of Virginia, and she was formerly a university professor and researcher. She has received awards from the Society for American Archaeology and the American Anthropological Association for her science writing.
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·基尔格罗夫 (Kristina Killgrove) 是《Live Science》的特约撰稿人，专注于考古学和古人类学新闻。她的文章还发表在《福布斯》、《史密森尼》和《Mental Floss》等杂志上。克里斯蒂娜拥有博士学位。北卡罗来纳大学生物人类学学士学位和古典考古学硕士学位，以及北卡罗来纳大学古典考古学学士学位。她拥有弗吉尼亚大学拉丁语学位，曾任大学教授和研究员。她因其科学写作而获得美国考古学会和美国人类学协会颁发的奖项。

articles.title: Earth is in the firing line of a strange new type of cosmic object, astronomers say
articles.author: Sarah Wild

paras.en: Researchers have observed the strongest candidate yet for a "microblazar" — a dazzling object that has long been predicted to exist but never spotted.
paras.zh: 研究人员观察到了迄今为​​止最强的“微耀体”候选者——这是一种令人眼花缭乱的物体，长期以来一直被预测存在，但从未被发现。

paras.en: Observations of microblazars would give astronomers closer views of black holes emitting powerful jets of energy and help them understand how these extreme objects behave.
paras.zh: 对微耀体的观测将使天文学家能够更近距离地观察发射强大能量射流的黑洞，并帮助他们了解这些极端物体的行为方式。

paras.en: Blazars are some of the most energetic objects in the universe. They are a type of quasar — a brightly glowing object fueled by a supermassive black hole stripping material from its host galaxy and then ejecting some of it in powerful, opposing jets of particles and radiation. To qualify as a blazar, one of those near-light-speed jets needs to point directly at Earth. Astronomers have previously discovered smaller versions of quasars, dubbed microquasars, and long theorized that there must be smaller versions of blazars as well.
paras.zh: 耀变体是宇宙中能量最高的物体之一。它们是类星体的一种，是一种明亮发光的物体，由超大质量黑洞从其宿主星系中剥离物质，然后以强大的、相反的粒子和辐射射流的形式喷射出其中的一些物质。为了获得耀变体的资格，其中一架近光速喷流需要直接指向地球。天文学家此前已经发现了较小版本的类星体，称为微类星体，并且长期以来一直认为一定存在较小版本的耀变体。

paras.en: Now, an international team led by astronomers in Spain, the Netherlands and Argentina has described a microblazar in a study accepted for publication in the journal Astronomy and Astrophysics.
paras.zh: 现在，由西班牙、荷兰和阿根廷天文学家领导的一个国际小组在《天文学与天体物理学》杂志上接受发表的一项研究中描述了一种微耀体。

paras.en: "It is the first time that we have a serious candidate," Josep Martí, an astronomer at the University of Jaén in Spain and first author of the study, told Live Science.
paras.zh: 该研究的第一作者、西班牙哈恩大学的天文学家何塞普·马蒂（Josep Martí）告诉《生活科学》杂志：“这是我们第一次有一个认真的候选者。”

paras.en: The object, called IRAS 18293-0941, is located in our galaxy, about 12,000 light-years from Earth, and it's hidden behind a veil of dust. It is a binary system that includes a black hole that orbits a hot, gigantic star every 11 days. Matter from the star falls into the black hole, and some of this material is jettisoned into the surrounding environment in two opposing jets. One of those jets flares toward Earth.
paras.zh: 这个名为 IRAS 18293-0941 的天体位于我们的银河系，距离地球约 12,000 光年，隐藏在尘埃后面。它是一个双星系统，其中包括一个黑洞，每 11 天绕一颗炽热的巨大恒星运行一次。来自恒星的物质落入黑洞，其中一些物质通过两个相对的喷流被抛入周围环境。其中一架喷气式飞机向地球喷射。

paras.en: These objects, as well as microquasars in general, are tricky to observe, Martí said. "Because of stellar evolution, you need to catch the system at the right time," he added. "The microquasar phase of evolution is very short, and so it is difficult to find one in that phase."
paras.zh: 马蒂说，这些物体以及一般的微类星体都很难观察。 “由于恒星演化，你需要在正确的时间捕捉到这个系统，”他补充道。 “微类星体的演化阶段非常短，因此很难在该阶段找到一个。”

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Theorists predicted that microblazars would have special characteristics that should help define them. These features include powerful emissions across the electromagnetic spectrum, rapid changes in brightness (variability), and a hotspot behind them where its opposing jet heats up the interstellar medium in the opposite direction of Earth.
paras.zh: 理论家预测，微耀体将具有有助于定义它们的特殊特征。这些特征包括整个电磁频谱的强大发射、亮度的快速变化（可变性）以及它们背后的热点，其相反的射流加热与地球相反方向的星际介质。

paras.en: To observe IRAS 18293-0941, the study authors used a variety of instruments — including the Calar Alto Astronomical Observatory in Spain, a network of radio astronomy telescopes called the European VLBI Network, and the MeerKAT radio telescope array in South Africa — as well as archival data from the Very Large Array in New Mexico.
paras.zh: 为了观测 IRAS 18293-0941，研究作者使用了多种仪器——包括西班牙的卡拉阿尔托天文台、欧洲 VLBI 网络的射电天文望远镜网络、南非的 MeerKAT 射电望远镜阵列——以及来自新墨西哥州甚大阵列的档案数据。

paras.en: They found that IRAS 18293-0941 has all of the expected microblazar characteristics, except one — variability. Microblazars have rapid variability, which means their brightness changes a lot in a short period, because one of the jets is facing Earth and small changes in brightness are amplified by an effect called Doppler boosting.
paras.zh: 他们发现 IRAS 18293-0941 具有所有预期的微耀体特征，除了变异性。微耀变体具有快速的变化性，这意味着它们的亮度在短时间内发生很大变化，因为其中一个喷流面向地球，并且亮度的微小变化会被称为多普勒增强的效应放大。

paras.en: Martí said IRAS 18293−0941's lack of rapid variability could be explained by the dense cloud of gas surrounding it, which could smooth out quick fluctuations in brightness.
paras.zh: 马蒂说，IRAS 18293−0941 缺乏快速变化的原因可能是它周围有浓密的气体云，这可以消除亮度的快速波动。

paras.en: The researchers are currently investigating whether the observed area behind the microblazar is in fact a hotspot, study co-author Pedro Luque-Escamilla, an astronomer at the University of Jaén, told Live Science.
paras.zh: 研究合著者、哈恩大学天文学家佩德罗·卢克-埃斯卡米拉告诉《生活科学》杂志，研究人员目前正在调查微耀体后面观察到的区域是否确实是一个热点。

paras.en: Even with one of the expected features missing, this object is a promising candidate for the first known microblazar. "The claims and the results of the paper are sensible and there are no questionable hidden assumptions," Kinwah Wu, a theoretical astrophysicist at University College London who was not involved in the research, told Live Science in an email. "The source in this paper had shown signatures of interactions between the jets and the ambient material, which naturally leads to [particle] interaction."
paras.zh: 即使缺少一个预期特征，该物体也是第一个已知微耀体的有希望的候选者。 “论文的主张和结果是合理的，不存在任何可疑的隐藏假设，”未参与这项研究的伦敦大学学院理论天体物理学家吴金华在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》。 “本文的来源显示了射流与周围材料之间相互作用的特征，这自然会导致[粒子]相互作用。”

paras.en: Svetlana Jorstad, a senior research scientist at the Institute for Astrophysical Research at Boston University who was not involved in the research, told Live Science in an email that the new study was "very interesting, important and comprehensive."
paras.zh: 波士顿大学天体物理研究所的高级研究科学家斯韦特兰娜·乔斯塔德（Svetlana Jorstad）没有参与这项研究，她在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》，这项新研究“非常有趣、重要且全面”。

paras.en: Itumeleng Monageng, an astronomer at the University of Cape Town who was also not involved in the research, added that the team's observations "presents a previously overlooked mechanism for generating some of the highest energy emissions observed."
paras.zh: 开普敦大学天文学家伊图梅伦·莫纳根（Itumeleng Monageng）也没有参与这项研究，他补充说，该团队的观测结果“提出了一种以前被忽视的机制，它产生了一些观察到的最高能量排放。”

paras.en: Microblazars "may power some of the universe's most energetic processes," Monageng told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: 莫纳根在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》，微耀体“可能为宇宙中一些最具能量的过程提供动力”。

paras.en: Martí, J., Luque-Escamilla, P. L., Marcote, B., Abaroa, L., Aguasca-Cabot, A., Combi, J. A., Romero, G. E., Paredes, J. M., García, F., Fogantini, F., Saavedra, E. A., Del Ser, D., & Van Den Eijnden, J. (2026). A Galactic microblazar as a potential accelerator of ultra-high-energy particles. Astronomy and Astrophysics. https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202661105
paras.zh: Martí, J.、Luque-Escamilla, P. L.、Marcote, B.、Abaroa, L.、Aguasca-Cabot, A.、Combi, J. A.、Romero, G. E.、Paredes, J. M.、García, F.、Fogantini, F.、Saavedra, E. A.、Del Ser, D. 和 Van Den Eijnden, J. (2026)。银河微耀体作为超高能粒子的潜在加速器。天文学和天体物理学。 https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202661105

paras.en: Sarah Wild is a British-South African freelance science journalist. She has written about particle physics, cosmology and everything in between. She studied physics, electronics and English literature at Rhodes University, South Africa, and later read for an MSc Medicine in bioethics.
paras.zh: 莎拉·怀尔德（Sarah Wild）是一位英国裔南非自由科学记者。她写过关于粒子物理学、宇宙学以及介于两者之间的一切的文章。她在南非罗德大学学习物理学、电子学和英语文学，后来攻读生物伦理学医学硕士学位。

paras.en: Since she started perpetrating journalism for a living, she's written books, won awards, and run national science desks. Her work has appeared in Nature, Science, Scientific American, and The Observer, among others. In 2017 she won a gold AAAS Kavli for her reporting on forensics in South Africa.
paras.zh: 自从她开始以新闻为生以来，她写了书，赢得了奖项，并管理着国家科学部门。她的作品曾发表在《自然》、《科学》、《科学美国人》和《观察家报》等杂志上。 2017 年，她因对南非法证学的报道而荣获 AAAS Kavli 金奖。

articles.title: This Brain Implant Allows People With Paralysis to Speak and Gesture at the Same Time Via a Mind-Controlled Virtual Avatar

paras.en: People with severe paralysis can struggle to communicate with others. While experimental brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) have come a long way in being able to help them convey their thoughts, these technologies have generally been limited to either speech or movement.
paras.zh: 严重瘫痪的人可能很难与他人交流。虽然实验性脑机接口（BCI）在帮助人们表达思想方面取得了长足的进步，但这些技术通常仅限于语音或动作。

paras.en: Now, scientists have developed a tool that can do both simultaneously.
paras.zh: 现在，科学家们开发出了一种可以同时完成这两件事的工具。

paras.en: The implant, described in the journal Nature Neuroscience on September 14, allows users to control the speech and movement of a virtual avatar with their mind in real time. While the work is still in its early stages, the innovation could one day help people with paralysis communicate with more nuance or serve as a stepping stone to robotic prosthetics that can be controlled with the mind.
paras.zh: 9 月 14 日的《自然神经科学》杂志上描述了这种植入物，它允许用户用意念实时控制虚拟化身的言语和动作。虽然这项工作仍处于早期阶段，但这项创新有一天可能会帮助瘫痪患者进行更细致的交流，或者成为可以用意念控制的机器人假肢的垫脚石。

paras.en: “In our everyday life, gestures play an important role in communication,” says study co-author Samantha Brosler, a bioengineer at the University of California, San Francisco, to Carissa Wong at New Scientist. “Saying ‘maybe’ and nodding your head has a very different connotation than if you shake your head.”
paras.zh: “在我们的日常生活中，手势在沟通中发挥着重要作用，”该研究的合著者、加州大学旧金山分校的生物工程师萨曼莎·布罗斯勒 (Samantha Brosler) 对《新科学家》杂志的 Carissa Wong 说道。 “说‘也许’并点头与摇头的含义截然不同。”

paras.en: In the new study, Brosler and colleagues focused on two participants, one of whom became paralyzed after a stroke, while the other had the neurodegenerative disease amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Each person had an iPhone-size device with 253 electrodes surgically implanted onto their sensorimotor cortex, a brain region involved in processing incoming sensations and outgoing movements. The implant can safely cover such a wide area because it lies on the brain’s surface rather than penetrating it like other BCIs, study co-author Edward Chang, a neurosurgeon at the University of California, San Francisco, tells Jennie Erin Smith at Science.
paras.zh: 在这项新研究中，布罗斯勒和同事重点关注了两名参与者，其中一名在中风后瘫痪，而另一名则患有神经退行性疾病肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）。每个人都有一个 iPhone 大小的设备，其中有 253 个电极，通过手术植入到他们的感觉运动皮层，这是一个参与处理传入感觉和传出运动的大脑区域。该研究的合著者、旧金山加利福尼亚大学的神经外科医生爱德华·张（Edward Chang）告诉《科学》杂志的珍妮·艾琳·史密斯（Jennie Erin Smith），植入物可以安全地覆盖如此大的区域，因为它位于大脑表面，而不是像其他脑机接口那样穿透大脑。

paras.en: The team trained computer models to decode the participants’ thoughts as they attempted to say up to ten phrases like “hello” and “nice to meet you” or attempted to perform up to ten gestures such as clapping and waving. They also practiced up to 100 realistic speech-and-gesture combinations. Then, the researchers mapped the brain activity linked to the phrases and gestures to a personalized full-body digital avatar, which could make movements and talk with onscreen text.
paras.zh: 该团队训练计算机模型来解码参与者的想法，因为他们试图说最多十个短语，如“你好”和“很高兴见到你”，或尝试执行最多十个手势，如拍手和挥手。他们还练习了多达 100 种逼真的语音和手势组合。然后，研究人员将与短语和手势相关的大脑活动映射到个性化的全身数字化身，该化身可以做出动作并与屏幕上的文字交谈。

paras.en: During five rounds of a conversation test with the participant with ALS, the decoders got the individual’s intended gesture correct 85 percent of the time, on average, and their intended phrase right 75 percent of the time, on average. The participant who had a stroke had 100 percent accuracy with the speech and gesture decoders during three rounds of a conversation test. The performance disparity might have something to do with the participants’ different causes of paralysis, according to the researchers.
paras.zh: 在与 ALS 参与者进行的五轮对话测试中，解码器平均在 85% 的时间内正确识别了该人的意图手势，平均在 75% 的时间内正确识别了他们的意图短语。在三轮对话测试中，中风的参与者的语音和手势解码器的准确率达到 100%。研究人员表示，表现差异可能与参与者瘫痪的不同原因有关。

paras.en: In March, researchers reported an experimental BCI that helped two people with paralysis type on a virtual keyboard with their minds. One participant could do it as fast as an able-bodied smartphone user can text.
paras.zh: 今年 3 月，研究人员报告了一项实验性脑机接口 (BCI)，它可以帮助两名瘫痪患者在虚拟键盘上打字。一名参与者可以像健全的智能手机用户发短信一样快地完成这项工作。

paras.en: “The authors have taken an important step toward developing highly naturalistic systems to restore function for people with paralysis,” says Daniel Rubin, a neurologist at Massachusetts General Hospital who wasn’t involved in the study, to Science.
paras.zh: “作者在开发高度自然的系统以恢复瘫痪患者的功能方面迈出了重要的一步，”未参与这项研究的马萨诸塞州总医院的神经学家丹尼尔·鲁宾（Daniel Rubin）对《科学》杂志说。

paras.en: While “the results are of very high quality, the level of speech decoding [in this study] is below what has been reported before,” Christian Herff, a computational neuroscientist at Maastricht University in the Netherlands who wasn’t involved in the work, tells Miryam Naddaf at Nature. What’s more, he notes, the BCI decoded only isolated gestures and sentences, whereas real conversations involve continuous streams of speech and movement.
paras.zh: 荷兰马斯特里赫特大学的计算神经科学家克里斯蒂安·赫夫（未参与这项工作）告诉《自然》杂志的 Miryam Naddaf，虽然“结果质量非常高，但（这项研究中的）语音解码水平低于之前报道的水平”。更重要的是，他指出，脑机接口只能解码孤立的手势和句子，而真正的对话涉及连续的语音和动作流。

paras.en: Brosler acknowledges the implant’s current limitations, explaining to the outlet that this study was meant to be a proof of concept. She plans to expand the speech decoder’s vocabulary and give the gesture decoder continuous control over individual body parts, such as moving 15 joints in the hand.
paras.zh: 布罗斯勒承认植入物目前的局限性，并向媒体解释说这项研究旨在证明概念。她计划扩展语音解码器的词汇量，并让手势解码器持续控制各个身体部位，例如移动手上的 15 个关节。

paras.en: The system could even be a step toward allowing amputees to control prosthetics with their minds.
paras.zh: 该系统甚至可能是让截肢者用意念控制假肢的一个步骤。

paras.en: Communicative gestures “are only one example of a body movement that you may want to do alongside speech,” Brosler tells Science. “I talk while I cook, right? Maybe somebody in the future will want to speak while cooking using their robotic arm.”
paras.zh: 布罗斯勒告诉《科学》杂志，交流手势“只是你可能想要与言语一起进行的身体运动的一个例子”。 “我一边做饭一边说话，对吧？也许将来有人会想用机械臂一边做饭一边说话。”

articles.title: Physicist Wins Nobel Prize for Developing a Massive, Ice-Embedded Observatory That Detects Ghostly Cosmic Particles

paras.en: On October 6, the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded to Francis Halzen, a theoretical physicist at the University of Wisconsin-Madison, for his role in developing a massive observatory to detect ghostly cosmic particles called high-energy neutrinos.
paras.zh: 10 月 6 日，2026 年诺贝尔物理学奖授予威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校理论物理学家弗朗西斯·哈尔岑 (Francis Halzen)，以表彰他在开发大型天文台以探测被称为高能中微子的幽灵宇宙粒子方面所做出的贡献。

paras.en: These electrically neutral and nearly massless particles constantly whiz through space, although they seldom interact with ordinary matter, which makes up stuff we can see like planets and people. In fact, roughly 100 trillion zip through your body per second. Neutrinos with low energies are produced by everyday astrophysical phenomena, such as nuclear fusion in the sun.
paras.zh: 这些电中性且几乎无质量的粒子不断地在太空中呼啸而过，尽管它们很少与普通物质相互作用，而普通物质构成了我们可以看到的行星和人类等物质。事实上，每秒大约有 100 万亿次穿过您的身体。低能量中微子是由日常天体物理现象产生的，例如太阳中的核聚变。

paras.en: But rare, high-energy neutrinos—the ones that have long fascinated the new Nobel laureate—are made by the most violent processes in the universe, including stars exploding in supernovas and black holes gorging themselves. The strange particles can be traced to the faraway astronomical objects that spewed them. And Halzen led efforts to establish an enormous, icy neutrino detector in the heart of the South Pole.
paras.zh: 但罕见的高能中微子——长期以来令这位新诺贝尔奖获得者着迷的中微子——是由宇宙中最剧烈的过程产生的，包括超新星爆炸的恒星和吞噬自身的黑洞。这些奇怪的粒子可以追溯到喷射它们的遥远天体。哈尔岑领导了在南极中心建立一个巨大的冰冷中微子探测器的工作。

paras.en: “His tenacity and scientific vision [have] paved the way for a new kind of astronomy,” says Mark Pearce, chair of the Nobel committee for physics and a physicist at the KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Sweden, in a statement.
paras.zh: 诺贝尔物理学委员会主席、瑞典皇家理工学院物理学家马克·皮尔斯在一份声明中表示：“他的坚韧和科学远见为新型天文学铺平了道路。”

paras.en: Born in Belgium in 1944, Halzen has spent the bulk of his career in the American Midwest. But the neutrino observatory he runs—called IceCube—lives in Antarctica. That’s because in the 1980s, Halzen came up with a clever strategy to catch these elusive high-energy particles: the southernmost continent’s glacial ice.
paras.zh: 哈尔岑 1944 年出生于比利时，他的大部分职业生涯都在美国中西部度过。但他运营的中微子观测站（名为 IceCube）位于南极洲。这是因为在 20 世纪 80 年代，哈尔岑想出了一个巧妙的策略来捕捉这些难以捉摸的高能粒子：最南端大陆的冰川。

paras.en: On the rare occasion that a neutrino bumps into an atom, the interaction produces a faint flash of light. Antarctica’s ice is a prime place to spot such signals. If you dig deep enough, it’s completely dark. What’s more, there would be no interference from large animals, low levels of radioactive substances and no earthquakes.
paras.zh: 在极少数情况下，中微子撞击原子时，相互作用会产生微弱的闪光。南极洲的冰层是发现此类信号的主要地点。如果你挖得足够深，就会完全黑暗。更重要的是，不会有大型动物的干扰，放射性物质含量低，也不会发生地震。

paras.en: “His bold idea—using Antarctic ice as a neutrino telescope—has paid off spectacularly,” Francesca Di Lodovico, a physicist at King’s College London, tells Nature’s Elizabeth Gibney and Davide Castelvecchi.
paras.zh: 伦敦国王学院的物理学家弗朗西斯卡·迪·洛多维科 (Francesca Di Lodovico) 告诉《自然》杂志的伊丽莎白·吉布尼 (Elizabeth Gibney) 和戴维德·卡斯特尔维奇 (Davide Castelvecchi)，“他的大胆想法——利用南极冰层作为中微子望远镜——已经获得了惊人的回报。”

paras.en: Halzen and colleagues finished constructing the IceCube Neutrino Observatory in 2011. Operated by UW-Madison and primarily funded by the National Science Foundation, the facility is a cubic kilometer of ice equipped with 5,160 light sensors. They’re attached to vertical strings thread through 86 boreholes and extending to depths of up to roughly 8,000 feet.
paras.zh: Halzen 和同事于 2011 年完成了 IceCube 中微子观测站的建设。该设施由威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校运营，主要由国家科学基金会资助，由一立方公里的冰组成，配备了 5,160 个光传感器。它们连接到垂直的绳子上，穿过 86 个钻孔，延伸至大约 8,000 英尺的深度。

paras.en: In 2013, the collaboration of scientists working on the observatory reported its first evidence of high-energy neutrinos that streamed in from beyond the solar system. “It is gratifying to finally see what we have been looking for,” Halzen said at the time in a statement. “This is the dawn of a new age of astronomy.”
paras.zh: 2013年，天文台科学家的合作首次报告了高能中微子从太阳系以外涌入的证据。哈尔岑当时在一份声明中表示：“很高兴终于看到我们一直在寻找的东西。” “这是天文学新时代的黎明。”

paras.en: This work, which birthed the field of neutrino astronomy, has since been followed by observations of ghost particles from our Milky Way galaxy and several other galaxies.
paras.zh: 这项工作催生了中微子天文学领域，此后人们对银河系和其他几个星系的幽灵粒子进行了观测。

paras.en: Did you know? Highest-energy neutrino ever detected
paras.zh: 你可知道？迄今为止检测到的最高能量中微子

paras.en: In 2023, an observatory in the Mediterranean Sea off Sicily detected a neutrino with the record-shattering energy of 220 million billion electron volts.
paras.zh: 2023年，西西里岛附近地中海的一座天文台探测到了一个中微子，其能量达到破纪录的2.2亿电子伏特。

paras.en: “It’s been a while since the Nobel Prize has gone to a single individual, and that points to the uniqueness of [Halzen’s] vision,” says Richard Fitzgerald, editor-in-chief of Physics Today, a magazine published by the American Institute of Physics, to CNN’s Issy Ronald and Katie Hunt. “It took a team of hundreds of people to build it, but it all started with one person.”
paras.zh: 美国物理研究所出版的《今日物理学》杂志主编理查德·菲茨杰拉德对 CNN 的伊西·罗纳德和凯蒂·亨特说道：“诺贝尔奖已经有一段时间没有颁给一个人了，这表明了哈尔岑的愿景的独特性。” “它需要一个数百人的团队来建造，但这一切都是从一个人开始的。”

paras.en: The observatory is still hunting for neutrinos today, and researchers have plans to expand it to eight cubic kilometers of South Pole ice. The IceCube collaboration included about 450 international scientists at roughly 60 institutions as of January 2025.
paras.zh: 该天文台至今仍在寻找中微子，研究人员计划将其扩大到 8 立方公里的南极冰层。截至 2025 年 1 月，IceCube 合作伙伴包括约 60 个机构的约 450 名国际科学家。

paras.en: “When we started this project, everybody realized this was maybe a good idea but very few thought it would work, including myself,” Halzen said during a livestream of the award announcement. “So, this was kind of an adventure where success wasn’t guaranteed.”
paras.zh: “当我们开始这个项目时，每个人都意识到这可能是一个好主意，但很少有人认为它会起作用，包括我自己，”哈尔岑在颁奖典礼的直播中说道。 “所以，这是一次无法保证成功的冒险。”

paras.en: The Nobel committees will continue revealing winners of their six award categories this week and early next week. Each award comes with 12 million Swedish kronor (about $1.2 million), which gets split among the laureates. Halzen, of course, gets the full amount—the first time since 1992 the Physics Nobel has gone to just one person.
paras.zh: 诺贝尔委员会将在本周和下周初继续公布六个奖项类别的获奖者。每个奖项的奖金为 1200 万瑞典克朗（约合 120 万美元），由获奖者平分。当然，哈尔岑获得了全额诺贝尔物理学奖——这是自 1992 年以来第一次只有一个人获得诺贝尔物理学奖。

articles.title: What Are Medieval English Coins Doing in Rome? They Could Be Rare Evidence of a 'Little England' Enclave That Received Special Papal Privileges

paras.en: A hoard of medieval coins unearthed in Rome could be the first physical evidence of an English neighborhood that once thrived near the Vatican.
paras.zh: 在罗马出土的一堆中世纪硬币可能是梵蒂冈附近曾经繁荣的英国社区的第一个实物证据。

paras.en: Researchers working in the walled garden of Rome’s Palazzo della Rovere discovered 19 silver pennies and one halfpenny minted in East Anglia, Kent, London and the West Midlands. Dating to the tenth century, the coins bear the names of the kings Edward the Elder, Athelstan and Eadred—all descendants of Alfred the Great. Fourteen were found clumped in two groups, while the others were scattered nearby.
paras.zh: 研究人员在罗马罗维尔宫的围墙花园里工作，发现了 19 枚银便士和 1 枚半便士，铸造于东安格利亚、肯特郡、伦敦和西米德兰兹郡。这些硬币的历史可追溯至十世纪，上面刻有国王老爱德华、阿塞尔斯坦和埃德雷德的名字，他们都是阿尔弗雷德大帝的后裔。十四人被发现聚集成两组，而其他人则分散在附近。

paras.en: In 2023, archaeologists working in the Palazzo della Rovere announced that they had discovered the ruins of an ancient building. They think the structure may have been the Roman emperor Nero’s theater, built in the first century C.E.
paras.zh: 2023年，在德拉罗韦雷宫工作的考古学家宣布，他们发现了一座古老建筑的遗址。他们认为这座建筑可能是罗马皇帝尼禄的剧院，建于公元一世纪。

paras.en: “The coins aren’t pretty, but they have a lot to say,” Rory Naismith, a historian at the University of Cambridge who helped interpret the coinage, says in a statement. “More Anglo-Saxon coins from this period have now been found in Rome than papal coins. This sounds bizarre, but it’s telling us that a very large amount of money was flowing in from England at this time.”
paras.zh: “这些硬币并不漂亮，但它们有很多话要说，”帮助解读该硬币的剑桥大学历史学家罗里·奈史密斯(Rory Naismith)在一份声明中表示。 “现在在罗马发现的这一时期的盎格鲁-撒克逊硬币比教皇硬币还多。这听起来很奇怪，但它告诉我们当时有大量资金从英格兰流入。”

paras.en: In a chapter published in a new book, Rome and the Others (300-1000): Foreigners in the City Between Conflicts and Integration, Naismith and his co-authors argue that the coinage is material evidence of Rome’s Schola Saxonum, an English enclave that historians had previously known about based on references in surviving medieval texts.
paras.zh: 在新书《罗马与其他人（300-1000）：冲突与融合之间城市中的外国人》一章中，奈史密斯和他的合著者认为，这种铸币是罗马 Schola Saxonum 的物质证据，历史学家之前根据幸存的中世纪文献中的参考文献了解了这片英国飞地。

paras.en: Though its exact size remains unknown, the neighborhood was located within the walled-in district between the Vatican and the Tiber River known as the Leonine City. Founded in the eighth century, the Schola Saxonum was a hub for English pilgrims traveling to Rome. The researchers also unearthed evidence of leather-, bone- and metal-working at the site, suggesting that hundreds of full-time residents may have once lived there.
paras.zh: 尽管其确切大小仍不得而知，但该街区位于梵蒂冈和台伯河之间的围墙区内，被称为利奥宁城。 Schola Saxonum 始建于八世纪，是英国朝圣者前往罗马的中心。研究人员还在该地点发现了皮革、骨头和金属加工的证据，表明数百名全职居民可能曾经住在那里。

paras.en: “The English quarter in Rome really was an interesting and vibrant place,” Naismith tells New Scientist’s James Woodford. “It might be compared with districts in modern major cities that house a specific community, like the Chinatown areas of London, Melbourne, San Francisco and other cities.”
paras.zh: “罗马的英国区确实是一个有趣且充满活力的地方，”奈史密斯告诉《新科学家》的詹姆斯·伍德福德。 “它可以与现代大城市中拥有特定社区的地区进行比较，例如伦敦、墨尔本、旧金山和其他城市的唐人街地区。”

paras.en: The new discovery corroborates the Schola Saxonum’s hypothesized geography and suggests that its residents enjoyed a degree of economic independence, including the privilege to use their native currency in a foreign land.
paras.zh: 这一新发现证实了Schola Saxonum的假设地理位置，并表明其居民享有一定程度的经济独立，包括在外国土地上使用本国货币的特权。

paras.en: The halfpenny discovery is especially significant, researchers say, as the small denomination is typically associated with the everyday transactions that took place in trading hubs. The researchers found no evidence of melted-down silver bullion, which would have suggested that English travelers were converting their money into local currency.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，半便士的发现尤其重要，因为小面额通常与交易中心发生的日常交易有关。研究人员没有发现银条熔化的证据，这表明英国旅行者正在将钱兑换成当地货币。

paras.en: “To see Anglo-Saxon coins in such numbers, from a site where they must have been used and lost over a sustained period, is therefore surprising and raises questions about the status of English currency in tenth-century Rome,” the researchers write in Rome and the Others, per the London Times’ Kaya Burgess.
paras.zh: 据《伦敦时报》的卡亚·伯吉斯报道，研究人员在《罗马及其他人》中写道：“在这些硬币肯定在长期使用和丢失的地点看到如此数量的盎格鲁撒克逊硬币，令人感到惊讶，并引发了人们对英国货币在十世纪罗马的地位的质疑。”

paras.en: Though other foreigners—including the Lombards, Franks and Frisians—also made pilgrimages to Rome and built institutions near the Vatican, they don’t seem to have received the same privileges as the English.
paras.zh: 尽管其他外国人——包括伦巴第人、法兰克人和弗里斯兰人——也前往罗马朝圣并在梵蒂冈附近建立机构，但他们似乎没有获得与英国人相同的特权。

paras.en: “The English in Rome were quite unique,” Francesca Tinti, a historian at the University of the Basque Country who collaborated with Naismith, says in the statement. “They made the greatest effort to get there. Their journey was really dangerous, and many people died on the way. But once in Rome, they were special. We knew they had the privilege of being able to bury their dead in this area and now, it seems, they were permitted to use their own currency.”
paras.zh: “罗马的英国人非常独特，”与奈史密斯合作的巴斯克地区大学历史学家弗朗西斯卡·丁蒂在声明中说。 “他们尽了最大的努力才到达那里。他们的旅程确实很危险，很多人死在路上。但一旦到达罗马，他们就很特别。我们知道他们有幸能够在这个地区埋葬死者，现在看来，他们被允许使用自己的货币。”

It’s the most well-rounded laptop you can buy, sporting great performance, long battery life, and a razor-thin chassis. The price has gone up considerably over the past year, but that’s true of many of the best laptops. And now, it's at its lowest price since June, making it an absolute must-buy and the top of my list for Prime Day laptop deals. —Luke Larsen
paras.zh: 作为今年已经测试过数十台笔记本电脑的人，我仍然发现自己比其他任何人都更推荐 MacBook Air M5。它是您能买到的最全面的笔记本电脑，具有出色的性能、较长的电池寿命和超薄的机箱。在过去的一年里，价格大幅上涨，但许多最好的笔记本电脑都是如此。现在，它的价格处于 6 月份以来的最低水平，使其成为绝对必买产品，也是我的 Prime Day 笔记本电脑优惠清单中的首选。 ——卢克·拉森

paras.en: Apple AirPods Pro 3 are the best wireless earbuds for anyone with an iPhone. They’ve got best-in-class noise-canceling, an excellent transparency mode, clear and detailed audio quality, and a plethora of advanced features like built-in heart rate sensors and live translation. The heart rate sensors are particularly impressive—you can go on a run with just your phone and these earbuds and get accurate GPS, heart rate zone, and calorie data. —Harry Rabinowitz
paras.zh: Apple AirPods Pro 3 是所有 iPhone 使用者的最佳无线耳机。它们具有一流的降噪功能、出色的透明模式、清晰细致的音频质量，以及内置心率传感器和实时翻译等大量高级功能。心率传感器尤其令人印象深刻——您只需携带手机和耳机即可跑步，并获得准确的 GPS、心率区和卡路里数据。 ——哈里·拉比诺维茨

paras.en: The Mac Mini has been sold out for the majority of this year due to the rapid escalation of interest in using them as local, agentic AI machines. The brand-new M6 model is faster (and more expensive) than ever. But the fact that you can buy them at all right now feels significant, and Amazon has the best deal on the latest model you’ll find. —Luke Larsen
paras.zh: 由于人们对将 Mac Mini 用作本地代理人工智能机器的兴趣迅速升温，Mac Mini 今年大部分时间都已售空。全新的 M6 型号比以往更快（而且更昂贵）。但事实上，你现在就可以购买它们，这感觉很重要，而且亚马逊对你能找到的最新型号有最优惠的价格。 ——卢克·拉森

paras.en: If you're looking to get the biggest discount on a new Kindle, the best sale is on the Kindle Scribe Colorsoft. It's got an 11-inch color screen and comes with a stylus to let it double as a digital notebook. It's the most expensive Kindle, but it also has the best discount during Amazon's sale event. —Nena Farrell
paras.zh: 如果您想获得新 Kindle 的最大折扣，Kindle Scribe Colorsoft 是最优惠的选择。它配备 11 英寸彩色屏幕，并配有手写笔，可兼作数字笔记本。它是最贵的Kindle，但在亚马逊促销活动期间它也有最好的折扣。 ——妮娜·法雷尔

paras.en: This is the lowest price ever for the Nothing Headphone (1), an excellent, stylish pair of over-ear headphones with great sound and even better battery life: up to 35 hours with noise-canceling on or 80 hours with it off. The headphones have tactile controls on each earcup I personally love—things like a volume wheel, Bluetooth pairing button, on-off switch, and media control paddle. —Harry Rabinowitz
paras.zh: 这是 Nothing Headphone (1) 有史以来的最低价格，这是一款出色、时尚的包耳式耳机，具有出色的音质和更长的电池寿命：开启降噪功能时长达 35 小时，关闭降噪功能时长达 80 小时。这款耳机的每个耳罩上都有我个人喜欢的触觉控制装置，例如音量轮、蓝牙配对按钮、开关和媒体控制拨片。 ——哈里·拉比诺维茨

paras.en: The Google Pixel Buds Pro 2 remain our top earbuds for Android users (they also work with iOS). They're aesthetically pleasing. They sound great. They're comfortable and have a long-lasting battery and active noise cancellation, plus some useful software features. If you want good earbuds that aren't AirPods, these might be up your alley. —Louryn Strampe
paras.zh: Google Pixel Buds Pro 2 仍然是 Android 用户的首选耳机（它们也适用于 iOS）。它们在审美上令人愉悦。他们听起来很棒。它们佩戴舒适，电池续航时间长，具有主动降噪功能，还有一些有用的软件功能。如果您想要 AirPods 以外的优质耳塞，这些可能正适合您。 ——卢琳·斯特兰普

paras.en: Amazon launched two new Echo Show smart displays last year, and the Echo Show 11 was easily the better of the two. The sound is better, and the screen is larger—but not so large that it's a pain to put on a kitchen counter. Amazon did raise the price by $30 at the end of August, but this is still the lowest deal price I've seen for it since its launch. —Nena Farrell
paras.zh: 亚马逊去年推出了两款新的 Echo Show 智能显示器，而 Echo Show 11 无疑是两者中更好的。声音更好，屏幕更大，但又不会大到放在厨房柜台上很麻烦。亚马逊确实在 8 月底将价格提高了 30 美元，但这仍然是自推出以来我见过的最低交易价格。 ——妮娜·法雷尔

paras.en: The Echo Studio has been our favorite Echo speaker for the sound quality since the original model, and the second-generation version packs fantastic sound like its predecessor. I also love that its price didn't increase between the two generations, or after Amazon's price hike in August. It's still one of the more expensive models, even on sale, so I'd choose it only if you have a massive room you're trying to fill with sound. But it's also the only new Echo that didn't get a price increase, so this sale isn't just a trick of the numbers. —Nena Farrell
paras.zh: 自最初的型号以来，Echo Studio 就其音质一直是我们最喜欢的 Echo 扬声器，而第二代版本则像其前身一样提供美妙的声音。我还喜欢它的价格在两代之间没有上涨，或者在亚马逊八月份涨价之后也没有上涨。它仍然是最昂贵的型号之一，即使是在打折，所以只有当你有一个巨大的房间并且想要充满声音时我才会选择它。但这也是唯一一款没有涨价的新款 Echo，因此这次促销不仅仅是数字上的骗局。 ——妮娜·法雷尔

paras.en: A good smart plug is handy all over the house. I really like this set from TP-Link's Tapo brand because the plugs are Matter-certified, making them easy to pair with any existing smart home ecosystem, and have a small form factor so they won't block the other outlets. I like them best for controlling lamps that don't fit for a smart bulb, but you could use them for all kinds of things. —Nena Farrell
paras.zh: 一个好的智能插头在整个房子里都很方便。我真的很喜欢 TP-Link Tapo 品牌的这套插头，因为这些插头经过 Matter 认证，可以轻松与任何现有的智能家居生态系统配对，并且外形小巧，不会阻塞其他插座。我最喜欢它们用于控制不适合智能灯泡的灯，但您可以将它们用于各种用途。 ——妮娜·法雷尔

paras.en: If you’re looking for a cheap automatic pet feeder in a home with two pets and you don’t need all of the bells and whistles, I recommend this model. It’s a solid, inexpensive dual feeder with a connected app where you can customize feeding plans of up to six meals a day, and it also has a knob on the front to plan meals if you want to go analog. Plus, I loved the hygienic stainless steel inserts that can be removed for easier cleaning. This is the lowest price we’ve seen all year. —Molly Higgins
paras.zh: 如果您正在为养有两只宠物的家中寻找一款便宜的自动宠物喂食器，并且不需要所有的花哨功能，我推荐此型号。它是一款坚固、廉价的双喂食器，带有连接的应用程序，您可以自定义每天最多六餐的喂食计划，如果您想进行模拟，它的前面还有一个旋钮可以计划膳食。另外，我喜欢卫生的不锈钢嵌件，它可以拆卸以便于清洁。这是我们全年见过的最低价格。 ——莫莉·希金斯

paras.en: If you value aesthetics and still want a solid small-to-midsize room air purifier, you may like this discounted model from Windmill. It has a chic Scandinavian look, with bamboo paneling that makes it look more like furniture than most other models I’ve tested. It has an intuitive connected app that integrates with other products in the Windmill ecosystem. It also has an internal sensor and indicator light that make it easy to tell the air quality at a glance. —Molly Higgins
paras.zh: 如果您重视美观，但仍想要一台坚固的中小型室内空气净化器，您可能会喜欢 Windmill 的这款打折型号。它具有别致的斯堪的纳维亚外观，配有竹制镶板，使其看起来比我测试过的大多数其他型号更像家具。它有一个直观的连接应用程序，可与 Windmill 生态系统中的其他产品集成。它还内置传感器和指示灯，让空气质量一目了然。 ——莫莉·希金斯

paras.en: When it comes to monitors, all most people need is something reliable, comfortable to use, and not horrifically ugly. That’s underselling the Dell S2725HSM, despite its price. It’s a basic 1080p resolution, but it has really solid image quality, and it even comes with a 144-Hz refresh rate. All those features are heightened when it’s on sale for just $130, too. That’s the biggest price drop I’ve seen on this monitor in a while. —Luke Larsen
paras.zh: 当谈到显示器时，大多数人需要的只是可靠、使用舒适、而且不是太丑陋的东西。尽管戴尔 S2725HSM 价格低廉，但其销量仍低于其售价。它是基本的 1080p 分辨率，但具有非常稳定的图像质量，甚至还具有 144 Hz 刷新率。当它的售价仅为 130 美元时，所有这些功能都得到了加强。这是我一段时间以来在这款显示器上看到的最大降价幅度。 ——卢克·拉森

paras.en: Tilt-Pan-Zoom webcams like the Obsbot Tiny 3 are so much more than just a webcam for video calls. The gimbal gives the camera a huge range of motion, letting you dramatically expand what you can shoot compared to a standard webcam. It’s ideal for streamers, content creators, podcasters, and online educators—or really anyone who wants to show more of their room on video. On top of that, it also has tons of interesting AI features to play with. This is a rare discount on this top-shelf webcam, too. —Luke Larsen
paras.zh: 像 Obsbot Tiny 3 这样的倾斜-平移-缩放网络摄像头不仅仅是用于视频通话的网络摄像头。与标准网络摄像头相比，万向节为相机提供了巨大的运动范围，让您可以极大地扩展您的拍摄范围。它非常适合主播、内容创作者、播客和在线教育工作者，或者任何想要在视频中展示更多房间的人。最重要的是，它还有大量有趣的人工智能功能可供使用。对于这款顶级网络摄像头来说，这也是难得的折扣。 ——卢克·拉森

paras.en: This tri-band Wi-Fi 7 mesh is the best subscription-free mesh system for most people. A two-pack will be enough to cover most homes, and each router has two 10-Gbps Ethernet ports, one Gigabit port, and a USB 3.0 port. Asus allows you to tinker with and configure everything and offers comprehensive security software and parental controls at no extra cost (you can even redeem a free year of NordVPN service with this mesh). Clip the on-page coupon to save. —Simon Hill
paras.zh: 对于大多数人来说，这款三频 Wi-Fi 7 网格是最好的免订阅网格系统。两件装就足以覆盖大多数家庭，每个路由器都有两个 10 Gbps 以太网端口、一个千兆位端口和一个 USB 3.0 端口。华硕允许您修补和配置所有内容，并提供全面的安全软件和家长控制，无需额外费用（您甚至可以使用此网格兑换一年免费的 NordVPN 服务）。夹住页面优惠券以保存。 ——西蒙·希尔

paras.en: The Branch Ergonomic Chair Pro is both our favorite office chair and our favorite gaming chair. It's incredibly comfortable and features several points of adjustment so you can fine-tune your experience. It's also high-quality and easy to assemble. You can't beat the value offered for the price. —Louryn Strampe
paras.zh: Branch 人体工学椅 Pro 既是我们最喜欢的办公椅，也是我们最喜欢的游戏椅。它非常舒适，并具有多个调节点，因此您可以微调您的体验。它还具有高品质且易于组装。您无法超越所提供的价格的价值。 ——卢琳·斯特兰普

paras.en: This soundbar plus subwoofer is a fantastic way to upgrade your TV audio system for a reasonable price, especially at 25 percent off. The Polk Signa S4 is one of our favorite soundbars for that very reason: It’s simple, easy to use, sounds great, and doesn’t cost an arm and a leg. Sure, it doesn’t have more advanced features like Wi-Fi connectivity, voice assistant support, or multi-speaker surround sound. But if you’re coming from built-in TV speakers, this is a great first upgrade. —Harry Rabinowitz
paras.zh: 这款条形音箱加低音炮是以合理的价格升级您的电视音频系统的绝佳方式，尤其是 25% 的折扣。 Polk Signa S4 是我们最喜欢的条形音箱之一，原因如下：它简单、易于使用、听起来很棒，而且价格低廉。当然，它没有 Wi-Fi 连接、语音助手支持或多扬声器环绕声等更高级的功能。但如果您使用的是内置电视扬声器，那么这是一次很棒的首次升级。 ——哈里·拉比诺维茨

paras.en: This is our favorite portable Bluetooth speaker. It delivers huge sound, and is small and durable enough to carry on any adventure. It also has IP68 water resistance, an easy-release strap, and a two-hour battery boost (or four if you reduce the bass). —Louryn Strampe
paras.zh: 这是我们最喜欢的便携式蓝牙扬声器。它可发出巨大的声音，而且体积小且耐用，足以进行任何冒险。它还具有 IP68 防水性能、易于释放的表带和两小时的电池续航时间（如果降低低音则为四小时）。 ——卢琳·斯特兰普

paras.en: I'm not going to act like 20 percent off is a huge bargain, but this is an iconic turntable and our number one pick from our best turntable guide. It’s durable, upgradable, and sounds great out of the box. Physically owning music, whether that’s vinyl or CD, is in vogue in 2026, and this USB-enabled turntable lets you plug in directly into your computer to rip your records to MP3 files. —Harry Rabinowitz
paras.zh: 我不会表现得好像 20% 的折扣是一个巨大的讨价还价，但这是一个标志性的转盘，也是我们从最佳转盘指南中挑选的第一名。它耐用、可升级，开箱即用，听起来很棒。实体拥有音乐（无论是黑胶唱片还是 CD）将在 2026 年盛行，而这款支持 USB 的转盘可让您直接插入计算机，将唱片翻录为 MP3 文件。 ——哈里·拉比诺维茨

paras.en: The best Samsung phones are on sale. If you want an Android phone with real power, but prefer something that’s not too big, the Samsung Galaxy S26 is tough to beat. It’s fast, has a bright and sharp screen, a reliable triple-camera system, and good battery life. You also get seven years of software support, and the base model has jumped to 256 GB of storage. This has been cheaper, but with prices on the rise across the market, I’m not sure when it will dip again. This is still a decent discount. —Simon Hill
paras.zh: 最好的三星手机正在促销。如果您想要一款功能强大的 Android 手机，但又喜欢不太大的手机，那么三星 Galaxy S26 是您的最佳选择。它速度快、屏幕明亮、锐利、可靠的三摄像头系统以及良好的电池续航时间。您还可以获得七年的软件支持，基本型号的存储空间已跃升至 256 GB。这已经更便宜了，但随着市场价格的上涨，我不确定什么时候会再次下跌。这还是一个不错的折扣。 ——西蒙·希尔

paras.en: The Google Pixel 11 is the value sweet spot in Google’s new lineup, especially with this hefty discount. It combines a great camera, strong battery life, and solid performance with Qi2 25W support and slick contextual AI features. —Simon Hill
paras.zh: 谷歌 Pixel 11 是谷歌新产品系列中性价比最高的一款，尤其是在如此大的折扣下。它结合了出色的摄像头、强大的电池续航时间、稳定的性能以及 Qi2 25W 支持和流畅的上下文 AI 功能。 ——西蒙·希尔

paras.en: My all-time favorite robot vacuum is often on sale, but this is the lowest the price it ever goes (and used to only go as low as $800, so don't miss it!) The Shark PowerDetect UV Reveal uses a UV light to spot stains and spills on your floor and will go back to scrub them away after doing its regular clean. It's the smartest one I've tried in 2026 by a long shot, and little announcements from the base station make it easy to know when the vacuum is just cleaning versus handling stains. —Nena Farrell
paras.zh: 我一直以来最喜欢的机器人真空吸尘器经常打折，但这是它有史以来的最低价格（以前只低至 800 美元，所以不要错过它！） Shark PowerDetect UV Reveal 使用紫外线来发现地板上的污渍和溢出物，并在定期清洁后返回将它们擦掉。这是我在 2026 年尝试过的最聪明的一款，基站发出的小通知让我很容易知道吸尘器何时只是在清洁，什么时候在处理污渍。 ——妮娜·法雷尔

paras.en: I usually see a lot of Dyson vacuums on sale during events like these, and the slightly older Dyson V15 is often one of them. Now that there are newer models, the V15's sale price is just under $600, and it's a good price for a Dyson vacuum that comes with both a hard floor and all-floor cleaner head, plus a crevice tool. There's an LCD screen too, which you won't find on Dyson's new, more affordable models. —Nena Farrell
paras.zh: 我通常会在此类活动期间看到很多戴森吸尘器打折，稍旧的戴森 V15 往往就是其中之一。现在有了更新的型号，V15 的售价略低于 600 美元，对于配备硬地板和全地板清洁头以及缝隙吸嘴的戴森吸尘器来说，这是一个不错的价格。还有液晶显示屏，这是戴森新的、更实惠的型号上找不到的。 ——妮娜·法雷尔

paras.en: This carpet cleaner looks like a normal vacuum, but it has two removable tanks: one for warm water and detergent, and another for the dirty water it extracts while wet-washing embedded grime. A pedal-activated spray jet helps target stains, and three modes—Max, Deep, and Express—let you adjust the cleaning. It also comes with plenty of attachments, including an upholstery attachment and a stair-cleaning tool. It’s a godsend for spill-prone kids and cats that love to throw up on soft surfaces, and it’s the lowest price we’ve seen this year. —Molly Higgins
paras.zh: 这款地毯清洁剂看起来像普通的真空吸尘器，但它有两个可拆卸的水箱：一个用于温水和清洁剂，另一个用于湿洗嵌入污垢时提取的脏水。踏板驱动的喷射器有助于瞄准污渍，三种模式（最大、深度和快速）可让您调整清洁效果。它还配有大量附件，包括室内装饰附件和楼梯清洁工具。对于容易溢出的孩子和喜欢在柔软的表面上呕吐的猫来说，这是天赐之物，而且这是我们今年见过的最低价格。 ——莫莉·希金斯

paras.en: Why settle for a dull black brick when you can snag translucent tech that looks like it came from a Cyberpunk world? This isn’t just the best-looking power bank, it’s also functionally awesome. It can supply up to 170 watts, has an ample 24,000-mAh capacity, and scores an IP66 rating for water resistance, meaning there’s no need to worry about rain. —Simon Hill
paras.zh: 当你能获得看起来像是来自赛博朋克世界的半透明技术时，为什么要选择暗淡的黑砖呢？这不仅是外观最好的移动电源，而且功能也很棒。它的供电功率高达 170 瓦，拥有 24,000 mAh 的充足容量，并获得 IP66 防水等级，这意味着无需担心雨水。 ——西蒙·希尔

paras.en: The Smartish Side Hustle is one of our favorite MagSafe wallets. These kinds of wallets can be tricky to use in daily life, but this wallet is designed to pop cards out for you, saving time at the register. This price is the best we've tracked. —Louryn Strampe
paras.zh: Smartish Side Hustle 是我们最喜欢的 MagSafe 钱包之一。这些类型的钱包在日常生活中使用起来可能很棘手，但这款钱包的设计可以为您弹出卡片，从而节省收银时间。这个价格是我们追踪过的最好价格。 ——卢琳·斯特兰普

paras.en: An affordable OLED TV is rare, but this newly launched model from Sony is an exception during this sale. It's Sony's entry-level OLED TV, and while it might have fewer bells and whistles than the Sony Bravia 8 II, it's far easier on your wallet and still delivers a rich picture with deep black tones and excellent color contrast. It also has Google Gemini built in, which you can use to control the picture, change settings, flip inputs, and ask about obscure sci-fi movies from the ’70s. —John Brandon
paras.zh: 价格实惠的 OLED 电视很少见，但索尼新推出的这款电视在本次促销中是个例外。它是索尼的入门级 OLED 电视，虽然它可能比索尼 Bravia 8 II 少了一些花哨的功能，但它更便宜，而且仍然提供具有深黑色调和出色色彩对比度的丰富图像。它还内置了 Google Gemini，您可以用它来控制图像、更改设置、翻转输入以及询问 70 年代晦涩的科幻电影。 ——约翰·布兰登

paras.en: This screen-free play stage and speaker for kids is enormous fun. Simply slot one of the wooden cartridges in the top and pop wooden character pieces on the circular soundstage, divided into four sections, to change the audio it plays. This basic functionality allows for a clever variety of themed add-on packs, including classical music and a cooking game.
paras.zh: 这个无屏幕的儿童游戏舞台和扬声器非常有趣。只需将其中一个木制唱头插入顶部，然后在圆形音场上弹出木制角色部件（分为四个部分），即可更改其播放的音频。这一基本功能允许巧妙地添加各种主题附加包，包括古典音乐和烹饪游戏。

paras.en: If you’re looking to cut down on food waste but don’t want to deal with smelly compost containers and mess, FoodCycler 3 is one of my top picks for this purpose. Put your peels, cores, and wilted herbs into the included 3.5-liter countertop bucket; when it’s full, seat it right in the machine, which will then grind and dry your scraps to a fine powder. You can then top-dress your lawn with the resultant “Foodilizer,” put it in your yard waste bin, or even mix it with soil (1:10 ratio) to use in your garden. —Kat Merck
paras.zh: 如果您想减少食物浪费，但又不想处理堆肥容器的臭味和混乱，那么 FoodCycler 3 是我为此目的的首选之一。将果皮、果核和枯萎的香草放入随附的 3.5 升台面桶中；当它装满时，将其放入机器中，然后机器会将您的废料研磨并干燥成细粉。然后，您可以用所得的“Foodilizer”对草坪进行追肥，将其放入院子的垃圾桶中，甚至与土壤（1:10 的比例）混合以在花园中使用。 ——凯特·默克

paras.en: My parents bought this bread machine years ago because it was one of the only models with a ceramic pan and no suspicious nonstick coatings. They handed it down to me, and I still have it. It works flawlessly, turning out ball-shaped 1-, 1.5-, or 2-lb. loaves. It doesn’t have as much versatility as higher-end machines like the Zojirushi Virtuoso, which does a better job with specialty breads, but if you’re interested in making your own basic, preservative-free loaves without having to mess with starters, kneading, and all-day rising schedules, this machine is the best value out there. —Kat Merck
paras.zh: 我的父母几年前买了这台面包机，因为它是唯一带有陶瓷锅且没有可疑的不粘涂层的型号之一。他们把它传给了我，我仍然保留着它。它工作完美，可生产 1 磅、1.5 磅或 2 磅的球形。面包。它不像象印 Virtuoso 这样的高端机器具有那么多的多功能性，象印 Virtuoso 在制作特色面包方面做得更好，但如果你有兴趣制作自己的基本、不含防腐剂的面包，而不必搞乱开胃菜、揉捏和全天发酵时间表，那么这台机器是最有价值的。 ——凯特·默克

paras.en: The Solo Stove Pi Prime is an excellent pizza oven, with an elegant and functional design that is more round than oval. It's propane-powered and has solid wind shielding, and it won't take up too much space in your backyard. —Louryn Strampe
paras.zh: Solo Stove Pi Prime 是一款出色的披萨烤箱，采用优雅且实用的设计，圆形多于椭圆形。它由丙烷驱动，具有坚固的防风罩，并且不会在您的后院占用太多空间。 ——卢琳·斯特兰普

paras.en: This is a solid deal on the best automatic latte and cappuccino maker we've tested. The Rivelia is user-friendly and easy to use, and it even has a built-in milk frother in addition to the grinder. We also like the touchscreen display and consistently tasty results. —Louryn Strampe
paras.zh: 对于我们测试过的最好的自动拿铁和卡布奇诺咖啡机来说，这是一笔划算的交易。 Rivelia 用户友好且易于使用，除了研磨机之外，它甚至还配有内置奶泡器。我们还喜欢触摸屏显示屏和始终如一的美味结果。 ——卢琳·斯特兰普

paras.en: Athletic Greens has a newer formula with a few additional ingredients, but the Classic formula is cheaper than we've seen before. This brand doesn't go on sale often. I noticed smoother digestion and higher energy levels when I tested this greens powder, which can be a beneficial way to supplement your diet in addition to whole fruits and veggies. —Louryn Strampe
paras.zh: Athletic Greens 有一个更新的配方，添加了一些额外的成分，但经典配方比我们以前见过的更便宜。这个牌子不经常打折。当我测试这种绿色粉末时，我注意到消化更顺畅，能量水平更高，除了完整的水果和蔬菜之外，这也是补充饮食的有益方式。 ——卢琳·斯特兰普

paras.en: I've tried many mobile gaming controllers, and the Backbone One remains the best. It feels great, it's fast and tactile, and the app makes finding new games easy. This price comes within $5 of the best we've seen. —Louryn Strampe
paras.zh: 我尝试过很多移动游戏控制器，Backbone One 仍然是最好的。感觉很棒，速度快且有触觉，而且该应用程序使寻找新游戏变得容易。这个价格与我们见过的最好价格相差不到 5 美元。 ——卢琳·斯特兰普

paras.en: In the world of PC gaming, this keyboard truly qualifies as a classic. It’s a few years old at this point, but this wireless, mechanical gaming keyboard is extremely balanced and well-made. The tenkeyless layout gives you everything you need without overtaking your desk (or getting in the way of your mouse hand), and the design has some flash without overdoing it. —Luke Larsen
paras.zh: 在电脑游戏领域，这款键盘确实堪称经典。虽然它已经有几年的历史了，但这款无线机械游戏键盘非常平衡且制作精良。无钥匙布局为您提供所需的一切，而不会占用您的办公桌（或妨碍您的鼠标手），并且设计有一些闪光但不过分。 ——卢克·拉森

paras.en: The Steelcase Gesture is our recommendation for a premium office chair. If you want something that feels a little more luxurious and cushy, it's a very safe bet. It still has several elegant points of adjustment and the foam seat is plush and comfortable. —Louryn Strampe
paras.zh: Steelcase Gesture 是我们推荐的优质办公椅。如果您想要感觉更奢华、更舒适的东西，这是一个非常安全的选择。它仍然有几个优雅的调节点，泡沫座椅柔软舒适。 ——卢琳·斯特兰普

paras.en: The wee little Lit Hero is GoPro's smallest, lightest, cheapest action camera. It's my favorite GoPro for selfies thanks to the included light. The cluster of four LEDs next to the lens ensures this camera keeps you well-lit in every scene. The Lit Hero isn't quite as capable video-wise as the Hero 13 Black (also on sale, see below), but it can shoot 4K at 60 fps, and the battery held up for a respectable 101 minutes during my test (shooting a 4K 60 fps video). —Scott Gilbertson
paras.zh: 小巧的 Lit Hero 是 GoPro 最小、最轻、最便宜的运动相机。由于附带的灯，它是我最喜欢的自拍 GoPro。镜头旁边的四个 LED 灯组确保这款相机在每个场景中都能保持良好的照明。 Lit Hero 在视频方面的能力不如 Hero 13 Black（也在销售，见下文），但它可以以 60 fps 拍摄 4K，并且在我的测试中（拍摄 4K 60 fps 视频），电池续航时间长达 101 分钟。 ——斯科特·吉尔伯森

paras.en: The Theragun Relief is our budget Theragun pick, and at $100, it’s an even cheaper buy. It’s an older 2023 model, but massage guns don’t need the latest features to be effective. You get three attachments and three speed settings, and it’s half the weight of the Pro Plus, making it much easier to pack for travel. I’ve seen the price drop slightly lower, but $100 is still a solid discount on one of our favorite percussive guns. —Boutayna Chokrane
paras.zh: Theragun Relief 是我们选择的预算款 Theragun，价格为 100 美元，甚至更便宜。这是 2023 年的较旧型号，但按摩枪不需要最新功能即可发挥作用。您可以获得三个附件和三种速度设置，而且它的重量是 Pro Plus 的一半，使其更容易打包旅行。我发现价格略有下降，但对于我们最喜欢的一款冲击枪来说，100 美元仍然是一个不错的折扣。 ——布泰纳·乔克兰

paras.en: Samsung’s newer Galaxy Watch9 is a modest upgrade, with a faster processor, slightly larger battery, and additional health metrics that may not be useful for everyone. The processor doesn’t make a dramatic difference in everyday use, and the larger battery doesn’t translate to a longer battery life. At $260, the Watch8 is $120 less than its successor; it’s a compelling option if you don’t need the latest model. —Boutayna Chokrane
paras.zh: 三星新款 Galaxy Watch9 是一次适度的升级，配备了更快的处理器、稍大的电池以及可能并不适合所有人的额外健康指标。处理器在日常使用中不会产生显着差异，并且更大的电池并不意味着更长的电池寿命。 Watch8 的售价为 260 美元，比其后继产品便宜 120 美元；如果您不需要最新型号，这是一个令人信服的选择。 ——布泰纳·乔克兰

paras.en: Smart scales can be tough to justify when they cost hundreds of dollars, but $99 off makes our top pick even easier to recommend. The Withings Body Comp is among the most advanced smart scales we’ve tested, with a companion app that can track data for up to eight users. It’s also meant to last a lifetime; WIRED reviewer Christopher Null has Withings info dating back to 2010 and plans to keep the streak going. At $131, this is also the lowest price we’ve seen. —Boutayna Chokrane
paras.zh: 智能秤售价数百美元，很难证明其合理性，但 99 美元的折扣让我们的首选产品更容易推荐。 Withings Body Comp 是我们测试过的最先进的智能体重秤之一，其配套应用程序可以跟踪最多八个用户的数据。它也意味着可以持续一生； 《连线》评论员 Christopher Null 拥有可追溯到 2010 年的 Withings 信息，并计划继续保持这一势头。 131 美元，这也是我们见过的最低价格。 ——布泰纳·乔克兰
