paras.en: Tuesday night’s episode of NBC’s The Voice saw team leaders Kelly Clarkson, Adam Levine, Queen Latifah, and Riley Green complete their rosters as the Blind Auditions came to an end.
paras.zh: 在周二晚上的 NBC 节目《好声音》中，随着盲选的结束，团队负责人凯莉·克拉克森 (Kelly Clarkson)、亚当·莱文 (Adam Levine)、奎因·拉蒂法 (Queen Latifah) 和莱利·格林 (Riley Green) 完成了他们的名单。

paras.en: The turns came in a flurry as each of Green, Levine, and Clarkson had two spots to fill, and Latifah had one to give.
paras.zh: 格林、莱文和克拉克森各有两个空位需要填补，而拉蒂法也有一个空位需要填补，比赛进行得很仓促。

paras.en: Going first was Lillie Kolich, a 25-year-old New Mexico native who covered Sombr’s “Back to Friends.” Latifah spoke the quiet words out loud with an enthusiastic “I like it.” Perhaps she didn’t like it as much as Clarkson, Levine, and Green who turned almost simultaneously. Latifah hit her buzzer late, giving Kolich a four-chair turn.
paras.zh: 第一个上台的是 25 岁的新墨西哥人 Lillie Kolich，她翻唱了 Sombr 的《Back to Friends》。拉蒂法热情地大声说出这句话，“我喜欢。”也许她不像克拉克森、莱文和格林那样喜欢它，他们几乎同时转身。拉蒂法按门铃迟到了，给了科利奇四把椅子。

paras.en: Raised in Albuquerque, Kolich is now based in Nashville and “pretty much fulltime songwriting,” she told the coaches.
paras.zh: 科利奇在阿尔伯克基长大，现在定居纳什维尔，“几乎全职创作歌曲，”她告诉教练们。

paras.en: With her cool, stripped-back performance, Kolich put herself in the box seat as Clarkson, Levine and Green unfurled their best sales pitches. “I heard a storyteller,” Green remarked. “And all I want to do is help you tell that story.” Kolich even hangs out in Green’s bar, so there’s that.
paras.zh: 科利奇凭借冷静、简约的表演，让自己坐在包厢里，听克拉克森、莱文和格林展开他们最好的销售宣传。 “我听到一个讲故事的人，”格林说。 “我想做的就是帮助你讲述这个故事。”科利奇甚至还去格林的酒吧闲逛，就是这样。

paras.en: Clarkson was equally impressed. “Dude, you’re rad. Your tone…sombr is like one of my favorite artists to be listening to right now. That one I never even thought about being into that vibe.” Even better, “why don’t we sing it together,” she added.
paras.zh: 克拉克森同样印象深刻。 “伙计，你太棒了。你的语气……sombr 就像我现在最喜欢听的艺术家之一。我从来没有想过要进入那种氛围。”更好的是，“为什么我们不一起唱呢，”她补充道。

paras.en: Levine tried a different approach. “I’m awesome.” He went on to praise the contestant’s choice of song and cascading talents. “The coolest thing about your voice is that in the beginning it had a bit of a softer presence and I loved that. But then I heard you open up more and realized, wow, there’s a lot more dynamic in your voice. All these layers came out…I’m going to be honest, I think it’s going to be tricky to have a voice like yours and win this competition.” But he can get her there, he reckons.
paras.zh: 莱文尝试了一种不同的方法。 “我很棒。”他接着对选手的歌曲选择和才华横溢表示赞赏。 “你的声音最酷的一点是，一开始它有一点柔和的存在，我喜欢这一点。但后来我听到你更加开放，并意识到，哇，你的声音更有活力。所有这些层次都出来了......我会说实话，我认为拥有像你这样的声音并赢得这场比赛将是很棘手的。”但他认为他可以把她带到那里。

paras.en: Latifah turned last, spoke last. Laughed last. “If you’re able to do that,” she remarked on how Lillie turned a current smash into something of her own, “you’re able to do anything. You’re able to win this show.”
paras.zh: 拉蒂法最后一个转身，最后发言。最后笑了“如果你能做到这一点，”她在谈到莉莉如何将当前的热门作品变成自己的东西时说道，“你就能做任何事情。你就能赢得这场演出。”

paras.en: In the end, Lillie had a choice to make. That was The Queen, Latifah.
paras.zh: 最后，莉莉必须做出选择。那是女王拉提法。

paras.en: Without any time wastage, producers called the start of the Battle Rounds. Green was forced to make an early, tough decision, when he paired up Nashville baker Brandy Neelly with sisters Ferryn and Brinkley.
paras.zh: 没有浪费任何时间，制作人宣布战斗回合开始。当格林将纳什维尔面包师布兰迪·尼利与费林和布林克利姐妹配对时，他被迫做出了一个早期的艰难决定。

paras.en: Grammy Award-winning singer-songwriter Carly Pearce stepped in as Battle advisor, as the contestants faced off with Miranda Lambert “Mama’s Broken Heart.”
paras.zh: 当参赛者与米兰达·兰伯特的《妈妈破碎的心》对决时，格莱美奖获奖歌手兼作曲家卡莉·皮尔斯担任战斗顾问。

paras.en: In the end, Green went with the sisters Ferryn and Brinkley, who advance to Cut Week. Neelly wasn’t given a lifeline by the other coaches.
paras.zh: 最终，格林与费林和布林克利姐妹一起晋级剪切周。其他教练没有给尼利提供生命线。

paras.en: The Voice is currently in its milestone 30th season, with episodes airing Mondays and Tuesdays at 8 p.m. ET on NBC, streaming next day on Peacock. Battle performances continue Monday, Oct. 12.
paras.zh: 《好声音》目前已播出具有里程碑意义的第 30 季，每集每周一和周二晚上 8 点播出。 ET 在 NBC 播出，次日在 Peacock 播出。战斗表演将于 10 月 12 日星期一继续。

articles.title: New Zealand’s Awning Signs With Winspear
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: AUCKLAND, New Zealand — Winspear has landed its first signing from Aotearoa/New Zealand, Awning.
paras.zh: 新西兰奥克兰——Winspear 已经从 Aotearoa/新西兰 Awning 签下了第一笔签约。

paras.en: Hailing from the country’s most populated city, Tāmaki Makaurau/Auckland, the alternative rock act celebrates its deal with the release of a new single, “Little Green Book.”
paras.zh: 来自该国人口最多的城市塔马基马考劳/奥克兰，另类摇滚乐队通过发行新单曲《小绿皮书》来庆祝其签约。

paras.en: Formed in 2023 by frontman Christian Dimick with Riley Noonan (drums), Damin McCabe (bass) and guitarists Ethan Broughtan and Eli Chamberlain, Awning have a growing reputation as a live outfit.
paras.zh: Awning 于 2023 年由主唱 Christian Dimick 与 Riley Noonan（鼓手）、Damin McCabe（贝斯手）以及吉他手 Ethan Broughtan 和 Eli Chamberlain 组建，作为现场乐队，其声誉与日俱增。

paras.en: The five-piece dropped a self-titled EP in 2025 and has played dates in Australia with Twine, supported North Carolina group Wednesday, and most recently showcased at NZ’s Going Global Festival.
paras.zh: 这支五人乐队于 2025 年推出了一张同名 EP，并与 Twine 一起在澳大利亚演出，周三还支持了北卡罗来纳州乐队，最近还在新西兰的走向全球音乐节上进行了演出。

paras.en: “Little Green Book” is “about grief, gritty stuff that feels almost too much to put into song format,” explains Dimick. The single was recorded at Neil Finn’s Roundhead Studios in Auckland, was produced by De Sevens (Womb, Office Dog, School Fair), and is accompanied with an official music video shot by Damin McCabe. Watch below.
paras.zh: 迪米克解释说，《小绿皮书》是“关于悲伤、坚韧的东西，感觉太多了，无法用歌曲的形式表达”。这首单曲是在奥克兰 Neil Finn 的 Roundhead Studios 录制的，由 De Sevens（Womb、Office Dog、School Fair）制作，并附有由 Damin McCabe 拍摄的官方音乐视频。请看下面。

paras.en: Awning is Los Angeles-based Winspear’s second signing from the region after Adelaide’s Swapmeet, joining labelmates Winter, Teethe and others.
paras.zh: Awning 是洛杉矶 Winspear 继阿德莱德 Swapmeet 后第二次从该地区签约，其他唱片公司包括 Winter、Teethe 等。

paras.en: “We are beyond thrilled to welcome Awning to the Winspear roster, our first signing from New Zealand, and our second international artist following Swapmeet earlier this year,” Swapmeet founder Jared Jones remarks. “When I first heard Awning’s music, what struck me was their ability to convey deeply felt emotions so succinctly. ‘Little Green Book’ is a perfect encapsulation of this. I can’t get that chorus out of my skull.”
paras.zh: Swapmeet 创始人 Jared Jones 表示：“我们非常高兴地欢迎 Awning 加入 Winspear 名单，这是我们从新西兰签下的第一个签约艺术家，也是继今年早些时候 Swapmeet 之后我们的第二位国际艺术家。” “当我第一次听到 Awning 的音乐时，令我印象深刻的是他们能够如此简洁地传达深切的情感。《小绿皮书》完美地概括了这一点。我无法将那副副歌从我的脑海中抹去。”

paras.en: On signing the new label deal, Dimick and his bandmates say: “Coming from Aotearoa it feels like a dream to have someone from the U.S. supporting us and they are an incredible team of people. I have loved teethe and Slow Pulp for years so I am at a loss for words to explain how exciting this all feels. It is an honor to jump on their roster.”
paras.zh: 在签署新厂牌协议时，Dimick 和他的乐队成员表示：“来自新西兰的我感觉有来自美国的人支持我们就像是一个梦想，他们是一支令人难以置信的团队。我多年来一直喜欢牙牙和 Slow Pulp，所以我无法用言语来解释这一切是多么令人兴奋。很荣幸能够加入他们的名单。”

articles.title: Jack White Slams Trump for Saying Iran Can “Take Out” L.A. and San Diego: “The Worst American of All Time”
articles.author: Carly Thomas

paras.en: Jack White is once again slamming Donald Trump, this time over the president’s comments suggesting Iran could “take out” Los Angeles and San Diego if it were allowed to develop a nuclear weapon.
paras.zh: 杰克·怀特再次猛烈抨击唐纳德·特朗普，这次是因为总统暗示伊朗如果被允许发展核武器就可以“摧毁”洛杉矶和圣地亚哥。

paras.en: In response, the musician and former White Stripes frontman wrote on Instagram Tuesday, “Hey republicans and conservatives that live in L.A. and San Diego; how do you feel about your Fuhrer recommending that the cities you live in get attacked? Click the video I reposted and watch for yourself. Listen to the cult members CLAPPING and cheering for this. Let me take a wild guess: it was a joke, owning the libs, insert cult rhetoric here, etc. The allegiance these people have to this corrupt felon is so laughable and ignorant.”
paras.zh: 作为回应，这位音乐家和前白条乐队主唱周二在 Instagram 上写道：“嘿，居住在洛杉矶和圣地亚哥的共和党人和保守派；你对你的元首建议攻击你所居住的城市有何感想？请点击我转发的视频，亲自观看。听听邪教成员为此鼓掌和欢呼。让我大胆猜测一下：这是一个笑话，拥有自由，在这里插入邪教言论等等。这些人效忠这个腐败的重罪犯真是可笑和无知。”

paras.en: “That’s right, a U.S. ‘President’ that recommended that two major cities in our country be bombed because they don’t give total allegiance to his ego,” White continued. “Imagine any other President or elected official in history saying this. False flag incoming anyone? Just wait till next month when he begins enacting illegal measures to not allow democracy at the polls to prevail when the right lose badly in the mid term elections. I’ve said it before and I’ll say it again: The Worst American of All Time. #TWAAT.”
paras.zh: “没错，一位美国‘总统’建议轰炸我们国家的两个主要城市，因为它们没有完全效忠他的自我，”怀特继续说道。 “想象一下历史上任何其他总统或民选官员都这么说。虚假信号即将到来？只要等到下个月，当右翼在中期选举中惨败时，他就会开始制定非法措施，不允许民主在民意调查中占上风。我以前说过，现在我会再说一遍：有史以来最糟糕的美国人。#TWAAT。”

paras.en: On Monday, Trump was speaking at a campaign rally in Nebraska, where he defended the war in Iran despite Americans’ concerns about the economic impact. The president called it a “small price to pay for keeping the world safe” and “keeping our country safe.”
paras.zh: 周一，特朗​​普在内布拉斯加州的一次竞选集会上发表讲话，尽管美国人担心伊朗战争的经济影响，但他还是为伊朗战争进行了辩护。总统称这是“为了维护世界安全”和“维护我们国家的安全而付出的微小代价”。

paras.en: Trump suggested that Iran could “take out” an American city if the country was to develop a nuclear weapon. “Let them take out Los Angeles. Let them take out San Diego,” he added, as the crowd cheered.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，如果伊朗要发展核武器，伊朗就可以“摧毁”美国的一座城市。 “让他们拿下洛杉矶。让他们拿下圣地亚哥，”他补充道，人群欢呼雀跃。

paras.en: California Gov. Gavin Newsom also denounced Trump’s remarks, calling the president “deranged and dangerous.” He added in another post on X, “An American president is talking about Los Angeles and San Diego being ‘taken out.’ Where the hell is Congress? This is dangerous. The time to stand up is NOW.”
paras.zh: 加州州长加文·纽瑟姆也谴责了特朗普的言论，称总统“精神错乱且危险”。他在 X 上的另一篇帖子中补充道，“一位美国总统正在谈论洛杉矶和圣地亚哥被‘消灭’。国会到底在哪里？这很危险。现在是站起来的时候了。”

paras.en: White and the Trump administration have previously feuded, with the musician calling the president “a danger to not just America but the whole world” last year, adding that “no intelligent person can defend this low life fascist.” In response, White House communications director Steven Cheung called White “a washed-up, has-been loser.”
paras.zh: 怀特和特朗普政府此前曾有过不和，这位音乐家去年称总统“不仅对美国而且对整个世界构成威胁”，并补充说“没有聪明人可以捍卫这个下流的法西斯主义者”。作为回应，白宫通讯主管史蒂文·张称怀特为“一个过气的失败者”。

articles.title: Apple and Dolby Bringing Dolby Atmos to Live Formula 1 Coverage
articles.author: Alex Weprin

paras.en: Apple wants Formula 1 fans to hear the roar of the engines, the squeals of the tires and the chaos of the pit lane as they’ve never heard it before.
paras.zh: 苹果希望一级方程式车迷能够听到引擎的轰鸣声、轮胎的尖叫声以及维修站通道的混乱声，因为他们以前从未听过。

paras.en: The tech giant is partnering with Dolby Laboratories to bring its Dolby Atmos sound to F1, beginning with the U.S. Grand Prix in Austin, Texas, later this month. The companies are betting that Atmos sound, paired with Dolby Vision, will make the races more exciting and visceral than they have ever been for viewers at home.
paras.zh: 这家科技巨头正在与杜比实验室合作，从本月晚些时候在德克萨斯州奥斯汀举行的美国大奖赛开始，将杜比全景声 (Dolby Atmos) 音效带入 F1。两家公司坚信，Atmos 音效与杜比视界 (Dolby Vision) 相结合，将使比赛对国内观众来说比以往任何时候都更加激动人心。

paras.en: “The sound is what makes it emotional; it is the sound that guides you through that and builds the tension,” John Couling, senior VP of entertainment for Dolby Laboratories, tells The Hollywood Reporter. “That is what Dolby Atmos will deliver.”
paras.zh: 杜比实验室娱乐高级副总裁约翰·库林 (John Couling) 告诉《好莱坞报道》：“声音让一切变得激动人心；正是声音引导你度过这一切并营造紧张感。” “这就是杜比全景声 (Dolby Atmos) 将提供的服务。”

paras.en: Apple, of course, is not a sports juggernaut like ESPN, nor is it pouring the same resources that, say, an Amazon Prime Video is putting into the space. Instead, the tech company has decided that whatever sports it does invest in, it wants to create the best experience possible for viewers, including video nd sound quality that is a step above what is available elsewhere.
paras.zh: 当然，苹果并不是 ESPN 那样的体育巨头，也没有像亚马逊 Prime Video 那样投入同样的资源。相反，这家科技公司决定，无论投资什么体育项目，它都希望为观众创造最好的体验，包括比其他地方提供的视频和声音质量高出一步的视频和声音质量。

paras.en: “If you are a sports fan today, our viewpoint today is that the experience is — am going to be polite and say not easy,” says Oliver Schusser, Apple’s VP of music, sports, Apple TV and Beats. “There really has not been a lot of innovation. We went into sports a couple of years back with the intention to make a difference for the customer, this is a continuation of that journey.”
paras.zh: “如果你今天是一名体育迷，我们今天的观点是——我会礼貌地说这种体验并不容易，”苹果音乐、体育、Apple TV 和 Beats 副总裁 Oliver Schusser 表示。 “确实没有太多创新。几年前，我们进入体育领域，目的是为客户带来改变，这是这一旅程的延续。”

paras.en: The new sound experience will be available on supported Apple devices and compatible Dolby-enabled TVs, soundbars and home theater systems, with plans to continue delivering that sound and video quality for future races. F1 is responsible for producing its races, with Apple delivering it to consumers through its tech stack.
paras.zh: 新的声音体验将在受支持的 Apple 设备和兼容的杜比电视、条形音箱和家庭影院系统上提供，并计划继续为未来的比赛提供这种声音和视频质量。 F1 负责制作比赛，苹果则通过其技术堆栈将其交付给消费者。

paras.en: Apple is in the first year of its F1 deal, paying an estimated $140-$150 million for the rights. Eddy Cue, the executive who oversees Apple’s services business and a devout F1 fan, said last month that viewership of races is younger, more female-skewing, and “up by significant double-digit percentage growth” compared to last year when they were on ESPN.
paras.zh: 苹果公司正处于 F1 协议的第一年，估计为版权支付了 140 至 1.5 亿美元。负责苹果服务业务的高管、F1 的忠实粉丝埃迪·库伊 (Eddy Cue) 上个月表示，观看比赛的观众更加年轻，女性比例更高，并且与去年 ESPN 上观看比赛时相比，“出现了两位数的显着百分比增长”。

articles.title: Malcolm Spellman on How ‘Snowfall’ Spinoff ‘The Drop’ Connects With the Original Series and Why He’s “Not Gonna Chase Cameos”
articles.author: Hilary Lewis

paras.en: [The following story contains spoilers from the first five episodes of The Drop: A Snowfall Saga, through “Homecoming.”]
paras.zh: [以下故事包含《The Drop: A Snowfall Saga》前五集到“Homecoming”的剧透。]

paras.en: If you Google Snowfall spinoff The Drop, one of the most popular questions is “Is Franklin in The Drop: A Snowfall Saga?”
paras.zh: 如果你谷歌《Snowfall》衍生剧《The Drop》，最常见的问题之一是“富兰克林在《The Drop：降雪传奇》中吗？”

paras.en: Those who’ve paid close attention to the news around the follow-up to the FX drama about the origins of the crack cocaine epidemic, starring Damson Idris as eventual drug kingpin Franklin Saint, would know that the answer is no.
paras.zh: 那些密切关注 FX 电视剧《强效可卡因流行病起源》后续新闻的人会知道，答案是否定的。该剧由达姆森·伊德里斯 (Damson Idris) 主演，饰演最终的毒枭富兰克林·圣特 (Franklin Saint)。

paras.en: Idris’ fallen entrepreneur isn’t expected to appear in the ’90s-set series, which centers around Gail Bean‘s Wanda and Isaiah John‘s Leon, two of the survivors of the original show.
paras.zh: 伊德里斯饰演的倒下的企业家预计不会出现在这部以 90 年代为背景的剧集中，该剧集以盖尔·比恩饰演的旺达和以赛亚·约翰饰演的莱昂为中心，他们是原剧的两名幸存者。

paras.en: The Drop: A Snowfall Saga centers around the rise of West Coast hip-hop, against the backdrop of street violence, as Wanda pursues a career in the music industry and Leon continues to operate his nonprofit community legal center.
paras.zh: 《The Drop: A Snowfall Saga》以西海岸嘻哈音乐的崛起为中心，在街头暴力的背景下，万达 (Wanda) 追求音乐行业的职业生涯，莱昂 (Leon) 继续经营他的非营利性社区法律中心。

paras.en: And, for The Drop showrunner Malcolm Spellman, it wasn’t until he “let go” of the original series that he found the hook for the spinoff, which he says hit him “like a bolt of lightning.”
paras.zh: 对于《The Drop》剧集主管马尔科姆·斯佩尔曼来说，直到他“放弃”原剧之后，他才找到了衍生剧的吸引力，他说衍生剧“就像一道闪电”击中了他。

paras.en: “I think in the beginning of development, I was really chasing Snowfall, and I couldn’t land a pilot,” Spellman tells The Hollywood Reporter. “We were probably developing the pilot for over two years before I found this tone and really found this family and found this energy and soul for the show, and even then it was still a learning process. But it was really, really hard to land here. And once we landed there, everything was organic. We knew when to reference Franklin, the other guys. We knew who to bring in and everything, almost as if we’d always been doing it because we took the time to let it become its own thing first, so that it could organically interface with the original.”
paras.zh: “我认为在开发之初，我真的在追逐《雪落》，但我无法找到飞行员，”斯佩尔曼告诉《好莱坞报道》。 “我们可能花了两年多的时间来开发试播集，然后我才找到了这种基调，真正找到了这个家庭，并为这部剧找到了这种能量和灵魂，即便如此，这仍然是一个学习过程。但要降落在这里真的非常非常困难。一旦我们降落到那里，一切都是有机的。我们知道何时参考富兰克林和其他人。我们知道要引入谁以及一切，几乎就像我们一直在这样做一样，因为我们首先花时间让它成为自己的东西，这样它就可以与原创。”

paras.en: Across The Drop‘s first five episodes of an eight-episode first season, Snowfall fans haven’t seen any memorable characters from the original — beyond Wanda, Leon and a cameo from Quincy Chad’s Deon — and they shouldn’t necessarily expect to, Spellman says.
paras.zh: 斯佩尔曼说，在《The Drop》第一季八集的前五集中，除了旺达、莱昂和昆西·查德饰演的德翁客串之外，《雪落》的粉丝们还没有看到任何令人难忘的原著角色，而且他们不一定会看到。

paras.en: “I’m not gonna chase cameos,” Spellman says. “There’s nobody I’m gonna put in this show just to have them in it. This show exists in a space where hustlers and fly girls who were in Snowfall would obviously be around this scene, and those characters from Snowfall who are gonna emerge in the show will raise their hands. We don’t pick them. Those characters should raise their hands in the middle of us breaking an episode and say, ‘I should be here.'”
paras.zh: “我不会追逐客串，”斯佩尔曼说。 “我不会为了让他们加入这部剧而把他们放进去。这部剧存在的空间里，《雪花》中的骗子和飞女们显然会出现在这个场景周围，那些《雪花》中即将出现在剧中的角色会举手。我们不会选择他们。这些角色应该在我们中间举起手来打破一集，并说，‘我应该在这里。’”

paras.en: Chad, Spellman says is “a perfect example of how the old show should lock into this one.”
paras.zh: 斯佩尔曼说，查德是“旧剧如何融入这部剧的完美例子”。

paras.en: Five episodes into an eight-episode first season, Tuesday night’s installment pauses the hip-hop story to focus on producing prodigy Lamar (Asante Blackk) learning the truth about how his mother died — a tragic accident that was connected to her involvement in the music industry, which has made Lamar’s grandparents, who raised him and his brother James (Peyton Alex Smith), strongly opposed to Lamar getting into the rap game.
paras.zh: 第一季共八集，共五集，周二晚上的剧集暂停了嘻哈故事，重点讲述神童拉马尔（阿桑特·布莱克饰）了解母亲去世的真相——这场悲惨事故与她涉足音乐行业有关，这使得拉马尔和他的兄弟詹姆斯（佩顿·亚历克斯·史密斯饰）抚养长大的祖父母强烈反对拉马尔进入说唱界。

paras.en: Speaking to THR, Spellman talks about why he wanted to turn a full episode over to the story of what happened to Lamar’s mom, the lighter tone of The Drop, why he’s trying to craft an authentic portrayal of his community but not tell the origin story of real-life hip-hop heavyweights and why he’s confident the show is a hit.
paras.zh: 在接受 THR 采访时，斯佩尔曼谈到了为什么他想把一整集的故事转向拉马尔妈妈的遭遇、《The Drop》的轻松基调、为什么他试图真实地描绘他的社区，但不讲述现实生活中嘻哈重量级人物的起源故事，以及为什么他相信这部剧会大受欢迎。

paras.en: How did you get involved with this spinoff? You didn’t work on the original Snowfall, but you knew [Snowfall co-creator] John Singleton.
paras.zh: 您是如何参与到这个衍生项目中的？你没有参与原版《Snowfall》的制作，但你认识[Snowfall 联合创作者]约翰·辛格尔顿 (John Singleton)。

paras.en: Me being involved with the show was kind of destiny. I’ve been tight with John since I broke into Hollywood. The whole process he had through Snowfall, me and him was in contact, texting, talking, hanging out. And mutually with FX, I’d worked on a documentary series called Hip Hop Uncovered that I’m super proud of. That’s in this space kind of, so they knew me from that, and then there was a long relationship even with the original producers of Snowfall; my wife had been on the show. If you know me and what I do, I was the obvious call here, just because the relationship had been so established, and it’s right in my wheelhouse.
paras.zh: 我参与这个节目是一种命运。自从我闯入好莱坞以来，我就和约翰关系密切。在他度过《Snowfall》的整个过程中，我和他一直保持着联系，发短信，聊天，闲逛。我与 FX 共同制作了一部名为《Hip Hop Uncovered》的纪录片系列，对此我感到非常自豪。就在这个领域，所以他们从那里认识了我，然后甚至与《Snowfall》的原始制作人也建立了长期的合作关系；我的妻子参加了演出。如果你了解我和我所做的事情，那么我就是这里的明显召唤，因为这种关系已经如此建立，而且它就在我的驾驶室里。

paras.en: For people who weren’t in this community or aware, what is the connective tissue between the origins of the crack epidemic and West Coast hip-hop and the gang violence of the ’90s. How does the show still exist in the Snowfall world and make sense as a follow-up?
paras.zh: 对于那些不在这个社区或不知道的人来说，快克流行病和西海岸嘻哈音乐的起源与 90 年代的帮派暴力之间的结缔组织是什么。该剧如何在《降雪》世界中仍然存在并作为后续作品有意义？

paras.en: I think the crack epidemic and hip-hop coming to the West Coast made the two phenomenons conjoined twins. The crack epidemic is a complete nuclear bomb that drops on our community in ways that can be explained, but also culturally it shifted the identity, in my opinion. [For] Black folk, I feel like the beginning of our story, all the way up to crack, is a continuum of us as a collective dealing with a system that’s oppressive. When crack comes, it says it’s not you guys as a collective anymore against the system, it’s the system against you guys as individual entrepreneurs in the street, and hip-hop was the soundtrack to that and the news report to it. So on one hand, you have a phenomenon and a bomb going off in a specific community, which is Snowfall, and then on the other hand, you have The Drop, which is sort of the news report that is speaking on this phenomenon, and I believe if you just listen to West Coast hip-hop, I don’t know how you would extract it from crack.
paras.zh: 我认为快克流行和嘻哈音乐来到西海岸使这两种现象成为连体双胞胎。在我看来，这种流行病是一颗彻底的核弹，它以可以解释的方式落在我们的社区上，但在文化上它也改变了身份。 [对于]黑人来说，我觉得我们故事的开始，一直到破裂，是我们作为一个集体应对压迫性制度的一个连续体。当裂纹来临时，它表明不再是你们作为一个集体来反对这个体系，而是这个体系在反对你们作为街头个体企业家，而嘻哈音乐就是它的配乐和新闻报道。因此，一方面，在一个特定的社区里有一种现象和一颗炸弹爆炸，这就是 Snowfall，然后另一方面，你有 The Drop，这是一种谈论这种现象的新闻报道，我相信如果你只听西海岸嘻哈音乐，我不知道你会如何从破解中提取它。

paras.en: In terms of the other characters, like the non-Wanda and Leon characters, how did you figure out that you wanted to have someone like a Lamar, an aspiring producer from this super religious family, and Artillery (Simmie “Buddy” Sims III) as the aspiring rapper and someone like DG (Brandon Mychal Smith), the record label executive?
paras.zh: 就其他角色而言，比如非旺达和莱昂的角色，你是怎么想到要像拉马尔这样的人，一个来自这个超级宗教家庭的有抱负的制作人，还有像阿蒂勒里（Simmie“Buddy”Sims III）这样有抱负的说唱歌手，以及像DG（布兰登·麦查尔·史密斯）这样的唱片公司高管？

paras.en: Those characters really came to life when I did that rewrite. It just was all there. It all filled out in the vibe of the show. I’d say Lamar is a very personal character to me. I was not quite as odd as the character, but I was odd and I was an artist, and I feel like I had a similar temperament to Lamar, and I knew the struggles that I saw up close, being directly involved with all this happening, and I knew Lamar as a counterpoint to Wanda, who’s experienced the streets in every possible fucking way, from murder to success to depression to drug abuse. Of course, her partner should be the polar opposite. That’s just basic storytelling. And the truth is, I feel like the dimensions of Blackness and watching the audience kind of struggle with Lamar at times is fascinating to me because I feel like we all got him in our families, but you don’t see him on TV. You only get to see gangsters or cool motherfuckers or cops or whatever.
paras.zh: 当我重写时，这些角色真的变得栩栩如生。一切就在那里。这一切都充满了演出的氛围。我想说拉马尔对我来说是一个非常个性化的角色。我不像这个角色那么奇怪，但我很奇怪，我是一名艺术家，我觉得我和拉马尔有相似的气质，我知道我近距离看到的挣扎，直接参与这一切发生，我知道拉马尔是旺达的对立面，旺达以各种可能的方式经历过街头，从谋杀到成功到抑郁到吸毒。当然，她的伴侣应该是截然相反的。这只是基本的讲故事。事实是，我觉得黑人的维度以及观看观众与拉马尔的斗争有时对我来说很有趣，因为我觉得我们都有他在我们的家庭中，但你在电视上看不到他。你只能看到歹徒或酷混蛋或警察或其他什么。

paras.en: Obviously, we find out more about Lamar’s family and his mother, but the family is very opposed to Lamar being involved with the music industry because of what happened with his mom and wants him to be involved with the church. Where did that background come from?
paras.zh: 显然，我们对拉马尔的家人和他的母亲有了更多的了解，但家人非常反对拉马尔涉足音乐行业，因为他母亲的事情，并希望他参与教会。这个背景是从哪里来的呢？

paras.en: This is all the shit that’s been neglected for the last 40 years since crack hit. This nation is still a fairly religious nation, and our community is very, very connected to the church. That shit should be generic damn near in everything we do and not presented as a fetish. These characters wield God and the Bible specifically and all that in the way people who were raised in church would, the vibe of these characters and the specificness. Everything you see on the show is either something I experienced directly, seen directly or one of my homeboys [experienced or saw]. I was involved. I was in it, and I got to see all this happen, and I got to see it wasn’t on TV in a way that I feel was authentic. I knew it was these details that you are talking about, like even their opinion on hip-hop or Big Daddy’s (Mykleti Williamson) opinion on the N-word. No one ever shows that word was never just certified in our community. We have a discussion in the public about whether other races should be allowed to use it. That shit never got resolved with us, and so to show that discussion on TV in the way that it happens in barbershops or in homes, to me is the special sauce of this thing, and that’s all shit I’ve seen up close and personal.
paras.zh: 这就是自破解以来 40 年来一直被忽视的事情。这个国家仍然是一个相当虔诚的国家，我们的社区与教会有着非常非常密切的联系。这种狗屎应该是我们所做的一切中普遍存在的东西，而不是作为一种恋物癖。这些人物专门运用上帝和圣经，以及在教堂长大的人的方式，这些人物的氛围和特殊性。你在节目中看到的一切要么是我直接经历过的、直接看到的，要么是我的一个同门男孩[经历过或看到过]。我也参与其中。我身在其中，我亲眼目睹了这一切的发生，我看到这一切不是在电视上以我认为真实的方式发生的。我知道你谈论的是这些细节，甚至包括他们对嘻哈音乐的看法或 Big Daddy（Mykleti Williamson）对 N 词的看法。没有人证明这个词从来没有在我们的社区中得到过验证。我们在公众中讨论是否应该允许其他种族使用它。我们从来没有解决过这个问题，所以在电视上以理发店或家庭中发生的方式展示这种讨论，对我来说是这件事的特殊酱汁，而这就是我近距离亲眼所见的所有狗屎。

paras.en: All of episode five is devoted to what happened to Lamar’s mother. Why did you want to take that full episode to unpack all of that?
paras.zh: 第五集全部讲述了拉马尔母亲的遭遇。你为什么想用整集来解开所有这些？

paras.en: It was a build. When we were laying out the season, there was a real rhythm to how these episodes were connecting with each other, how they were all featuring different dynamics. Some feature violence, some feature music, some feature Black joy, and in a way that I think is like spectacle. And as it was coming together, we were feeling a way to build up the importance of this family conflict and starve the audience for the answer, and we were like, how long can we starve the audience and how satisfying can the answer be? And as we started to roadmap that, it became very apparent even before we’d written episode two that episode five was going to have to be a version of itself.
paras.zh: 这是一个构建。当我们设计这一季时，这些剧集如何相互联系，如何展现不同的动态，有一种真正的节奏。有些以暴力为特色，有些以音乐为特色，有些以黑人欢乐为特色，在某种程度上我认为就像奇观。当它走到一起时，我们感觉到有一种方法可以增强这种家庭冲突的重要性，并让观众渴望得到答案，我们想，我们能让观众挨饿多久，答案能有多令人满意？当我们开始制定路线图时，甚至在我们写第二集之前就很明显第五集必须是它自己的一个版本。

paras.en: You’ve spoken extensively about authenticity, and not only were you in the community, but you also have writers and consultants who were in it as well. But how much are you thinking in terms of well-known real-life counterparts or is it more of just like a broader sense of authenticity about the community?
paras.zh: 您广泛谈论了真实性，不仅您在社区中，而且社区中还有作家和顾问。但你在多大程度上考虑了现实生活中知名的同行，或者更像是对社区更广泛的真实感？

paras.en: That’s interesting what you’re saying because when I look online, everybody thinks these characters are based on someone from the original Snowfall or from a rap album or whatever. These are all people I grew up with, was in the streets with. I did not look at it like that. Every one of these characters is somebody I know, either lost or still hang out with. Even in the writers’ room, people would be like, oh, this reminds me of this dude or this legend or whatever, and we might talk about the legend that that sort of embodies what the character has, but for me they were just born out of that one fitful moment when the show hit me. And to me, these are the real people. Like my boy who was in the room was at Death Row from beginning to end. My boy is in the show, not the people at Death Row. That’s how I’m writing it. This is an eyewitness.
paras.zh: 你说的很有趣，因为当我在网上查看时，每个人都认为这些角色是基于原版《Snowfall》或说唱专辑或其他任何东西中的某个人。这些都是和我一起长大、一起在街上的人。我不这么看。这些角色中的每一个都是我认识的人，要么失踪了，要么仍然在一起。即使在编剧室里，人们也会说，哦，这让我想起了这个家伙或者这个传奇之类的东西，我们可能会谈论这个传奇，它体现了这个角色的特质，但对我来说，它们只是在这部剧打动我的那一刻诞生的。对我来说，这些都是真实的人。就像我在房间里的男孩从头到尾都在死囚牢房一样。剧中出现的是我的儿子，而不是死囚区的人。我就是这样写的。这是一位目击者。

paras.en: One of the things that struck me from the pilot is how The Drop has a lighter tone than Snowfall, which, especially in the final season, was very heavy just because of the nature of the story it was telling. But I think you’ve spoken about this: There being maybe less violence in this show and there’s so much about the uplifting and healing power of music. Can you talk about how intentional that tone was and why you wanted to take that approach?
paras.zh: 试播集给我留下深刻印象的一件事是，《The Drop》的基调比《Snowfall》要轻一些，而《Snowfall》的基调非常沉重，尤其是在最后一季，因为它所讲述的故事的性质，所以显得非常沉重。但我想你已经谈到了这一点：这部剧中的暴力可能会少一些，而且音乐的振奋和治愈力量也有很多。您能谈谈这种语气是多么有意为之，以及为什么您想采取这种方法？

paras.en: As someone who was directly affected by the drug phenomenon — I caught my first felony drug case in the late 1980s — every great filmmaker in America should have a crack movie or show under their belt if they take it seriously and understand that these stories reshaped and still define all of America and pop culture today. I knew the tone, the lightness, the humor, the love, the Black joy was a flip side to the coin of crack, of murder, millionaires made overnight and then lost and addiction and all that. They always went hand in hand together. Since none of our lead characters are actually pursuing crime, it made it easier to work into those pockets and show the flip side of the same coin.
paras.zh: 作为一个直接受到毒品现象影响的人——我在 20 世纪 80 年代末抓获了第一起毒品重罪案件——每一位美国伟大的电影制片人都应该拥有一部出色的电影或电视剧，如果他们认真对待并理解这些故事重塑并仍然定义着整个美国和当今的流行文化。我知道这种语气、轻松、幽默、爱、黑人的欢乐是毒品、谋杀、一夜暴富、然后迷失的百万富翁和所有这些的反面。他们总是携手并进。由于我们的主角都没有真正追求犯罪，所以更容易进入这些口袋并展示同一枚硬币的反面。

paras.en: At the time that we’re talking, three episodes have aired. What sort of feedback have you encountered? What’s the reaction to the show that you’ve caught wind of?
paras.zh: 在我们谈话时，三集已经播出。您遇到过什么样的反馈？您听说过的这部剧有何反应？

paras.en: The shit I care about, which is the community, and I’m still tapped in; it’s off the charts, and for me, nothing else matters. I don’t read reviews. What I will do is go to every single reaction channel I can, because those reactors are people from our community who love this kind of material and talk to people like them. That shit has been off the fucking charts, and I’m not scared to say it. I think the culture saw official people was behind us, felt it and embraced it in a way that’s gonna make this thing a force to be reckoned with. And, of course, let me first shout out the foundation to all of this is the original Snowfall fans. If we lose them, we’re fucked, and we didn’t. But overall, I can tell you the response to this shit is nuts, and ain’t no one called to tell me that, and they don’t have to, because I go out into the world. I can see it. I’ve done everything from Falcon and the Winter Soldier to Empire to Bel-Air. I know what the fuck a hit feels like. This motherfucker is a hit.
paras.zh: 我关心的就是社区，而我仍然参与其中；这太不可思议了，对我来说，其他一切都不重要。我不看评论。我要做的就是尽可能地进入每一个反应渠道，因为这些反应者是来自我们社区的人，他们喜欢这种材料并与像他们这样的人交谈。这件事已经超出了他妈的记录，而且我并不害怕说出来。我认为这种文化看到了官方人士在我们身后，感受到了它并以某种方式拥抱它，这将使这件事成为一股不可忽视的力量。当然，首先让我大声说出这一切的基础是最初的《Snowfall》粉丝。如果我们失去了它们，我们就完蛋了，但我们没有。但总的来说，我可以告诉你，人们对这件事的反应是疯狂的，没有人打电话告诉我这一点，他们也没有必要这样做，因为我走向了外面的世界。我能看到它。从《猎鹰与冬兵》到《帝国》再到《贝莱尔》，我什么都拍过。我知道被击中是什么感觉。这个混蛋很受欢迎。

paras.en: The Drop: A Snowfall Saga airs Tuesday nights at 9 p.m. on FX and Hulu.
paras.zh: 《The Drop: A Snowfall Saga》每周二晚上 9 点播出。在 FX 和 Hulu 上。
